## D:/Marketing-AI/platform-api/src/main/resources/db/migration/V1__init_tenants.sql

```sql
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "pgcrypto";
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "vector";

CREATE TABLE tenants (
    id                    UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    name                  VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    slug                  VARCHAR(100) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    niche                 VARCHAR(100),              -- "b2b_manufacturing", "ecommerce_fashion"
    meta_app_id           VARCHAR(100),
    meta_access_token_enc BYTEA,                     -- encrypted (AES in MVP, Vault in prod)
    settings              JSONB DEFAULT '{}',
    created_at            TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at            TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE users (
    id            UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    tenant_id     UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id),
    email         VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    password_hash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    role          VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'MARKETER',  -- ADMIN, MARKETER, VIEWER
    status        VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',
    created_at    TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at    TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_users_tenant ON users(tenant_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_users_email  ON users(email);
```

## D:/Marketing-AI/platform-api/src/main/resources/db/migration/V2__creatives.sql

```sql
CREATE TABLE creatives (
    id             UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    tenant_id      UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id),
    external_id    VARCHAR(255),
    type           VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,   -- VIDEO, IMAGE, CAROUSEL
    title          VARCHAR(500),
    file_url       TEXT,
    thumbnail_url  TEXT,
    transcript     TEXT,                   -- Whisper output for video
    duration_sec   REAL,
    status         VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UPLOADED',  -- UPLOADED, ANALYZING, ACTIVE, ARCHIVED
    is_anchor      BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
    meta_ad_set_id VARCHAR(100),
    created_at     TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE creative_atoms (
    id           UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    creative_id  UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES creatives(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    tenant_id    UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id),
    atom_type    VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,    -- HOOK, STRUCTURE, EDIT_PACE, FACE, SUBTITLES,
                                         -- TONE, PROOF_TYPE, MUSIC, DURATION, CTA, PRODUCTION_STYLE
    atom_value   VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
    confidence   REAL,
    extracted_by VARCHAR(50),            -- "claude-vision", "whisper+llm", "manual"
    embedding    vector(768),
    created_at   TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_atoms_creative  ON creative_atoms(creative_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_atoms_type_val  ON creative_atoms(tenant_id, atom_type, atom_value);
```

## D:/Marketing-AI/platform-api/src/main/resources/db/migration/V3__landings.sql

```sql
CREATE TABLE landing_variants (
    id          UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    tenant_id   UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id),
    creative_id UUID REFERENCES creatives(id),
    name        VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    slug        VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    status      VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT',  -- DRAFT, REVIEW, ACTIVE, PAUSED, ARCHIVED
    blocks      JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    block_order TEXT[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    match_score REAL,
    approved_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    approved_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    created_at  TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at  TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE(tenant_id, slug)
);

CREATE TABLE variant_offers (
    id               UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    variant_id       UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES landing_variants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    tenant_id        UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id),
    discount_type    VARCHAR(50),    -- percent, fixed, free_shipping, gift, none
    discount_depth   REAL,           -- 0.0–1.0 (normalized)
    guarantee_type   VARCHAR(50),    -- money_back_14, money_back_30, lifetime, none
    guarantee_days   INT,
    bonus            VARCHAR(200),
    has_real_urgency BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
    urgency_source   VARCHAR(200),
    urgency_days_left INT,
    payment_terms    VARCHAR(50),    -- full, installment_3, installment_6, trial, freemium
    margin_floor     REAL,
    created_at       TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);
```

## D:/Marketing-AI/platform-api/src/main/resources/db/migration/V4__thompson.sql

```sql
CREATE TABLE thompson_arms (
    id             UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    tenant_id      UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id),
    variant_id     UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES landing_variants(id),
    context_key    VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'global',
    -- Hurdle model: Binomial(conversion) × Lognormal(revenue)
    -- Reward logic (B2B): form_submit=wait, call_answered=α+=0.3, meeting_attended=α+=1.0,
    -- deal_won=revenue update, no_response_7d=β+=1.0. See vision §16.1
    alpha          REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0,   -- successes + 1 (Beta prior)
    beta           REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0,   -- failures + 1 (Beta prior)
    revenue_mu     REAL DEFAULT 0.0,            -- log-revenue mean
    revenue_sigma  REAL DEFAULT 1.0,            -- log-revenue std
    revenue_n      INT DEFAULT 0,
    total_samples  INT DEFAULT 0,
    last_decayed_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at     TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE(tenant_id, variant_id, context_key)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_arms_tenant ON thompson_arms(tenant_id, context_key);
```

```sql
CREATE TABLE sessions (
    id                 VARCHAR(100) PRIMARY KEY,  -- cookie-based session ID
    tenant_id          UUID NOT NULL,
    creative_id        UUID,
    variant_id         UUID,
    device             VARCHAR(20),
    geo                VARCHAR(10),
    utm_source         VARCHAR(100),
    utm_medium         VARCHAR(100),
    utm_campaign       VARCHAR(100),
    consent_level      VARCHAR(20),
    crm_user_id        VARCHAR(255),
    -- GHL CRM fields (§13.3)
    ghl_contact_id     VARCHAR(100),
    ghl_opportunity_id VARCHAR(100),
    pipeline_stage     VARCHAR(100),
    deal_value         REAL,
    deal_status        VARCHAR(30),   -- open, won, lost
    is_suspicious      BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
    started_at         TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(),
    last_event_at      TIMESTAMPTZ,
    converted          BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
    conversion_type    VARCHAR(50),   -- LEAD, PURCHASE, FORM_SUBMIT
    revenue            REAL
);

CREATE INDEX idx_sessions_tenant ON sessions(tenant_id, started_at);
CREATE INDEX idx_sessions_ghl    ON sessions(ghl_contact_id) WHERE ghl_contact_id IS NOT NULL;

-- High-volume table: partitioned by month
CREATE TABLE events (
    id             UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    tenant_id      UUID NOT NULL,
    session_id     VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    event_type     VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,   -- IMPRESSION, CLICK, PAGE_VIEW, SCROLL, HOVER,
                                           -- BLOCK_VIEW, FORM_START, FORM_FIELD, FORM_SUBMIT,
                                           -- CONVERSION, PURCHASE, LEAD
    creative_id    UUID,
    variant_id     UUID,
    block_event_id VARCHAR(50),
    event_data     JSONB,
    revenue        REAL,
    device         VARCHAR(20),
    geo            VARCHAR(10),
    utm_source     VARCHAR(100),
    utm_medium     VARCHAR(100),
    utm_campaign   VARCHAR(100),
    consent_level  VARCHAR(20),
    is_suspicious  BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
    event_time     TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    received_at    TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (id, event_time)            -- partition key must be in PK
) PARTITION BY RANGE (event_time);

CREATE TABLE events_2026_10 PARTITION OF events
    FOR VALUES FROM ('2026-10-01') TO ('2026-11-01');
CREATE TABLE events_2026_11 PARTITION OF events
    FOR VALUES FROM ('2026-11-01') TO ('2026-12-01');
CREATE TABLE events_2026_12 PARTITION OF events
    FOR VALUES FROM ('2026-12-01') TO ('2027-01-01');
CREATE TABLE events_2027_01 PARTITION OF events
    FOR VALUES FROM ('2027-01-01') TO ('2027-02-01');
CREATE TABLE events_2027_02 PARTITION OF events
    FOR VALUES FROM ('2027-02-01') TO ('2027-03-01');
CREATE TABLE events_2027_03 PARTITION OF events
    FOR VALUES FROM ('2027-03-01') TO ('2027-04-01');

CREATE INDEX idx_events_session ON events(tenant_id, session_id, event_time);
CREATE INDEX idx_events_variant ON events(tenant_id, variant_id, event_type, event_time);
```

## D:/Marketing-AI/platform-api/src/main/resources/db/migration/V6__decision_log.sql

```sql
-- Every Thompson Sampling decision logged with full context (mandatory for off-policy eval, §23)
CREATE TABLE decision_log (
    id                UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    tenant_id         UUID NOT NULL,
    session_id        VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    creative_id       UUID,
    chosen_variant_id UUID NOT NULL,
    -- Full candidate set: [{"variant_id":"...","arm_id":"...","propensity":0.72,"sample_value":0.42,"alpha":12,"beta":88},...]
    -- propensity = P(arm wins) from N=200 Monte Carlo draws (arch v1.1 §4.6, mandatory §23)
    candidates        JSONB NOT NULL,
    context           JSONB,   -- device, geo, utm_*, time_of_day, etc.
    model_version     VARCHAR(50),
    decided_at        TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_decisions_tenant_time ON decision_log(tenant_id, decided_at);
```

```sql
-- pixel_id is UUID without FK constraint here; FK to meta_pixels added in V8 (dependency order)
CREATE TABLE meta_campaigns (
    id               UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    tenant_id        UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id),
    pixel_id         UUID,
    meta_campaign_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    name             VARCHAR(500),
    objective        VARCHAR(50),
    contour          VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'TEST',  -- TEST, SCALE (§6.5 two-contour)
    daily_budget     REAL,
    status           VARCHAR(20),
    learning_phase   VARCHAR(20),  -- LEARNING, ACTIVE, LEARNING_LIMITED
    synced_at        TIMESTAMPTZ,
    created_at       TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE meta_ad_sets (
    id             UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    tenant_id      UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id),
    campaign_id    UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES meta_campaigns(id),
    meta_ad_set_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    creative_id    UUID REFERENCES creatives(id),
    audience_spec  JSONB,
    daily_budget   REAL,
    status         VARCHAR(20),
    learning_phase VARCHAR(20),
    synced_at      TIMESTAMPTZ,
    created_at     TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

-- Financial Circuit Breaker L1 (§12.5a)
CREATE TABLE budget_guards (
    id            UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    tenant_id     UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id),
    guard_type    VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,  -- PER_CREATIVE_STOP_LOSS, MONTHLY_CEILING
    reference_id  UUID,                  -- creative_id for per-creative, NULL for account-level
    threshold     REAL NOT NULL,
    current_spend REAL DEFAULT 0,
    is_triggered  BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
    triggered_at  TIMESTAMPTZ,
    period_start  DATE,
    created_at    TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

-- GHL webhook audit log for replay and debugging (§13.3)
CREATE TABLE ghl_webhook_log (
    id                 UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    tenant_id          UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id),
    event_type         VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    ghl_contact_id     VARCHAR(100),
    ghl_opportunity_id VARCHAR(100),
    payload            JSONB NOT NULL,
    processed          BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
    received_at        TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_ghl_log_contact ON ghl_webhook_log(ghl_contact_id) WHERE ghl_contact_id IS NOT NULL;
```

## D:/Marketing-AI/platform-api/src/main/resources/db/migration/V9__rls_policies.sql

```sql
-- Row-Level Security: all tenant-scoped tables are isolated by app.current_tenant
-- Spring Boot sets: SET LOCAL app.current_tenant = '<uuid>' at the start of each request
-- current_setting('app.current_tenant', true) returns NULL (not error) when unset

-- FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY is required because the DB user 'mai' owns the tables;
-- without FORCE, the table owner bypasses RLS by default in PostgreSQL

ALTER TABLE tenants ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE tenants FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON tenants
    USING (id = current_setting('app.current_tenant', true)::uuid);

ALTER TABLE users ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE users FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON users
    USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant', true)::uuid);

ALTER TABLE creatives ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE creatives FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON creatives
    USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant', true)::uuid);

ALTER TABLE creative_atoms ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE creative_atoms FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON creative_atoms
    USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant', true)::uuid);

ALTER TABLE landing_variants ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE landing_variants FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON landing_variants
    USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant', true)::uuid);

ALTER TABLE variant_offers ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE variant_offers FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON variant_offers
    USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant', true)::uuid);

ALTER TABLE thompson_arms ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE thompson_arms FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON thompson_arms
    USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant', true)::uuid);

ALTER TABLE sessions ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE sessions FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON sessions
    USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant', true)::uuid);

-- Partitioned table: policy on parent automatically applies to all partitions
ALTER TABLE events ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE events FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON events
    USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant', true)::uuid);

ALTER TABLE decision_log ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE decision_log FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON decision_log
    USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant', true)::uuid);

ALTER TABLE meta_pixels ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE meta_pixels FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON meta_pixels
    USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant', true)::uuid);

ALTER TABLE meta_campaigns ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE meta_campaigns FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON meta_campaigns
    USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant', true)::uuid);

ALTER TABLE meta_ad_sets ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE meta_ad_sets FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON meta_ad_sets
    USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant', true)::uuid);

ALTER TABLE budget_guards ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE budget_guards FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON budget_guards
    USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant', true)::uuid);

ALTER TABLE ghl_webhook_log ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
```

## D:/Marketing-AI/platform-api/src/main/resources/db/migration/V10__remove_force_rls.sql

```sql
-- Remove FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY from all tenant-scoped tables.
-- Phase 0 MVP: application user 'mai' is the table owner and bypasses RLS by default.
-- RLS policies remain in place (infrastructure ready for production enforcement).
-- Re-enable FORCE when a separate mai_app role is added for production deployment.
-- Without FORCE: 'mai' bypasses RLS; application enforces isolation via TenantContext WHERE clauses.

ALTER TABLE tenants        NO FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE users          NO FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE creatives      NO FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE creative_atoms NO FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE landing_variants NO FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE variant_offers NO FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE thompson_arms  NO FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE sessions       NO FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE events         NO FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE decision_log   NO FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE meta_pixels    NO FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE meta_campaigns NO FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE meta_ad_sets   NO FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE budget_guards  NO FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE ghl_webhook_log NO FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
```

## D:/Marketing-AI/platform-api/src/main/resources/db/migration/V12__capi_events.sql

```sql
-- CAPI events log: records every event queued or sent to Meta Conversions API
-- Status flow: PENDING → SENT | FAILED | SKIPPED
-- PENDING = credentials not yet configured; SKIPPED = quality gate rejected
CREATE TABLE capi_events (
    id              UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    tenant_id       UUID NOT NULL,
    session_id      VARCHAR(100),
    event_name      VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,   -- Lead, Purchase, Schedule, CompleteRegistration
    event_id        VARCHAR(100),            -- client_event_id for dedup with browser pixel
    pixel_id        VARCHAR(100),
    proxy_value     REAL,
    currency        VARCHAR(10) DEFAULT 'USD',
    payload         JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',   -- full CAPI payload sent
    meta_response   JSONB,                          -- Meta Graph API response
    status          VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING', -- PENDING|SENT|FAILED|SKIPPED
    ghl_event_type  VARCHAR(100),            -- originating GHL event (call.completed, etc.)
    ghl_contact_id  VARCHAR(100),
    sent_at         TIMESTAMPTZ,
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_capi_tenant_time ON capi_events(tenant_id, created_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX idx_capi_event_id    ON capi_events(tenant_id, event_id) WHERE event_id IS NOT NULL;
CREATE INDEX idx_capi_pending     ON capi_events(tenant_id, status)   WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED');
```

```sql
-- Phase 0-6: Fraud Protection — add behavioral scoring columns to sessions

ALTER TABLE sessions ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS ip_address  VARCHAR(45);
ALTER TABLE sessions ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS user_agent  TEXT;
ALTER TABLE sessions ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS fraud_score  REAL    DEFAULT 0;
ALTER TABLE sessions ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS fraud_reasons JSONB  DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb;

-- Index for IP clustering detection (hourly fraud review)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sessions_ip_started
    ON sessions (ip_address, started_at DESC)
    WHERE ip_address IS NOT NULL;

-- Index to efficiently query suspicious sessions per tenant
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sessions_suspicious
    ON sessions (tenant_id, is_suspicious, started_at DESC)
    WHERE is_suspicious = true;
```

## D:/Marketing-AI/platform-api/src/main/resources/db/migration/V14__appointments.sql

```sql
-- Phase 0-10: Google Calendar Integration
-- Add calendar credentials storage to tenants
ALTER TABLE tenants ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS calendar_credentials_enc BYTEA;

-- Appointment tracking table: GHL appointment.scheduled/completed/no_show + Calendar fallback
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS appointments (
    id                   UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    tenant_id            UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id),
    session_id           VARCHAR(100),
    ghl_contact_id       VARCHAR(100),
    ghl_appointment_id   VARCHAR(100),
    calendar_event_id    VARCHAR(255),
    calendar_id          VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT 'primary',
    attendee_email       VARCHAR(255),
    scheduled_at         TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    status               VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'SCHEDULED',
    source               VARCHAR(30),   -- GHL_WEBHOOK, CALENDAR_FALLBACK, TIMEOUT
    calendar_checked_at  TIMESTAMPTZ,
    ghl_updated_at       TIMESTAMPTZ,
    created_at           TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_appointments_tenant
    ON appointments(tenant_id, scheduled_at DESC);

-- Partial index: only SCHEDULED rows — used by the pending-check query
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_appointments_pending
    ON appointments(scheduled_at)
    WHERE status = 'SCHEDULED';

-- Unique index: prevent duplicate registrations for the same GHL appointment
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_appointments_ghl_id
    ON appointments(tenant_id, ghl_appointment_id)
    WHERE ghl_appointment_id IS NOT NULL;

-- RLS
ALTER TABLE appointments ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation_appointments ON appointments
    USING (tenant_id::text = current_setting('app.current_tenant', true));
```

## D:/Marketing-AI/platform-api/src/main/resources/db/migration/V21__glm_posteriors.sql

```sql
-- Bayesian GLM posterior summaries per tenant per atom effect
-- Fitted by ml-service (PyMC); read by /glm/posteriors and predict endpoint

CREATE TABLE glm_posteriors (
    id          UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    tenant_id   UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    model_stage VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,    -- CTR, CVR, AOV
    atom_type   VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,   -- β_hook, β_cta, β_offer, β_face, β_match_ctr, mu_aov …
    atom_value  VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,   -- hook label or "__scalar__"
    mean        REAL NOT NULL,
    std         REAL NOT NULL,
    hdi_low     REAL,                    -- 94% HDI lower bound
    hdi_high    REAL,                    -- 94% HDI upper bound
    n_obs       INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    fitted_at   TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE(tenant_id, model_stage, atom_type, atom_value)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_glm_posteriors_tenant ON glm_posteriors(tenant_id, model_stage);

-- Audit trail of fit runs (one row per tenant per run)
CREATE TABLE glm_fit_runs (
    id          UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    tenant_id   UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    status      VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'RUNNING',   -- RUNNING, DONE, FAILED
    n_obs_ctr   INT,
    n_obs_cvr   INT,
    n_obs_aov   INT,
    r_hat_max   REAL,        -- max Gelman-Rubin statistic across all chains/params
    error_msg   TEXT,
    started_at  TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    finished_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);
```

```sql
-- arch v1.1 §4.4: each arm is tied to a specific reward event type
-- (one binary count per event — no fractional increments).
-- The UNIQUE constraint must include reward_event so a single variant can have
-- separate arms for different reward events (e.g., CALL_ANSWERED vs MEETING_ATTENDED).

ALTER TABLE thompson_arms
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS reward_event VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'FORM_SUBMIT';

-- Drop the old 3-column unique constraint (name assigned by PostgreSQL)
ALTER TABLE thompson_arms
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS thompson_arms_tenant_id_variant_id_context_key_key;

-- Add the correct 4-column unique constraint including reward_event
ALTER TABLE thompson_arms
    ADD CONSTRAINT thompson_arms_tenant_variant_ctx_event_unique
        UNIQUE (tenant_id, variant_id, context_key, reward_event);

-- Update the existing comment so it reflects the arch v1.1 §4.4 binary reward rule
COMMENT ON COLUMN thompson_arms.reward_event IS
    'Event type this arm counts: CALL_ANSWERED, MEETING_ATTENDED, PURCHASE, etc. '
    'Binary: every qualifying event increments alpha by exactly 1.0 (arch v1.1 §4.4).';
```

## D:/Marketing-AI/platform-api/src/main/resources/db/migration/V25__fix_rls_nullif_and_force.sql

```sql
-- arch v1.1 §8: two-part RLS fix
--
-- FIX 1 (I5): All policies used current_setting(...)::uuid without NULLIF.
--   When the GUC is unset, current_setting returns '' (empty string), and ''::uuid
--   throws "invalid input syntax for type uuid" — crashing every request that
--   runs outside a SET LOCAL block. NULLIF converts '' to NULL so the cast succeeds.
--
-- FIX 2 (I6): V10 removed FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY.
--   Without FORCE, the table owner role ('mai') bypasses all policies.
--   arch v1.1 §8 requires FORCE + a non-owner application role ('mai_app').
--
-- FIX 3: V14 (appointments) compared tenant_id::text = current_setting() — wrong type.
--        V15 (creator_briefs) called current_setting without the `, true` flag — errors on unset.

-- ─── Non-owner application role ───────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Create role only if it doesn't already exist
DO $$ BEGIN
    CREATE ROLE mai_app;
EXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_object THEN NULL;
END $$;
-- Password and CONNECT privilege are set via docker-compose DB_APP_ROLE_PASSWORD env (not here)
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO mai_app;
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO mai_app;
GRANT USAGE, SELECT ON ALL SEQUENCES IN SCHEMA public TO mai_app;

-- ─── Drop all existing tenant_isolation policies ──────────────────────────────
-- V9 tables
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS tenant_isolation ON tenants;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS tenant_isolation ON users;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS tenant_isolation ON creatives;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS tenant_isolation ON creative_atoms;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS tenant_isolation ON landing_variants;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS tenant_isolation ON variant_offers;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS tenant_isolation ON thompson_arms;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS tenant_isolation ON sessions;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS tenant_isolation ON events;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS tenant_isolation ON decision_log;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS tenant_isolation ON meta_pixels;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS tenant_isolation ON meta_campaigns;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS tenant_isolation ON meta_ad_sets;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS tenant_isolation ON budget_guards;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS tenant_isolation ON ghl_webhook_log;
-- V14 appointments (different policy name)
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS tenant_isolation_appointments ON appointments;
-- V15 creator_briefs
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS tenant_isolation ON creator_briefs;

-- ─── Recreate with NULLIF fix ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON tenants
    USING (id = NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant', true), '')::uuid);

CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON users
    USING (tenant_id = NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant', true), '')::uuid);

CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON creatives
    USING (tenant_id = NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant', true), '')::uuid);

CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON creative_atoms
    USING (tenant_id = NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant', true), '')::uuid);

CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON landing_variants
    USING (tenant_id = NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant', true), '')::uuid);

CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON variant_offers
    USING (tenant_id = NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant', true), '')::uuid);

CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON thompson_arms
    USING (tenant_id = NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant', true), '')::uuid);

CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON sessions
    USING (tenant_id = NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant', true), '')::uuid);

CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON events
    USING (tenant_id = NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant', true), '')::uuid);

CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON decision_log
    USING (tenant_id = NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant', true), '')::uuid);

CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON meta_pixels
    USING (tenant_id = NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant', true), '')::uuid);

CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON meta_campaigns
    USING (tenant_id = NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant', true), '')::uuid);

CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON meta_ad_sets
    USING (tenant_id = NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant', true), '')::uuid);

CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON budget_guards
    USING (tenant_id = NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant', true), '')::uuid);

CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON ghl_webhook_log
    USING (tenant_id = NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant', true), '')::uuid);

CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON appointments
    USING (tenant_id = NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant', true), '')::uuid);

CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON creator_briefs
    USING (tenant_id = NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant', true), '')::uuid);

-- ─── Re-enable FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY ──────────────────────────────────────
ALTER TABLE tenants           FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE users             FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE creatives         FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE creative_atoms    FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE landing_variants  FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE variant_offers    FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE thompson_arms     FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE sessions          FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE events            FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE decision_log      FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE meta_pixels       FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE meta_campaigns    FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE meta_ad_sets      FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE budget_guards     FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE ghl_webhook_log   FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE appointments      FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE creator_briefs    FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
```

## D:/Marketing-AI/platform-api/src/main/resources/db/migration/V27__churn_penalty.sql

```sql
-- 3-7: Delayed Churn Penalty infrastructure (vision §6.7)
--
-- When a deal is lost (GHL OpportunityStatusUpdate/status=lost), the Thompson arm
-- that was shown to that lead's session receives a retroactive β penalty.
-- Rules (§6.7): min cohort ≥ 20, decay λ=0.02/day, cap 30% of (α+β) per recalc.
--
-- Attribution chain:
--   sessions.deal_status='lost' + ghl_contact_id
--   → decision_log.session_id → chosen_variant_id + context_key
--   → thompson_arms.variant_id → arm_id + current posteriors

-- Track whether a lost session has been through the penalty scan.
-- Sessions older than 90 days with churn_penalized_at IS NULL are force-closed
-- (cohort never reached min size 20 — penalty skipped, session marked anyway).
ALTER TABLE sessions
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS churn_penalized_at TIMESTAMPTZ;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sessions_churn_pending
    ON sessions(tenant_id, deal_status, started_at)
    WHERE deal_status = 'lost' AND churn_penalized_at IS NULL;

-- Every retroactive β correction applied to a Thompson arm
CREATE TABLE churn_penalty_log (
    id           UUID         PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    tenant_id    UUID         NOT NULL,
    arm_id       UUID         NOT NULL REFERENCES thompson_arms(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    variant_id   UUID         NOT NULL,
    context_key  VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'global',
    beta_delta   NUMERIC(8,4) NOT NULL CHECK (beta_delta >= 0),
    cohort_size  INT          NOT NULL CHECK (cohort_size >= 0),
    churn_count  INT          NOT NULL CHECK (churn_count >= 0),
    weighted_sum NUMERIC(8,4) NOT NULL,
    capped       BOOLEAN      NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    applied_at   TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX idx_churn_penalty_tenant ON churn_penalty_log(tenant_id, applied_at DESC);

ALTER TABLE churn_penalty_log ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE churn_penalty_log FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON churn_penalty_log
    USING (tenant_id = NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant', true), '')::uuid);
GRANT SELECT, INSERT ON churn_penalty_log TO mai_app;
```

## D:/Marketing-AI/platform-api/src/main/resources/db/migration/V28__holdout_benchmark.sql

```sql
-- 3-9: System vs Baseline Benchmark — micro-holdout infrastructure (vision §21.5)
--
-- A small fraction of traffic (default 4%) receives a random variant instead of
-- Thompson Sampling. This creates a continuous control group that measures the
-- incremental lift of the AI system vs. a static/random baseline.
--
-- Toggle: tenants.holdout_enabled=true (default ON).
-- Rate:   tenants.holdout_rate (default 0.04 = 4%). Recommended 3–5%.
-- Assignment: deterministic hash of session_id → same session always same group.

ALTER TABLE tenants
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS holdout_enabled BOOLEAN      NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS holdout_rate    NUMERIC(4,3) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.040
                                             CHECK (holdout_rate BETWEEN 0 AND 0.20);

ALTER TABLE decision_log
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_holdout BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_decisions_holdout
    ON decision_log(tenant_id, is_holdout, decided_at);
```

## D:/Marketing-AI/platform-api/src/main/resources/db/migration/V29__pixel_pollution.sql

```sql
-- 3-11: Pixel Pollution Auto-Detection — Level 3 (vision §6.8)
--
-- Monitors drift between incoming lead volume and confirmed-quality lead rate.
-- Quality rate = CRM_MEETING_ATTENDED / FORM_SUBMIT per UTM campaign (14-day window).
-- Alert fires when quality_rate < 0.7 × baseline_30d AND volume ≥ 20 forms.
-- Creates a CircuitBreaker L2 event + Telegram alert.

CREATE TABLE pixel_pollution_scans (
    id               UUID         PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    tenant_id        UUID         NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    utm_campaign     VARCHAR(100),                -- NULL = tenant-level aggregate
    scan_date        DATE         NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE,
    forms_14d        INT          NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    meetings_14d     INT          NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    quality_rate_14d NUMERIC(6,4),               -- meetings_14d / forms_14d
    baseline_rate_30d NUMERIC(6,4),
    drift_pct        NUMERIC(7,2),               -- (quality_rate_14d / baseline_rate_30d - 1) * 100
    alert_fired      BOOLEAN      NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    created_at       TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_pixel_pollution_dedup
    ON pixel_pollution_scans(tenant_id, COALESCE(utm_campaign, ''), scan_date);
CREATE INDEX idx_pixel_pollution_tenant
    ON pixel_pollution_scans(tenant_id, scan_date DESC);

ALTER TABLE pixel_pollution_scans ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE pixel_pollution_scans FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON pixel_pollution_scans
    USING (tenant_id = NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant', true), '')::uuid);
GRANT SELECT, INSERT ON pixel_pollution_scans TO mai_app;
```

## D:/Marketing-AI/platform-api/src/main/resources/db/migration/V30__competitive_intelligence.sql

```sql
-- 3-10: Reactive Competitive Intelligence (vision §9.1)
--
-- Polls Meta Ad Library for competitor ads running > 14 days (proxy for profitability).
-- LLM extracts atoms → generates counter-hypotheses → alert to marketer for human approval.
-- ⚠️ Auto-deploy without human approval is FORBIDDEN (vision §9.1).

-- Competitor page IDs to monitor are stored per-tenant in tenants.settings JSONB:
--   {"competitor_page_ids": ["123456", "789012"]}

CREATE TABLE competitor_ads (
    id               UUID         PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    tenant_id        UUID         NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    meta_ad_id       VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    page_id          VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    page_name        VARCHAR(255),
    ad_title         TEXT,
    ad_body          TEXT,
    snapshot_url     TEXT,
    running_since    DATE,
    run_days         INT,
    atoms_extracted  JSONB,       -- LLM-extracted creative atoms
    first_seen_at    TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    last_seen_at     TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE (tenant_id, meta_ad_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_competitor_ads_tenant ON competitor_ads(tenant_id, run_days DESC);

-- Alert record: groups competitor ads into a test-batch recommendation
CREATE TABLE competitive_intel_alerts (
    id                UUID         PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    tenant_id         UUID         NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    status            VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING'
                                   CHECK (status IN ('PENDING','APPROVED','DISMISSED')),
    competitor_ad_ids UUID[]       NOT NULL,     -- competitor_ads.id[] that triggered this alert
    counter_hypotheses JSONB       NOT NULL,     -- LLM-generated counter-creatives
    approved_by       UUID,                      -- user who approved (NULL until approved)
    approved_at       TIMESTAMPTZ,
    created_at        TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX idx_ci_alerts_tenant ON competitive_intel_alerts(tenant_id, status, created_at DESC);

ALTER TABLE competitor_ads           ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE competitor_ads           FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE competitive_intel_alerts ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE competitive_intel_alerts FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON competitor_ads
    USING (tenant_id = NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant', true), '')::uuid);
CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON competitive_intel_alerts
    USING (tenant_id = NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant', true), '')::uuid);

GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE ON competitor_ads, competitive_intel_alerts TO mai_app;
```

```sql
    status           VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',  -- PENDING, RENDERING, COMPLETED, FAILED

);
```

```sql
-- GDPR erasure requests audit trail
CREATE TABLE erasure_requests (
    id               UUID        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
```

```sql
-- Funnel as Configuration (vision §19.3 / arch §16.3)
-- Replaces hard-coded B2B stage chain with per-tenant DB-driven funnel.

CREATE TABLE funnel_stages (
    id         UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    tenant_id  UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    stage_key  VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
    ordinal    INT NOT NULL,
    label      VARCHAR(120),
    is_quality_key  BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    is_terminal     BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    maps_to_ghl_status  VARCHAR(60),
    maps_to_event_type  VARCHAR(60),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE (tenant_id, stage_key)
);

ALTER TABLE funnel_stages ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY rls_funnel_stages ON funnel_stages
    USING (tenant_id = NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant', true), '')::uuid);
ALTER TABLE funnel_stages FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON funnel_stages TO mai_app;

-- CAPI event map: stage_key → which pixel to fire, with what value formula
CREATE TABLE capi_event_map (
    id             UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    tenant_id      UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    stage_key      VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
    pixel_role     VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,  -- maps to meta_pixels.role_key
    meta_event_name VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
    value_formula  VARCHAR(200),          -- token expression, e.g. "4000*k_accr*k_ticket"
    send_condition VARCHAR(200),          -- SQL-like condition, e.g. "self_accredited = true"
    created_at     TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE (tenant_id, stage_key, pixel_role)
);

ALTER TABLE capi_event_map ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY rls_capi_event_map ON capi_event_map
    USING (tenant_id = NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant', true), '')::uuid);
ALTER TABLE capi_event_map FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON capi_event_map TO mai_app;

-- Session-level investor qualification columns
ALTER TABLE sessions
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS self_accredited          BOOLEAN,
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS ticket_bucket            VARCHAR(20),  -- LT25K/25_50K/50_100K/100_250K/GT250K
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS accreditation_verified_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS funnel_key               VARCHAR(60) DEFAULT 'b2b';

-- Appointment enrichment for investor funnel
ALTER TABLE appointments
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS booking_distance_h  FLOAT,
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS slot_tz             VARCHAR(60),
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS lead_tz             VARCHAR(60),
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS coord_confirmed_at  TIMESTAMPTZ,
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS followup_variant_id UUID;

-- Pixel role key (used by capi_event_map to select the right pixel)
ALTER TABLE meta_pixels
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS role_key VARCHAR(60) DEFAULT 'investor_primary';

-- New event schema entries for investor funnel tracking
INSERT INTO event_schemas (event_type, schema_version, json_schema, created_at)
VALUES
    ('CALENDAR_OPEN',  1, '{"type":"object","properties":{"session_id":{"type":"string"},"page":{"type":"string"}}}', now()),
    ('SLOT_SELECTED',  1, '{"type":"object","properties":{"session_id":{"type":"string"},"slot_ts":{"type":"string"},"slot_tz":{"type":"string"}}}', now()),
    ('MATERIAL_VIEW',  1, '{"type":"object","properties":{"session_id":{"type":"string"},"material_key":{"type":"string"}}}', now()),
    ('DATAROOM_OPEN',  1, '{"type":"object","properties":{"session_id":{"type":"string"},"dataroom_id":{"type":"string"}}}', now())
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
```

```sql
-- Securities compliance rulebases (vision §19.5 / arch §16.5)
-- Platform-wide rules: no tenant RLS (platform admins own these).
-- Tenant-scoped approved phrases: RLS applies.

CREATE TABLE compliance_rulebases (
    id           UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    rulebase_key VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    description  VARCHAR(255),
    rules        JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    created_at   TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at   TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

GRANT SELECT ON compliance_rulebases TO mai_app;

-- Approved phrases per tenant (marketer-reviewed, pre-cleared copy)
CREATE TABLE approved_phrases (
    id         UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    tenant_id  UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    phrase     TEXT NOT NULL,
    context    VARCHAR(120),
    approved_by UUID,
    approved_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE (tenant_id, phrase)
);

ALTER TABLE approved_phrases ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY rls_approved_phrases ON approved_phrases
    USING (tenant_id = NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant', true), '')::uuid);
ALTER TABLE approved_phrases FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON approved_phrases TO mai_app;

-- ─── Seed platform-wide rulebases ──────────────────────────────────────────

-- META_FINANCIAL: financial promotion rules for Meta
INSERT INTO compliance_rulebases (rulebase_key, description, rules) VALUES (
    'META_FINANCIAL',
    'Meta Advertising Policy — financial products and services',
    '[
        {
            "rule_id": "MF001",
            "severity": "FAIL",
            "description": "Guaranteed return promises",
            "pattern": "guaranteed (return|profit|income|earning|yield|gain)",
            "suggestion": "Replace with realistic, non-guaranteed language"
        },
        {
            "rule_id": "MF002",
            "severity": "FAIL",
            "description": "Risk-free claims",
            "pattern": "risk.?free (investment|opportunity|return)",
            "suggestion": "All investments carry risk; remove risk-free claim"
        },
        {
            "rule_id": "MF003",
            "severity": "FAIL",
            "description": "Specific return promises",
            "pattern": "(earn|make|get|return) (\\d+%|\\$\\d+) (per|a|each) (month|year|week|day)",
            "suggestion": "Remove specific return figures or add material risk disclosure"
        },
        {
            "rule_id": "MF004",
            "severity": "WARN",
            "description": "Missing risk disclosure on financial ad",
            "pattern": "invest|investment|returns|yield|portfolio|fund",
            "suggestion": "Ensure risk disclosure is present in ad or landing copy"
        },
        {
            "rule_id": "MF005",
            "severity": "FAIL",
            "description": "Unrealistic urgency with financial promise",
            "pattern": "(limited time|act now|last chance).{0,80}(profit|return|invest)",
            "suggestion": "Remove artificial urgency combined with financial promise"
        }
    ]'
) ON CONFLICT (rulebase_key) DO UPDATE
    SET rules = EXCLUDED.rules, updated_at = now();

-- META_PERSONAL_ATTR: personal attribute targeting prohibition
-- Rule: describe the offer, never the viewer (vision §19.5)
INSERT INTO compliance_rulebases (rulebase_key, description, rules) VALUES (
    'META_PERSONAL_ATTR',
    'Meta Policy — personal attribute targeting prohibition (§19.5: describe offer, not viewer)',
    '[
        {
            "rule_id": "PA001",
            "severity": "FAIL",
            "description": "Directly addressing viewer as accredited investor",
            "pattern": "(are you|you are|you''re|you must be).{0,40}accredited",
            "suggestion": "Replace with offer description: ''Open to accredited investors''"
        },
        {
            "rule_id": "PA002",
            "severity": "FAIL",
            "description": "Implying viewer has financial problem",
            "pattern": "(if you|you have|struggling with|tired of).{0,60}(debt|financial|money problem)",
            "suggestion": "Describe your solution benefits without implying viewer hardship"
        },
        {
            "rule_id": "PA003",
            "severity": "FAIL",
            "description": "Targeting by implied net worth",
            "pattern": "(for (high.net.worth|wealthy|rich)|if you have \\$\\d+)",
            "suggestion": "State offer criteria without targeting implied wealth status"
        },
        {
            "rule_id": "PA004",
            "severity": "WARN",
            "description": "Second-person financial qualification questions",
            "pattern": "do you (qualify|meet the criteria|have \\$\\d+|earn|make)",
            "suggestion": "Rephrase to describe offer eligibility without viewer interrogation"
        },
        {
            "rule_id": "PA005",
            "severity": "FAIL",
            "description": "Implying viewer''s current investment failures",
            "pattern": "(your (portfolio|investments|stocks) (is|are|has|have)).{0,60}(underperform|failing|losing|down)",
            "suggestion": "Do not imply viewer''s investment situation is negative"
        }
    ]'
) ON CONFLICT (rulebase_key) DO UPDATE
    SET rules = EXCLUDED.rules, updated_at = now();

-- SEC_506C: Reg D 506(c) advertising guidance
INSERT INTO compliance_rulebases (rulebase_key, description, rules) VALUES (
```

```sql
-- Follow-up sequence optimisation — Thompson Sampling bandit (vision §19.6 / arch §16.6)

CREATE TABLE followup_variants (

    channels     TEXT[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
```

```sql
CREATE INDEX path_gate_log_session ON path_gate_log(session_id);
```

```sql
-- Phase 8-18: Post-Call Intelligence
-- call_notes: coordinator-entered structured call outcome + objection tags
-- call_objections: individual objection instances linked to creative + segment (for brief)
-- objection_summary: per-tenant aggregate for feedback loop and dashboard

CREATE TABLE call_notes (
    id                      UUID        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    tenant_id               UUID        NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id),
    session_id              UUID        REFERENCES sessions(id),
    appointment_id          UUID        REFERENCES appointments(id),
    call_outcome            VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL
        CHECK (call_outcome IN ('COMMITTED','INTERESTED_FOLLOW','COLD','NO_SHOW','RESCHEDULED')),
    next_step               VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NONE'
        CHECK (next_step IN ('SEND_DECK','WIRE_INSTRUCTIONS','SCHEDULE_FOLLOWUP','NONE')),
    objection_tags          JSONB       NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    coordinator_note        TEXT,
    follow_up_arm_override  VARCHAR(40),
    signal_sent_at          TIMESTAMPTZ,
    created_by              VARCHAR(40) DEFAULT 'coordinator',
    created_at              TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
ALTER TABLE call_notes ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE call_notes FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY call_notes_tenant ON call_notes
    USING (tenant_id = NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant', true), '')::uuid);
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON call_notes TO mai_app;

CREATE INDEX call_notes_session     ON call_notes(session_id);
CREATE INDEX call_notes_appointment ON call_notes(appointment_id);
CREATE INDEX call_notes_tenant_ts   ON call_notes(tenant_id, created_at DESC);

-- Detailed per-objection records linked back to creative + ticket bucket
CREATE TABLE call_objections (
    id              UUID        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    tenant_id       UUID        NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id),
    call_note_id    UUID        NOT NULL REFERENCES call_notes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    objection_tag   VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    ticket_bucket   VARCHAR(20),
    creative_id     UUID        REFERENCES creatives(id),
    stage_after     VARCHAR(30),  -- funnel stage after the call
    resolved        BOOLEAN     NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
ALTER TABLE call_objections ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE call_objections FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY call_objections_tenant ON call_objections

GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON call_objections TO mai_app;

CREATE INDEX call_objections_note       ON call_objections(call_note_id);
CREATE INDEX call_objections_creative   ON call_objections(creative_id);
CREATE INDEX call_objections_tag_tenant ON call_objections(tenant_id, objection_tag);

-- Aggregate per tenant (upserted on each new call_note)
CREATE TABLE objection_summary (
    id              UUID        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    tenant_id       UUID        NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id),

    count_total     INT         NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    count_converted INT         NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    last_seen_at    TIMESTAMPTZ,
    UNIQUE (tenant_id, objection_tag)
);
ALTER TABLE objection_summary ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE objection_summary FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

    USING (tenant_id = NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant', true), '')::uuid);
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON objection_summary TO mai_app;
```

```sql
    added_at        TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE (tenant_id, email)
);

    USING (tenant_id = NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant', true), '')::uuid);

    tenant_id       UUID        NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id),

        CHECK (status IN ('FROZEN','PENDING_REVIEW','APPROVED','ACTIVE')),

    unlocked_at     TIMESTAMPTZ,
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

ALTER TABLE regcf_activation_gate FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY regcf_gate_tenant ON regcf_activation_gate
    USING (tenant_id = NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant', true), '')::uuid);
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE ON regcf_activation_gate TO mai_app;

-- Weekly value estimate: n_leads * p_convert_regcf * avg_ticket_regcf with CI
CREATE TABLE waitlist_value_estimates (
    id                  UUID    PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    tenant_id           UUID    NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id),
    estimated_at        DATE    NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE,
    n_leads             INT     NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    p_convert_regcf     REAL    NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.05,
    avg_ticket_regcf    REAL    NOT NULL DEFAULT 10000.0,
    estimated_value     REAL    GENERATED ALWAYS AS (n_leads * p_convert_regcf * avg_ticket_regcf) STORED,
    ci_lower            REAL,
    ci_upper            REAL,
    UNIQUE (tenant_id, estimated_at)
);
ALTER TABLE waitlist_value_estimates ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE waitlist_value_estimates FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

    USING (tenant_id = NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant', true), '')::uuid);
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE ON waitlist_value_estimates TO mai_app;

-- Seed: all existing tenants start FROZEN (OI-3)
INSERT INTO regcf_activation_gate (tenant_id, status)
SELECT id, 'FROZEN' FROM tenants
ON CONFLICT (tenant_id) DO NOTHING;
```

## D:/Marketing-AI/ml-service/app/models/bayesian_glm.py

```py
"""
Bayesian GLM for creative performance prediction (vision §6.3a, §15.3, §15.4).

Three models:
  CTR: BetaBinomial(clicks | impressions, p_ctr)  — logit link, atom effects
  CVR: BetaBinomial(conversions | clicks, p_cvr)  — logit link, offer/urgency effects
  AOV: Lognormal(revenue)                          — log-normal, revenue distribution

Partial pooling: atom effects share a HalfNormal hyperprior (σ_atoms) so
low-data atoms shrink toward the group mean rather than over-fitting.

match_score: wide prior Normal(0, 2.0) — noisy LLM-computed feature; data calibrates.
Beta-Binomial by default (vision §6.3a): handles overdispersion from daily/placement variance.

LKJ correlated creative random effects (CTR↔CVR anti-correlation = clickbait detection)
are deferred to Phase 3-1b — three independent models first.

Call fit_all() from a thread executor; it is synchronous (PyMC/pytensor).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from dataclasses import dataclass

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

# pymc and arviz are imported lazily inside functions that need them so that
# the module can be imported (and prepare_dataset / GlmDataset used) without
# PyMC installed — e.g. in unit tests for the data-preparation logic only.

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# Minimum data thresholds before fitting a stage
MIN_IMPRESSIONS = 50
MIN_CLICKS_CVR = 10
MIN_REVENUES = 5
MIN_ROWS = 2  # need at least 2 ad-set rows for any pooling


# ─── Data container ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

@dataclass
class GlmDataset:
    creative_ids: list[str]
    n_obs: int

    impressions: np.ndarray    # (n_obs,)  int
    clicks: np.ndarray         # (n_obs,)  int, clamped ≤ impressions
    cvr_mask: np.ndarray       # (n_obs,)  bool — rows with clicks >= MIN_CLICKS_CVR
    conversions: np.ndarray    # (n_obs,)  int, clamped ≤ clicks
    revenues: np.ndarray       # (n_revenues,) float — flat array from PURCHASE events

    match_scores: np.ndarray   # (n_obs,) float [0,1]
    has_face: np.ndarray       # (n_obs,) float {0,1}
    urgency: np.ndarray        # (n_obs,) float {0,1}

    hook_idx: np.ndarray       # (n_obs,) int
    cta_idx: np.ndarray        # (n_obs,) int
    offer_idx: np.ndarray      # (n_obs,) int

    hook_labels: list[str]
    cta_labels: list[str]
    offer_labels: list[str]


def prepare_dataset(df: pd.DataFrame) -> GlmDataset | None:
    """
    Build a GlmDataset from a raw DataFrame.

    Expected columns:
        creative_id, impressions, clicks, conversions,
        revenues (list[float] | None per row),
        match_score, has_face, has_urgency,
        hook_type, cta_type, offer_type
    """
    df = df[df["impressions"] >= MIN_IMPRESSIONS].copy().reset_index(drop=True)
    if len(df) < MIN_ROWS:
        log.warning("GLM: only %d rows after impression filter — skipping fit", len(df))
        return None

    def _encode(col: str, default: str) -> tuple[np.ndarray, list[str]]:
        series = df[col].fillna(default) if col in df.columns else pd.Series([default] * len(df))
        labels = sorted(series.unique().tolist())
        mapping = {v: i for i, v in enumerate(labels)}
        return series.map(mapping).values.astype(int), labels

    hook_idx, hook_labels = _encode("hook_type", "unknown")
    cta_idx, cta_labels   = _encode("cta_type",  "unknown")
    offer_idx, offer_labels = _encode("offer_type", "none")

    impressions = df["impressions"].values.astype(int)
    clicks      = np.minimum(df["clicks"].values.astype(int), impressions)
    conversions = np.minimum(df["conversions"].values.astype(int), clicks)

    # Flatten revenue observations from the list-per-row column
    revenues: list[float] = []
    if "revenues" in df.columns:
        for rv in df["revenues"]:
            if rv is not None:
                revenues.extend(r for r in rv if r and r > 0)

    def _flt(col: str, fill: float) -> np.ndarray:
        s = df[col].fillna(fill) if col in df.columns else pd.Series([fill] * len(df))
        return s.values.astype(float)

    return GlmDataset(
        creative_ids=df["creative_id"].tolist(),
        n_obs=len(df),
        impressions=impressions,
        clicks=clicks,
        cvr_mask=clicks >= MIN_CLICKS_CVR,
        conversions=conversions,
        revenues=np.array(revenues, dtype=float),
        match_scores=_flt("match_score", 0.5),
        has_face=_flt("has_face", 0.0),
        urgency=_flt("has_urgency", 0.0),
        hook_idx=hook_idx,
        cta_idx=cta_idx,
        offer_idx=offer_idx,
        hook_labels=hook_labels,
        cta_labels=cta_labels,
        offer_labels=offer_labels,
    )


# ─── Model builders ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def _ctr_model(d: GlmDataset):
    """
    logit(CTR_i) = mu_ctr + β_hook[h_i] + β_cta[c_i] + β_face * face_i + β_match_ctr * ms_i
    clicks_i ~ BetaBinomial(impressions_i, p_ctr_i * κ_ctr, (1-p_ctr_i) * κ_ctr)
    """
    import pymc as pm
    with pm.Model() as model:
        σ       = pm.HalfNormal("σ_atoms", 0.5)
        mu      = pm.Normal("mu_ctr", 0.0, 1.0)
        β_hook  = pm.Normal("β_hook",      0.0, σ,   shape=len(d.hook_labels))
        β_cta   = pm.Normal("β_cta",       0.0, σ,   shape=len(d.cta_labels))
        β_face  = pm.Normal("β_face",      0.0, 0.5)
        β_match = pm.Normal("β_match_ctr", 0.0, 2.0)  # wide — noisy LLM feature

        logit_p = (mu
                   + β_hook[d.hook_idx]
                   + β_cta[d.cta_idx]
                   + β_face  * d.has_face
                   + β_match * d.match_scores)

        κ = pm.Exponential("κ_ctr", 0.5)
        p = pm.Deterministic("p_ctr", pm.math.sigmoid(logit_p))
        pm.BetaBinomial("obs_ctr",
                        alpha=p * κ, beta=(1.0 - p) * κ,
                        n=d.impressions, observed=d.clicks)
    return model


def _cvr_model(d: GlmDataset):
    """
    logit(CVR_i) = mu_cvr + β_offer[o_i] + β_urgency * urg_i + β_match_cvr * ms_i
    conversions_i ~ BetaBinomial(clicks_i, q_cvr_i * κ_cvr, (1-q_cvr_i) * κ_cvr)
    Only rows with clicks >= MIN_CLICKS_CVR are used.
    """
    import pymc as pm
    mask = d.cvr_mask
    if int(mask.sum()) < MIN_ROWS:
        log.warning("GLM CVR: only %d rows with >= %d clicks — skipping",
                    int(mask.sum()), MIN_CLICKS_CVR)
        return None

    with pm.Model() as model:
        σ         = pm.HalfNormal("σ_atoms", 0.5)
        mu        = pm.Normal("mu_cvr",       -1.0, 1.0)  # CVR typically < 50%
        β_offer   = pm.Normal("β_offer",       0.0, σ,   shape=len(d.offer_labels))
        β_urgency = pm.Normal("β_urgency",     0.0, 0.5)
        β_match   = pm.Normal("β_match_cvr",   0.0, 2.0)

        logit_q = (mu
                   + β_offer[d.offer_idx[mask]]
                   + β_urgency * d.urgency[mask]
                   + β_match   * d.match_scores[mask])

        κ = pm.Exponential("κ_cvr", 0.5)
        q = pm.Deterministic("q_cvr", pm.math.sigmoid(logit_q))
        pm.BetaBinomial("obs_cvr",
                        alpha=q * κ, beta=(1.0 - q) * κ,
                        n=d.clicks[mask], observed=d.conversions[mask])
    return model


def _aov_model(revenues: np.ndarray):
    """Lognormal AOV. Prior centred at observed log-mean."""
    import pymc as pm
    if len(revenues) < MIN_REVENUES:
        log.warning("GLM AOV: only %d revenue observations — skipping", len(revenues))
        return None

    log_mean = float(np.log(np.mean(revenues)))
    with pm.Model() as model:
        μ = pm.Normal("mu_aov", log_mean, 1.0)
        σ = pm.HalfNormal("σ_aov", 0.5)
        pm.Lognormal("obs_aov", mu=μ, sigma=σ, observed=revenues)
    return model


# ─── Sampling + posterior extraction ─────────────────────────────────────────

def _sample(model, draws: int, tune: int, chains: int):
    import pymc as pm
    with model:
        return pm.sample(
            draws=draws,
            tune=tune,
            chains=chains,
            target_accept=0.9,
            progressbar=False,
            return_inferencedata=True,
        )


def _rhat_max(idata) -> float:
    import arviz as az
    return float(np.nanmax(az.rhat(idata).to_array().values))


def _extract_vector(idata, stage: str, param: str, labels: list[str]) -> list[dict]:
    """Extract posterior summary for a 1-D parameter (one entry per label)."""
    import arviz as az
    post = idata.posterior
    if param not in post:
        return []
    arr = post[param].values  # (chains, draws, n_labels)
    flat = arr.reshape(-1, len(labels))
    results = []
    for i, label in enumerate(labels):
        samples = flat[:, i]
        hdi = az.hdi(samples, hdi_prob=0.94)
        results.append({
            "stage": stage, "param": param,
            "atom_type": param, "atom_value": label,
            "mean": float(np.mean(samples)),
            "std":  float(np.std(samples)),
            "hdi_low":  float(hdi[0]),
            "hdi_high": float(hdi[1]),
        })
    return results


def _extract_scalar(idata, stage: str, param: str) -> dict | None:
    import arviz as az
    post = idata.posterior
    if param not in post:
        return None
    samples = post[param].values.flatten()
    hdi = az.hdi(samples, hdi_prob=0.94)
    return {
        "stage": stage, "param": param,
        "atom_type": param, "atom_value": "__scalar__",
        "mean": float(np.mean(samples)),
        "std":  float(np.std(samples)),
        "hdi_low":  float(hdi[0]),
        "hdi_high": float(hdi[1]),
    }


# ─── Public API ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

@dataclass
class FitResult:
    posteriors: list[dict]
    r_hat_max: float
    n_obs_ctr: int
    n_obs_cvr: int
    n_obs_aov: int
    error: str | None = None


def fit_all(
    dataset: GlmDataset,
    draws: int = 1000,
    tune: int = 1000,
    chains: int = 2,
) -> FitResult:
    """
    Fit CTR, CVR, and AOV models sequentially.
    Returns posterior summaries for all atom effects.

    Synchronous — call from asyncio.get_event_loop().run_in_executor().
    """
    posteriors: list[dict] = []
    r_hats: list[float] = []
    n_obs_cvr = int(dataset.cvr_mask.sum())
    n_obs_aov = len(dataset.revenues)

    # CTR ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    try:
        idata_ctr = _sample(_ctr_model(dataset), draws, tune, chains)
        rh = _rhat_max(idata_ctr)
        r_hats.append(rh)
        if rh > 1.1:
            log.warning("CTR model: R-hat=%.3f (>1.1) — chains may not have converged", rh)

        posteriors += _extract_vector(idata_ctr, "CTR", "β_hook", dataset.hook_labels)
        posteriors += _extract_vector(idata_ctr, "CTR", "β_cta",  dataset.cta_labels)
        for p in ("β_face", "β_match_ctr", "mu_ctr"):
            s = _extract_scalar(idata_ctr, "CTR", p)
            if s:
                posteriors.append(s)
    except Exception:
        log.exception("CTR model fit failed")

    # CVR ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    cvr_m = _cvr_model(dataset)
    if cvr_m is not None:
        try:
            idata_cvr = _sample(cvr_m, draws, tune, chains)
            rh = _rhat_max(idata_cvr)
            r_hats.append(rh)
            if rh > 1.1:
                log.warning("CVR model: R-hat=%.3f", rh)

            posteriors += _extract_vector(idata_cvr, "CVR", "β_offer", dataset.offer_labels)
            for p in ("β_urgency", "β_match_cvr", "mu_cvr"):
                s = _extract_scalar(idata_cvr, "CVR", p)
                if s:
                    posteriors.append(s)
        except Exception:
            log.exception("CVR model fit failed")
            n_obs_cvr = 0

    # AOV ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    aov_m = _aov_model(dataset.revenues)
    if aov_m is not None:
        try:
            idata_aov = _sample(aov_m, draws, tune, chains)
            rh = _rhat_max(idata_aov)
            r_hats.append(rh)

            for p in ("mu_aov", "σ_aov"):
                s = _extract_scalar(idata_aov, "AOV", p)
                if s:
                    posteriors.append(s)
        except Exception:
            log.exception("AOV model fit failed")
            n_obs_aov = 0

    return FitResult(
        posteriors=posteriors,
        r_hat_max=max(r_hats) if r_hats else 0.0,
        n_obs_ctr=dataset.n_obs,
        n_obs_cvr=n_obs_cvr,
        n_obs_aov=n_obs_aov,
    )
```

```py
"""Creative DNA extraction: turns raw creative metadata into atoms."""
from app.services import llm_client

IMAGE_EXTENSIONS = {".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".gif", ".webp", ".avif"}
CONFIDENCE_VISION = 0.80
CONFIDENCE_TRANSCRIPT = 0.75
CONFIDENCE_METADATA = 1.0


def _is_image_url(url: str) -> bool:
    lower = url.lower().split("?")[0]
    return any(lower.endswith(ext) for ext in IMAGE_EXTENSIONS)


def _duration_label(sec: float) -> str:
    if sec <= 16:
        return "15s"
    if sec <= 31:
        return "30s"
    if sec <= 61:
        return "60s"
    return "60s_plus"


async def extract(
    media_type: str,
    file_url: str | None,
    thumbnail_url: str | None,
    transcript: str | None,
    duration_sec: float | None,
) -> list[dict]:
    """
    Returns list of atom dicts: {type, value, confidence, extracted_by}

    Phase 1 capabilities:
    - IMAGE: Vision analysis via Claude
    - VIDEO + image URL (thumbnail or .jpg file_url): Vision analysis
    - VIDEO + transcript: Text analysis via Claude
    - DURATION: from metadata
    - Whisper (auto-transcript) and FFmpeg (frame extract) → Phase 4
    """
    atoms: list[dict] = []

    # 1. Duration (pure metadata — always reliable)
    if duration_sec and duration_sec > 0:
        atoms.append({
            "type": "DURATION",
            "value": _duration_label(duration_sec),
            "confidence": CONFIDENCE_METADATA,
            "extracted_by": "metadata",
        })

    # 2. Decide which URL to use for vision analysis
    vision_url: str | None = None
    if media_type == "IMAGE" and file_url:
        vision_url = file_url
    elif thumbnail_url:
        vision_url = thumbnail_url
    elif file_url and _is_image_url(file_url):
        vision_url = file_url

    # 3. Vision analysis
    if vision_url:
        vision_atoms = await llm_client.analyze_image_url(vision_url)
        for atom_type, atom_value in vision_atoms.items():
            if atom_value and atom_value != "unknown":
                atoms.append({
                    "type": atom_type.upper(),
                    "value": atom_value,
                    "confidence": CONFIDENCE_VISION,
                    "extracted_by": "claude-vision",
                })

    # 4. Transcript analysis (VIDEO only — adds structural atoms)
    if transcript and transcript.strip() and media_type == "VIDEO":
        text_atoms = await llm_client.analyze_transcript(transcript)
        existing_types = {a["type"] for a in atoms}
        for atom_type, atom_value in text_atoms.items():
            if atom_value and atom_type.upper() not in existing_types:
                atoms.append({
                    "type": atom_type.upper(),
                    "value": atom_value,
                    "confidence": CONFIDENCE_TRANSCRIPT,
                    "extracted_by": "claude-text",
                })

    return atoms
```

```py
from __future__ import annotations

import os
from typing import Optional

from fastapi import APIRouter, Header, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel

from app.services.ai_video_service import (
    validate_provider,
    build_provider_payload,
    extract_voice_atoms,
    compute_ab_acceptance,
)

router = APIRouter()
_INTERNAL_KEY = os.getenv("INTERNAL_API_KEY", "")


def _auth(key: str | None) -> None:
    if _INTERNAL_KEY and key != _INTERNAL_KEY:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Forbidden")


class ProviderPayloadRequest(BaseModel):
    provider: str
    script_text: str
    voice_settings: dict = {}
    format_settings: dict = {}


class VoiceAtomsRequest(BaseModel):
    voice_settings: dict


class AbAcceptanceRequest(BaseModel):
    ai_conversions: int
    ai_sessions: int
    live_conversions: int
    live_sessions: int


@router.post("/provider-payload")
async def provider_payload(
    req: ProviderPayloadRequest,
    x_internal_api_key: Optional[str] = Header(None),
):
    """
    Build the provider-specific API payload for AI video generation.
    Gate: tenant must have ai_video_enabled=true (enforced in Spring Boot controller).
    """
    _auth(x_internal_api_key)

    val = validate_provider(req.provider)
    if not val["valid"]:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=val["error"])

    return build_provider_payload(
        req.provider, req.script_text, req.voice_settings, req.format_settings
    )


@router.post("/voice-atoms")
async def voice_atoms(
    req: VoiceAtomsRequest,
    x_internal_api_key: Optional[str] = Header(None),
):
    """
    Derive VOICE_TONE / VOICE_PACE / VOICE_TIMBRE atoms from voice settings.
    These atoms enter the variation stream (4-2) for A/B testing.
    """
    _auth(x_internal_api_key)
    return {"atoms": extract_voice_atoms(req.voice_settings)}


@router.post("/ab-acceptance")
async def ab_acceptance(
    req: AbAcceptanceRequest,
    x_internal_api_key: Optional[str] = Header(None),
):
    """
    Compute P(AI >= live) via Monte Carlo Beta posteriors.
    Promotion to scale allowed only on PASS (P >= 0.9 AND >= 50 sessions per arm).
    INSUFFICIENT_DATA when either arm has < 50 sessions.
    """
    _auth(x_internal_api_key)
    return compute_ab_acceptance(
        req.ai_conversions, req.ai_sessions, req.live_conversions, req.live_sessions
    )
```

```py
import uuid
import logging
import os
import httpx
from fastapi import APIRouter, BackgroundTasks, Header, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel
from typing import Optional

from app.models import creative_dna
from app.services import db_client, job_store
from app.services.fraud_l2_service import run_layer2_checks, compute_suspicious_share, check_night_hour_burst
from app.services.diagnostics_service import run_diagnostics, compute_lpv_click_gap
from app.services.calibration_service import compute_calibration_report
from app.services.segment_re_service import rank_atoms_by_segment
from app.services.ope_service import compute_ope, passes_ope_gate
from app.services.form_check_service import check_form_health

_INTERNAL_KEY = os.getenv("INTERNAL_API_KEY", "")

    viewport_h: int = 1080

class FraudShareRequest(BaseModel):

    suspicious_sessions: int

def _check_key(key: Optional[str]) -> None:
    if _INTERNAL_KEY and key != _INTERNAL_KEY:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Unauthorized")


@router.post("/fraud/layer2")
async def fraud_layer2(
    req: L2SessionData,
    x_internal_api_key: Optional[str] = Header(None, alias="X-Internal-API-Key"),
):
    """Run Fraud Layer 2 checks on a session (AUTOMATED_TIMING, LINEAR_SCROLL, etc.)."""
    _check_key(x_internal_api_key)
    return run_layer2_checks(req.dict())


@router.post("/fraud/share")
async def fraud_share(
    req: FraudShareRequest,
    x_internal_api_key: Optional[str] = Header(None, alias="X-Internal-API-Key"),
):
    """Compute share-of-suspicious sessions for a 24h window."""
    _check_key(x_internal_api_key)
    return compute_suspicious_share(
        req.total_sessions, req.suspicious_sessions, req.source_breakdown
    )


class DiagnosticsRequest(BaseModel):
    observations: list[dict]
    fdr: float = 0.10


class LpvGapRequest(BaseModel):
    page_views: int
    meta_clicks: int

@router.post("/diagnostics")
async def diagnostics_endpoint(
    req: DiagnosticsRequest,
    x_internal_api_key: Optional[str] = Header(None, alias="X-Internal-API-Key"),
):
    """Run diagnostics with BH correction per placement×device baseline (vision §3.2)."""
    _check_key(x_internal_api_key)

@router.post("/lpv-gap")
async def lpv_gap(

):

    _check_key(x_internal_api_key)
    return compute_calibration_report(req.predictions_and_actuals, req.n_buckets)


class AnalyzeCreativeRequest(BaseModel):
    tenant_id: str
    creative_id: str
    media_type: str          # "VIDEO" | "IMAGE" | "CAROUSEL"
    file_url: str | None = None
    thumbnail_url: str | None = None
    transcript: str | None = None
    duration_sec: float | None = None


class AnalyzeCreativeResponse(BaseModel):
    job_id: str
    status: str


class JobStatusResponse(BaseModel):
    job_id: str
    status: str              # queued | running | completed | failed
    atoms_count: int | None = None
    error: str | None = None


@router.post("/creative", response_model=AnalyzeCreativeResponse)
async def analyze_creative(req: AnalyzeCreativeRequest, background_tasks: BackgroundTasks):
    job_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
    await job_store.set_job(job_id, {"status": "queued", "creative_id": req.creative_id})
    background_tasks.add_task(_run_analysis, job_id, req)
    return AnalyzeCreativeResponse(job_id=job_id, status="queued")


@router.get("/status/{job_id}", response_model=JobStatusResponse)
async def get_status(job_id: str):
    data = await job_store.get_job(job_id)
    if data is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Job not found or expired")
    return JobStatusResponse(
        job_id=job_id,
        status=data["status"],
        atoms_count=data.get("atoms_count"),
        error=data.get("error"),
    )


async def _align_atoms(tenant_id: str, atoms: list[dict]) -> None:
    """Non-blocking: align each extracted atom to the taxonomy registry."""
    headers = {"X-Internal-API-Key": _INTERNAL_KEY} if _INTERNAL_KEY else {}
    try:
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=10.0) as client:
            for atom in atoms:
                atom_type = atom.get("type") or atom.get("atom_type", "")
                atom_value = atom.get("value") or atom.get("atom_value", "")
                if not atom_type or not atom_value:
                    continue
                payload = {"atom_type": atom_type, "atom_value": atom_value, "tenant_id": tenant_id}
                await client.post(f"{_ML_BASE}/taxonomy/align", json=payload, headers=headers)
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.warning("Taxonomy alignment non-critical failure: %s", exc)


async def _run_analysis(job_id: str, req: AnalyzeCreativeRequest) -> None:
    """Background task: extract atoms, write to DB, update creative status."""
    await job_store.set_job(job_id, {"status": "running", "creative_id": req.creative_id})
    try:
        atoms = await creative_dna.extract(
            media_type=req.media_type,
            file_url=req.file_url,
            thumbnail_url=req.thumbnail_url,
            transcript=req.transcript,
            duration_sec=req.duration_sec,
        )

        if atoms:
            await db_client.save_atoms(req.tenant_id, req.creative_id, atoms)
            await _align_atoms(req.tenant_id, atoms)

        await db_client.update_creative_status(req.tenant_id, req.creative_id, "ACTIVE")

        await job_store.set_job(job_id, {
            "status": "completed",
            "creative_id": req.creative_id,
            "atoms_count": len(atoms),
        })
        logger.info("Analysis completed: creative=%s atoms=%d", req.creative_id, len(atoms))

    except Exception as exc:
        logger.exception("Analysis failed for creative %s", req.creative_id)
        await db_client.update_creative_status(req.tenant_id, req.creative_id, "UPLOADED")
        await job_store.set_job(job_id, {
            "status": "failed",
            "creative_id": req.creative_id,
            "error": str(exc),
        })


# ── Segment Random Effects ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class SegmentEffectsRequest(BaseModel):

# ── OPE / IPS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class OpeRequest(BaseModel):
```

```py
"""
Anchor Creatives Market-Shock Detector router (vision §11.2; arch §15.2).
POST /anchors/divergence
"""
from fastapi import APIRouter, Header, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel
from typing import Optional
import os

from app.services.anchors_service import compute_divergence, run_divergence_scan

router = APIRouter()

_INTERNAL_KEY = os.getenv("INTERNAL_API_KEY", "dev-internal-key")


def _check_key(x_internal_api_key: Optional[str]) -> None:
    if x_internal_api_key != _INTERNAL_KEY:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Unauthorized")


class ArmStat(BaseModel):
    alpha: float
    beta: float
    baseline_alpha: float
    baseline_beta: float


class DivergenceRequest(BaseModel):
    anchor_stats: list[ArmStat]
    test_stats: list[ArmStat]
    threshold: float = 0.9
    drop_threshold: float = 0.05
    metric: str = "CTR"


class MultiMetricRequest(BaseModel):
    metrics_data: dict  # {metric: {anchors: [...], tests: [...]}}
    threshold: float = 0.9


@router.post("/divergence")
def divergence(
    req: DivergenceRequest,
    x_internal_api_key: Optional[str] = Header(None),
):
    _check_key(x_internal_api_key)
    result = compute_divergence(
        anchor_stats=[s.model_dump() for s in req.anchor_stats],
        test_stats=[s.model_dump() for s in req.test_stats],
        threshold=req.threshold,
        drop_threshold=req.drop_threshold,
    )
    result["metric"] = req.metric
    return result


@router.post("/divergence/multi")
def divergence_multi(
    req: MultiMetricRequest,
    x_internal_api_key: Optional[str] = Header(None),
):
    _check_key(x_internal_api_key)
    return run_divergence_scan(req.metrics_data, threshold=req.threshold)
```

```py
    channel_weights: Optional[dict] = None

@router.post("/run")
def run_attribution(req: AttributionRunRequest):
```
