```java
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/capi-events")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class CAPIEventController {

    private final CAPIEventLogRepository capiRepo;

    /** Recent CAPI events for this tenant — used for EMQ monitoring in the dashboard. */
    @GetMapping
    public List<CAPIEventLog> list(
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "50") int limit) {
        int cap = Math.min(limit, 200);
        return capiRepo.findByTenantIdOrderByCreatedAtDesc(
                currentTenant(), PageRequest.of(0, cap));
    }

    /** Quick summary: counts by status. */
    @GetMapping("/summary")
    public Map<String, Long> summary() {
        UUID tid = currentTenant();
        return Map.of(
                "sent",    capiRepo.countByTenantIdAndStatus(tid, "SENT"),
                "pending", capiRepo.countByTenantIdAndStatus(tid, "PENDING"),
                "failed",  capiRepo.countByTenantIdAndStatus(tid, "FAILED"),
                "skipped", capiRepo.countByTenantIdAndStatus(tid, "SKIPPED")
        );
    }

    private UUID currentTenant() {
        String raw = TenantContext.get();
        if (raw == null) throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED, "No tenant context");
        return UUID.fromString(raw);
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import com.marketingai.service.GoogleAdsApiService;
import com.marketingai.service.TikTokApiService;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.*;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * Cross-channel account management and insights sync (Phase 7).
 * Manages Google Ads and TikTok Ads channel accounts.
 */
@Slf4j
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/channels")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class ChannelController {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private final GoogleAdsApiService googleAdsApiService;
    private final TikTokApiService tikTokApiService;

    // ─── GET / — list channel accounts ───────────────────────────────────────

    @GetMapping
    public ResponseEntity<List<Map<String, Object>>> list(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId) {

        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT id, channel, account_id, name, status, token_expires_at, settings, created_at
                FROM channel_accounts
                WHERE tenant_id = ?
                ORDER BY channel, created_at
                """, tenantId);

        return ResponseEntity.ok(rows);
    }

    // ─── POST / — add channel account ────────────────────────────────────────

    @PostMapping
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> create(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {

        String channel   = (String) body.get("channel");
        String accountId = (String) body.get("account_id");
        String name      = (String) body.get("name");
        String settings  = body.getOrDefault("settings", "{}").toString();

        if (channel == null || accountId == null) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "channel and account_id are required");
        }

        UUID id = UUID.randomUUID();
        jdbc.update("""
                INSERT INTO channel_accounts (id, tenant_id, channel, account_id, name, settings)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?::jsonb)
                """, id, tenantId, channel.toUpperCase(), accountId, name, settings);

        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CREATED).body(Map.of(
                "id",         id,
                "channel",    channel.toUpperCase(),
                "account_id", accountId
        ));
    }

    // ─── DELETE /{id} — deactivate ───────────────────────────────────────────

    @DeleteMapping("/{id}")
    public ResponseEntity<Void> deactivate(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @PathVariable UUID id) {

        int updated = jdbc.update("""
                UPDATE channel_accounts SET status = 'INACTIVE'
                WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ?
                """, id, tenantId);

        if (updated == 0) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Channel account not found");
        }
        return ResponseEntity.noContent().build();
    }

    // ─── GET /{id}/campaigns ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @GetMapping("/{id}/campaigns")
    public ResponseEntity<List<Map<String, Object>>> campaigns(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @PathVariable UUID id) {

        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT cc.id, cc.channel, cc.external_id, cc.name, cc.status,
                       cc.daily_budget, cc.objective, cc.synced_at
                FROM channel_campaigns cc
                JOIN channel_accounts ca ON ca.id = cc.channel_account_id
                WHERE cc.tenant_id = ? AND ca.id = ?
                ORDER BY cc.created_at DESC
                LIMIT 200
                """, tenantId, id);

        return ResponseEntity.ok(rows);
    }

    // ─── POST /sync — sync insights from all ACTIVE accounts ─────────────────

    @PostMapping("/sync")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> sync(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId) {

        List<Map<String, Object>> accounts = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT id, channel, account_id,
                       ENCODE(access_token_enc, 'escape') AS access_token
                FROM channel_accounts
                WHERE tenant_id = ? AND status = 'ACTIVE'
                """, tenantId);

        int synced = 0;
        List<String> errors = new ArrayList<>();
        String today = LocalDate.now().toString();
        String weekAgo = LocalDate.now().minusDays(7).toString();

        for (Map<String, Object> account : accounts) {
            String channel     = (String) account.get("channel");
            String accountId   = (String) account.get("account_id");
            String accessToken = (String) account.get("access_token");
            UUID accountUuid   = (UUID) account.get("id");

            if (accessToken == null || accessToken.isBlank()) {
                errors.add(channel + ":" + accountId + " — no access token");
                continue;
            }

            try {
                List<Map<String, Object>> campaigns;
                if ("GOOGLE".equals(channel)) {
                    campaigns = googleAdsApiService.getCampaigns(accessToken, accountId);
                } else if ("TIKTOK".equals(channel)) {
                    campaigns = tikTokApiService.getCampaigns(accessToken, accountId);
                } else {
                    continue;
                }

                for (Map<String, Object> campaign : campaigns) {
                    String extId = (String) campaign.get("id");
                    String name  = (String) campaign.get("name");
                    String status = (String) campaign.get("status");

                    // Upsert campaign record
                    jdbc.update("""
                            INSERT INTO channel_campaigns
                                (tenant_id, channel_account_id, channel, external_id, name, status, synced_at)
                            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, now())
                            ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, channel, external_id)
                            DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, status = EXCLUDED.status, synced_at = now()
                            """, tenantId, accountUuid, channel, extId, name, status);

                    // Fetch and store insights
                    Map<String, ?> insights;
                    if ("GOOGLE".equals(channel)) {
                        insights = googleAdsApiService.getCampaignInsights(
                                accessToken, accountId, extId, "LAST_7_DAYS");
                    } else {
                        insights = tikTokApiService.getCampaignInsights(
                                accessToken, accountId, extId, weekAgo, today);
                    }

                    BigDecimal spend = toBigDecimal(insights.get("spend"));
                    long impressions  = toLong(insights.get("impressions"));
                    long clicks       = toLong(insights.get("clicks"));
                    long conversions  = toLong(insights.get("conversions"));

                    jdbc.update("""
                            INSERT INTO channel_insights_history
                                (tenant_id, channel, account_id, campaign_id, ad_set_id, date,
                                 spend, impressions, clicks, conversions)
                            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, NULL, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                            ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, channel, campaign_id, ad_set_id, date)
                            DO UPDATE SET spend = EXCLUDED.spend, impressions = EXCLUDED.impressions,
                                          clicks = EXCLUDED.clicks, conversions = EXCLUDED.conversions
                            """, tenantId, channel, accountId, extId, today,
                            spend, impressions, clicks, conversions);

                    synced++;
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.warn("Sync failed for {}:{} — {}", channel, accountId, e.getMessage());
                errors.add(channel + ":" + accountId + " — " + e.getMessage());
            }
        }

        Map<String, Object> result = new HashMap<>();
        result.put("synced_campaigns", synced);
        result.put("errors", errors);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(result);
    }

    private BigDecimal toBigDecimal(Object v) {
        if (v == null) return BigDecimal.ZERO;
        return new BigDecimal(v.toString());
    }

    private long toLong(Object v) {
        if (v == null) return 0L;
        if (v instanceof Number n) return n.longValue();
        return Long.parseLong(v.toString());
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import com.marketingai.entity.CircuitBreakerEvent;
import com.marketingai.repository.CircuitBreakerEventRepository;
import com.marketingai.security.TenantContext;
import com.marketingai.service.CircuitBreakerService;
import com.marketingai.service.RecoveryDiagnosisService;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Circuit Breaker visibility and resolution.
 * GET /circuit-breaker — list active events
 * POST /circuit-breaker/{id}/resolve — marketer resolves L2/L3
 * POST /circuit-breaker/check — manual trigger (for testing / on-demand)
 */
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/circuit-breaker")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class CircuitBreakerController {

    private final CircuitBreakerService cbService;
    private final CircuitBreakerEventRepository cbRepo;
    private final RecoveryDiagnosisService recoveryDiagnosisService;

    @GetMapping
    public List<CircuitBreakerEvent> listActive() {
        return cbRepo.findByTenantIdAndResolvedAtIsNull(currentTenant());
    }

    @GetMapping("/history")
    public List<CircuitBreakerEvent> history() {
        return cbRepo.findByTenantIdAndCreatedAtAfter(currentTenant(),
                java.time.Instant.now().minus(30, java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit.DAYS));
    }

    @PostMapping("/{id}/resolve")
    public CircuitBreakerEvent resolve(@PathVariable UUID id,
                                       @RequestParam(defaultValue = "marketer") String resolvedBy) {
        cbService.resolveEvent(currentTenant(), id, resolvedBy);
        return cbRepo.findById(id)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND));
    }

    @PostMapping("/check")
    public String manualCheck() {
        cbService.checkAll(currentTenant());
        return "OK";
    }

    @GetMapping("/{id}/diagnosis")
    public Map<String, Object> getDiagnosis(@PathVariable UUID id) {
        return recoveryDiagnosisService.diagnose(currentTenant(), id);
    }

    @PostMapping("/{id}/confirm-cause")
    public Map<String, String> confirmCause(@PathVariable UUID id,
                                             @RequestParam String cause) {
        recoveryDiagnosisService.confirmCause(currentTenant(), id, cause);
        return Map.of("status", "confirmed", "cause", cause);
    }

    @PostMapping("/resume-batch")
    public Map<String, Object> resumeBatch(@RequestBody List<UUID> ids) {
        int resumed = recoveryDiagnosisService.resumeBatch(currentTenant(), ids);
        return Map.of("resumed", resumed, "requested", ids.size());
    }

    private UUID currentTenant() {
        String raw = TenantContext.get();
        if (raw == null) throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED, "No tenant context");
        return UUID.fromString(raw);
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import com.marketingai.config.AppProperties;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.*;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * Behavioral Cluster endpoints (Phase 5-1, §7.3 Этап 1).
 *
 * Spring Boot stores cluster metadata in behavior_clusters and session_propensity.
 * Heavy K-means fitting is delegated to FastAPI /cluster/fit.
 * Online assignment (real-time per session) delegates to FastAPI /cluster/assign.
 *
 * Security constraints:
 *   - Only sessions with consent_level='full' and is_suspicious=false are sent to /cluster/fit
 *   - Personalisation group is enforced: 5–10% of sessions stay in 'control' (§7.4)
 */
@Slf4j
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/cluster")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class ClusterController {

    private final RestTemplate   restTemplate;
    private final AppProperties  appProperties;
    private final JdbcTemplate   jdbc;

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // GET /api/v1/cluster/labels — return stored cluster labels for tenant
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @GetMapping("/labels")
    public ResponseEntity<List<Map<String, Object>>> getClusterLabels(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId) {

        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT cluster_idx, label, hypothesis, session_count, cvr_estimate, fitted_at
                FROM behavior_clusters
                WHERE tenant_id = ?
                ORDER BY cluster_idx
                """, tenantId);

        return ResponseEntity.ok(rows);
    }

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // POST /api/v1/cluster/assign — assign one session to a cluster (real-time)
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @PostMapping("/assign")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> assignSession(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {

        String sessionId = (String) body.get("session_id");
        if (sessionId == null || sessionId.isBlank()) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "session_id required");
        }

        // Enforce consent gate (§12.1a): only full-consent sessions get personalisation
        String consentLevel = jdbc.queryForObject("""
                SELECT COALESCE(consent_level, 'none')
                FROM sessions WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ?
                """, String.class, sessionId, tenantId);

        if (!"full".equals(consentLevel)) {
            return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of(
                    "cluster_idx",  -1,
                    "rule_label",   "no_consent",
                    "block_order",  body.getOrDefault("default_block_order", List.of())
            ));
        }

        // Load stored centroids for this tenant
        List<Map<String, Object>> centroidRows = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT cluster_idx, centroid, label FROM behavior_clusters
                WHERE tenant_id = ? ORDER BY cluster_idx
                """, tenantId);

        if (centroidRows.isEmpty()) {
            return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of(
                    "cluster_idx", -1,
                    "rule_label",  "no_model",
                    "block_order", body.getOrDefault("default_block_order", List.of())
            ));
        }

        // Forward to FastAPI for online assignment
        Map<String, Object> mlBody = new HashMap<>();
        mlBody.put("tenant_id",       tenantId.toString());
        mlBody.put("session",         body.getOrDefault("session", Map.of()));
        mlBody.put("events",          body.getOrDefault("events", List.of()));
        mlBody.put("centroid_dicts",  buildCentroidDicts(centroidRows));

        HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
        headers.setContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
        headers.set("X-Internal-API-Key", appProperties.getInternalApiKey());

        String url = appProperties.getMlServiceUrl() + "/cluster/assign";
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        Map<String, Object> result = restTemplate.postForObject(
                url, new HttpEntity<>(mlBody, headers), Map.class);

        if (result == null) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_GATEWAY, "ML service returned null");
        }

        int clusterIdx = ((Number) result.getOrDefault("cluster_idx", -1)).intValue();
        String ruleLabel = (String) result.getOrDefault("rule_label", "researcher");

        // Persist cluster assignment back to sessions table
        jdbc.update("""
                UPDATE sessions SET cluster_id = ?, cluster_label = ?
                WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ?
                """, clusterIdx >= 0 ? clusterIdx : null, ruleLabel, sessionId, tenantId);

        return ResponseEntity.ok(result);
    }

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // POST /api/v1/cluster/personalise — get personalised block order
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @PostMapping("/personalise")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> personalise(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {

        String sessionId = (String) body.get("session_id");

        // Enforce personalisation control group (§7.4): 5–10% stay unPersonalised
        String group = assignPersonalisationGroup(tenantId, sessionId);
        if ("control".equals(group)) {
            return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of(
                    "cluster_idx",   -1,
                    "cluster_label", "control",
                    "block_order",   body.getOrDefault("default_block_order", List.of())
            ));
        }

        // Enforce consent gate
        if (sessionId != null) {
            try {
                String consent = jdbc.queryForObject("""
                        SELECT COALESCE(consent_level, 'none')
                        FROM sessions WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ?
                        """, String.class, sessionId, tenantId);
                if (!"full".equals(consent)) {
                    return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of(
                            "cluster_idx",   -1,
                            "cluster_label", "no_consent",
                            "block_order",   body.getOrDefault("default_block_order", List.of())
                    ));
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
                // session not found yet — proceed without consent gate
            }
        }

        List<Map<String, Object>> centroidRows = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT cluster_idx, centroid, label FROM behavior_clusters
                WHERE tenant_id = ? ORDER BY cluster_idx
                """, tenantId);

        if (centroidRows.isEmpty()) {
            return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of(
                    "cluster_idx",   -1,
                    "cluster_label", "no_model",
                    "block_order",   body.getOrDefault("default_block_order", List.of())
            ));
        }

        List<String> clusterLabels = centroidRows.stream()
                .map(r -> (String) r.getOrDefault("label", "researcher"))
                .toList();

        Map<String, Object> mlBody = new HashMap<>();
        mlBody.put("tenant_id",           tenantId.toString());
        mlBody.put("session",             body.getOrDefault("session", Map.of()));
        mlBody.put("events",              body.getOrDefault("events", List.of()));
        mlBody.put("centroid_dicts",      buildCentroidDicts(centroidRows));
        mlBody.put("cluster_labels",      clusterLabels);
        mlBody.put("default_block_order", body.getOrDefault("default_block_order", List.of()));
        mlBody.put("allowed_block_ids",   body.get("allowed_block_ids"));

        HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
        headers.setContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
        headers.set("X-Internal-API-Key", appProperties.getInternalApiKey());

        String url = appProperties.getMlServiceUrl() + "/cluster/personalise";
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        Map<String, Object> result = restTemplate.postForObject(
                url, new HttpEntity<>(mlBody, headers), Map.class);

        if (result == null) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_GATEWAY, "ML service returned null");
        }

        return ResponseEntity.ok(result);
    }

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Private helpers
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /** Unpack stored JSONB centroid column into list of feature maps. */
    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private List<Map<String, Object>> buildCentroidDicts(List<Map<String, Object>> rows) {
        List<Map<String, Object>> result = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Map<String, Object> row : rows) {
            Object centroidObj = row.get("centroid");
            if (centroidObj instanceof Map<?,?> map) {
                Map<String, Object> cd = new HashMap<>((Map<String, Object>) map);
                cd.put("_cluster_idx", ((Number) row.getOrDefault("cluster_idx", 0)).intValue());
                result.add(cd);
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    /**
     * Deterministically assign personalisation group for a session.
     * Uses hash of session_id so assignment is stable across requests.
     * Control group is ~7.5% of sessions (§7.4: 5–10%).
     */
    private String assignPersonalisationGroup(UUID tenantId, String sessionId) {
        if (sessionId == null) return "personalised";
        // Mask sign bit before mod to avoid Integer.MIN_VALUE overflow from Math.abs()
        int hash = ((tenantId.toString() + sessionId).hashCode() & Integer.MAX_VALUE) % 1000;
        return hash < 75 ? "control" : "personalised";
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Competitive Intelligence REST API (vision §9.1).
 *
 * GET  /api/v1/competitive-intel          — list alerts for the authenticated tenant
 * POST /api/v1/competitive-intel/{id}/approve  — human approves a counter-hypothesis batch
 * POST /api/v1/competitive-intel/{id}/dismiss  — marketer dismisses alert (won't re-alert)
 *
 * ⚠️ Auto-deploy without human approval is FORBIDDEN.
 *    approve() only flags the alert; test-batch launch is a separate manual action.
 */
@Slf4j
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/competitive-intel")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class CompetitiveIntelligenceController {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;

    @GetMapping
    public List<Map<String, Object>> listAlerts(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "PENDING") String status) {
        return jdbc.queryForList(
                """
                SELECT
                    a.id::text          AS id,
                    a.status,
                    a.counter_hypotheses,
                    a.created_at,
                    a.approved_at,
                    COUNT(ca.id)        AS ad_count,
                    ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT ca.page_name) AS page_names
                FROM   competitive_intel_alerts a
                JOIN   competitor_ads ca
                    ON  ca.id = ANY(a.competitor_ad_ids)
                    AND ca.tenant_id = a.tenant_id
                WHERE  a.tenant_id = ?
                  AND  a.status    = ?
                GROUP  BY a.id, a.status, a.counter_hypotheses, a.created_at, a.approved_at
                ORDER  BY a.created_at DESC
                LIMIT  50
                """,
                tenantId, status
        );
    }

    @GetMapping("/{alertId}/ads")
    public List<Map<String, Object>> getAlertAds(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @PathVariable UUID alertId) {
        return jdbc.queryForList(
                """
                SELECT
                    ca.id::text     AS id,
                    ca.meta_ad_id,
                    ca.page_name,
                    ca.ad_title,
                    ca.ad_body,
                    ca.snapshot_url,
                    ca.run_days,
                    ca.atoms_extracted
                FROM   competitor_ads ca
                JOIN   competitive_intel_alerts a
                    ON  ca.id = ANY(a.competitor_ad_ids)
                    AND a.tenant_id = ca.tenant_id
                WHERE  a.id        = ?
                  AND  a.tenant_id = ?
                """,
                alertId, tenantId
        );
    }

    /**
     * Human approval — marks alert APPROVED.
     * ⚠️ This does NOT auto-launch a test batch. The marketer must manually
     * create a campaign using the approved counter-hypotheses.
     */
    @PostMapping("/{alertId}/approve")
    public Map<String, Object> approve(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestAttribute("userId")   UUID userId,
            @PathVariable UUID alertId) {

        int updated = jdbc.update(
                """
                UPDATE competitive_intel_alerts
                SET status = 'APPROVED', approved_by = ?, approved_at = now()
                WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ? AND status = 'PENDING'
                """,
                userId, alertId, tenantId
        );
        if (updated == 0) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
                    "Alert not found, already actioned, or not owned by tenant");
        }
        log.info("CI alert {} approved by user {} (tenant {})", alertId, userId, tenantId);
        return Map.of(
                "id", alertId,
                "status", "APPROVED",
                "message", "Counter-hypotheses approved for review. Launch the test batch manually."
        );
    }

    @PostMapping("/{alertId}/dismiss")
    public Map<String, Object> dismiss(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @PathVariable UUID alertId) {

        int updated = jdbc.update(
                """
                UPDATE competitive_intel_alerts
                SET status = 'DISMISSED'
                WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ? AND status = 'PENDING'
                """,
                alertId, tenantId
        );
        if (updated == 0) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
                    "Alert not found, already actioned, or not owned by tenant");
        }
        return Map.of("id", alertId, "status", "DISMISSED");
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import com.marketingai.entity.ComplianceCheck;
import com.marketingai.service.ComplianceService;
import com.marketingai.service.MlServiceClient;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * Compliance API — generic text checks + securities rulebases (vision §19.5).
 */
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/compliance")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class ComplianceController {

    private final ComplianceService complianceService;
    private final MlServiceClient mlClient;
    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;

    private UUID currentTenant() {
        return UUID.fromString(SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication().getName());
    }

    // ─── Generic text compliance ─────────────────────────────────────────────

    @PostMapping("/check")
    public ResponseEntity<ComplianceCheck> check(@RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {
        String entityType = (String) body.get("entity_type");
        UUID entityId = UUID.fromString((String) body.get("entity_id"));
        String text = (String) body.get("text");
        return ResponseEntity.ok(complianceService.runTextCheck(entityType, entityId, text));
    }

    @GetMapping("/{entityId}")
    public ResponseEntity<List<ComplianceCheck>> getChecks(@PathVariable UUID entityId) {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(complianceService.getChecks(entityId));
    }

    @PutMapping("/{id}/override")
    public ResponseEntity<ComplianceCheck> override(
            @PathVariable UUID id,
            @RequestBody Map<String, String> body) {
        UUID overriderId = UUID.fromString(
                SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication().getName());
        String reason = body.get("reason");
        return ResponseEntity.ok(complianceService.override(id, overriderId, reason));
    }

    // ─── Rulebases (platform-wide) ───────────────────────────────────────────

    @GetMapping("/rulebases")
    public ResponseEntity<List<Map<String, Object>>> getRulebases() {
        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbc.queryForList(
                "SELECT rulebase_key, description, rules, updated_at FROM compliance_rulebases ORDER BY rulebase_key");
        return ResponseEntity.ok(rows);
    }

    @GetMapping("/rulebases/{key}")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> getRulebase(@PathVariable String key) {
        try {
            Map<String, Object> row = jdbc.queryForMap(
                    "SELECT rulebase_key, description, rules, updated_at FROM compliance_rulebases WHERE rulebase_key = ?", key);
            return ResponseEntity.ok(row);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return ResponseEntity.notFound().build();
        }
    }

    // ─── Approved phrases ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @GetMapping("/approved-phrases")
    public ResponseEntity<List<Map<String, Object>>> getApprovedPhrases() {
        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbc.queryForList(
                "SELECT id, phrase, context, approved_at FROM approved_phrases WHERE tenant_id = ? ORDER BY approved_at DESC",
                currentTenant());
        return ResponseEntity.ok(rows);
    }

    @PostMapping("/approved-phrases")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> addApprovedPhrase(@RequestBody Map<String, String> body) {
        String phrase = body.get("phrase");
        if (phrase == null || phrase.isBlank()) {
            return ResponseEntity.badRequest().body(Map.of("error", "phrase required"));
        }
        String context = body.getOrDefault("context", "");
        UUID approvedBy = currentTenant();

        UUID id = UUID.randomUUID();
        jdbc.update("""
            INSERT INTO approved_phrases (id, tenant_id, phrase, context, approved_by, approved_at)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, phrase) DO UPDATE
                SET context = EXCLUDED.context,
                    approved_by = EXCLUDED.approved_by,
                    approved_at = EXCLUDED.approved_at
            """, id, currentTenant(), phrase, context, approvedBy, Instant.now());
        return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of("id", id.toString(), "status", "saved"));
    }

    // ─── Pre-check (proxy to ML service) ─────────────────────────────────────

    /**
     * Run text against one or more named rulebases via ML service.
     * Loads rulebase rules from DB, proxies to /compliance/check in ML service.
     */
    @PostMapping("/pre-check")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> preCheck(@RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {
        String text = (String) body.get("text");
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        List<String> rulebases = (List<String>) body.getOrDefault("rulebases", List.of("META_FINANCIAL", "META_PERSONAL_ATTR"));

        if (text == null || text.isBlank()) {
            return ResponseEntity.badRequest().body(Map.of("error", "text required"));
        }

        Map<String, Object> rules = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (String rk : rulebases) {
            try {
                String json = jdbc.queryForObject(
                        "SELECT rules FROM compliance_rulebases WHERE rulebase_key = ?",
                        String.class, rk);
                if (json != null) rules.put(rk, json);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }

        Map<String, Object> mlReq = Map.of("text", text, "rulebases", rules);
        try {
            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
            Map<String, Object> result = mlClient.post("/compliance/check", mlReq, Map.class);
            return ResponseEntity.ok(result);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return ResponseEntity.internalServerError().body(
                    Map.of("error", "ML service unavailable", "detail", e.getMessage()));
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import com.marketingai.security.TenantContext;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Consent analytics endpoint — admin dashboard (§12.1a).
 * Shows how many visitors accepted / refused tracking.
 *
 * Used by the marketer to understand:
 *  - What % of traffic is trackable (full consent)
 *  - Whether GDPR opt-outs are distorting model inputs
 *  - No-consent sessions are NEVER treated as bounces (vision §12.1a note)
 */
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/consent")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class ConsentController {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;

    /** Consent level breakdown by time window for this tenant. */
    @GetMapping("/stats")
    public Map<String, Object> stats() {
        UUID tid = currentTenant();
        return Map.of(
                "last_24h", consentBreakdown(tid, "24 hours"),
                "last_7d",  consentBreakdown(tid, "7 days")
        );
    }

    private Map<String, Object> consentBreakdown(UUID tenantId, String interval) {
        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT
                    COALESCE(consent_level, 'unknown')     AS consent_level,
                    COUNT(*)                               AS sessions
                FROM sessions
                WHERE tenant_id = ?
                  AND started_at > now() - CAST(? AS INTERVAL)
                GROUP BY consent_level
                ORDER BY sessions DESC
                """, tenantId, interval);

        long total = rows.stream()
                .mapToLong(r -> ((Number) r.get("sessions")).longValue())
                .sum();

        long fullConsent = rows.stream()
                .filter(r -> "full".equals(r.get("consent_level")))
                .mapToLong(r -> ((Number) r.get("sessions")).longValue())
                .sum();

        double consentRate = total > 0 ? Math.round(1000.0 * fullConsent / total) / 10.0 : 0.0;

        return Map.of(
                "total",          total,
                "full_consent",   fullConsent,
                "consent_rate_pct", consentRate,
                "breakdown",      rows
        );
    }

    private UUID currentTenant() {
        String raw = TenantContext.get();
        if (raw == null) throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED, "No tenant context");
        return UUID.fromString(raw);
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import com.marketingai.config.AppProperties;
import com.marketingai.repository.ProductFactRepository;
import com.marketingai.security.TenantContext;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.HttpEntity;
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

@Slf4j
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/landings")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class ContentGenerationController {

    private final RestTemplate restTemplate;
    private final AppProperties appProperties;
    private final ProductFactRepository factRepo;

    @PostMapping("/{variantId}/generate")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> generate(
            @PathVariable UUID variantId,
            @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {

        UUID tenantId = UUID.fromString(TenantContext.get());

        List<String> facts = factRepo.findByTenantIdOrderByCreatedAtDesc(tenantId)
                .stream().map(f -> f.getFact()).toList();

        Map<String, Object> req = new HashMap<>(body);
        req.put("tenant_id", tenantId.toString());
        req.putIfAbsent("product_facts", facts);

        HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
        headers.setContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
        headers.set("X-Internal-API-Key", appProperties.getInternalApiKey());

        try {
            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
            Map<String, Object> result = restTemplate.postForObject(
                    appProperties.getMlServiceUrl() + "/content/generate",
                    new HttpEntity<>(req, headers), Map.class);
            return ResponseEntity.ok(result != null ? result : Map.of());
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            log.error("content generation failed for variant {}: {}", variantId, ex.getMessage());
            return ResponseEntity.internalServerError().body(Map.of("error", ex.getMessage()));
        }
    }

    @PostMapping("/{variantId}/match-score")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> matchScore(
            @PathVariable UUID variantId,
            @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {

        HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
        headers.setContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
        headers.set("X-Internal-API-Key", appProperties.getInternalApiKey());

        try {
            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
            Map<String, Object> result = restTemplate.postForObject(
                    appProperties.getMlServiceUrl() + "/content/match-score",
                    new HttpEntity<>(body, headers), Map.class);
            return ResponseEntity.ok(result != null ? result : Map.of());
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            log.error("match-score failed for variant {}: {}", variantId, ex.getMessage());
            return ResponseEntity.internalServerError().body(Map.of("error", ex.getMessage()));
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import com.marketingai.config.AppProperties;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.*;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * CPM Cost Model endpoints (4-6).
 * Delegates Bayesian regression + LightGBM second opinion to FastAPI POST /predict/cpm.
 * Used in 3-23 profit-per-impression before launch for new creatives.
 */
@Slf4j
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/predict/cpm")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class CpmController {

    private final RestTemplate restTemplate;
    private final AppProperties appProperties;
    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;

    /**
     * Estimate CPM for a creative before launch.
     * Query params: creative_id (optional), placement, calendar_tags (comma-separated), cpm_index
     * Delegates to FastAPI /predict/cpm with atom list loaded from DB.
     */
    @GetMapping
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> estimateCpm(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestParam(required = false) UUID creativeId,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "FEED") String placement,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "") String calendarTags,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "0.0") double cpmIndex) {

        List<String> atoms = Collections.emptyList();
        if (creativeId != null) {
            atoms = jdbc.queryForList("""
                    SELECT atom_value
                    FROM creative_atoms
                    WHERE creative_id = ?
                    ORDER BY created_at
                    """, String.class, creativeId);
        }

        // Build ML request
        List<String> calendarList = calendarTags.isBlank()
                ? Collections.emptyList()
                : Arrays.asList(calendarTags.split(","));

        Map<String, Object> mlReq = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        mlReq.put("atoms", atoms);
        mlReq.put("placement", placement);
        mlReq.put("calendar_tags", calendarList);
        mlReq.put("cpm_index", cpmIndex);

        HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
        headers.setContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
        headers.set("X-Internal-API-Key", appProperties.getInternalApiKey());

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        Map<String, Object> mlResult;
        try {
            mlResult = restTemplate.postForObject(
                    appProperties.getMlServiceUrl() + "/predict/cpm",
                    new HttpEntity<>(mlReq, headers), Map.class);
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            log.warn("CPM service unavailable: {}", ex.getMessage());
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_GATEWAY, "CPM service unavailable");
        }

        if (mlResult == null) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_GATEWAY, "CPM service returned null");
        }

        Map<String, Object> resp = new LinkedHashMap<>(mlResult);
        resp.put("creative_id", creativeId);
        resp.put("tenant_id", tenantId);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(resp);
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import com.marketingai.dto.creative.CreativeAtomResponse;
import com.marketingai.dto.creative.CreativeResponse;
import com.marketingai.dto.creative.UpdateAtomRequest;
import com.marketingai.service.CreativeService;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;

import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/creatives")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class CreativeController {

    private final CreativeService creativeService;

    /** GET /creatives?type=VIDEO */
    @GetMapping
    public List<CreativeResponse> list(@RequestParam(required = false) String type) {
        return creativeService.list(type);
    }

    /** GET /creatives/{id} — includes atoms */
    @GetMapping("/{id}")
    public CreativeResponse get(@PathVariable UUID id) {
        return creativeService.get(id);
    }

    /**
     * POST /creatives — multipart/form-data
     * Fields: type (required), title, externalId, metaAdSetId, fileUrl, file
     */
    @PostMapping(consumes = MediaType.MULTIPART_FORM_DATA_VALUE)
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED)
    public CreativeResponse create(
            @RequestParam("type") String type,
            @RequestParam(value = "title", required = false) String title,
            @RequestParam(value = "externalId", required = false) String externalId,
            @RequestParam(value = "metaAdSetId", required = false) String metaAdSetId,
            @RequestParam(value = "fileUrl", required = false) String fileUrl,
            @RequestPart(value = "file", required = false) MultipartFile file) {
        return creativeService.create(type, title, externalId, metaAdSetId, fileUrl, file);
    }

    /**
     * PUT /creatives/{id} — update metadata (title, externalId, transcript, etc.)
     * Accepts JSON body.
     */
    @PutMapping("/{id}")
    public CreativeResponse update(
            @PathVariable UUID id,
            @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {
        return creativeService.update(
                id,
                (String) body.get("title"),
                (String) body.get("externalId"),
                (String) body.get("metaAdSetId"),
                (String) body.get("transcript"),
                body.get("durationSec") != null ? ((Number) body.get("durationSec")).floatValue() : null
        );
    }

    /** POST /creatives/{id}/analyze — trigger Creative DNA extraction */
    @PostMapping("/{id}/analyze")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, String>> analyze(@PathVariable UUID id) {
        String jobId = creativeService.triggerAnalysis(id);
        return ResponseEntity.accepted().body(Map.of("jobId", jobId, "status", "queued"));
    }

    /** PUT /creatives/{id}/anchor — toggle anchor flag */
    @PutMapping("/{id}/anchor")
    public CreativeResponse toggleAnchor(@PathVariable UUID id) {
        return creativeService.toggleAnchor(id);
    }

    /** DELETE /creatives/{id} — archive (soft delete) */
    @DeleteMapping("/{id}")
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT)
    public void archive(@PathVariable UUID id) {
        creativeService.archive(id);
    }

    // ─── Atom endpoints ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /** POST /creatives/{id}/atoms — add atom manually */
    @PostMapping("/{id}/atoms")
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED)
    public CreativeAtomResponse addAtom(@PathVariable UUID id, @Valid @RequestBody UpdateAtomRequest req) {
        return creativeService.addAtom(id, req);
    }

    /** PUT /creatives/{id}/atoms/{atomId} — update atom */
    @PutMapping("/{id}/atoms/{atomId}")
    public CreativeAtomResponse updateAtom(@PathVariable UUID id,
                                           @PathVariable UUID atomId,
                                           @Valid @RequestBody UpdateAtomRequest req) {
        return creativeService.updateAtom(id, atomId, req);
    }

    /** DELETE /creatives/{id}/atoms/{atomId} — remove atom */

    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT)

        creativeService.deleteAtom(id, atomId);
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * 8-11: Creative Production & Exploration Set-up (vision §19.10).
 * Import client dashboard labels as informed priors; manage creative aliases.
 */
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/creative-setup")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Slf4j
public class CreativeSetupController {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;

    /**
     * Bulk-import client labels: winner → Beta(5,1), loser → Beta(1,5),
     * questionable → Beta(2,2). Unknown labels default to Beta(1,1).
     *
     * Body: { "entries": [ { "creative_id": "...", "client_label": "winner" }, ... ] }
     */
    @PostMapping("/import-labels")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> importLabels(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        List<Map<String, Object>> entries =
            (List<Map<String, Object>>) body.getOrDefault("entries", List.of());

        int updated = 0;
        for (Map<String, Object> entry : entries) {
            String rawId = (String) entry.get("creative_id");
            String label = (String) entry.getOrDefault("client_label", "");
            if (rawId == null) continue;

            UUID creativeId;
            try { creativeId = UUID.fromString(rawId); } catch (Exception e) { continue; }

            double alpha = 1.0, beta = 1.0;
            switch (label.toLowerCase()) {
                case "winner"       -> { alpha = 5.0; beta  = 1.0; }
                case "loser"        -> { alpha = 1.0; beta  = 5.0; }
                case "questionable" -> { alpha = 2.0; beta  = 2.0; }
            }

            int rows = jdbc.update("""
                UPDATE creatives
                SET client_label = ?, informed_prior_alpha = ?, informed_prior_beta = ?
                WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ?
                """, label.toLowerCase(), alpha, beta, creativeId, tenantId);
            updated += rows;
        }

        return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of("imported", entries.size(), "updated", updated));
    }

    /**
     * List creatives with their informed priors and graveyard status.
     * Useful for confirming import results.
     */
    @GetMapping("/labels")
    public ResponseEntity<List<Map<String, Object>>> listLabels(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId) {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(jdbc.queryForList("""
            SELECT c.id, c.name, c.client_label,
                   c.informed_prior_alpha, c.informed_prior_beta,
                   g.id IS NOT NULL AS in_graveyard, g.reason AS graveyard_reason
            FROM creatives c
            LEFT JOIN graveyard_entries g
                ON g.creative_id = c.id AND g.tenant_id = c.tenant_id
            WHERE c.tenant_id = ?
            ORDER BY c.client_label NULLS LAST, c.name
            """, tenantId));
    }

    // ── Creative Aliases ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @GetMapping("/aliases")
    public ResponseEntity<List<Map<String, Object>>> listAliases(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestParam(required = false) UUID creativeId) {
        if (creativeId != null) {
            return ResponseEntity.ok(jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT id, creative_id, alias_type, label, notes, created_at
                FROM creative_aliases
                WHERE tenant_id = ? AND creative_id = ?
                ORDER BY created_at
                """, tenantId, creativeId));
        }
        return ResponseEntity.ok(jdbc.queryForList("""
            SELECT id, creative_id, alias_type, label, notes, created_at
            FROM creative_aliases
            WHERE tenant_id = ?
            ORDER BY creative_id, created_at
            """, tenantId));
    }

    @PostMapping("/aliases")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> createAlias(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {
        String rawCreativeId = (String) body.get("creative_id");
        String aliasType     = (String) body.getOrDefault("alias_type", "hook_variant");
        String label         = (String) body.getOrDefault("label", "");
        String notes         = (String) body.get("notes");

        if (rawCreativeId == null || label.isBlank())
            return ResponseEntity.badRequest().build();

        UUID creativeId;
        try { creativeId = UUID.fromString(rawCreativeId); }
        catch (Exception e) { return ResponseEntity.badRequest().build(); }

        // Verify creative belongs to this tenant
        Integer count = jdbc.queryForObject(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM creatives WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ?",
            Integer.class, creativeId, tenantId);
        if (count == null || count == 0)
            return ResponseEntity.notFound().build();

        UUID id = UUID.randomUUID();
        jdbc.update("""
            INSERT INTO creative_aliases (id, tenant_id, creative_id, alias_type, label, notes)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            """, id, tenantId, creativeId, aliasType, label, notes);

        return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of("id", id.toString(), "created", true));
    }

    // ── Graveyard Entry (wrapper for Phase 3-17) ───────────────────────────────

    /**
     * Adds a graveyard entry for a blocked/disabled creative with a reason.
     * Assumes graveyard_entries table exists from earlier phase.
     */
    @PostMapping("/graveyard-entry")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> addGraveyardEntry(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {
        String rawCreativeId = (String) body.get("creative_id");
        String reason        = (String) body.getOrDefault("reason", "blocked_by_client");
        String notes         = (String) body.get("notes");

        if (rawCreativeId == null)
            return ResponseEntity.badRequest().build();

        UUID creativeId;
        try { creativeId = UUID.fromString(rawCreativeId); }
        catch (Exception e) { return ResponseEntity.badRequest().build(); }

        // creative_postmortems is the graveyard table (Phase 6-5)
        String analysis = "{\"source\":\"client_label_import\",\"reason\":\"" + reason + "\"}";
        jdbc.update("""
            INSERT INTO creative_postmortems
                (tenant_id, creative_id, failure_mode, cvr, benchmark_cvr, sessions, analysis, postmortem_md)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, 0, 0, 0, ?::jsonb, ?)
            ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
            """, tenantId, creativeId, reason, analysis, notes);

        return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of("created", true));
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * GDPR Right to Erasure — POST /api/v1/privacy/erasure
 * Deletes all data tied to a subject (by crm_user_id or external_id_hash).
 */
@Slf4j
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/privacy")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class ErasureController {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private static final ObjectMapper MAPPER = new ObjectMapper();

    @PostMapping("/erasure")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> requestErasure(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestBody Map<String, String> body) {

        String subjectKeyType = body.get("subject_key_type");
        String subjectKey     = body.get("subject_key");

        if (subjectKey == null || subjectKey.isBlank()) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "subject_key is required");
        }
        if (!"CRM_USER_ID".equals(subjectKeyType) && !"EXTERNAL_ID_HASH".equals(subjectKeyType)) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                    "subject_key_type must be CRM_USER_ID or EXTERNAL_ID_HASH");
        }

        String idColumn = "CRM_USER_ID".equals(subjectKeyType) ? "crm_user_id" : "external_id_hash";

        List<UUID> sessionIds = jdbc.queryForList(
                "SELECT id FROM sessions WHERE tenant_id = ? AND " + idColumn + " = ?",
                UUID.class, tenantId, subjectKey);

        int deletedEvents = 0, deletedDecisions = 0, deletedSessions = 0;

        if (!sessionIds.isEmpty()) {
            String placeholders = sessionIds.stream().map(id -> "?").collect(Collectors.joining(","));

            Object[] eventsArgs = new Object[1 + sessionIds.size()];
            eventsArgs[0] = tenantId;
            for (int i = 0; i < sessionIds.size(); i++) eventsArgs[i + 1] = sessionIds.get(i);

            deletedEvents = jdbc.update(
                    "DELETE FROM events WHERE tenant_id = ? AND session_id IN (" + placeholders + ")",
                    eventsArgs);

            deletedDecisions = jdbc.update(
                    "DELETE FROM decision_log WHERE tenant_id = ? AND session_id IN (" + placeholders + ")",
                    eventsArgs);

            jdbc.update(
                    "UPDATE ghl_webhook_log SET payload = '{\"redacted\":true}'::jsonb WHERE tenant_id = ? AND ghl_contact_id = ?",
                    tenantId, subjectKey);

            deletedSessions = jdbc.update(
                    "DELETE FROM sessions WHERE tenant_id = ? AND " + idColumn + " = ?",
                    tenantId, subjectKey);
        }

        Map<String, Integer> rowsDeleted = Map.of(
                "sessions", deletedSessions,
                "events", deletedEvents,
                "decision_log", deletedDecisions);

        String keyHash = subjectKey.length() > 8 ? subjectKey.substring(0, 8) + "..." : subjectKey;
        try {
            jdbc.update("""
                    INSERT INTO erasure_requests (tenant_id, subject_key_type, subject_key_hash, completed_at, rows_deleted)
                    VALUES (?, ?, ?, now(), ?::jsonb)
                    """,
                    tenantId, subjectKeyType, keyHash, MAPPER.writeValueAsString(rowsDeleted));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.warn("Failed to write erasure audit record: {}", e.getMessage());
        }

        log.info("Erasure completed: tenant={} type={} sessions={} events={} decisions={}",
                tenantId, subjectKeyType, deletedSessions, deletedEvents, deletedDecisions);

        return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of(
                "status", "completed",
                "rows_deleted", rowsDeleted,
                "sessions_found", sessionIds.size()));
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import com.marketingai.dto.event.EventBatchRequest;
import com.marketingai.dto.event.EventBatchResponse;
import com.marketingai.service.EventIngestionService;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/events")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class EventController {

    private final EventIngestionService ingestionService;

    /**
     * Public endpoint — called by tracker.ts from landing pages.
     * No JWT required; tenant_id is embedded in each event by the tracker.
     *
     * Headers used for fraud scoring (Phase 0-6):
     *  CF-Connecting-IP / X-Forwarded-For → real visitor IP
     *  User-Agent                         → bot detection
     *  CF-Bot-Score                        → Cloudflare bot confidence (0-99, lower = more bot)
     */
    @PostMapping
    public ResponseEntity<EventBatchResponse> ingest(
            @Valid @RequestBody EventBatchRequest req,
            HttpServletRequest httpRequest) {

        String ip         = resolveIp(httpRequest);
        String userAgent  = httpRequest.getHeader("User-Agent");
        Integer cfBotScore = parseCfBotScore(httpRequest.getHeader("CF-Bot-Score"));

        EventBatchResponse response = ingestionService.ingest(
                req.getEvents(), ip, userAgent, cfBotScore);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(response);
    }

    /** Cloudflare sets CF-Connecting-IP; behind nginx use X-Forwarded-For. */
    private String resolveIp(HttpServletRequest req) {
        String cf = req.getHeader("CF-Connecting-IP");
        if (cf != null && !cf.isBlank()) return cf.trim();

        String xff = req.getHeader("X-Forwarded-For");
        if (xff != null && !xff.isBlank()) {
            // XFF can be a comma-separated list; first entry = original client
            return xff.split(",")[0].trim();
        }
        return req.getRemoteAddr();
    }

    private Integer parseCfBotScore(String header) {
        if (header == null || header.isBlank()) return null;
        try {
            return Integer.parseInt(header.trim());
        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            return null;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.*;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * Evolutionary Creative Generation API (Phase 6-4).
 * Generates, approves, and tracks evolved creative candidates.
 */
@Slf4j
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/evolve")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class EvolveController {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private final RestTemplate restTemplate;

    // ─── POST /generate ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @PostMapping("/generate")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> generate(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {

        // Load top arms with atoms from DB
        List<Map<String, Object>> arms = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT ta.id::text AS id, ta.alpha, ta.beta, c.atoms
                FROM thompson_arms ta
                JOIN creatives c ON c.id = ta.creative_id
                WHERE ta.tenant_id = ?
                  AND ta.alpha + ta.beta >= 50
                ORDER BY ta.alpha / (ta.alpha + ta.beta) DESC
                LIMIT 10
                """, tenantId);

        if (arms.size() < 2) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.PRECONDITION_FAILED,
                    "Need at least 2 arms with ≥50 trials to evolve");
        }

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        List<Map<String, Object>> atomPool = (List<Map<String, Object>>) body.getOrDefault("atom_pool", List.of());
        int nCandidates = body.containsKey("n_candidates")
                ? ((Number) body.get("n_candidates")).intValue() : 5;

        Map<String, Object> mlReq = Map.of(
                "arms",          arms,
                "atom_pool",     atomPool,
                "n_candidates",  nCandidates,
                "mutation_rate", body.getOrDefault("mutation_rate", 0.15)
        );

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        Map<String, Object> mlResult = restTemplate.postForObject(
                "http://ml-service:8001/evolve/candidates", mlReq, Map.class);

        if (mlResult == null) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_GATEWAY, "ML service unavailable");
        }

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        List<Map<String, Object>> candidates = (List<Map<String, Object>>) mlResult.get("candidates");
        List<String> savedIds = new ArrayList<>();

        if (candidates != null) {
            for (Map<String, Object> c : candidates) {
                String id = jdbc.queryForObject("""
                        INSERT INTO evolution_candidates
                            (tenant_id, parent_a_id, parent_b_id, atoms, status)
                        VALUES (?, ?::uuid, ?::uuid, ?::jsonb, 'PROPOSED')
                        RETURNING id::text
                        """,
                        String.class,
                        tenantId,
                        c.getOrDefault("parent_ids[0]", null),
                        c.getOrDefault("parent_ids[1]", null),
                        c.getOrDefault("atoms", "[]").toString());
                savedIds.add(id);
            }
        }

        return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of("candidate_ids", savedIds, "count", savedIds.size()));
    }

    // ─── GET /candidates ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @GetMapping("/candidates")
    public ResponseEntity<List<Map<String, Object>>> candidates(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "PROPOSED") String status) {

        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT id, parent_a_id, parent_b_id, atoms, status, created_at
                FROM evolution_candidates
                WHERE tenant_id = ? AND status = ?
                ORDER BY created_at DESC
                LIMIT 50
                """, tenantId, status);

        return ResponseEntity.ok(rows);
    }

    // ─── POST /{id}/approve ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @PostMapping("/{id}/approve")
    public ResponseEntity<Void> approve(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @PathVariable UUID id,
            @RequestAttribute("userId") UUID userId) {

        int updated = jdbc.update("""
                UPDATE evolution_candidates
                SET status = 'APPROVED', approved_by = ?, approved_at = now(), updated_at = now()
                WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ? AND status = 'PROPOSED'
                """, userId, id, tenantId);

        if (updated == 0) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Candidate not found or not in PROPOSED state");
        }
        return ResponseEntity.noContent().build();
    }

    // ─── POST /{id}/reject ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @PostMapping("/{id}/reject")
    public ResponseEntity<Void> reject(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @PathVariable UUID id) {

        int updated = jdbc.update("""
                UPDATE evolution_candidates
                SET status = 'REJECTED', updated_at = now()
                WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ? AND status = 'PROPOSED'
                """, id, tenantId);

        if (updated == 0) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Candidate not found or not in PROPOSED state");
        }
        return ResponseEntity.noContent().build();
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import com.marketingai.service.ExperimentService;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;

import java.util.*;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/experiments")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class ExperimentController {

    private final ExperimentService experimentService;
    private final JdbcTemplate      jdbc;

    @GetMapping
    public ResponseEntity<List<Map<String, Object>>> list(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String status) {
        String sql = "SELECT * FROM experiments WHERE tenant_id = ?";
        List<Object> params = new ArrayList<>(List.of((Object) tenantId));
        if (status != null) { sql += " AND status = ?"; params.add(status); }
        sql += " ORDER BY created_at DESC";
        return ResponseEntity.ok(jdbc.queryForList(sql, params.toArray()));
    }

    @PostMapping
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> create(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestAttribute("userId")   UUID userId,
            @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {
        UUID id = experimentService.createExperiment(tenantId, userId, body);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of("id", id));
    }

    @PostMapping("/{id}/submit")
    public ResponseEntity<Void> submit(
            @PathVariable UUID id,
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId) {
        experimentService.submitForReview(tenantId, id);
        return ResponseEntity.ok().build();
    }

    @PostMapping("/{id}/approve")
    public ResponseEntity<Void> approve(
            @PathVariable UUID id,
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestAttribute("userId")   UUID userId) {
        experimentService.approve(tenantId, id, userId);
        return ResponseEntity.ok().build();
    }

    @PostMapping("/{id}/start")
    public ResponseEntity<Void> start(
            @PathVariable UUID id,
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId) {
        experimentService.start(tenantId, id);
        return ResponseEntity.ok().build();
    }

    @GetMapping("/{id}/results")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> results(
            @PathVariable UUID id,
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId) {
        Map<String, Object> exp = jdbc.queryForMap(
            "SELECT * FROM experiments WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ?", id, tenantId);
        List<Map<String, Object>> arms = jdbc.queryForList("""
            SELECT lv.id AS variant_id, lv.name, lv.is_control, lv.status,
                   COALESCE(ta.alpha, 1.0) AS alpha, COALESCE(ta.beta, 1.0) AS beta
            FROM landing_variants lv
            LEFT JOIN thompson_arms ta ON ta.variant_id = lv.id AND ta.tenant_id = ?
                AND ta.reward_event = 'quality_gate_pass'
            WHERE lv.experiment_id = ?
            ORDER BY lv.is_control DESC
            """, tenantId, id);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of("experiment", exp, "arms", arms));
    }

    @GetMapping("/{id}/events")
    public ResponseEntity<List<Map<String, Object>>> events(
            @PathVariable UUID id,
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId) {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(jdbc.queryForList("""
            SELECT * FROM experiment_events
            WHERE experiment_id = ? AND tenant_id = ?
            ORDER BY created_at DESC
            """, id, tenantId));
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import com.marketingai.security.TenantContext;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Expert ratings for creatives (3-17 autonomy levels).
 * POST /api/v1/creatives/{id}/expert-rating — submit a rating
 * GET  /api/v1/creatives/{id}/expert-rating — list ratings
 */
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/creatives")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class ExpertRatingController {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;

    record RatingRequest(int rating, boolean veto, String reason) {}

    @PostMapping("/{id}/expert-rating")
    public Map<String, Object> submitRating(
            @PathVariable UUID id,
            @RequestBody RatingRequest body) {
        UUID tenantId = currentTenant();

        if (body.rating() < 1 || body.rating() > 5) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "rating must be 1-5");
        }

        UUID ratingId = UUID.randomUUID();
        jdbc.update("""
                INSERT INTO expert_ratings (id, tenant_id, entity_type, entity_id, rating, veto, reason, created_at)
                VALUES (?, ?, 'CREATIVE', ?, ?, ?, ?, now())
                """, ratingId, tenantId, id, body.rating(), body.veto(), body.reason());

        return Map.of(
                "id", ratingId,
                "creative_id", id,
                "rating", body.rating(),
                "veto", body.veto(),
                "reason", body.reason() != null ? body.reason() : ""
        );
    }

    @GetMapping("/{id}/expert-rating")
    public List<Map<String, Object>> listRatings(@PathVariable UUID id) {
        UUID tenantId = currentTenant();
        return jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT id, entity_id AS creative_id, rating, veto, reason, rated_by, created_at
                FROM expert_ratings
                WHERE tenant_id = ? AND entity_type = 'CREATIVE' AND entity_id = ?
                ORDER BY created_at DESC
                """, tenantId, id);
    }

    private UUID currentTenant() {
        String raw = TenantContext.get();
        if (raw == null) throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED, "No tenant context");
        return UUID.fromString(raw);
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import com.marketingai.scheduler.ExternalSignalsScheduler;
import com.marketingai.security.TenantContext;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * External Signals + Event Calendar API (3-12).
 * GET  /api/v1/signals/calendar
 * POST /api/v1/signals/calendar
 */
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/signals")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class ExternalSignalsController {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private final ExternalSignalsScheduler scheduler;

    record CalendarEventRequest(
            String name, String tag,
            String starts_on, String ends_on,
            String geo, String expected_effect) {}

    @GetMapping("/calendar")
    public List<Map<String, Object>> getCalendar(
            @RequestParam(required = false) String from,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String to) {
        UUID tenantId = currentTenant();

        LocalDate fromDate = from != null ? LocalDate.parse(from) : LocalDate.now().minusDays(30);
        LocalDate toDate   = to   != null ? LocalDate.parse(to)   : LocalDate.now().plusDays(90);

        return jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT id, tenant_id, name, tag, starts_on, ends_on, geo, expected_effect, created_at
                FROM event_calendar
                WHERE (tenant_id = ? OR tenant_id IS NULL)
                  AND starts_on <= ? AND ends_on >= ?
                ORDER BY starts_on
                """, tenantId, toDate, fromDate);
    }

    @PostMapping("/calendar")
    public Map<String, Object> createCalendarEvent(@RequestBody CalendarEventRequest body) {
        UUID tenantId = currentTenant();

        if (body.name() == null || body.tag() == null
                || body.starts_on() == null || body.ends_on() == null) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                    "name, tag, starts_on, ends_on are required");
        }

        LocalDate startsOn = LocalDate.parse(body.starts_on());
        LocalDate endsOn   = LocalDate.parse(body.ends_on());

        scheduler.saveCalendarEvent(tenantId, body.name(), body.tag(),
                startsOn, endsOn, body.geo(), body.expected_effect());

        return Map.of(
                "status", "created",
                "name", body.name(),
                "tag", body.tag(),
                "starts_on", startsOn.toString(),
                "ends_on", endsOn.toString()
        );
    }

    private UUID currentTenant() {
        String raw = TenantContext.get();
        if (raw == null) throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED, "No tenant context");
        return UUID.fromString(raw);
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import com.marketingai.config.AppProperties;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.condition.ConditionalOnProperty;
import org.springframework.core.io.FileSystemResource;
import org.springframework.core.io.Resource;
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PathVariable;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;

import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Serves locally stored creative files.
 * Only active when app.storage.type=local (default for dev).
 * In production (R2), file URLs are direct R2 links — this controller is unused.
 */
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/files")
@ConditionalOnProperty(name = "app.storage.type", havingValue = "local", matchIfMissing = true)
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class FileController {

    private final AppProperties props;

    @GetMapping("/{tenantId}/{creativeId}/{filename}")
    public ResponseEntity<Resource> serve(
            @PathVariable UUID tenantId,
            @PathVariable UUID creativeId,
            @PathVariable String filename) {

        Path file = Path.of(props.getStorage().getLocalPath(),
                tenantId.toString(), creativeId.toString(), sanitize(filename));

        if (!Files.exists(file)) {
            return ResponseEntity.notFound().build();
        }

        Resource resource = new FileSystemResource(file);
        String contentType = detectContentType(filename);

        return ResponseEntity.ok()
                .header(HttpHeaders.CONTENT_DISPOSITION, "inline; filename=\"" + filename + "\"")
                .contentType(MediaType.parseMediaType(contentType))
                .body(resource);
    }

    private String sanitize(String filename) {
        return filename.replaceAll("[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]", "_");
    }

    private String detectContentType(String filename) {
        String lower = filename.toLowerCase();
        if (lower.endsWith(".mp4")) return "video/mp4";
        if (lower.endsWith(".mov")) return "video/quicktime";
        if (lower.endsWith(".jpg") || lower.endsWith(".jpeg")) return "image/jpeg";
        if (lower.endsWith(".png")) return "image/png";
        if (lower.endsWith(".gif")) return "image/gif";
        if (lower.endsWith(".webp")) return "image/webp";
        return "application/octet-stream";
    }
}
```
