```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import com.marketingai.service.MlServiceClient;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * Follow-up sequence management — Thompson Sampling bandit (vision §19.6 / arch §16.6).
 *
 * SECURITY: Auto-deploy variants WITHOUT marketer approval FORBIDDEN (§19.6).
 * All variants must be in lifecycle_state=APPROVED before going live.
 */
@Slf4j
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/followup")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class FollowupController {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private final MlServiceClient mlClient;

    private UUID currentTenant() {
        return UUID.fromString(SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication().getName());
    }

    // ─── Variant CRUD ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @GetMapping("/variants")
    public ResponseEntity<List<Map<String, Object>>> getVariants() {
        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT id, name, audience, cadence, channels, is_control,
                       lifecycle_state, approved_by, approved_at, alpha, beta
                FROM followup_variants
                WHERE tenant_id = ?
                ORDER BY created_at
                """, currentTenant());
        return ResponseEntity.ok(rows);
    }

    @PostMapping("/variants")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> createVariant(@RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {
        String name     = (String) body.get("name");
        String audience = (String) body.get("audience");
        if (name == null || audience == null) {
            return ResponseEntity.badRequest().body(Map.of("error", "name and audience required"));
        }

        String cadence  = toJsonString(body.getOrDefault("cadence", List.of()));
        Object chObj    = body.getOrDefault("channels", List.of());
        String channels = chObj instanceof List<?> l
                ? "{" + String.join(",", l.stream().map(Object::toString).toList()) + "}"
                : "{}";
        boolean isControl = Boolean.TRUE.equals(body.get("is_control"));

        UUID id = UUID.randomUUID();
        jdbc.update("""
                INSERT INTO followup_variants
                    (id, tenant_id, name, audience, cadence, channels, is_control, lifecycle_state)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?::jsonb, ?, ?, 'DRAFT')
                """, id, currentTenant(), name, audience, cadence, channels, isControl);

        return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of("id", id.toString(), "lifecycle_state", "DRAFT"));
    }

    @PutMapping("/variants/{id}")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> updateVariant(
            @PathVariable UUID id,
            @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {

        // Only DRAFT variants can be edited (APPROVED requires re-review)
        int updated = jdbc.update("""
                UPDATE followup_variants
                SET name     = COALESCE(?, name),
                    cadence  = COALESCE(?::jsonb, cadence),
                    channels = COALESCE(?, channels)
                WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ? AND lifecycle_state = 'DRAFT'
                """,
                body.get("name"),
                body.containsKey("cadence") ? toJsonString(body.get("cadence")) : null,
                null,
                id, currentTenant());

        if (updated == 0) return ResponseEntity.notFound().build();
        return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of("status", "updated"));
    }

    /** Approve a variant — sets lifecycle_state = APPROVED. */
    @PostMapping("/variants/{id}/approve")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> approveVariant(@PathVariable UUID id) {
        UUID approver = currentTenant();
        int updated = jdbc.update("""
                UPDATE followup_variants
                SET lifecycle_state = 'APPROVED',
                    approved_by     = ?,
                    approved_at     = ?
                WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ? AND lifecycle_state = 'PENDING_REVIEW'
                """, approver, Instant.now(), id, currentTenant());

        if (updated == 0) return ResponseEntity.badRequest()
                .body(Map.of("error", "Variant not found or not in PENDING_REVIEW state"));
        log.info("Follow-up variant approved: id={} by={}", id, approver);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of("id", id.toString(), "lifecycle_state", "APPROVED"));
    }

    /** Submit variant for review (DRAFT → PENDING_REVIEW). */
    @PostMapping("/variants/{id}/submit")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> submitForReview(@PathVariable UUID id) {
        int updated = jdbc.update("""
                UPDATE followup_variants
                SET lifecycle_state = 'PENDING_REVIEW'
                WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ? AND lifecycle_state = 'DRAFT'
                """, id, currentTenant());
        if (updated == 0) return ResponseEntity.badRequest()
                .body(Map.of("error", "Variant not found or not in DRAFT state"));
        return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of("id", id.toString(), "lifecycle_state", "PENDING_REVIEW"));
    }

    // ─── Assignment ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /**
     * Assign a follow-up variant to an appointment (via ML service Thompson decision).
     * Only assigns if no assignment exists yet (idempotent).
     */
    @PostMapping("/assign")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> assignFollowup(@RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {
        UUID tenantId      = currentTenant();
        String apptId      = (String) body.get("appointment_id");
        String countryCode = (String) body.get("country_code");
        String ticketBucket= (String) body.get("ticket_bucket");

        if (apptId == null) return ResponseEntity.badRequest().body(Map.of("error", "appointment_id required"));

        // Check no existing assignment
        Integer existing = jdbc.queryForObject(
                "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM followup_assignments WHERE appointment_id = ?::uuid",
                Integer.class, apptId);
        if (existing != null && existing > 0) {
            return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of("status", "already_assigned"));
        }

        // Load eligible variants
        List<Map<String, Object>> variants = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT id, name, alpha, beta, is_control, lifecycle_state
                FROM followup_variants
                WHERE tenant_id = ? AND (lifecycle_state = 'APPROVED' OR is_control = true)
                """, tenantId);

        if (variants.isEmpty()) {
            return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of("status", "no_variants"));
        }

        // Delegate Thompson selection to ML service
        Map<String, Object> mlReq = Map.of(
                "tenant_id", tenantId.toString(),
                "appointment_id", apptId,
                "country_code", countryCode != null ? countryCode : "",
                "ticket_bucket", ticketBucket != null ? ticketBucket : "",
                "exploration_rate", 0.15,
                "variants", variants);

        try {
            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
            Map<String, Object> mlResp = mlClient.post("/decide/followup", mlReq, Map.class);

            String variantId  = (String) mlResp.get("variant_id");
            String contextKey = (String) mlResp.get("context_key");

            UUID assignId = UUID.randomUUID();
            jdbc.update("""
                    INSERT INTO followup_assignments
                        (id, tenant_id, appointment_id, variant_id, context_key, outcome)
                    VALUES (?, ?, ?::uuid, ?::uuid, ?, 'UNKNOWN')
                    ON CONFLICT (appointment_id) DO NOTHING
                    """, assignId, tenantId, apptId, variantId, contextKey);

            return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of(
                    "assignment_id", assignId.toString(),
                    "variant_id", variantId,
                    "context_key", contextKey));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.warn("Follow-up assignment ML call failed: {}", e.getMessage());
            return ResponseEntity.internalServerError().body(Map.of("error", e.getMessage()));
        }
    }

    /** Record outcome (SHOWED / NO_SHOW) for a follow-up assignment. */
    @PostMapping("/outcome")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> recordOutcome(@RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {
        String apptId = (String) body.get("appointment_id");
        String outcome= (String) body.get("outcome");

        if (apptId == null || outcome == null) {
            return ResponseEntity.badRequest().body(Map.of("error", "appointment_id and outcome required"));
        }
        if (!List.of("SHOWED", "NO_SHOW").contains(outcome)) {
            return ResponseEntity.badRequest().body(Map.of("error", "outcome must be SHOWED or NO_SHOW"));
        }

        // Update assignment outcome
        jdbc.update("""
                UPDATE followup_assignments
                SET outcome = ?, resolved_at = ?
                WHERE appointment_id = ?::uuid AND tenant_id = ?
                """, outcome, Instant.now(), apptId, currentTenant());

        // Update variant posteriors (single writer: FastAPI only — this just marks outcome, not alpha/beta)
        return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of("status", "recorded", "outcome", outcome));
    }

    // ─── Report ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @GetMapping("/report")
    public ResponseEntity<List<Map<String, Object>>> getReport() {
        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT fv.name, fv.is_control, fv.alpha, fv.beta,
                       COUNT(fa.id) as assignments,
                       SUM(CASE WHEN fa.outcome = 'SHOWED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as showed_count,
                       SUM(CASE WHEN fa.outcome = 'NO_SHOW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as no_show_count,
                       ROUND(fv.alpha / (fv.alpha + fv.beta), 4) as estimated_show_rate
                FROM followup_variants fv
                LEFT JOIN followup_assignments fa ON fv.id = fa.variant_id
                WHERE fv.tenant_id = ?
                GROUP BY fv.id, fv.name, fv.is_control, fv.alpha, fv.beta
                ORDER BY fv.is_control DESC, estimated_show_rate DESC
                """, currentTenant());
        return ResponseEntity.ok(rows);
    }

    // ─── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private String toJsonString(Object obj) {
        if (obj instanceof String s) return s;
        try {
            return new com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper().writeValueAsString(obj);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return "[]";
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import com.marketingai.service.FunnelService;
import com.marketingai.service.ValueFormulaService;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/form")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Slf4j
public class FormSubmissionController {

    private final org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private final RestTemplate      restTemplate;
    private final ValueFormulaService valueFormulaService;
    private final FunnelService     funnelService;
    private static final ObjectMapper MAPPER = new ObjectMapper();

    @PostMapping("/submit")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> submit(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {

        UUID sessionId = body.get("session_id") != null
            ? UUID.fromString((String) body.get("session_id")) : null;

        Boolean selfAccredited = body.get("self_accredited") instanceof Boolean b ? b : null;
        String  ticketBucket   = (String) body.get("ticket_bucket");

        if (sessionId != null) {
            jdbc.update("""
                UPDATE sessions SET
                    self_accredited = ?,
                    ticket_bucket   = ?,
                    funnel_key      = COALESCE(funnel_key, 'investor')
                WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ?
                """, selfAccredited, ticketBucket, sessionId, tenantId);
        }

        UUID submissionId = UUID.randomUUID();
        jdbc.update("""
            INSERT INTO form_submissions
                (id, tenant_id, session_id, funnel_key, self_accredited, ticket_bucket,
                 first_name, last_name, email, phone, company, utm_source, utm_campaign,
                 raw_payload, consent_level)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?::jsonb, ?)
            """,
            submissionId, tenantId, sessionId,
            body.getOrDefault("funnel_key", "investor"),
            selfAccredited, ticketBucket,
            body.get("first_name"), body.get("last_name"),
            body.get("email"), body.get("phone"), body.get("company"),
            body.get("utm_source"), body.get("utm_campaign"),
            toJson(body), body.getOrDefault("consent_level", "basic"));

        if (selfAccredited != null && ticketBucket != null) {
            // Look up value_formula for FORM_SUBMIT stage from capi_event_map
            String formula = lookupFormula(tenantId, "FORM_SUBMIT");
            double predictedValue = formula != null
                ? valueFormulaService.computeValue(tenantId, formula, selfAccredited, ticketBucket)
                : 0.0;
            if (predictedValue > 0) {
                jdbc.update("""
                    INSERT INTO value_calibration_log
                        (tenant_id, session_id, predicted_value, ticket_bucket, self_accredited, stage_key)
                    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'FORM_SUBMIT')
                    """, tenantId, sessionId, predictedValue, ticketBucket, selfAccredited);
            }
        }

        log.debug("Form submitted: submission={} tenant={}", submissionId, tenantId);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of("submission_id", submissionId, "status", "accepted"));
    }

    @GetMapping("/calibration-report")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> calibrationReport(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId) {
        List<Map<String, Object>> log = jdbc.queryForList("""
            SELECT predicted_value, actual_value, ticket_bucket, self_accredited
            FROM value_calibration_log WHERE tenant_id = ?
            ORDER BY logged_at DESC LIMIT 500
            """, tenantId);
        Map<String, Object> req = Map.of("calibration_log", log, "min_samples", 20);
        try {
            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
            Map<String, Object> result = restTemplate.postForObject(
                "http://ml-service:8001/form/calibrate-value", req, Map.class);
            return ResponseEntity.ok(result != null ? result : Map.of());
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of("error", e.getMessage()));
        }
    }

    private String lookupFormula(java.util.UUID tenantId, String stageKey) {
        try {
            return jdbc.queryForObject(
                "SELECT value_formula FROM capi_event_map WHERE tenant_id = ? AND stage_key = ? AND is_active = TRUE LIMIT 1",
                String.class, tenantId, stageKey);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private String toJson(Object obj) {
        try { return MAPPER.writeValueAsString(obj); }
        catch (Exception e) { return "{}"; }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import com.marketingai.security.TenantContext;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/fraud")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class FraudController {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;

    /**
     * Fraud summary for the current tenant — used in admin dashboard.
     * Returns counts for last 1h and 24h windows, plus top fraud reasons.
     */
    @GetMapping("/summary")
    public Map<String, Object> summary() {
        UUID tid = currentTenant();

        Map<String, Object> last1h = jdbc.queryForMap("""
                SELECT
                    COUNT(*)                                         AS total,
                    SUM(CASE WHEN is_suspicious THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)  AS suspicious,
                    ROUND(
                        CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0
                        ELSE 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_suspicious THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)
                        END, 1)                                      AS fraud_rate_pct
                FROM sessions
                WHERE tenant_id = ? AND started_at > now() - interval '1 hour'
                """, tid);

        Map<String, Object> last24h = jdbc.queryForMap("""
                SELECT
                    COUNT(*)                                         AS total,
                    SUM(CASE WHEN is_suspicious THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)  AS suspicious,
                    ROUND(
                        CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0
                        ELSE 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_suspicious THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)
                        END, 1)                                      AS fraud_rate_pct
                FROM sessions
                WHERE tenant_id = ? AND started_at > now() - interval '24 hours'
                """, tid);

        // Top fraud reasons in last 24h (unnest JSONB array)
        List<Map<String, Object>> topReasons = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT reason, COUNT(*) AS cnt
                FROM (
                    SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(fraud_reasons) AS reason
                    FROM sessions
                    WHERE tenant_id = ?
                      AND is_suspicious = true
                      AND started_at > now() - interval '24 hours'
                ) r
                GROUP BY reason
                ORDER BY cnt DESC
                LIMIT 10
                """, tid);

        return Map.of(
                "last_1h",    last1h,
                "last_24h",   last24h,
                "top_reasons", topReasons
        );
    }

    private UUID currentTenant() {
        String raw = TenantContext.get();
        if (raw == null) throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED, "No tenant context");
        return UUID.fromString(raw);
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import com.marketingai.service.FunnelService;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Funnel as Configuration REST API (vision §19.3 / arch §16.3).
 */
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/funnel")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class FunnelController {

    private final FunnelService funnelService;
    private final JdbcTemplate  jdbc;

    private UUID currentTenant() {
        return UUID.fromString(SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication().getName());
    }

    @GetMapping
    public ResponseEntity<List<Map<String, Object>>> getStages() {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(funnelService.getStages(currentTenant()));
    }

    @PutMapping("/seed/b2b")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, String>> seedB2B() {
        funnelService.seedB2BTemplate(currentTenant());
        return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of("status", "seeded", "template", "b2b"));
    }

    @PutMapping("/seed/investor")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, String>> seedInvestor() {
        funnelService.seedInvestorFunnel(currentTenant());
        return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of("status", "seeded", "template", "investor"));
    }

    /** GET /api/v1/funnel/me — funnel stages + CAPI map for current tenant (admin UI 8-1). */
    @GetMapping("/me")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> getMyFunnel() {
        UUID tenantId = currentTenant();
        List<Map<String, Object>> stages = jdbc.queryForList("""
            SELECT fs.stage_key, fs.stage_label, fs.ordinal, fs.is_quality_key,
                   fs.reward_weight, fs.micro_reward_weight,
                   cem.meta_event_name AS capi_event
            FROM funnel_stages fs
            LEFT JOIN capi_event_map cem
                ON cem.tenant_id = fs.tenant_id AND cem.stage_key = fs.stage_key
            WHERE fs.tenant_id = ?
            ORDER BY fs.ordinal
            """, tenantId);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of("stages", stages, "tenant_id", tenantId));
    }

    @PostMapping("/stages")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, String>> upsertStage(@RequestBody Map<String, Object> stage) {
        if (!stage.containsKey("stage_key") || !stage.containsKey("ordinal")) {
            return ResponseEntity.badRequest().body(Map.of("error", "stage_key and ordinal required"));
        }
        funnelService.upsertStage(currentTenant(), stage);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of("status", "saved", "stage_key", (String) stage.get("stage_key")));
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * Funnel Path as Thompson Arm (vision §19.18.1; arch §16.14).
 * 4 paths for Client #1 investor funnel.
 */
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/funnel-paths")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Slf4j
public class FunnelPathController {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private final RestTemplate restTemplate;

    @GetMapping
    public ResponseEntity<List<Map<String, Object>>> list(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId) {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(jdbc.queryForList("""
            SELECT fp.*, COALESCE(ta.alpha, 1.0) AS alpha, COALESCE(ta.beta, 1.0) AS beta
            FROM funnel_paths fp
            LEFT JOIN thompson_arms ta ON ta.variant_id = fp.id
                AND ta.tenant_id = fp.tenant_id AND ta.reward_event = 'CALL_HELD'
            WHERE fp.tenant_id = ? ORDER BY fp.created_at
            """, tenantId));
    }

    @PostMapping
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> create(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {
        UUID id = UUID.randomUUID();
        jdbc.update("""
            INSERT INTO funnel_paths
                (id, tenant_id, path_key, path_label, description, is_control, ghl_workflow_id, config)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?::jsonb)
            ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, path_key) DO UPDATE SET
                path_label = EXCLUDED.path_label, config = EXCLUDED.config
            """, id, tenantId,
            body.get("path_key"), body.get("path_label"), body.get("description"),
            body.getOrDefault("is_control", false),
            body.get("ghl_workflow_id"), toJson(body.getOrDefault("config", Map.of())));
        return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of("id", id));
    }

    @PostMapping("/{id}/approve")
    public ResponseEntity<Void> approve(
            @PathVariable UUID id,
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId) {
        jdbc.update("""
            UPDATE funnel_paths SET status = 'ACTIVE'
            WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ? AND status = 'PENDING_REVIEW'
            """, id, tenantId);
        return ResponseEntity.ok().build();
    }

    @PostMapping("/seed/client1")
    public ResponseEntity<Void> seedClient1(@RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId) {
        Object[][] paths = {
            {"CALL_4D",          "Book a call (4-day window)", true,
             "Evergreen default. Book → coordinator → call in 4 days."},
            {"MATERIALS_FIRST",  "Materials first, then invite", false,
             "Founder video + data-room-light → engagement gate → call invite."},
            {"TIERED_BY_TICKET", "Tiered by investment size", false,
             "<$50K webinar / $50-250K 1:1 / >$250K founder direct call."},
            {"CALL_24H",         "24-hour call window", false,
             "Coordinator offers slot within 24 h; team call follows."},
        };
        for (Object[] p : paths) {
            UUID id = UUID.randomUUID();
            jdbc.update("""
                INSERT INTO funnel_paths
                    (id, tenant_id, path_key, path_label, is_control, description, status)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'DRAFT')
                ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, path_key) DO NOTHING
                """, id, tenantId, p[0], p[1], p[2], p[3]);
        }
        return ResponseEntity.ok().build();
    }

    @GetMapping("/dashboard")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> dashboard(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "30") int days) {
        List<Map<String, Object>> paths = jdbc.queryForList(
            "SELECT id, path_key, path_label, status, is_control FROM funnel_paths WHERE tenant_id = ?",
            tenantId);
        List<Map<String, Object>> metrics = jdbc.queryForList("""
            SELECT
                COALESCE(s.funnel_path_id::text, 'null') AS path_id,
                COUNT(DISTINCT s.id)                     AS page_views,
                COUNT(re.id) FILTER (WHERE re.is_quality_stage) AS held_calls
            FROM sessions s
            LEFT JOIN reward_events re ON re.session_id = s.id AND re.tenant_id = s.tenant_id
                AND re.rewarded_at >= NOW() - (? || ' days')::interval
            WHERE s.tenant_id = ? AND s.created_at >= NOW() - (? || ' days')::interval
            GROUP BY COALESCE(s.funnel_path_id::text, 'null')
            """, String.valueOf(days), tenantId, String.valueOf(days));
        return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of("paths", paths, "metrics", metrics, "days", days));
    }

    private String toJson(Object o) {
        try { return new ObjectMapper().writeValueAsString(o); }
        catch (Exception e) { return "{}"; }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * 8-10: External Signals Role per Funnel (vision §19.13; arch §16.10).
 * Manages funnel_signal_config on the tenant and funnel_calendar_events.
 */
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/funnel-signals")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Slf4j
public class FunnelSignalController {

    private final JdbcTemplate  jdbc;
    private final RestTemplate  restTemplate;

    // ── Signal Config ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @GetMapping("/config")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> getConfig(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId) {
        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbc.queryForList(
            "SELECT funnel_signal_config FROM tenants WHERE id = ?", tenantId);
        if (rows.isEmpty()) return ResponseEntity.notFound().build();
        return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of("funnel_signal_config", rows.get(0).get("funnel_signal_config")));
    }

    @PutMapping("/config")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> updateConfig(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {
        Object config = body.get("funnel_signal_config");
        if (config == null) return ResponseEntity.badRequest().build();

        String json = config instanceof String s ? s : toJson(config);
        jdbc.update(
            "UPDATE tenants SET funnel_signal_config = ?::jsonb WHERE id = ?",
            json, tenantId);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of("updated", true));
    }

    // ── Calendar Events ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @GetMapping("/calendar")
    public ResponseEntity<List<Map<String, Object>>> listCalendar(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "investor") String funnelKey) {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(jdbc.queryForList("""
            SELECT id, funnel_key, event_type, event_name, event_date,
                   jurisdiction, metadata, created_at,
                   (event_date - CURRENT_DATE) AS days_until
            FROM funnel_calendar_events
            WHERE tenant_id = ? AND funnel_key = ?
            ORDER BY event_date
            """, tenantId, funnelKey));
    }

    @PostMapping("/calendar")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> addCalendarEvent(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {
        UUID id = UUID.randomUUID();
        String funnelKey   = (String) body.getOrDefault("funnel_key",   "investor");
        String eventType   = (String) body.getOrDefault("event_type",   "regulatory");
        String eventName   = (String) body.getOrDefault("event_name",   "");
        String eventDate   = (String) body.getOrDefault("event_date",   "");
        String jurisdiction = (String) body.get("jurisdiction");
        String meta        = body.get("metadata") != null ? toJson(body.get("metadata")) : "{}";

        if (eventName.isBlank() || eventDate.isBlank())
            return ResponseEntity.badRequest().build();

        jdbc.update("""
            INSERT INTO funnel_calendar_events
                (id, tenant_id, funnel_key, event_type, event_name, event_date, jurisdiction, metadata)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?::date, ?, ?::jsonb)
            """, id, tenantId, funnelKey, eventType, eventName, eventDate, jurisdiction, meta);

        return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of("id", id.toString(), "created", true));
    }

    @DeleteMapping("/calendar/{eventId}")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> deleteCalendarEvent(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @PathVariable UUID eventId) {
        int rows = jdbc.update(
            "DELETE FROM funnel_calendar_events WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ?",
            eventId, tenantId);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of("deleted", rows > 0));
    }

    // ── Narrative Context (proxies to ml-service) ──────────────────────────────

    @GetMapping("/narrative-context")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> narrativeContext(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "investor") String funnelKey) {

        List<Map<String, Object>> calRows = jdbc.queryForList("""
            SELECT event_type, event_name,
                   (event_date - CURRENT_DATE) AS days_until
            FROM funnel_calendar_events
            WHERE tenant_id = ? AND funnel_key = ?
            AND event_date >= CURRENT_DATE
            ORDER BY event_date
            LIMIT 10
            """, tenantId, funnelKey);

        List<Map<String, Object>> configRows = jdbc.queryForList(
            "SELECT funnel_signal_config FROM tenants WHERE id = ?", tenantId);
        List<String> newsTags = List.of();
        if (!configRows.isEmpty()) {
            Object cfg = configRows.get(0).get("funnel_signal_config");
            newsTags = extractNewsTags(cfg, funnelKey);
        }

        try {
            Map<String, Object> req = new HashMap<>();
            req.put("raw_signals",     List.of());  // live signals fetched by ExternalSignalsScheduler
            req.put("news_tags",       newsTags);
            req.put("calendar_events", calRows);

            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
            Map<String, Object> resp = restTemplate.postForObject(
                "http://ml-service:8001/signals/narrative-context", req, Map.class);
            return ResponseEntity.ok(resp != null ? resp : Map.of());
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.warn("ml-service narrative-context unavailable: {}", e.getMessage());
            return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of("context_lines", List.of()));
        }
    }

    // ── helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private List<String> extractNewsTags(Object configObj, String funnelKey) {
        try {
            if (configObj instanceof Map<?,?> map) {
                Object funnelCfg = map.get(funnelKey);
                if (funnelCfg instanceof Map<?,?> fc) {
                    Object tags = fc.get("news_tags");
                    if (tags instanceof List<?> list) {
                        return (List<String>) list;
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return List.of();
    }

    private String toJson(Object obj) {
        try {
            return new com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper().writeValueAsString(obj);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return "{}";
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import com.marketingai.dto.meta.GateStatusResponse;
import com.marketingai.dto.meta.GateSummaryResponse;
import com.marketingai.entity.MetaAdSet;
import com.marketingai.entity.MetaCampaign;
import com.marketingai.repository.MetaAdSetRepository;
import com.marketingai.repository.MetaCampaignRepository;
import com.marketingai.security.TenantContext;
import com.marketingai.service.GateEvaluationService;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Gate status visibility and manual evaluation trigger.
 * Automatic gate evaluation runs hourly via GateScanScheduler.
 * Vision §12.3: marketer sees gate status, can trigger manually.
 */
@RestController
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class GateController {

    private final GateEvaluationService gateService;
    private final MetaCampaignRepository campaignRepo;
    private final MetaAdSetRepository adSetRepo;

    /**
     * Manual gate evaluation for a specific campaign.
     * Returns number of ad sets whose status changed.
     */
    @PostMapping("/campaigns/{id}/evaluate-gates")
    public int evaluateGates(@PathVariable UUID id) {
        MetaCampaign campaign = requireCampaign(id);
        return gateService.evaluateCampaign(campaign);
    }

    /**
     * Gate summary for a campaign: counts by gate status + per-adset details.
     */
    @GetMapping("/campaigns/{id}/gate-summary")
    public GateSummaryResponse gateSummary(@PathVariable UUID id) {
        MetaCampaign campaign = requireCampaign(id);

        List<MetaAdSet> adSets = adSetRepo.findAllByCampaignId(campaign.getId())
                .stream()
                .filter(a -> a.getTenantId().equals(currentTenant()))
                .toList();

        List<GateStatusResponse> details = adSets.stream().map(this::toGateStatus).toList();

        return GateSummaryResponse.builder()
                .campaignId(id)
                .total(adSets.size())
                .atGate1((int) adSets.stream().filter(a -> "GATE_1".equals(a.getGateStatus())).count())
                .atGate2((int) adSets.stream().filter(a -> "GATE_2".equals(a.getGateStatus())).count())
                .atGate3((int) adSets.stream().filter(a -> "GATE_3".equals(a.getGateStatus())).count())
                .passed((int) adSets.stream().filter(a -> "PASSED".equals(a.getGateStatus())).count())
                .killed((int) adSets.stream().filter(a -> "KILLED".equals(a.getGateStatus())).count())
                .adSets(details)
                .build();
    }

    /**
     * Gate status for a single ad set.
     */
    @GetMapping("/ad-sets/{id}/gate-status")
    public GateStatusResponse adSetGateStatus(@PathVariable UUID id) {
        MetaAdSet adSet = adSetRepo.findById(id)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Ad set not found"));
        if (!adSet.getTenantId().equals(currentTenant())) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN);
        }
        return toGateStatus(adSet);
    }

    /**
     * Mark an ad set as anchor creative for Gate 3 comparison.
     * The anchor is the known-good control creative (vision §12.3).
     */
    @PutMapping("/ad-sets/{id}/anchor")
    public GateStatusResponse setAnchor(@PathVariable UUID id, @RequestParam boolean anchor) {
        MetaAdSet adSet = adSetRepo.findById(id)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Ad set not found"));
        if (!adSet.getTenantId().equals(currentTenant())) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN);
        }

        // Only one anchor per campaign
        if (anchor) {
            adSetRepo.findAllByCampaignId(adSet.getCampaignId())
                    .forEach(a -> {
                        if (a.isAnchor()) {
                            a.setAnchor(false);
                            adSetRepo.save(a);
                        }
                    });
        }

        adSet.setAnchor(anchor);
        return toGateStatus(adSetRepo.save(adSet));
    }

    // ─── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private MetaCampaign requireCampaign(UUID id) {
        MetaCampaign c = campaignRepo.findById(id)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Campaign not found"));
        if (!c.getTenantId().equals(currentTenant())) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN);
        }
        return c;
    }

    private UUID currentTenant() {
        String raw = TenantContext.get();
        if (raw == null) throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED, "No tenant context");
        return UUID.fromString(raw);
    }

    private GateStatusResponse toGateStatus(MetaAdSet a) {
        return GateStatusResponse.builder()
                .adSetId(a.getId())
                .metaAdSetId(a.getMetaAdSetId())
                .creativeId(a.getCreativeId())
                .gateStatus(a.getGateStatus())
                .killReason(a.getGateKillReason())
                .killAt(a.getGateKillAt())
                .impressionsTotal(a.getImpressionsTotal() != null ? a.getImpressionsTotal() : 0L)
                .clicksTotal(a.getClicksTotal() != null ? a.getClicksTotal() : 0L)
                .conversionsTotal(a.getConversionsTotal() != null ? a.getConversionsTotal() : 0L)
                .spendTotal(a.getSpendTotal() != null ? a.getSpendTotal() : 0f)
                .isAnchor(a.isAnchor())
                .gate1EvaluatedAt(a.getGate1EvaluatedAt())
                .gate2EvaluatedAt(a.getGate2EvaluatedAt())
                .gate3EvaluatedAt(a.getGate3EvaluatedAt())
                .batchLaunchedAt(a.getBatchLaunchedAt())
                .build();
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import com.marketingai.config.AppProperties;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.*;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * Geo-Lift incrementality endpoints (5-7).
 * Uses client sales data (NOT pixel); credible intervals on all figures (vision §17.3).
 * Delegates synthetic-control computation to FastAPI.
 */
@Slf4j
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/geo-lift")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class GeoLiftController {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private final RestTemplate restTemplate;
    private final AppProperties appProperties;
    private final ObjectMapper objectMapper;

    // ── POST / — create test ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @PostMapping
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> createTest(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {

        String testName   = (String) body.get("test_name");
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        List<String> controlGeos = (List<String>) body.get("control_geos");
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        List<String> testGeos    = (List<String>) body.get("test_geos");
        String startDate  = (String) body.get("start_date");

        if (testName == null || controlGeos == null || testGeos == null || startDate == null) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                    "test_name, control_geos, test_geos, start_date are required");
        }

        // Validate geo split via FastAPI
        Map<String, Object> validateReq = Map.of("control_geos", controlGeos, "test_geos", testGeos);
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        Map<String, Object> validation = callFastApi("/geo-lift/validate", validateReq);

        if (Boolean.FALSE.equals(validation.get("valid"))) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
                    "Invalid geo split: " + validation.get("errors"));
        }

        String controlGeosArr = toArray(controlGeos);
        String testGeosArr    = toArray(testGeos);

        UUID testId = UUID.randomUUID();
        jdbc.update("""
                INSERT INTO geo_lift_tests
                    (id, tenant_id, test_name, control_geos, test_geos, start_date, status)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?::text[], ?::text[], ?::date, 'DRAFT')
                """,
                testId, tenantId, testName, controlGeosArr, testGeosArr, startDate);

        log.info("Geo-lift test {} created for tenant {}", testId, tenantId);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of("test_id", testId, "status", "DRAFT"));
    }

    // ── GET / — list tests ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @GetMapping
    public ResponseEntity<List<Map<String, Object>>> listTests(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId) {

        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT id, test_name, control_geos, test_geos,
                       start_date, end_date, status, result, created_at
                FROM geo_lift_tests
                WHERE tenant_id = ?
                ORDER BY created_at DESC
                LIMIT 50
                """, tenantId);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(rows);
    }

    // ── POST /{id}/analyze — run synthetic control ────────────────────────────

    @PostMapping("/{id}/analyze")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> analyze(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @PathVariable UUID id,
            @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {

        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbc.queryForList(
                "SELECT id, status FROM geo_lift_tests WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ?",
                id, tenantId);
        if (rows.isEmpty()) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Geo-lift test not found");
        }

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        Map<String, Object> mlResult = callFastApi("/geo-lift/analyze", body);

        // Persist result
        jdbc.update("""
                UPDATE geo_lift_tests
                SET result = ?::jsonb, status = 'COMPLETED', updated_at = now()
                WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ?
                """,
                toJson(mlResult), id, tenantId);

        Map<String, Object> resp = new LinkedHashMap<>(mlResult);
        resp.put("test_id", id);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(resp);
    }

    // ── PUT /{id}/complete — manual close ─────────────────────────────────────

    @PutMapping("/{id}/complete")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> completeTest(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @PathVariable UUID id,
            @RequestBody(required = false) Map<String, Object> body) {

        int updated = jdbc.update("""
                UPDATE geo_lift_tests
                SET status = 'COMPLETED', end_date = now(), updated_at = now()
                WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ?
                """, id, tenantId);
        if (updated == 0) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Geo-lift test not found");
        }
        return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of("test_id", id, "status", "COMPLETED"));
    }

    // ── helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private Map<String, Object> callFastApi(String path, Object body) {
        HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
        headers.setContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
        headers.set("X-Internal-API-Key", appProperties.getInternalApiKey());

        try {
            Map<String, Object> result = restTemplate.postForObject(
                    appProperties.getMlServiceUrl() + path,
                    new HttpEntity<>(body, headers), Map.class);
            if (result == null) {
                throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_GATEWAY,
                        "FastAPI returned null from " + path);
            }
            return result;
        } catch (ResponseStatusException e) {
            throw e;
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            log.warn("FastAPI {} call failed: {}", path, ex.getMessage());
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_GATEWAY,
                    "ML service error: " + ex.getMessage());
        }
    }

    private String toArray(List<String> list) {
        return "{" + String.join(",", list.stream().map(s -> "\"" + s + "\"").toList()) + "}";
    }

    private String toJson(Object obj) {
        try {
            return objectMapper.writeValueAsString(obj);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return "{}";
        }
    }
}
```

```java
    }
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.*;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * Creative Graveyard API (Phase 6-5).
 * Stores post-mortems for retired creatives.
 */
@Slf4j
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/graveyard")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class GraveyardController {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private final RestTemplate restTemplate;

    // ─── GET / ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @GetMapping
    public ResponseEntity<List<Map<String, Object>>> list(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "20") int limit) {

        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT id, creative_id, failure_mode, cvr, benchmark_cvr,
                       sessions, ctr, created_at
                FROM creative_postmortems
                WHERE tenant_id = ?
                ORDER BY created_at DESC
                LIMIT ?
                """, tenantId, Math.min(limit, 100));

        return ResponseEntity.ok(rows);
    }

    // ─── GET /{id} ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @GetMapping("/{id}")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> get(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @PathVariable UUID id) {

        try {
            Map<String, Object> row = jdbc.queryForMap("""
                    SELECT * FROM creative_postmortems WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ?
                    """, id, tenantId);
            return ResponseEntity.ok(row);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Post-mortem not found");
        }
    }

    // ─── POST /analyze/{creativeId} ───────────────────────────────────────────

    @PostMapping("/analyze/{creativeId}")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> analyze(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @PathVariable UUID creativeId,
            @RequestBody(required = false) Map<String, Object> body) {

        // Load creative atoms
        Map<String, Object> creative;
        try {
            creative = jdbc.queryForMap("""
                    SELECT atoms FROM creatives WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ?
                    """, creativeId, tenantId);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Creative not found");
        }

        // Load performance stats from thompson_arms
        Map<String, Object> arm;
        try {
            arm = jdbc.queryForMap("""
                    SELECT alpha, beta, alpha + beta AS trials
                    FROM thompson_arms WHERE creative_id = ? AND tenant_id = ?
                    """, creativeId, tenantId);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            arm = Map.of("alpha", 1.0, "beta", 1.0, "trials", 2.0);
        }

        double alpha   = ((Number) arm.get("alpha")).doubleValue();
        double beta    = ((Number) arm.get("beta")).doubleValue();
        double trials  = ((Number) arm.get("trials")).doubleValue();
        double cvr     = trials > 0 ? alpha / trials : 0.0;
        double benchCvr = body != null && body.containsKey("benchmark_cvr")
                ? ((Number) body.get("benchmark_cvr")).doubleValue() : 0.02;

        Map<String, Object> mlReq = new HashMap<>();
        mlReq.put("creative_id",    creativeId.toString());
        mlReq.put("atoms",          creative.getOrDefault("atoms", List.of()));
        mlReq.put("sessions",       (int) trials);
        mlReq.put("cvr",            cvr);
        mlReq.put("benchmark_cvr",  benchCvr);
        if (body != null && body.containsKey("top_performing_atoms")) {
            mlReq.put("top_performing_atoms", body.get("top_performing_atoms"));
        }

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        Map<String, Object> result = restTemplate.postForObject(
                "http://ml-service:8001/graveyard/postmortem", mlReq, Map.class);

        if (result == null) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_GATEWAY, "ML service unavailable");
        }

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        Map<String, Object> analysis = (Map<String, Object>) result.get("analysis");
        String postmortemMd = (String) result.get("postmortem_md");

        // Persist
        jdbc.update("""
                INSERT INTO creative_postmortems
                    (tenant_id, creative_id, failure_mode, cvr, benchmark_cvr, sessions, analysis, postmortem_md)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?::jsonb, ?)
                """,
                tenantId, creativeId,
                analysis != null ? analysis.get("failure_mode") : "unknown",
                cvr, benchCvr, (int) trials,
                analysis != null ? analysis.toString() : "{}",
                postmortemMd);

        return ResponseEntity.ok(result);
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * Investor Archetypes (vision §19.18.6; arch §16.19).
 * Classifies leads into archetypes; upserts result; drives path/follow-up/brief routing.
 */
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/investor-archetypes")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Slf4j
public class InvestorArchetypeController {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private final RestTemplate restTemplate;
    private static final ObjectMapper MAPPER = new ObjectMapper();

    @PostMapping("/classify")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> classify(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {

        UUID sessionId = body.get("session_id") != null
            ? UUID.fromString((String) body.get("session_id")) : null;

        Map<String, Object> features = buildFeatures(tenantId, sessionId, body);

        try {
            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
            Map<String, Object> result = restTemplate.postForObject(
                "http://ml-service:8001/investor/classify", features, Map.class);
            if (result == null) return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of("archetype", "UNKNOWN"));

            jdbc.update("""
                INSERT INTO investor_archetypes
                    (tenant_id, session_id, archetype, confidence, signals)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?::jsonb)
                ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, session_id) DO UPDATE SET
                    archetype     = EXCLUDED.archetype,
                    confidence    = EXCLUDED.confidence,
                    signals       = EXCLUDED.signals,
                    classified_at = NOW()
                """, tenantId, sessionId,
                result.get("archetype"),
                result.get("confidence"),
                toJson(result.get("signals")));

            return ResponseEntity.ok(result);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.warn("Archetype classification failed for session {}: {}", sessionId, e.getMessage());
            return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of("archetype", "UNKNOWN", "error", e.getMessage()));
        }
    }

    @GetMapping("/session/{sessionId}")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> getBySession(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @PathVariable UUID sessionId) {
        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbc.queryForList("""
            SELECT * FROM investor_archetypes WHERE session_id = ? AND tenant_id = ?
            """, sessionId, tenantId);
        return rows.isEmpty() ? ResponseEntity.notFound().build()
                              : ResponseEntity.ok(rows.get(0));
    }

    @GetMapping("/distribution")
    public ResponseEntity<List<Map<String, Object>>> distribution(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "30") int days) {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(jdbc.queryForList("""
            SELECT archetype, COUNT(*) AS count, AVG(confidence) AS avg_confidence
            FROM investor_archetypes
            WHERE tenant_id = ? AND classified_at >= NOW() - (? || ' days')::interval
            GROUP BY archetype ORDER BY count DESC
            """, tenantId, String.valueOf(days)));
    }

    @GetMapping("/policies")
    public ResponseEntity<List<Map<String, Object>>> policies(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId) {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(jdbc.queryForList("""
            SELECT * FROM archetype_policies WHERE tenant_id = ? AND is_active = TRUE
            ORDER BY cluster_label
            """, tenantId));
    }

    @PostMapping("/policies")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> upsertPolicy(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {
        UUID id = UUID.randomUUID();
        jdbc.update("""
            INSERT INTO archetype_policies
                (id, tenant_id, cluster_label, funnel_path_key, first_touch_format,
                 followup_audience_override, brief_segment)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, cluster_label) DO UPDATE SET
                funnel_path_key            = EXCLUDED.funnel_path_key,
                first_touch_format         = EXCLUDED.first_touch_format,
                followup_audience_override = EXCLUDED.followup_audience_override,
                brief_segment              = EXCLUDED.brief_segment
            """, id, tenantId,
            body.get("cluster_label"), body.get("funnel_path_key"),
            body.get("first_touch_format"), body.get("followup_audience_override"),
            body.get("brief_segment"));
        return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of("id", id));
    }

    private Map<String, Object> buildFeatures(UUID tenantId, UUID sessionId, Map<String, Object> body) {
        Map<String, Object> features = new HashMap<>(body);
        if (sessionId != null) {
            try {
                List<Map<String, Object>> sessions = jdbc.queryForList("""
                    SELECT ticket_bucket, self_accredited, device_type,
                        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (form_submitted_at - created_at))/3600 AS time_to_form_h
                    FROM sessions WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ?
                    """, sessionId, tenantId);
                if (!sessions.isEmpty()) sessions.get(0).forEach(features::putIfAbsent);

                List<Map<String, Object>> eventCounts = jdbc.queryForList("""
                    SELECT event_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt
                    FROM events WHERE session_id = ? AND tenant_id = ? GROUP BY event_type
                    """, sessionId, tenantId);
                features.putIfAbsent("material_views", eventCounts.stream()
                    .filter(r -> "MATERIAL_VIEW".equals(r.get("event_type")))
                    .mapToInt(r -> ((Number) r.get("cnt")).intValue()).sum());
                features.putIfAbsent("dataroom_opens", eventCounts.stream()
                    .filter(r -> "DATAROOM_OPEN".equals(r.get("event_type")))
                    .mapToInt(r -> ((Number) r.get("cnt")).intValue()).sum());

                List<Map<String, Object>> callNotes = jdbc.queryForList("""
                    SELECT call_outcome, objection_tags FROM call_notes
                    WHERE session_id = ? AND tenant_id = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
                    """, sessionId, tenantId);
                if (!callNotes.isEmpty()) {
                    features.putIfAbsent("call_outcome",   callNotes.get(0).get("call_outcome"));
                    features.putIfAbsent("objection_tags", callNotes.get(0).get("objection_tags"));
                }

                List<Map<String, Object>> noshow = jdbc.queryForList("""
                    SELECT risk_tier FROM noshow_scores
                    WHERE session_id = ? AND tenant_id = ? ORDER BY scored_at DESC LIMIT 1
                    """, sessionId, tenantId);
                if (!noshow.isEmpty()) features.putIfAbsent("noshow_risk_tier", noshow.get(0).get("risk_tier"));

                List<Map<String, Object>> touchCount = jdbc.queryForList("""
                    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM touchpoints WHERE session_id = ? AND tenant_id = ?
                    """, sessionId, tenantId);
                if (!touchCount.isEmpty())
                    features.putIfAbsent("touch_count", ((Number) touchCount.get(0).get("cnt")).intValue());

            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.warn("Could not load features for session {}: {}", sessionId, e.getMessage());
            }
        }
        features.remove("session_id");
        return features;
    }

    private String toJson(Object o) {
        try { return MAPPER.writeValueAsString(o); }
        catch (Exception e) { return "[]"; }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import com.marketingai.config.AppProperties;
import com.marketingai.entity.ComplianceCheck;
import com.marketingai.repository.ComplianceCheckRepository;
import com.marketingai.security.TenantContext;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.*;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * Media compliance endpoints (4-5): FACE, MUSIC, AI_LABEL checks for renders / footage.
 * Delegates detection to FastAPI POST /compliance/media/check.
 */
@Slf4j
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/compliance/media")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class MediaComplianceController {

    private final ComplianceCheckRepository repo;
    private final RestTemplate restTemplate;
    private final AppProperties appProperties;
    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private final ObjectMapper objectMapper;

    /**
     * Submit an asset for all three media checks (FACE + MUSIC + AI_LABEL).
     * Stores one ComplianceCheck row per check_type that has findings.
     */
    @PostMapping("/check")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> checkMedia(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {

        String entityType = (String) body.getOrDefault("entity_type", "CREATIVE");
        UUID entityId = UUID.fromString((String) body.get("entity_id"));
        String assetUrl = (String) body.getOrDefault("asset_url", "");
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        Map<String, Object> metadata = (Map<String, Object>) body.getOrDefault("metadata", Map.of());

        // Persist the asset record
        jdbc.update("""
                INSERT INTO media_compliance_assets
                    (id, tenant_id, entity_type, entity_id, asset_url, metadata)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?::jsonb)
                """,
                UUID.randomUUID(), tenantId, entityType, entityId,
                assetUrl, toJson(metadata));

        // Call FastAPI
        HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
        headers.setContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
        headers.set("X-Internal-API-Key", appProperties.getInternalApiKey());

        Map<String, Object> mlReq = Map.of("asset_url", assetUrl, "metadata", metadata);
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        Map<String, Object> mlResult;
        try {
            mlResult = restTemplate.postForObject(
                    appProperties.getMlServiceUrl() + "/compliance/media/check",
                    new HttpEntity<>(mlReq, headers), Map.class);
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            log.warn("FastAPI media compliance unavailable for entity {}: {}", entityId, ex.getMessage());
            mlResult = Map.of("result", "WARN", "checks", Map.of(), "findings", List.of());
        }

        if (mlResult == null) {
            mlResult = Map.of("result", "WARN", "checks", Map.of(), "findings", List.of());
        }

        // Persist one row per check type
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        List<Map<String, Object>> individual =
                (List<Map<String, Object>>) mlResult.getOrDefault("individual", List.of());

        List<ComplianceCheck> saved = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Map<String, Object> singleCheck : individual) {
            ComplianceCheck cc = new ComplianceCheck();
            cc.setTenantId(tenantId);
            cc.setEntityType(entityType);
            cc.setEntityId(entityId);
            cc.setCheckType((String) singleCheck.getOrDefault("check_type", "UNKNOWN"));
            cc.setResult((String) singleCheck.getOrDefault("result", "WARN"));
            try {
                cc.setFindings(objectMapper.writeValueAsString(
                        singleCheck.getOrDefault("findings", List.of())));
            } catch (Exception e) {
                cc.setFindings("[]");
            }
            cc.setModelVersion("ml-service-media");
            saved.add(repo.save(cc));
        }

        log.info("Media compliance check for entity {} → result={}", entityId, mlResult.get("result"));
        return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of(
                "result", mlResult.get("result"),
                "checks", mlResult.getOrDefault("checks", Map.of()),
                "saved_checks", saved.size()
        ));
    }

    /** List all media compliance checks for an entity. */
    @GetMapping("/{entityId}")
    public ResponseEntity<List<ComplianceCheck>> getMediaChecks(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @PathVariable UUID entityId) {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(
                repo.findByTenantIdAndEntityIdOrderByCreatedAtDesc(tenantId, entityId)
                        .stream()
                        .filter(c -> List.of("FACE", "MUSIC", "AI_LABEL").contains(c.getCheckType()))
                        .toList()
        );
    }

    /** Override a media compliance check (marketer confirms e.g. model release uploaded). */
    @PostMapping("/{checkId}/override")
    public ResponseEntity<ComplianceCheck> override(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @PathVariable UUID checkId,
            @RequestBody Map<String, String> body) {

        ComplianceCheck check = repo.findById(checkId)
                .filter(c -> c.getTenantId().equals(tenantId))
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND));

        String reason = body.get("reason");
        if (reason == null || reason.isBlank()) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                    "Override reason must not be blank");
        }

        UUID overriderId = UUID.fromString(
                SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication().getName());
        check.setOverriddenBy(overriderId);
        check.setOverrideReason(reason);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(repo.save(check));
    }

    private String toJson(Object obj) {
        try {
            return objectMapper.writeValueAsString(obj);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return "{}";
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import com.marketingai.service.MetaApiService;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.*;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * Meta Custom Audience Sync (Phase 5-5, §7.3 Этап 5).
 *
 * Pushes behavioural segments to Meta as custom audiences via CAPI.
 * Spring Boot is the ONLY CAPI sender (arch §12 #14).
 *
 * Custom audiences = hints to Advantage+ — NOT hard targeting (§25 п.12).
 * Only sessions with consent_level='full' contribute to audience lists.
 */
@Slf4j
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/meta/audiences")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class MetaAudienceController {

    private final JdbcTemplate   jdbc;
    private final MetaApiService metaApiService;

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // GET /api/v1/meta/audiences — list sync history for tenant
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @GetMapping
    public ResponseEntity<List<Map<String, Object>>> list(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId) {

        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT segment_label, audience_id, session_count, synced_at
                FROM meta_audience_sync
                WHERE tenant_id = ?
                ORDER BY synced_at DESC
                LIMIT 100
                """, tenantId);

        return ResponseEntity.ok(rows);
    }

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // POST /api/v1/meta/audiences/sync — push behavioural segments to Meta
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @PostMapping("/sync")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> syncAudiences(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestBody(required = false) Map<String, Object> body) {

        // Build segments from cluster labels with consent_level='full'
        List<Map<String, Object>> segments = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT s.cluster_label AS segment_label,
                       COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS session_count
                FROM sessions s
                WHERE s.tenant_id = ?
                  AND s.consent_level = 'full'
                  AND s.is_suspicious = false
                  AND s.cluster_label IS NOT NULL
                  AND s.started_at > now() - interval '30 days'
                GROUP BY s.cluster_label
                HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) >= 100
                """, tenantId);

        if (segments.isEmpty()) {
            return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of(
                    "synced", 0,
                    "message", "No segments with ≥100 qualifying sessions"
            ));
        }

        // Retrieve Meta pixel credentials for this tenant
        Map<String, Object> pixelConfig;
        try {
            pixelConfig = jdbc.queryForMap("""
                    SELECT ENCODE(p.capi_access_token_enc, 'escape') AS access_token,
                           p.pixel_id,
                           t.meta_ad_account_id AS ad_account_id
                    FROM meta_pixels p
                    JOIN tenants t ON t.id = p.tenant_id
                    WHERE p.tenant_id = ? AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' AND p.purpose = 'PRIMARY'
                    LIMIT 1
                    """, tenantId);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.PRECONDITION_FAILED,
                    "No active Meta pixel configured for this tenant");
        }

        String accessToken  = (String) pixelConfig.get("access_token");
        String adAccountId  = (String) pixelConfig.get("ad_account_id");

        int syncedCount = 0;
        List<Map<String, Object>> results = new ArrayList<>();

        for (Map<String, Object> seg : segments) {
            String segmentLabel = (String) seg.get("segment_label");
            int    sessionCount = ((Number) seg.get("session_count")).intValue();

            // Pull hashed emails/phones for this segment (only users who gave full consent)
            List<Map<String, Object>> contacts = jdbc.queryForList("""
                    SELECT DISTINCT
                        encode(sha256(LOWER(TRIM(u.email))::bytea), 'hex') AS hashed_email
                    FROM sessions s
                    JOIN users u ON u.id::text = s.crm_user_id
                    WHERE s.tenant_id = ?
                      AND s.cluster_label = ?
                      AND s.consent_level = 'full'
                      AND s.is_suspicious = false
                      AND s.started_at > now() - interval '30 days'
                      AND u.email IS NOT NULL
                    LIMIT 10000
                    """, tenantId, segmentLabel);

            if (contacts.isEmpty()) {
                continue;
            }

            List<String> hashedEmails = contacts.stream()
                    .map(c -> (String) c.get("hashed_email"))
                    .filter(Objects::nonNull)
                    .toList();

            try {
                // Create or update custom audience via Meta CAPI
                String audienceId = metaApiService.upsertCustomAudience(
                        accessToken,
                        adAccountId,
                        "mai_" + segmentLabel,
                        "Marketing AI behavioral segment: " + segmentLabel,
                        hashedEmails
                );

                // Record sync in meta_audience_sync
                jdbc.update("""
                        INSERT INTO meta_audience_sync
                            (tenant_id, segment_label, audience_id, session_count, synced_at)
                        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, now())
                        """, tenantId, segmentLabel, audienceId, sessionCount);

                results.add(Map.of(
                        "segment_label", segmentLabel,
                        "audience_id",   audienceId,
                        "session_count", sessionCount,
                        "contacts_sent", hashedEmails.size()
                ));
                syncedCount++;

                log.info("Meta audience sync: tenant={} segment={} audienceId={} contacts={}",
                        tenantId, segmentLabel, audienceId, hashedEmails.size());

            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.error("Failed to sync segment {} for tenant {}: {}",
                        segmentLabel, tenantId, e.getMessage());
                results.add(Map.of(
                        "segment_label", segmentLabel,
                        "error",         e.getMessage()
                ));
            }
        }

        return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of(
                "synced",  syncedCount,
                "results", results
        ));
    }

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // GET /api/v1/meta/audiences/segments — preview which segments exist
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @GetMapping("/segments")
    public ResponseEntity<List<Map<String, Object>>> segments(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId) {

        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT cluster_label AS segment_label,
                       COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS session_count,
                       ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN converted THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)::numeric, 4) AS cvr
                FROM sessions
                WHERE tenant_id = ?
                  AND consent_level = 'full'
                  AND is_suspicious = false
                  AND cluster_label IS NOT NULL
                  AND started_at > now() - interval '30 days'
                GROUP BY cluster_label
                ORDER BY session_count DESC
                """, tenantId);

        return ResponseEntity.ok(rows);
    }
}
```
