```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import com.marketingai.dto.meta.AdSetRequest;
import com.marketingai.dto.meta.AdSetResponse;
import com.marketingai.dto.meta.CampaignRequest;
import com.marketingai.dto.meta.CampaignResponse;
import com.marketingai.dto.meta.RecommendedBatchResponse;
import com.marketingai.dto.meta.TestBatchRequest;
import com.marketingai.dto.meta.WinnerResponse;
import com.marketingai.security.TenantContext;
import com.marketingai.service.ExplorationBudgetService;
import com.marketingai.service.MetaCampaignService;
import com.marketingai.service.TwoContourService;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * REST endpoints for Meta Ads campaigns and ad sets.
 * Base paths follow architecture.md §5.1: /campaigns and /ad-sets
 */
@RestController
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class MetaCampaignController {

    private final MetaCampaignService campaignService;
    private final TwoContourService twoContourService;
    private final ExplorationBudgetService explorationService;
    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;

    // ─── Campaigns ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @PostMapping("/campaigns")
    public ResponseEntity<CampaignResponse> createCampaign(
            @Valid @RequestBody CampaignRequest req) {
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CREATED)
                .body(campaignService.createCampaign(currentTenant(), req));
    }

    @GetMapping("/campaigns")
    public List<CampaignResponse> listCampaigns() {
        return campaignService.listCampaigns(currentTenant());
    }

    @PostMapping("/campaigns/{id}/pause")
    public CampaignResponse pauseCampaign(@PathVariable UUID id) {
        return campaignService.pauseCampaign(currentTenant(), id);
    }

    @PostMapping("/campaigns/{id}/activate")
    public CampaignResponse activateCampaign(@PathVariable UUID id) {
        return campaignService.activateCampaign(currentTenant(), id);
    }

    /**
     * Transfer winning ad set from TEST contour to SCALE campaign.
     * Implements two-contour structure per vision §6.5.
     */
    @PostMapping("/campaigns/transfer-to-scale")
    public CampaignResponse transferToScale(@RequestParam UUID winnerAdSetId) {
        return campaignService.transferToScale(currentTenant(), winnerAdSetId);
    }

    // ─── Two-Contour Workflow (§6.5) ────────────────────────────────────────

    /**
     * Recommend next test batch using Exploration Budget (§6.4).
     * Returns exploitation (EVI-ranked) + exploration (new/untested) candidate slots.
     * The marketer reviews and submits the chosen creatives via /launch-batch.
     */
    @GetMapping("/campaigns/{id}/recommend-batch")
    public RecommendedBatchResponse recommendBatch(
            @PathVariable UUID id,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "9") int batchSize) {
        return explorationService.recommendBatch(currentTenant(), id, batchSize);
    }

    /**
     * Launch a batch of ad sets in a TEST campaign with equal budgets.
     * All ad sets in the batch get the same perAdSetDailyBudget.
     */
    @PostMapping("/campaigns/{id}/launch-batch")
    public ResponseEntity<List<AdSetResponse>> launchTestBatch(
            @PathVariable UUID id,
            @Valid @RequestBody TestBatchRequest req) {
        req.setCampaignId(id);
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CREATED)
                .body(twoContourService.launchTestBatch(currentTenant(), req));
    }

    /**
     * Select the winner from the latest test batch using shrinkage-adjusted estimates.
     * Returns a recommendation for the marketer before starting confirmation run.
     */
    @GetMapping("/campaigns/{id}/winner")
    public WinnerResponse selectWinner(@PathVariable UUID id) {
        return twoContourService.selectWinner(currentTenant(), id);
    }

    /**
     * Start confirmation run for the winner ad set.
     * Creates a new ad set with 1.5× budget to verify the result reproduces.
     */
    @PostMapping("/campaigns/{id}/confirmation-run")
    public CampaignResponse startConfirmationRun(
            @PathVariable UUID id,
            @RequestParam UUID winnerAdSetId) {
        return twoContourService.startConfirmationRun(currentTenant(), id, winnerAdSetId);
    }

    /**
     * Confirm the winner passed the confirmation run and transfer to SCALE.
     * Should be called after confirmation run has been live ≥ 3 days.
     */
    @PostMapping("/campaigns/{id}/confirm-and-transfer")
    public CampaignResponse confirmAndTransfer(
            @PathVariable UUID id,
            @RequestParam UUID winnerAdSetId) {
        return twoContourService.confirmAndTransfer(currentTenant(), id, winnerAdSetId);
    }

    /**
     * Mark confirmation run as FAILED (marketer decision — result did not reproduce).
     * Resets confirmationStatus to FAILED so a new winner can be selected.
     */
    @PostMapping("/campaigns/{id}/fail-confirmation")
    public CampaignResponse failConfirmation(@PathVariable UUID id) {
        return twoContourService.failConfirmation(currentTenant(), id);
    }

    // ─── Ad Sets ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @PostMapping("/ad-sets")
    public ResponseEntity<AdSetResponse> createAdSet(
            @Valid @RequestBody AdSetRequest req) {
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CREATED)
                .body(campaignService.createAdSet(currentTenant(), req));
    }

    @GetMapping("/ad-sets")
    public List<AdSetResponse> listAdSets(@RequestParam UUID campaignId) {
        return campaignService.listAdSets(currentTenant(), campaignId);
    }

    /**
     * Campaign-setup guard: checks conversion event volume for meaningful optimization (vision §16.1).
     * Meta requires ≥50 conversions/week before optimizing for conversion events.
     */
    @GetMapping("/campaigns/{id}/setup-guard")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> setupGuard(@PathVariable UUID id) {
        UUID tenantId = currentTenant();

        Integer convCount = jdbc.queryForObject("""
            SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.id)
            FROM events e
            JOIN sessions s ON s.id = e.session_id
            WHERE s.tenant_id = ?
              AND e.event_type = 'CONVERSION'
              AND e.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
            """, Integer.class, tenantId);

        int n = convCount != null ? convCount : 0;
        boolean sufficient = n >= 50;

        Map<String, Object> resp = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        resp.put("campaign_id",         id);
        resp.put("conversion_count_7d", n);
        resp.put("min_required",        50);
        resp.put("has_enough_events",   sufficient);
        resp.put("can_launch",          sufficient);
        resp.put("recommendation", sufficient
            ? "Sufficient conversion volume for Meta optimization."
            : String.format("Only %d conversion events in last 7 days. Meta recommends ≥50/week. Consider broader audience or longer attribution window.", n));
        return ResponseEntity.ok(resp);
    }

    // ─── Internal ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private UUID currentTenant() {
        String raw = TenantContext.get();
        if (raw == null) throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED, "No tenant context");
        return UUID.fromString(raw);
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import com.marketingai.dto.pixel.CreatePixelRequest;
import com.marketingai.dto.pixel.PixelResponse;
import com.marketingai.dto.pixel.UpdatePixelRequest;
import com.marketingai.security.TenantContext;
import com.marketingai.service.MetaPixelService;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Multi-Pixel management — §6.8 Pixel Pollution Protection.
 *
 * Pixel purposes:
 *  PRIMARY  — clean pixel for confirmed CRM conversions (scale contour)
 *  TEST     — isolated pixel for test campaigns (prevents primary pixel pollution)
 *  PRODUCT  — per-product pixel for multi-product tenants
 *
 * Default pixel is used by CAPIForwardingService when no explicit pixel is specified.
 */
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/pixels")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class MetaPixelController {

    private final MetaPixelService pixelService;

    @GetMapping
    public List<PixelResponse> list() {
        return pixelService.listForTenant(currentTenant());
    }

    @PostMapping
    public ResponseEntity<PixelResponse> create(@Valid @RequestBody CreatePixelRequest req) {
        PixelResponse created = pixelService.create(currentTenant(), req);
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CREATED).body(created);
    }

    @GetMapping("/{id}")
    public PixelResponse get(@PathVariable UUID id) {
        return pixelService.getOwned(id, currentTenant());
    }

    @PutMapping("/{id}")
    public PixelResponse update(
            @PathVariable UUID id,
            @Valid @RequestBody UpdatePixelRequest req) {
        return pixelService.update(id, currentTenant(), req);
    }

    /** Deactivate pixel (sets status = ARCHIVED). Cannot deactivate the default pixel. */
    @DeleteMapping("/{id}")
    public ResponseEntity<Void> delete(@PathVariable UUID id) {
        pixelService.delete(id, currentTenant());
        return ResponseEntity.noContent().build();
    }

    /**
     * Set pixel as the tenant default.
     * Atomically unsets previous default and sets this one.
     * Default pixel is used by CAPI forwarding when no campaign-level pixel override exists.
     */
    @PutMapping("/{id}/default")
    public PixelResponse setDefault(@PathVariable UUID id) {
        return pixelService.setDefault(id, currentTenant());
    }

    private UUID currentTenant() {
        String raw = TenantContext.get();
        if (raw == null) throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED, "No tenant context");
        return UUID.fromString(raw);
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * Micro-conversion funnel map per landing block (vision §7.2).
 * Tracks BLOCK_VIEW → CTA_CLICK → FORM_START → FORM_SUBMIT per block.
 */
@Slf4j
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/micro-conversion")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class MicroConversionController {

    private static final Set<String> VALID_TYPES =
            Set.of("BLOCK_VIEW", "CTA_CLICK", "FORM_START", "FORM_SUBMIT");

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;

    /** Batch ingest micro-conversion events. */
    @PostMapping
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> ingest(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        List<Map<String, Object>> events = (List<Map<String, Object>>)
                body.getOrDefault("events", List.of());

        int inserted = 0;
        for (Map<String, Object> ev : events) {
            String eventType = String.valueOf(ev.getOrDefault("event_type", ""));
            if (!VALID_TYPES.contains(eventType)) continue;

            String blockId = String.valueOf(ev.getOrDefault("block_id", ""));
            if (blockId.isBlank()) continue;

            Object sessionIdRaw = ev.get("session_id");
            UUID sessionId = sessionIdRaw != null ? UUID.fromString(sessionIdRaw.toString()) : null;

            Object landingIdRaw = ev.get("landing_id");
            UUID landingId = landingIdRaw != null ? UUID.fromString(landingIdRaw.toString()) : null;

            String blockEventId = ev.containsKey("block_event_id")
                    ? ev.get("block_event_id").toString() : null;

            jdbc.update("""
                    INSERT INTO micro_conversion_events
                        (id, tenant_id, session_id, landing_id, block_id, event_type, block_event_id)
                    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                    """,
                    UUID.randomUUID(), tenantId, sessionId, landingId, blockId, eventType, blockEventId);
            inserted++;
        }

        return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of("inserted", inserted));
    }

    /** Funnel report: BLOCK_VIEW → CTA_CLICK → FORM_START → FORM_SUBMIT per block. */
    @GetMapping("/funnel")
    public ResponseEntity<List<Map<String, Object>>> funnel(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestParam(required = false) UUID landingId) {

        String sql;
        Object[] args;

        if (landingId != null) {
            sql = """
                    SELECT block_id,
                           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'BLOCK_VIEW')   AS block_views,
                           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'CTA_CLICK')    AS cta_clicks,
                           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'FORM_START')   AS form_starts,
                           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'FORM_SUBMIT')  AS form_submits
                    FROM micro_conversion_events
                    WHERE tenant_id = ? AND landing_id = ?
                    GROUP BY block_id
                    ORDER BY block_views DESC
                    """;
            args = new Object[]{tenantId, landingId};
        } else {
            sql = """
                    SELECT block_id,
                           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'BLOCK_VIEW')   AS block_views,
                           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'CTA_CLICK')    AS cta_clicks,
                           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'FORM_START')   AS form_starts,
                           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'FORM_SUBMIT')  AS form_submits
                    FROM micro_conversion_events
                    WHERE tenant_id = ?
                    GROUP BY block_id
                    ORDER BY block_views DESC
                    """;
            args = new Object[]{tenantId};
        }

        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbc.queryForList(sql, args);

        // Enrich with conversion rates
        for (Map<String, Object> row : rows) {
            long views  = toLong(row.get("block_views"));
            long clicks = toLong(row.get("cta_clicks"));
            long starts = toLong(row.get("form_starts"));
            long submits = toLong(row.get("form_submits"));
            row.put("view_to_click_rate",   views  > 0 ? round((double) clicks  / views, 4)  : null);
            row.put("click_to_start_rate",  clicks > 0 ? round((double) starts  / clicks, 4) : null);
            row.put("start_to_submit_rate", starts > 0 ? round((double) submits / starts, 4) : null);
        }

        return ResponseEntity.ok(rows);
    }

    private long toLong(Object v) {
        return v instanceof Number ? ((Number) v).longValue() : 0L;
    }

    private double round(double v, int decimals) {
        double scale = Math.pow(10, decimals);
        return Math.round(v * scale) / scale;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import com.marketingai.config.AppProperties;
import com.marketingai.security.TenantContext;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.HttpEntity;
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * MMF + Offer Explorer (3-19).
 * GET  /api/v1/mmf          — latest diagnoses
 * GET  /api/v1/mmf/offers   — active offer candidates
 * POST /api/v1/mmf/diagnose — trigger ML diagnosis for a campaign
 */
@Slf4j
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/mmf")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class MmfController {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private final RestTemplate restTemplate;
    private final AppProperties appProperties;

    @GetMapping
    public List<Map<String, Object>> getRecentDiagnoses() {
        UUID tenantId = currentTenant();
        return jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT id, campaign_id, diagnosis, confidence, recommendations, created_at
                FROM mmf_diagnoses
                WHERE tenant_id = ?
                  AND created_at > now() - interval '7 days'
                ORDER BY created_at DESC
                LIMIT 20
                """, tenantId);
    }

    @GetMapping("/offers")
    public List<Map<String, Object>> getActiveOffers() {
        UUID tenantId = currentTenant();
        return jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT id, campaign_id, label, price, usp, guarantee_days,
                       price_anchor, expected_value, status, created_at
                FROM offer_candidates
                WHERE tenant_id = ?
                  AND status = 'ACTIVE'
                ORDER BY expected_value DESC
                LIMIT 50
                """, tenantId);
    }

    record DiagnoseRequest(UUID campaign_id, Map<String, Object> metrics) {}

    @PostMapping("/diagnose")
    public Map<String, Object> diagnose(@RequestBody DiagnoseRequest req) {
        UUID tenantId = currentTenant();

        String url = appProperties.getMlServiceUrl() + "/mmf/diagnose";
        HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
        headers.setContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
        headers.set("X-Internal-API-Key", appProperties.getInternalApiKey());

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        Map<String, Object> mlResult;
        try {
            mlResult = restTemplate.postForObject(
                    url, new HttpEntity<>(req.metrics(), headers), Map.class);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("MMF ml-service call failed: {}", e.getMessage());
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, "ML service unavailable");
        }

        if (mlResult == null) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, "Empty MMF response");
        }

        String diagnosis = mlResult.getOrDefault("diagnosis", "HEALTHY").toString();
        double confidence = mlResult.get("confidence") instanceof Number n ? n.doubleValue() : 0.5;
        Object recommendations = mlResult.getOrDefault("recommendations", List.of());

        UUID diagId = UUID.randomUUID();
        jdbc.update("""
                INSERT INTO mmf_diagnoses
                (id, tenant_id, campaign_id, diagnosis, confidence, recommendations, created_at)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?::jsonb, now())
                """,
                diagId, tenantId, req.campaign_id(),
                diagnosis, (float) confidence,
                recommendations.toString().replace("[", "[\"").replace("]", "\"]").replace(", ", "\", \""));

        Map<String, Object> result = new HashMap<>(mlResult);  // safe: mlResult is Map<String,Object>
        result.put("diagnosis_id", diagId);
        result.put("campaign_id", req.campaign_id());
        return result;
    }

    private UUID currentTenant() {
        String raw = TenantContext.get();
        if (raw == null) throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED, "No tenant context");
        return UUID.fromString(raw);
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.*;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * Bayesian MMM endpoints (Phase 7, §17.3).
 * Delegates model computation to FastAPI /mmm/contributions and /mmm/optimize.
 */
@Slf4j
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/mmm")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class MmmController {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private final RestTemplate restTemplate;

    // ─── GET /latest ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @GetMapping("/latest")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> latest(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId) {

        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT id, model_version, channels, contributions, saturation_curves,
                       budget_allocation, total_budget, date_range_start, date_range_end,
                       n_obs, fit_metrics, created_at
                FROM mmm_results
                WHERE tenant_id = ?
                ORDER BY created_at DESC
                LIMIT 1
                """, tenantId);

        if (rows.isEmpty()) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "No MMM results yet for this tenant");
        }
        return ResponseEntity.ok(rows.get(0));
    }

    // ─── POST /fit ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Loads 90-day insights → calls FastAPI /mmm/contributions → stores result.

    @PostMapping("/fit")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> fit(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId) {

        LocalDate end   = LocalDate.now();
        LocalDate start = end.minusDays(90);

        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT channel, SUM(spend) AS total_spend, SUM(conversions) AS total_conversions,
                       SUM(impressions) AS total_impressions
                FROM channel_insights_history
                WHERE tenant_id = ?
                  AND date BETWEEN ? AND ?
                GROUP BY channel
                """, tenantId, start, end);

        if (rows.isEmpty()) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
                    "No channel insights data for the last 90 days");
        }

        // Build spend_data per channel (daily series — simplified: one value per channel)
        Map<String, List<Double>> spendData = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        Map<String, Double> contributions = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        double totalSpend = rows.stream()
                .mapToDouble(r -> ((Number) r.get("total_spend")).doubleValue()).sum();

        for (Map<String, Object> row : rows) {
            String channel = (String) row.get("channel");
            double spend   = ((Number) row.get("total_spend")).doubleValue();
            spendData.put(channel, List.of(spend));
            contributions.put(channel, totalSpend > 0 ? spend / totalSpend : 0.0);
        }

        Map<String, Object> mlReq = Map.of(
                "spend_data",    spendData,
                "contributions", contributions
        );

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        Map<String, Object> mlResult;
        try {
            mlResult = restTemplate.postForObject(
                    "http://ml-service:8001/mmm/contributions", mlReq, Map.class);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_GATEWAY,
                    "MMM service error: " + e.getMessage());
        }

        if (mlResult == null) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_GATEWAY, "MMM service returned null");
        }

        UUID resultId = UUID.randomUUID();
        jdbc.update("""
                INSERT INTO mmm_results
                    (id, tenant_id, model_version, channels, contributions, saturation_curves,
                     budget_allocation, total_budget, date_range_start, date_range_end, n_obs, fit_metrics)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?::jsonb, ?::jsonb, ?::jsonb, ?::jsonb, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?::jsonb)
                """,
                resultId, tenantId, "v1",
                toJson(mlResult.get("channels")),
                toJson(mlResult.get("contributions")),
                toJson(mlResult.getOrDefault("saturation_curves", Map.of())),
                toJson(mlResult.getOrDefault("budget_allocation", Map.of())),
                BigDecimal.valueOf(totalSpend),
                start, end,
                rows.size(),
                "{}"
        );

        Map<String, Object> resp = new LinkedHashMap<>(mlResult);
        resp.put("result_id", resultId);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(resp);
    }

    // ─── GET /budget-recommendation ──────────────────────────────────────────

    @GetMapping("/budget-recommendation")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> budgetRecommendation(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "10000") double totalBudget) {

        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT contributions, channels
                FROM mmm_results
                WHERE tenant_id = ?
                ORDER BY created_at DESC
                LIMIT 1
                """, tenantId);

        if (rows.isEmpty()) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
                    "No MMM results yet — run /fit first");
        }

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        Map<String, Double> contributions = (Map<String, Double>) rows.get(0).get("contributions");

        // Build default saturation params from contributions (simple heuristic)
        Map<String, Map<String, Object>> satParams = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        if (contributions != null) {
            for (Map.Entry<String, Double> e : contributions.entrySet()) {
                satParams.put(e.getKey(), Map.of(
                        "half_saturation", 5000.0,
                        "slope",           1.0,
                        "decay_rate",      0.5,
                        "roi_scale",       e.getValue() > 0 ? 1.0 / e.getValue() : 1.0
                ));
            }
        }

        Map<String, Object> mlReq = Map.of(
                "saturation_params", satParams,
                "total_budget",      totalBudget
        );

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        Map<String, Object> mlResult;
        try {
            mlResult = restTemplate.postForObject(
                    "http://ml-service:8001/mmm/optimize", mlReq, Map.class);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_GATEWAY,
                    "MMM service error: " + e.getMessage());
        }

        if (mlResult == null) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_GATEWAY, "MMM service returned null");
        }

        return ResponseEntity.ok(mlResult);
    }

    private String toJson(Object obj) {
        try {
            return new com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper().writeValueAsString(obj);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return "{}";
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * Compliance by Construction + Moderation Probe + Reviewer Persona (vision §19.18.4; arch §16.17).
 */
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/moderation")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Slf4j
public class ModerationController {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private final RestTemplate restTemplate;

    @GetMapping("/results")
    public ResponseEntity<List<Map<String, Object>>> getResults(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId) {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(jdbc.queryForList("""
            SELECT mr.*, c.name AS creative_name
            FROM moderation_results mr
            LEFT JOIN creatives c ON c.id = mr.creative_id
            WHERE mr.tenant_id = ? ORDER BY mr.checked_at DESC LIMIT 100
            """, tenantId));
    }

    @PostMapping("/record")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> record(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {
        UUID id = UUID.randomUUID();
        jdbc.update("""
            INSERT INTO moderation_results
                (id, tenant_id, creative_id, ad_set_id, probe_type, result, meta_rejection_code)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            """, id, tenantId,
            body.get("creative_id") != null ? UUID.fromString((String) body.get("creative_id")) : null,
            body.get("ad_set_id")   != null ? UUID.fromString((String) body.get("ad_set_id"))   : null,
            body.getOrDefault("probe_type", "meta_review"),
            body.get("result"),
            body.get("meta_rejection_code"));

        if ("REJECTED".equals(body.get("result")) && body.get("creative_id") != null) {
            jdbc.update("""
                UPDATE creatives SET client_label = 'loser' WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ?
                """, UUID.fromString((String) body.get("creative_id")), tenantId);
            log.info("Creative {} marked as loser after Meta rejection", body.get("creative_id"));
        }
        return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of("id", id));
    }

    @PostMapping("/persona-score")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> personaScore(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {
        String text = (String) body.get("text");
        if (text == null || text.isBlank()) {
            return ResponseEntity.badRequest().body(Map.of("error", "text required"));
        }

        List<Map<String, Object>> personas = jdbc.queryForList("""
            SELECT persona_key, rulebases, traits FROM personas
            WHERE persona_key = 'META_REVIEWER' AND is_active = TRUE LIMIT 1
            """);
        if (personas.isEmpty()) {
            return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of("verdict", "UNKNOWN", "note", "META_REVIEWER persona not seeded"));
        }

        List<Map<String, Object>> rulebases = jdbc.queryForList("""
            SELECT rulebase_key, rules::text AS rules FROM compliance_rulebases
            WHERE (tenant_id = ? OR tenant_id IS NULL) AND is_active = TRUE
            """, tenantId);

        Map<String, Object> complianceReq = Map.of("text", text, "rulebases", rulebases);
        try {
            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
            Map<String, Object> complianceResult = restTemplate.postForObject(
                "http://ml-service:8001/compliance/check", complianceReq, Map.class);

            Map<String, Object> personaReq = Map.of(
                "text",               text,
                "persona",            personas.get(0),
                "compliance_results", complianceResult != null ? complianceResult : Map.of());
            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
            Map<String, Object> result = restTemplate.postForObject(
                "http://ml-service:8001/persona/score", personaReq, Map.class);
            return ResponseEntity.ok(result != null ? result : Map.of("verdict", "ERROR"));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of("verdict", "UNKNOWN", "error", e.getMessage()));
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * 8-12: Month-1 Deliverables for Client #1 (vision §19.15).
 * Three widgets for the investor lead-gen funnel.
 */
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/month1")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Slf4j
public class Month1Controller {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;

    /**
     * Widget 1 — Pixel protection.
     * Returns leads NOT sent to the investor pixel this week
     * (non-accredited routed to future_regcf; no-shows withheld).
     */
    @GetMapping("/pixel-protection")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> pixelProtection(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId) {

        // Leads submitted this week
        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbc.queryForList("""
            SELECT
                COUNT(*)                                          AS total_submissions,
                COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE (payload->>'self_accredited')::boolean = false)
                                                                  AS non_accredited,
                COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE (payload->>'self_accredited')::boolean = true
                                    AND (payload->>'lead_score')::numeric < 50)
                                                                  AS low_score_withheld
            FROM form_submissions
            WHERE tenant_id = ?
            AND submitted_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
            """, tenantId);

        Map<String, Object> data = rows.isEmpty() ? Map.of() : rows.get(0);
        long total       = toLong(data.get("total_submissions"));
        long nonAccr     = toLong(data.get("non_accredited"));
        long lowScore    = toLong(data.get("low_score_withheld"));
        long protected_  = nonAccr + lowScore;
        long sent        = total - protected_;

        return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of(
            "period",               "last_7_days",
            "total_submissions",    total,
            "sent_to_investor_pixel", sent,
            "protected_count",      protected_,
            "non_accredited",       nonAccr,
            "low_score_withheld",   lowScore,
            "protection_rate_pct",  total > 0 ? Math.round(100.0 * protected_ / total) : 0
        ));
    }

    /**
     * Widget 2 — Cost per CALL_HELD per creative with CI vs anchor.
     * Returns cost_per_held_call per creative_id for the past 30 days.
     */
    @GetMapping("/cost-per-held-call")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> costPerHeldCall(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId) {

        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbc.queryForList("""
            SELECT
                e.creative_id,
                c.name AS creative_name,
                COUNT(DISTINCT e.session_id) FILTER (
                    WHERE e.event_type = 'CALL_HELD'
                )                                                  AS held_calls,
                COUNT(DISTINCT e.session_id) FILTER (
                    WHERE e.event_type = 'PAGE_VIEW'
                )                                                  AS page_views,
                ROUND(
                    SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'CALL_HELD'
                             THEN COALESCE((e.properties->>'cpm_cost')::numeric, 0)
                             ELSE 0 END)
                    / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT e.session_id) FILTER (
                        WHERE e.event_type = 'CALL_HELD'), 0),
                2)                                                 AS cost_per_held_call
            FROM events e
            LEFT JOIN creatives c ON c.id = e.creative_id AND c.tenant_id = e.tenant_id
            WHERE e.tenant_id = ?
            AND e.occurred_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
            GROUP BY e.creative_id, c.name
            HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.session_id) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = 'CALL_HELD') > 0
            ORDER BY cost_per_held_call NULLS LAST
            """, tenantId);

        // Anchor = minimum cost_per_held_call across creatives
        OptionalDouble anchor = rows.stream()
            .mapToDouble(r -> toDouble(r.get("cost_per_held_call")))
            .filter(v -> v > 0)
            .min();

        rows.forEach(r -> {
            double cph = toDouble(r.get("cost_per_held_call"));
            double anch = anchor.orElse(cph);
            r.put("vs_anchor_pct", anch > 0 ? Math.round(100.0 * (cph - anch) / anch) : 0);
        });

        return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of(
            "period",    "last_30_days",
            "creatives", rows,
            "anchor_cost_per_held_call", anchor.orElse(0.0)
        ));
    }

    /**
     * Widget 3 — No-show rate per follow-up variant vs control.
     */
    @GetMapping("/noshow-rate")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> noshowRate(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId) {

        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbc.queryForList("""
            SELECT
                fv.id            AS variant_id,
                fv.name          AS variant_name,
                fv.is_control,
                COUNT(fa.id)     AS assigned,
                COUNT(fa.id) FILTER (WHERE fa.outcome = 'SHOWED')    AS showed,
                COUNT(fa.id) FILTER (WHERE fa.outcome = 'NO_SHOW')   AS no_shows,
                ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(fa.id) FILTER (WHERE fa.outcome = 'NO_SHOW')
                    / NULLIF(COUNT(fa.id) FILTER (
                        WHERE fa.outcome IN ('SHOWED','NO_SHOW')), 0), 1)
                                 AS noshow_rate_pct
            FROM followup_variants fv
            LEFT JOIN followup_assignments fa ON fa.variant_id = fv.id
                AND fa.assigned_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
            WHERE fv.tenant_id = ?
            GROUP BY fv.id, fv.name, fv.is_control
            ORDER BY fv.is_control DESC, noshow_rate_pct NULLS LAST
            """, tenantId);

        // Estimate days-to-significance using normal approximation (p1 vs p2)
        double controlRate = rows.stream()
            .filter(r -> Boolean.TRUE.equals(r.get("is_control")))
            .mapToDouble(r -> toDouble(r.get("noshow_rate_pct")) / 100.0)
            .findFirst().orElse(0.5);

        rows.forEach(r -> {
            if (!Boolean.TRUE.equals(r.get("is_control"))) {
                long n = toLong(r.get("assigned"));
                double p2 = toDouble(r.get("noshow_rate_pct")) / 100.0;
                long daysEst = estimateDaysToSignificance(controlRate, p2, n);
                r.put("days_to_significance_est", daysEst < 0 ? "already_sig" : daysEst);
            }
        });

        return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of(
            "period",    "last_30_days",
            "variants",  rows,
            "control_noshow_rate_pct", controlRate * 100
        ));
    }

    /**
     * Compliance status — lists recently failed pre-checks for this tenant.
     */
    @GetMapping("/compliance-status")
    public ResponseEntity<List<Map<String, Object>>> complianceStatus(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId) {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(jdbc.queryForList("""
            SELECT id, rule_type, input_text_snippet, violations, checked_at
            FROM (
                SELECT id, rule_type,
                       LEFT(input_text, 80) AS input_text_snippet,
                       violations,
                       created_at AS checked_at
                FROM compliance_rulebases
                WHERE 1=0  -- placeholder; real impl reads audit log
                UNION ALL
                SELECT gen_random_uuid(), 'N/A', 'No violations recorded', '[]'::jsonb, NOW()
            ) sub
            LIMIT 20
            """));
    }

    /**
     * Summary — all three widgets combined.
     */
    @GetMapping("/summary")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> summary(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId) {
        Map<String, Object> result = new LinkedHashMap<>();

        try { result.put("pixel_protection", pixelProtection(tenantId).getBody()); }
        catch (Exception e) { result.put("pixel_protection", Map.of("error", e.getMessage())); }

        try { result.put("cost_per_held_call", costPerHeldCall(tenantId).getBody()); }
        catch (Exception e) { result.put("cost_per_held_call", Map.of("error", e.getMessage())); }

        try { result.put("noshow_rate", noshowRate(tenantId).getBody()); }
        catch (Exception e) { result.put("noshow_rate", Map.of("error", e.getMessage())); }

        return ResponseEntity.ok(result);
    }

    // ── helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private long toLong(Object v) {
        if (v == null) return 0;
        if (v instanceof Number n) return n.longValue();
        try { return Long.parseLong(v.toString()); } catch (Exception e) { return 0; }
    }

    private double toDouble(Object v) {
        if (v == null) return 0.0;
        if (v instanceof Number n) return n.doubleValue();
        try { return Double.parseDouble(v.toString()); } catch (Exception e) { return 0.0; }
    }

    /**
     * Rough estimate of additional days needed for p2 to reach significance vs p1.
     * Returns -1 if already significant (|z| >= 1.96).
     */
    private long estimateDaysToSignificance(double p1, double p2, long currentN) {
        if (currentN < 5) return 90;
        double diff = Math.abs(p1 - p2);
        if (diff < 0.001) return 999;
        double pooled = (p1 + p2) / 2.0;
        double se = Math.sqrt(2 * pooled * (1 - pooled) / currentN);
        double z = diff / (se < 1e-9 ? 1e-9 : se);
        if (z >= 1.96) return -1;
        double requiredN = 2 * pooled * (1 - pooled) * Math.pow(1.96 / diff, 2);
        long additionalN = Math.max(0, (long) requiredN - currentN);
        // assume same daily rate
        double dailyRate = currentN / 30.0;
        return dailyRate > 0 ? (long) (additionalN / dailyRate) : 999;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import com.marketingai.security.TenantContext;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Month-1 analytics dashboard.
 * Returns Quality Gate savings and date-to-significance estimates.
 */
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/analytics/month1")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class Month1DashboardController {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;

    @GetMapping
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> month1() {
        UUID tenantId = UUID.fromString(TenantContext.get());

        // Quality Gate savings: sessions/conversions blocked from low-quality variants
        Map<String, Object> qualityGate = jdbc.queryForMap("""
                SELECT
                    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE quality_score < 0.3)            AS low_quality_sessions,
                    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE quality_score >= 0.3)           AS passing_sessions,
                    ROUND(AVG(quality_score)::numeric, 3)                  AS avg_quality_score,
                    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE quality_score < 0.3 AND converted) AS blocked_conversions_estimate
                FROM sessions
                WHERE tenant_id = ?
                  AND quality_score IS NOT NULL
                  AND closed_at >= now() - INTERVAL '30 days'
                  AND consent_level = 'full'
                  AND is_suspicious = false
                """, tenantId);

        // Date-to-significance: active variants with Thompson arms
        List<Map<String, Object>> significance = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT
                    v.id        AS variant_id,
                    v.name      AS variant_name,
                    ta.alpha    AS alpha,
                    ta.beta     AS beta,
                    (ta.alpha + ta.beta - 2) AS total_observations,
                    CASE
                        WHEN (ta.alpha + ta.beta - 2) < 100 THEN 'Collecting data'
                        WHEN ta.alpha / NULLIF(ta.alpha + ta.beta, 0) > 0.55 THEN 'Approaching significance'
                        ELSE 'Insufficient signal'
                    END AS significance_status
                FROM landing_variants v
                JOIN thompson_arms ta ON ta.variant_id = v.id AND ta.context_key = 'global'
                WHERE v.tenant_id = ?
                  AND v.status = 'ACTIVE'
                ORDER BY total_observations DESC
                LIMIT 20
                """, tenantId);

        // Clickbait suspects in last 30 days
        List<Map<String, Object>> clickbaitSuspects = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT creative_id, quality_score, clickbait_suspect, computed_at
                FROM creative_quality
                WHERE tenant_id = ?
                  AND clickbait_suspect = true
                  AND computed_at >= now() - INTERVAL '30 days'
                ORDER BY computed_at DESC
                """, tenantId);

        Map<String, Object> result = new HashMap<>();
        result.put("quality_gate", qualityGate);
        result.put("variant_significance", significance);
        result.put("clickbait_suspects", clickbaitSuspects);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(result);
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;

import java.util.*;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/benchmarks")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Slf4j
public class NicheBenchmarkController {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private final RestTemplate restTemplate;

    @GetMapping("/niche/{nicheKey}")
    public ResponseEntity<List<Map<String, Object>>> getNicheBenchmarks(
            @PathVariable String nicheKey) {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(jdbc.queryForList("""
            SELECT metric_key, value, tenant_count, computed_at, data_window_days
            FROM niche_benchmarks
            WHERE niche_key = ?
            AND computed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '48 hours'
            ORDER BY metric_key, computed_at DESC
            """, nicheKey));
    }

    @GetMapping("/my-performance")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> myPerformance(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId) {
        List<String> niches = jdbc.queryForList(
            "SELECT COALESCE(niche_key, 'generic') FROM tenants WHERE id = ?",
            String.class, tenantId);
        if (niches.isEmpty()) return ResponseEntity.notFound().build();
        String niche = niches.get(0);

        Map<String, Object> tenantMetrics = computeTenantMetrics(tenantId);

        List<Map<String, Object>> benchmarks = jdbc.queryForList("""
            SELECT metric_key, value FROM niche_benchmarks
            WHERE niche_key = ? AND value IS NOT NULL
            AND computed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '48 hours'
            ORDER BY computed_at DESC
            """, niche);

        try {
            Map<String, Object> req = Map.of(
                "tenant_metrics", tenantMetrics,
                "benchmarks",     benchmarks
            );
            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
            Map<String, Object> comparison = restTemplate.postForObject(
                "http://ml-service:8001/attribution/benchmarks/compare", req, Map.class);
            return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of(
                "niche",      niche,
                "my_metrics", tenantMetrics,
                "benchmarks", benchmarks,
                "comparison", comparison != null ? comparison : Map.of()
            ));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.warn("Benchmark compare failed: {}", e.getMessage());
            return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of(
                "niche", niche, "my_metrics", tenantMetrics, "benchmarks", benchmarks));
        }
    }

    private Map<String, Object> computeTenantMetrics(UUID tenantId) {
        try {
            return jdbc.queryForMap("""
                SELECT
                    ROUND(COUNT(re.id) FILTER (WHERE re.is_quality_stage) * 1.0 /
                          NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT a.id), 0), 4) AS show_rate,
                    ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) * 1.0 /
                          NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT fs.id), 0), 4) AS form_to_booked,
                    AVG(a.booking_distance_h)                   AS avg_booking_distance_h
                FROM tenants t
                LEFT JOIN appointments    a  ON a.tenant_id = t.id
                    AND a.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
                LEFT JOIN reward_events   re ON re.tenant_id = t.id
                    AND re.is_quality_stage = TRUE
                    AND re.rewarded_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
                LEFT JOIN form_submissions fs ON fs.tenant_id = t.id
                    AND fs.submitted_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
                WHERE t.id = ?
                """, tenantId);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return Map.of();
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import com.marketingai.service.CAPIEmqCheckService;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Onboarding readiness checklist + CAPI EMQ pre-check (roadmap 8-2; vision §19.2).
 * GET /api/v1/onboarding/checklist — 7-item go-live checklist
 * GET /api/v1/onboarding/capi-emq-check — CAPI EMQ first-party pre-check
 */
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/onboarding")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Slf4j
public class OnboardingController {

    private final JdbcTemplate        jdbc;
    private final CAPIEmqCheckService  emqCheckService;

    @GetMapping("/capi-emq-check")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> capiEmqCheck(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId) {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(emqCheckService.runEmqPreCheck(tenantId));
    }

    @GetMapping("/checklist")
    public ResponseEntity<List<Map<String, Object>>> checklist(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId) {

        List<Map<String, Object>> items = new ArrayList<>();

        int stageCount = count("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM funnel_stages WHERE tenant_id = ?", tenantId);
        items.add(item("funnel_stages", "Funnel stages configured",
                stageCount >= 3, stageCount + " stages found (minimum 3)"));

        int pixelCount = count("""
            SELECT COUNT(*) FROM meta_pixels WHERE tenant_id = ? AND status = 'ACTIVE'
            """, tenantId);
        items.add(item("pixel", "Active Meta pixel configured",
                pixelCount > 0, pixelCount + " active pixel(s)"));

        int capiMapCount = count("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM capi_event_map WHERE tenant_id = ?", tenantId);
        items.add(item("capi_map", "CAPI event mapping defined",
                capiMapCount >= 3, capiMapCount + " events mapped (minimum 3)"));

        int controlCount = count("""
            SELECT COUNT(*) FROM followup_variants
            WHERE tenant_id = ? AND is_control = TRUE AND status = 'ACTIVE'
            """, tenantId);
        items.add(item("followup_control", "Follow-up control arm active",
                controlCount > 0, controlCount + " control arm(s)"));

        int pathCount = count("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM funnel_paths WHERE tenant_id = ?", tenantId);
        items.add(item("funnel_paths", "Funnel paths seeded (CALL_4D minimum)",
                pathCount >= 1, pathCount + " path(s) configured"));

        int ruleCount = count("""
            SELECT COUNT(*) FROM compliance_rulebases
            WHERE (tenant_id = ? OR tenant_id IS NULL) AND is_active = TRUE
            """, tenantId);
        items.add(item("compliance", "Compliance rulebases active",
                ruleCount >= 2, ruleCount + " active rulebase(s)"));

        List<Map<String, Object>> gate = jdbc.queryForList(
                "SELECT status FROM regcf_activation_gate WHERE tenant_id = ?", tenantId);
        String gateStatus = gate.isEmpty() ? "NOT_FOUND" : (String) gate.get(0).get("status");
        items.add(item("regcf_gate", "Reg CF gate acknowledged",
                !gate.isEmpty(), "Status: " + gateStatus + " (FROZEN is correct for 506(c) launch)"));

        long passed = items.stream().filter(i -> Boolean.TRUE.equals(i.get("passed"))).count();
        boolean ready = passed == items.size();

        items.add(0, Map.of("_summary", Map.of(
                "ready_to_launch", ready,
                "passed",          passed,
                "total",           items.size()
        )));

        return ResponseEntity.ok(items);
    }

    private int count(String sql, UUID tenantId) {
        try {
            Integer n = jdbc.queryForObject(sql, Integer.class, tenantId);
            return n != null ? n : 0;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return 0;
        }
    }

    private Map<String, Object> item(String key, String label, boolean passed, String detail) {
        return Map.of("key", key, "label", label, "passed", passed, "detail", detail);
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import com.marketingai.config.AppProperties;
import com.marketingai.security.TenantContext;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.HttpEntity;
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * Off-Policy Evaluation gate (3-18).
 * GET  /api/v1/benchmark     — latest OPE run for current tenant
 * POST /api/v1/benchmark/evaluate — trigger OPE, save result
 */
@Slf4j
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/benchmark")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class OpeController {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private final RestTemplate restTemplate;
    private final AppProperties appProperties;

    @GetMapping
    public Map<String, Object> getLatestBenchmark() {
        UUID tenantId = currentTenant();
        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT id, policy_version, logged_from, logged_to,
                       ips, snips, dr, ci_low, ci_high, ess, clipped_mass, verdict, created_at
                FROM ope_runs
                WHERE tenant_id = ?
                ORDER BY created_at DESC
                LIMIT 1
                """, tenantId);

        if (rows.isEmpty()) {
            return Map.of("verdict", "INSUFFICIENT_DATA", "message", "No OPE runs yet.");
        }
        return rows.get(0);
    }

    @PostMapping("/evaluate")
    public Map<String, Object> evaluate() {
        UUID tenantId = currentTenant();

        // Fetch decisions from decision_log
        List<Map<String, Object>> decisions = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT variant_id, propensity AS logged_prob,
                       CASE WHEN converted THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS reward
                FROM decision_log
                WHERE tenant_id = ?
                  AND created_at > now() - interval '30 days'
                LIMIT 5000
                """, tenantId);

        if (decisions.size() < 10) {
            return Map.of("verdict", "INSUFFICIENT_DATA",
                    "message", "Need at least 10 decision_log rows.");
        }

        // Fetch current policy probs from thompson_arms
        List<Map<String, Object>> arms = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT ta.variant_id, ta.alpha, ta.beta
                FROM thompson_arms ta
                JOIN landing_variants lv ON lv.id = ta.variant_id
                WHERE lv.tenant_id = ?
                """, tenantId);

        Map<String, Double> currentPolicyProbs = new HashMap<>();
        for (Map<String, Object> arm : arms) {
            String vid = arm.get("variant_id").toString();
            double alpha = ((Number) arm.get("alpha")).doubleValue();
            double beta  = ((Number) arm.get("beta")).doubleValue();
            double prob  = alpha / Math.max(alpha + beta, 1e-9);
            currentPolicyProbs.put(vid, prob);
        }

        // Call ml-service OPE endpoint
        String url = appProperties.getMlServiceUrl() + "/ope/evaluate";
        HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
        headers.setContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
        headers.set("X-Internal-API-Key", appProperties.getInternalApiKey());

        Map<String, Object> body = new HashMap<>();
        body.put("decisions", decisions);
        body.put("current_policy_probs", currentPolicyProbs);
        body.put("min_ess", 200.0);

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        Map<String, Object> opeResult;
        try {
            opeResult = restTemplate.postForObject(url, new HttpEntity<>(body, headers), Map.class);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("OPE ml-service call failed: {}", e.getMessage());
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, "ML service unavailable");
        }

        if (opeResult == null) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, "Empty OPE response");
        }

        // Save to ope_runs
        UUID runId = UUID.randomUUID();
        jdbc.update("""
                INSERT INTO ope_runs
                (id, tenant_id, policy_version, ips, snips, dr, ci_low, ci_high,
                 ess, clipped_mass, verdict, created_at)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, now())
                """,
                runId, tenantId,
                opeResult.getOrDefault("policy_version", "").toString(),
                toFloat(opeResult.get("ips")),
                toFloat(opeResult.get("snips")),
                toFloat(opeResult.get("dr")),
                toFloat(opeResult.get("ci_low")),
                toFloat(opeResult.get("ci_high")),
                toFloat(opeResult.get("ess")),
                toFloat(opeResult.get("clipped_mass")),
                opeResult.getOrDefault("verdict", "INSUFFICIENT_DATA").toString());

        Map<String, Object> result = new HashMap<>(opeResult);
        result.put("run_id", runId);
        result.put("n_decisions", decisions.size());
        return result;
    }

    private Float toFloat(Object o) {
        if (o == null) return null;
        if (o instanceof Number n) return n.floatValue();
        try { return Float.parseFloat(o.toString()); } catch (Exception e) { return null; }
    }

    private UUID currentTenant() {
        String raw = TenantContext.get();
        if (raw == null) throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED, "No tenant context");
        return UUID.fromString(raw);
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import com.marketingai.security.TenantContext;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Persona Sandbox CRUD (3-22).
 * GET    /api/v1/personas
 * POST   /api/v1/personas
 * DELETE /api/v1/personas/{id}
 */
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/personas")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class PersonaController {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;

    record CreatePersonaRequest(
            String name, String description,
            Integer cluster_id, Object trait_snapshot) {}

    @GetMapping
    public List<Map<String, Object>> listPersonas() {
        UUID tenantId = currentTenant();
        return jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT id, name, description, traits, created_at
                FROM personas
                WHERE tenant_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL
                ORDER BY created_at DESC
                """, tenantId);
    }

    @PostMapping
    public Map<String, Object> createPersona(@RequestBody CreatePersonaRequest body) {
        UUID tenantId = currentTenant();

        if (body.name() == null || body.name().isBlank()) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "name is required");
        }

        UUID id = UUID.randomUUID();
        // Store cluster_id inside traits JSONB since personas table has a flexible traits column
        String traitsJson = body.cluster_id() != null
                ? "{\"cluster_id\": " + body.cluster_id() + "}"
                : "{}";
        jdbc.update("""
                INSERT INTO personas (id, tenant_id, name, description, traits, created_at)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?::jsonb, now())
                """, id, tenantId, body.name(), body.description(), traitsJson);

        return Map.of(
                "id", id,
                "name", body.name(),
                "description", body.description() != null ? body.description() : "",
                "cluster_id", body.cluster_id() != null ? body.cluster_id() : 0
        );
    }

    @DeleteMapping("/{id}")
    public Map<String, String> deletePersona(@PathVariable UUID id) {
        UUID tenantId = currentTenant();
        int updated = jdbc.update("""
                UPDATE personas SET deleted_at = now()
                WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL
                """, id, tenantId);

        if (updated == 0) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Persona not found");
        }
        return Map.of("status", "deleted", "id", id.toString());
    }

    private UUID currentTenant() {
        String raw = TenantContext.get();
        if (raw == null) throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED, "No tenant context");
        return UUID.fromString(raw);
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import com.marketingai.security.TenantContext;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * Personalization rules CRUD — replaces hard-coded CLUSTER_BLOCK_RULES (vision §5.4.1).
 * Marketer must approve rules; only approved (is_active=true) rules are used by /decide/personalise.
 * System NEVER generates new text — only reorders pre-existing blocks.
 */
@Slf4j
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/personalization-rules")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class PersonalizationRulesController {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;

    // ─── Create ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @PostMapping
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED)
    public Map<String, Object> create(@RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {
        UUID tenantId = tenantId();
        String clusterLabel = required(body, "cluster_label");
        List<String> blockOrder = requireList(body, "allowed_block_order");
        String description = (String) body.get("description");

        // Upsert: one rule per cluster per tenant
        UUID id = UUID.randomUUID();
        jdbc.update("""
                INSERT INTO personalization_rules
                    (id, tenant_id, cluster_label, allowed_block_order, description,
                     is_active, created_at, updated_at)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, false, now(), now())
                ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, cluster_label) DO UPDATE SET
                    allowed_block_order = EXCLUDED.allowed_block_order,
                    description = EXCLUDED.description,
                    is_active = false,
                    approved_by = null,
                    approved_at = null,
                    updated_at = now()
                """,
                id, tenantId, clusterLabel, blockOrder.toArray(new String[0]), description);

        return getByCluster(tenantId, clusterLabel);
    }

    // ─── List ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @GetMapping
    public List<Map<String, Object>> list() {
        return jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT id, cluster_label, allowed_block_order, description,
                       is_active, approved_by, approved_at, created_at, updated_at
                FROM personalization_rules
                WHERE tenant_id = ?
                ORDER BY cluster_label
                """, tenantId());
    }

    // ─── Get ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @GetMapping("/{id}")
    public Map<String, Object> get(@PathVariable UUID id) {
        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT id, cluster_label, allowed_block_order, description,
                       is_active, approved_by, approved_at, created_at, updated_at
                FROM personalization_rules
                WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ?
                """, id, tenantId());
        if (rows.isEmpty()) throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Rule not found");
        return rows.get(0);
    }

    // ─── Update (resets approval) ─────────────────────────────────────────────

    @PutMapping("/{id}")
    public Map<String, Object> update(@PathVariable UUID id, @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {
        UUID tenantId = tenantId();
        List<String> blockOrder = requireList(body, "allowed_block_order");
        String description = (String) body.get("description");

        int updated = jdbc.update("""
                UPDATE personalization_rules SET
                    allowed_block_order = ?,
                    description = ?,
                    is_active = false,
                    approved_by = null,
                    approved_at = null,
                    updated_at = now()
                WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ?
                """, blockOrder.toArray(new String[0]), description, id, tenantId);
        if (updated == 0) throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Rule not found");
        return get(id);
    }

    // ─── Approve ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @PostMapping("/{id}/approve")
    public Map<String, Object> approve(@PathVariable UUID id) {
        UUID tenantId = tenantId();
        UUID userId = userId();
        int updated = jdbc.update("""
                UPDATE personalization_rules SET
                    is_active = true,
                    approved_by = ?,
                    approved_at = now(),
                    updated_at = now()
                WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ?
                """, userId, id, tenantId);
        if (updated == 0) throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Rule not found");
        log.info("Personalization rule {} approved by {}", id, userId);
        return get(id);
    }

    // ─── Deactivate ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @DeleteMapping("/{id}")
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT)
    public void deactivate(@PathVariable UUID id) {
        jdbc.update("""
                UPDATE personalization_rules SET is_active = false, updated_at = now()
                WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ?
                """, id, tenantId());
    }

    // ─── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private UUID tenantId() {
        return UUID.fromString(TenantContext.get());
    }

    private UUID userId() {
        return UUID.fromString(SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication().getName());
    }

    private String required(Map<String, Object> body, String key) {
        Object v = body.get(key);
        if (v == null || v.toString().isBlank())
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, key + " is required");
        return v.toString();
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private List<String> requireList(Map<String, Object> body, String key) {
        Object v = body.get(key);
        if (v instanceof List) return (List<String>) v;
        throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, key + " must be a list");
    }

    private Map<String, Object> getByCluster(UUID tenantId, String clusterLabel) {
        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT id, cluster_label, allowed_block_order, description,
                       is_active, approved_by, approved_at, created_at, updated_at
                FROM personalization_rules
                WHERE tenant_id = ? AND cluster_label = ?
                """, tenantId, clusterLabel);
        if (rows.isEmpty()) throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Rule not found");
        return rows.get(0);
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Pixel Pollution Auto-Detection API — Level 3 (vision §6.8).
 *
 * GET /api/v1/pixel-pollution/scans           — scan history for the tenant
 * GET /api/v1/pixel-pollution/recommendations — campaigns with active drift alerts
 *
 * Pause recommendations are informational: the marketer acts manually via
 * the campaign dashboard. Auto-pausing requires Marketing API write (Phase 3).
 */
@Slf4j
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/pixel-pollution")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class PixelPollutionController {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;

    /** Scan history for the last N days (default 30). */
    @GetMapping("/scans")
    public List<Map<String, Object>> listScans(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "30") int days) {

        return jdbc.queryForList(
                """
                SELECT
                    id::text           AS id,
                    utm_campaign,
                    scan_date,
                    forms_14d,
                    meetings_14d,
                    quality_rate_14d,
                    baseline_rate_30d,
                    drift_pct,
                    alert_fired,
                    created_at
                FROM pixel_pollution_scans
                WHERE tenant_id = ?
                  AND scan_date >= CURRENT_DATE - ?::int
                ORDER BY scan_date DESC, alert_fired DESC
                LIMIT 200
                """,
                tenantId, days
        );
    }

    /**
     * Pause recommendations — campaigns whose quality rate drifted > 30% below baseline
     * in the last 14 days, with at least 20 form submissions.
     *
     * Each row includes the drift percentage and recommended action.
     * Marketer must manually pause the campaign; there is no auto-pause.
     */
    @GetMapping("/recommendations")
    public List<Map<String, Object>> listRecommendations(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId) {

        return jdbc.queryForList(
                """
                SELECT
                    utm_campaign,
                    MAX(scan_date)          AS latest_scan,
                    MAX(forms_14d)          AS forms_14d,
                    MAX(meetings_14d)       AS meetings_14d,
                    MAX(quality_rate_14d)   AS quality_rate_14d,
                    MAX(baseline_rate_30d)  AS baseline_rate_30d,
                    MIN(drift_pct)          AS worst_drift_pct,
                    COUNT(*)                AS alert_days,
                    'PAUSE_CAMPAIGN'        AS recommended_action
                FROM pixel_pollution_scans
                WHERE tenant_id  = ?
                  AND alert_fired = true
                  AND scan_date  >= CURRENT_DATE - 14
                GROUP BY utm_campaign
                ORDER BY worst_drift_pct ASC
                """,
                tenantId
        );
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import com.marketingai.config.AppProperties;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.*;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * Portfolio Budget Optimisation endpoint (6-7).
 * Only after >= 6 months of ad-set return history.
 * Output = RECOMMENDATION only — never triggers spend changes.
 * Never inside a CBO campaign.
 * vision §8.5, architecture §15.21.
 */
@Slf4j
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/portfolio")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class PortfolioController {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private final RestTemplate restTemplate;
    private final AppProperties appProperties;

    /**
     * GET /api/v1/portfolio/recommendation
     * Loads ad-set performance history from channel_insights_history and thompson_arms,
     * then asks FastAPI to compute Sharpe-ratio portfolio weights.
     * Requires total_budget query param.
     */
    @GetMapping("/recommendation")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> recommendation(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "10000") double totalBudget) {

        // Load ad-set daily return series from channel_insights_history (spend vs conversions)
        List<Map<String, Object>> insights = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT campaign_id, channel, date,
                       CASE WHEN spend > 0 THEN (conversions::float / spend) ELSE 0 END AS daily_return
                FROM channel_insights_history
                WHERE tenant_id = ?
                ORDER BY campaign_id, date
                """, tenantId);

        if (insights.isEmpty()) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
                    "No channel insights history for this tenant. Run ad-set sync first.");
        }

        // Group by campaign_id
        Map<String, List<Double>> returnsByCampaign = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (Map<String, Object> row : insights) {
            String campaignId = Objects.toString(row.get("campaign_id"), "unknown");
            double ret = row.get("daily_return") != null
                    ? ((Number) row.get("daily_return")).doubleValue() : 0.0;
            returnsByCampaign.computeIfAbsent(campaignId, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(ret);
        }

        // Find history date range
        LocalDate earliest = insights.stream()
                .map(r -> {
                    Object d = r.get("date");
                    if (d instanceof java.sql.Date sd) return sd.toLocalDate();
                    return LocalDate.now().minusYears(1);
                })
                .min(Comparator.naturalOrder())
                .orElse(LocalDate.now().minusYears(1));

        LocalDate latest = insights.stream()
                .map(r -> {
                    Object d = r.get("date");
                    if (d instanceof java.sql.Date sd) return sd.toLocalDate();
                    return LocalDate.now();
                })
                .max(Comparator.naturalOrder())
                .orElse(LocalDate.now());

        // Load CBO status from meta_campaigns
        Set<String> cboCampaigns = new HashSet<>(jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT id::text FROM meta_campaigns
                WHERE tenant_id = ? AND objective = 'CBO'
                """, String.class, tenantId));

        // Build campaign list for FastAPI
        List<Map<String, Object>> campaigns = returnsByCampaign.entrySet().stream()
                .map(e -> {
                    Map<String, Object> c = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                    c.put("id", e.getKey());
                    c.put("name", e.getKey());
                    c.put("is_cbo", cboCampaigns.contains(e.getKey()));
                    c.put("daily_returns", e.getValue());
                    return c;
                })
                .collect(Collectors.toList());

        Map<String, Object> mlReq = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        mlReq.put("campaigns", campaigns);
        mlReq.put("total_budget", totalBudget);
        mlReq.put("earliest_date", earliest.toString());
        mlReq.put("latest_date", latest.toString());

        HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
        headers.setContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
        headers.set("X-Internal-API-Key", appProperties.getInternalApiKey());

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        Map<String, Object> mlResult;
        try {
            mlResult = restTemplate.postForObject(
                    appProperties.getMlServiceUrl() + "/portfolio/optimize",
                    new HttpEntity<>(mlReq, headers), Map.class);
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            log.warn("Portfolio service failed: {}", ex.getMessage());
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_GATEWAY,
                    "Portfolio service error: " + ex.getMessage());
        }

        if (mlResult == null) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_GATEWAY, "Portfolio service returned null");
        }

        Map<String, Object> resp = new LinkedHashMap<>(mlResult);
        resp.put("tenant_id", tenantId);
        resp.put("computed_at", java.time.Instant.now().toString());
        return ResponseEntity.ok(resp);
    }
}
```
