```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * Post-Call Intelligence (vision §19.18.5; arch §16.18).
 * Coordinator submits structured call outcomes; objection tags route follow-up arms.
 */
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/post-call")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Slf4j
public class PostCallController {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private final RestTemplate restTemplate;
    private static final ObjectMapper MAPPER = new ObjectMapper();

    @PostMapping("/notes")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> submitNote(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {

        UUID id      = UUID.randomUUID();
        String outcome  = (String) body.get("call_outcome");
        String nextStep = (String) body.getOrDefault("next_step", "NONE");
        Object tagsRaw  = body.getOrDefault("objection_tags", List.of());

        jdbc.update("""
            INSERT INTO call_notes
                (id, tenant_id, session_id, appointment_id,
                 call_outcome, next_step, objection_tags, coordinator_note, created_by)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?::jsonb, ?, ?)
            """, id, tenantId,
            body.get("session_id")     != null ? UUID.fromString((String) body.get("session_id"))     : null,
            body.get("appointment_id") != null ? UUID.fromString((String) body.get("appointment_id")) : null,
            outcome, nextStep, toJson(tagsRaw),
            body.get("coordinator_note"),
            body.getOrDefault("created_by", "coordinator"));

        // Expand objection_tags into call_objections for per-creative linking
        if (tagsRaw instanceof List<?> tags && !tags.isEmpty()) {
            UUID sessionId = body.get("session_id") != null
                ? UUID.fromString((String) body.get("session_id")) : null;
            for (Object tag : tags) {
                if (tag == null) continue;
                jdbc.update("""
                    INSERT INTO call_objections
                        (tenant_id, call_note_id, objection_tag, ticket_bucket, stage_after)
                    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                    """, tenantId, id, tag.toString(),
                    body.get("ticket_bucket"), body.get("stage_after"));
            }
        }

        // Upsert objection_summary aggregate
        updateObjectionSummary(tenantId, tagsRaw, "COMMITTED".equals(outcome));

        // Route follow-up arm via FastAPI
        routeFollowupArm(tenantId, id, tagsRaw, outcome);

        return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of("id", id));
    }

    @GetMapping("/notes")
    public ResponseEntity<List<Map<String, Object>>> getNotes(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "30") int days) {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(jdbc.queryForList("""
            SELECT cn.*, s.ticket_bucket
            FROM call_notes cn
            LEFT JOIN sessions s ON s.id = cn.session_id
            WHERE cn.tenant_id = ? AND cn.created_at >= NOW() - (? || ' days')::interval
            ORDER BY cn.created_at DESC LIMIT 200
            """, tenantId, String.valueOf(days)));
    }

    @GetMapping("/summary")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> summary(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "30") int days) {
        List<Map<String, Object>> objections = jdbc.queryForList("""
            SELECT objection_tag, count_total, count_converted,
                ROUND(count_converted::numeric / NULLIF(count_total, 0), 4) AS conversion_rate
            FROM objection_summary WHERE tenant_id = ?
            ORDER BY count_total DESC
            """, tenantId);
        List<Map<String, Object>> notes = getNotes(tenantId, days).getBody();
        if (notes == null) notes = List.of();
        try {
            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
            Map<String, Object> mlRates = restTemplate.postForObject(
                "http://ml-service:8001/post-call/objection-rates",
                Map.of("call_notes", notes), Map.class);
            return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of(
                "objection_rates", objections,
                "ml_rates",        mlRates != null ? mlRates : List.of()
            ));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of("objection_rates", objections, "ml_error", e.getMessage()));
        }
    }

    @GetMapping("/objections")
    public ResponseEntity<List<Map<String, Object>>> objections(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId) {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(jdbc.queryForList("""
            SELECT objection_tag, count_total, count_converted,
                ROUND(count_converted::numeric / NULLIF(count_total, 0), 4) AS conversion_rate,
                last_seen_at
            FROM objection_summary WHERE tenant_id = ?
            ORDER BY count_total DESC
            """, tenantId));
    }

    private void updateObjectionSummary(UUID tenantId, Object tagsRaw, boolean converted) {
        if (!(tagsRaw instanceof List<?> tags)) return;
        int inc = converted ? 1 : 0;
        for (Object tag : tags) {
            if (tag == null) continue;
            jdbc.update("""
                INSERT INTO objection_summary
                    (tenant_id, objection_tag, count_total, count_converted, last_seen_at)
                VALUES (?, ?, 1, ?, NOW())
                ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, objection_tag) DO UPDATE SET
                    count_total     = objection_summary.count_total + 1,
                    count_converted = objection_summary.count_converted + ?,
                    last_seen_at    = NOW()
                """, tenantId, tag.toString(), inc, inc);
        }
    }

    private void routeFollowupArm(UUID tenantId, UUID noteId, Object tagsRaw, String outcome) {
        try {
            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
            Map<String, Object> result = restTemplate.postForObject(
                "http://ml-service:8001/post-call/route-followup",
                Map.of(
                    "objection_tags", tagsRaw instanceof List ? tagsRaw : List.of(),
                    "call_outcome",   outcome
                ),
                Map.class);
            if (result != null && result.get("arm") != null) {
                jdbc.update("""
                    UPDATE call_notes SET follow_up_arm_override = ?, signal_sent_at = NOW()
                    WHERE id = ?
                    """, result.get("arm"), noteId);
                log.debug("Post-call routing: note={} arm={}", noteId, result.get("arm"));
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.warn("Post-call routing failed for note {}: {}", noteId, e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    private String toJson(Object o) {
        try { return MAPPER.writeValueAsString(o); }
        catch (Exception e) { return "[]"; }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.*;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * Campaign-level postmortem (4-x, vision §4.x).
 * Collects metrics, circuit breaker events, and fraud alerts for a closed campaign.
 */
@Slf4j
@RestController
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class PostmortemController {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;

    @PostMapping("/api/v1/campaigns/{id}/postmortem")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> postmortem(
            @PathVariable UUID id,
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId) {

        List<Map<String, Object>> campaigns = jdbc.queryForList(
                """
                SELECT id, name, status, created_at,
                       monthly_budget_ceiling, target_cpa, breakeven_roas,
                       bid_cap_amount, bid_cap_type, launch_mode
                FROM meta_campaigns
                WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ?
                """, id, tenantId);

        if (campaigns.isEmpty()) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Campaign not found");
        }

        Map<String, Object> campaign = campaigns.get(0);
        Object campaignCreatedAt = campaign.get("created_at");

        List<Map<String, Object>> cbEvents = jdbc.queryForList(
                """
                SELECT id, level, trigger_reason, bayesian_prob,
                       contour, action_taken, resolved_at, created_at
                FROM circuit_breaker_events
                WHERE tenant_id = ?
                  AND (:created_at::timestamptz IS NULL OR created_at >= :created_at::timestamptz)
                ORDER BY created_at
                """.replace(":created_at::timestamptz", "?"),
                tenantId, campaignCreatedAt, campaignCreatedAt);

        List<Map<String, Object>> fraudAlerts = jdbc.queryForList(
                """
                SELECT id, suspicious_share, mode, created_at
                FROM fraud_share_alerts
                WHERE tenant_id = ?
                  AND created_at >= ?
                """, tenantId, campaignCreatedAt);

        // Aggregate spend/conversions from channel_insights_history if available
        List<Map<String, Object>> metrics = jdbc.queryForList(
                """
                SELECT channel,
                       SUM(spend)       AS total_spend,
                       SUM(conversions) AS total_conversions,
                       SUM(impressions) AS total_impressions,
                       SUM(clicks)      AS total_clicks
                FROM channel_insights_history
                WHERE tenant_id = ?
                  AND date >= (SELECT created_at::date FROM meta_campaigns WHERE id = ?)
                GROUP BY channel
                """, tenantId, id);

        Map<String, Object> report = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        report.put("campaign",      campaign);
        report.put("channel_metrics", metrics);
        report.put("cb_events",     cbEvents);
        report.put("fraud_alerts",  fraudAlerts);
        report.put("generated_at",  Instant.now());

        return ResponseEntity.ok(report);
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.*;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * Predictive Budget Curve API (Phase 6-3, §8.4).
 * Loads alpha/beta from thompson_arms (read-only — FastAPI is sole writer).
 * Delegates Monte Carlo simulation to ml-service /predict/budget-curve.
 */
@Slf4j
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/predict")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class PredictiveController {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private final RestTemplate restTemplate;

    @PostMapping("/budget-curve")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> budgetCurve(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {

        String creativeId = (String) body.get("creative_id");
        if (creativeId == null) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "creative_id required");
        }

        // Load alpha/beta from thompson_arms (Spring Boot never writes these — FastAPI only)
        Map<String, Object> arm;
        try {
            arm = jdbc.queryForMap("""
                    SELECT alpha, beta
                    FROM thompson_arms
                    WHERE tenant_id = ? AND creative_id = ?::uuid
                    """, tenantId, creativeId);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
                    "No Thompson arm found for creative " + creativeId);
        }

        double alpha = ((Number) arm.get("alpha")).doubleValue();
        double beta  = ((Number) arm.get("beta")).doubleValue();

        double sessionsPerDollar = body.containsKey("sessions_per_dollar")
                ? ((Number) body.get("sessions_per_dollar")).doubleValue()
                : 10.0;

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        List<Number> rawPoints = (List<Number>) body.getOrDefault("budget_points",
                List.of(100, 200, 500, 1000, 2000, 5000));
        List<Double> budgetPoints = rawPoints.stream().map(Number::doubleValue).toList();

        Map<String, Object> mlReq = Map.of(
                "alpha",               alpha,
                "beta",                beta,
                "sessions_per_dollar", sessionsPerDollar,
                "budget_points",       budgetPoints,
                "n_mc",                body.getOrDefault("n_mc", 2000)
        );

        try {
            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
            Map<String, Object> result = restTemplate.postForObject(
                    "http://ml-service:8001/predict/budget-curve", mlReq, Map.class);
            return ResponseEntity.ok(Objects.requireNonNullElse(result, Map.of()));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Budget curve ML call failed: {}", e.getMessage());
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_GATEWAY, "ML service unavailable");
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import com.marketingai.entity.ProductFact;
import com.marketingai.repository.ProductFactRepository;
import com.marketingai.security.TenantContext;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/product-facts")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class ProductFactController {

    private final ProductFactRepository repo;

    @GetMapping
    public ResponseEntity<List<ProductFact>> list() {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(repo.findByTenantIdOrderByCreatedAtDesc(UUID.fromString(TenantContext.get())));
    }

    @PostMapping
    public ResponseEntity<ProductFact> create(@RequestBody Map<String, String> body) {
        ProductFact fact = new ProductFact();
        fact.setTenantId(UUID.fromString(TenantContext.get()));
        fact.setFact(body.get("fact"));
        fact.setSource(body.get("source"));
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CREATED).body(repo.save(fact));
    }

    @DeleteMapping("/{id}")
    public ResponseEntity<Void> delete(@PathVariable UUID id) {
        UUID tenantId = UUID.fromString(TenantContext.get());
        ProductFact fact = repo.findByIdAndTenantId(id, tenantId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND));
        repo.delete(fact);
        return ResponseEntity.noContent().build();
    }
}
```

## D:/Marketing-AI/platform-api/src/main/java/com/marketingai/controller/PropensityController.java

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import com.marketingai.config.AppProperties;
import com.marketingai.service.BookingWindowService;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.*;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * Propensity Model endpoints (Phase 5-2, §7.3 Этап 2).
 *
 * Spring Boot persists P(convert) + main_objection to session_propensity.
 * Gradient Boosting scoring is delegated to FastAPI /propensity/score.
 *
 * Caller must ensure consent_level='full' before calling /score (§12.1a).
 * Spring Boot weekly fit scheduler is in PropensityFitScheduler.
 */
@Slf4j
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/propensity")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class PropensityController {

    private final RestTemplate        restTemplate;
    private final AppProperties       appProperties;
    private final JdbcTemplate        jdbc;
    private final BookingWindowService bookingWindowService;

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // POST /api/v1/propensity/score — score a single session
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @PostMapping("/score")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> scoreSession(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {

        String sessionId = (String) body.get("session_id");
        if (sessionId == null || sessionId.isBlank()) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "session_id required");
        }

        // Enforce consent gate (§12.1a)
        try {
            String consent = jdbc.queryForObject("""
                    SELECT COALESCE(consent_level, 'none')
                    FROM sessions WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ?
                    """, String.class, sessionId, tenantId);
            if (!"full".equals(consent)) {
                return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of(
                        "p_convert",      0.0,
                        "main_objection", (Object) null,
                        "uplift_score",   0.0,
                        "skipped",        true,
                        "reason",         "no_consent"
                ));
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.debug("Session {} not found, proceeding without consent check", sessionId);
        }

        // Load cluster assignment for contextual propensity
        int clusterId = -1;
        try {
            Integer cid = jdbc.queryForObject("""
                    SELECT cluster_id FROM sessions WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ?
                    """, Integer.class, sessionId, tenantId);
            if (cid != null) clusterId = cid;
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}

        // Load stored model bytes for tenant (base64 encoded, stored in propensity_models if exists)
        String modelB64 = loadModelB64(tenantId);

        Map<String, Object> mlBody = new HashMap<>();
        mlBody.put("tenant_id",  tenantId.toString());
        mlBody.put("session",    body.getOrDefault("session", Map.of()));
        mlBody.put("events",     body.getOrDefault("events", List.of()));
        mlBody.put("cluster_id", clusterId);
        if (modelB64 != null) mlBody.put("model_b64", modelB64);

        HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
        headers.setContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
        headers.set("X-Internal-API-Key", appProperties.getInternalApiKey());

        String url = appProperties.getMlServiceUrl() + "/propensity/score";
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        Map<String, Object> result = restTemplate.postForObject(
                url, new HttpEntity<>(mlBody, headers), Map.class);

        if (result == null) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_GATEWAY, "ML service returned null");
        }

        double pConvert    = ((Number) result.getOrDefault("p_convert",    0.0)).doubleValue();
        String objection   = (String)  result.get("main_objection");
        double upliftScore = ((Number) result.getOrDefault("uplift_score", 0.0)).doubleValue();

        // Persist to session_propensity
        jdbc.update("""
                INSERT INTO session_propensity
                    (session_id, tenant_id, p_convert, main_objection, uplift_score, cluster_id, scored_at)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, now())
                ON CONFLICT (session_id, tenant_id) DO UPDATE SET
                    p_convert      = EXCLUDED.p_convert,
                    main_objection = EXCLUDED.main_objection,
                    uplift_score   = EXCLUDED.uplift_score,
                    cluster_id     = EXCLUDED.cluster_id,
                    scored_at      = now()
                """, sessionId, tenantId, pConvert, objection, upliftScore,
                clusterId >= 0 ? clusterId : null);

        log.debug("Propensity scored: tenant={} session={} p={} objection={}",
                tenantId, sessionId, pConvert, objection);

        return ResponseEntity.ok(result);
    }

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // GET /api/v1/propensity/session/{sessionId} — retrieve stored score
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @GetMapping("/session/{sessionId}")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> getScore(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @PathVariable String sessionId) {

        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT p_convert, main_objection, uplift_score, cluster_id, scored_at
                FROM session_propensity
                WHERE session_id = ? AND tenant_id = ?
                """, sessionId, tenantId);

        if (rows.isEmpty()) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
                    "No propensity score for session " + sessionId);
        }

        return ResponseEntity.ok(rows.get(0));
    }

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Private helpers
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /** GET /api/v1/propensity/booking-window — dynamic slot window by risk tier (roadmap 8-15). */
    @GetMapping("/booking-window")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> bookingWindow(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestParam("session_id") UUID sessionId) {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(bookingWindowService.getBookingWindow(tenantId, sessionId));
    }

    /** Load base64-encoded model bytes from DB if a trained model exists. */
    private String loadModelB64(UUID tenantId) {
        try {
            return jdbc.queryForObject("""
                    SELECT model_b64 FROM propensity_models
                    WHERE tenant_id = ?
                    ORDER BY fitted_at DESC LIMIT 1
                    """, String.class, tenantId);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return null;  // No model yet — FastAPI will use rule-based scoring
        }
    }
}
```

## D:/Marketing-AI/platform-api/src/main/java/com/marketingai/controller/RegCfWaitlistController.java

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * Reg CF Waitlist (vision §19.18.8; arch §16.20).
 * ⚠️ FROZEN — OI-3: Meta audience NOT activated until regcf_activation_gate = ACTIVE.
 * DO NOT add any code that sends leads to Meta audiences from this controller.
 */
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/regcf-waitlist")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Slf4j
public class RegCfWaitlistController {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private final RestTemplate restTemplate;

    @PostMapping("/join")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> join(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {

        String email = (String) body.get("email");
        if (email == null || !email.contains("@"))
            return ResponseEntity.badRequest().body(Map.of("error", "Valid email required"));
        if (!Boolean.TRUE.equals(body.get("consent_given")))
            return ResponseEntity.badRequest().body(Map.of("error", "Explicit consent required"));

        UUID id = UUID.randomUUID();
        jdbc.update("""
            INSERT INTO regcf_waitlist
                (id, tenant_id, email, ticket_interest, source_session, consent_given, consent_ts)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, TRUE, NOW())
            ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, email) DO NOTHING
            """, id, tenantId, email,
            body.get("ticket_interest"),
            body.get("session_id") != null ? UUID.fromString((String) body.get("session_id")) : null);

        return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of(
            "id",   id,
            "note", "Added to Reg CF waitlist. Activation pending OI-3 counsel answer."));
    }

    @GetMapping
    public ResponseEntity<List<Map<String, Object>>> list(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId) {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(jdbc.queryForList("""
            SELECT id, email, ticket_interest, consent_given, status, added_at
            FROM regcf_waitlist WHERE tenant_id = ? ORDER BY added_at DESC
            """, tenantId));
    }

    @GetMapping("/gate")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> getGate(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId) {
        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbc.queryForList("""
            SELECT status, counsel_answer, unlocked_at FROM regcf_activation_gate WHERE tenant_id = ?
            """, tenantId);
        if (rows.isEmpty()) {
            return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of(
                "status",       "FROZEN",
                "oi_reference", "OI-3",
                "vision_ref",   "§19.16",
                "note",         "OI-3: Awaiting counsel answer before activating non-accredited marketing"));
        }
        Map<String, Object> gate = new HashMap<>(rows.get(0));
        gate.put("oi_reference", "OI-3");
        gate.put("vision_ref",   "§19.16");
        gate.put("note", "REGCF_WAITLIST audience NOT activated until status = ACTIVE + counsel sign-off");
        return ResponseEntity.ok(gate);
    }

    /** Requires counsel answer text. Moves FROZEN → PENDING_REVIEW only. Never auto-activates Meta. */
    @PostMapping("/gate/unlock")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> unlockGate(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {
        String counselAnswer = (String) body.get("counsel_answer");
        if (counselAnswer == null || counselAnswer.isBlank())
            return ResponseEntity.badRequest().body(Map.of(
                "error", "counsel_answer required (OI-3 answer must be documented before unlocking)"));

        jdbc.update("""
            UPDATE regcf_activation_gate
            SET status = 'PENDING_REVIEW', counsel_answer = ?, unlocked_by = ?, unlocked_at = NOW()
            WHERE tenant_id = ? AND status = 'FROZEN'
            """, counselAnswer, body.get("unlocked_by"), tenantId);

        log.info("RegCF gate unlock → PENDING_REVIEW: tenant={} by={}", tenantId, body.get("unlocked_by"));
        return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of(
            "status", "PENDING_REVIEW",
            "note",   "Gate moved to PENDING_REVIEW. Requires additional approval before ACTIVE. " +
                      "Meta audience remains inactive until ACTIVE status."));
    }

    @GetMapping("/value")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> waitlistValue(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "0.05") double pConvert,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "10000") double avgTicket) {

        int nLeads = 0;
        try {
            nLeads = jdbc.queryForObject(
                "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM regcf_waitlist WHERE tenant_id = ? AND status != 'REMOVED'",
                Integer.class, tenantId);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.warn("Could not count waitlist leads: {}", e.getMessage());
        }

        try {
            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
            Map<String, Object> result = restTemplate.postForObject(
                "http://ml-service:8001/waitlist/value",
                Map.of("n_leads", nLeads, "p_convert_regcf", pConvert, "avg_ticket_regcf", avgTicket),
                Map.class);
            return ResponseEntity.ok(result != null ? result : Map.of("n_leads", nLeads));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            double estimated = nLeads * pConvert * avgTicket;
            return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of(
                "n_leads", nLeads, "estimated_value", estimated,
                "frozen_note", "OI-3: REGCF_WAITLIST NOT activated"));
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import com.marketingai.security.TenantContext;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

// RlhaController uses TenantContext.get() for tenant isolation

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/rlha")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class RlhaController {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;

    @GetMapping("/corrections")
    public ResponseEntity<List<Map<String, Object>>> corrections(
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "50") int limit) {
        UUID tenantId = UUID.fromString(TenantContext.get());
        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT id, generation_id, generated_text, approved_text,
                       delta_tags, use_as_few_shot, edited_by, created_at
                FROM rlha_corrections
                WHERE tenant_id = ?
                ORDER BY created_at DESC
                LIMIT ?
                """, tenantId, Math.min(limit, 200));
        return ResponseEntity.ok(rows);
    }

    @GetMapping("/metrics")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> metrics() {
        UUID tenantId = UUID.fromString(TenantContext.get());
        Map<String, Object> row = jdbc.queryForMap("""
                SELECT
                    COUNT(*) AS total_corrections,
                    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE use_as_few_shot) AS few_shot_count,
                    COUNT(DISTINCT edited_by) AS unique_editors
                FROM rlha_corrections
                WHERE tenant_id = ?
                """, tenantId);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(row);
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.*;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * Audience Saturation API (Phase 6-2, §8.2).
 * Records reach/frequency snapshots and proxies saturation scoring to ml-service.
 */
@Slf4j
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/saturation")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class SaturationController {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;

    // ─── GET /summary ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @GetMapping("/summary")
    public ResponseEntity<List<Map<String, Object>>> summary(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId) {

        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT ad_set_id,
                       MAX(recorded_at)   AS latest_at,
                       MAX(frequency)     AS frequency_max,
                       MIN(frequency)     AS frequency_min,
                       AVG(ctr)           AS ctr_avg,
                       SUM(spend)         AS total_spend
                FROM meta_insights_history
                WHERE tenant_id = ?
                  AND recorded_at > now() - interval '30 days'
                GROUP BY ad_set_id
                ORDER BY frequency_max DESC
                LIMIT 50
                """, tenantId);

        return ResponseEntity.ok(rows);
    }

    // ─── POST /record ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Record a Meta insights snapshot for saturation tracking.

    @PostMapping("/record")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> record(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {

        String adSetId     = (String) body.get("ad_set_id");
        if (adSetId == null || adSetId.isBlank()) {
            return ResponseEntity.badRequest().body(Map.of("error", "ad_set_id required"));
        }

        jdbc.update("""
                INSERT INTO meta_insights_history
                    (tenant_id, ad_set_id, reach, impressions, spend, frequency, clicks, ctr)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                ON CONFLICT (ad_set_id, recorded_at) DO NOTHING
                """,
                tenantId,
                adSetId,
                toLong(body.get("reach")),
                toLong(body.get("impressions")),
                toDouble(body.get("spend")),
                toDouble(body.get("frequency")),
                toLong(body.get("clicks")),
                body.containsKey("ctr") ? toDouble(body.get("ctr")) : null
        );

        return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of("recorded", true));
    }

    private double toDouble(Object v) { return v instanceof Number n ? n.doubleValue() : 0.0; }
    private long   toLong(Object v)   { return v instanceof Number n ? n.longValue()   : 0L;  }
}
```

## D:/Marketing-AI/platform-api/src/main/java/com/marketingai/controller/SegmentCreativeMapController.java

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import com.marketingai.security.TenantContext;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * Segment-to-Creative mapping (Block F §1).
 * Maps cluster segments to approved creative variants per channel.
 * Used by the bid layer to pre-select creatives before Thompson sampling.
 */
@Slf4j
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/segment-creative-map")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class SegmentCreativeMapController {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;

    // ─── Create ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @PostMapping
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> create(@RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {
        UUID tenantId = UUID.fromString(TenantContext.get());
        String clusterLabel = required(body, "cluster_label");
        String creativeIdStr = required(body, "creative_id");
        String channel = ((String) body.getOrDefault("channel", "META")).toUpperCase();
        int priority = body.containsKey("priority") ? ((Number) body.get("priority")).intValue() : 0;

        UUID creativeId;
        try {
            creativeId = UUID.fromString(creativeIdStr);
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "Invalid creative_id UUID");
        }

        Map<String, Object> row = jdbc.queryForMap("""
            INSERT INTO segment_creative_map (tenant_id, cluster_label, creative_id, channel, priority)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            RETURNING id, tenant_id, cluster_label, creative_id::text, channel, priority, is_active, created_at
            """, tenantId, clusterLabel, creativeId, channel, priority);

        log.info("SegmentCreativeMap created: {} → {} [{}] (tenant {})", clusterLabel, creativeId, channel, tenantId);
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CREATED).body(row);
    }

    // ─── List by cluster ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @GetMapping
    public List<Map<String, Object>> list(
            @RequestParam(required = false) String cluster_label,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String channel,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "true") boolean active_only) {

        UUID tenantId = UUID.fromString(TenantContext.get());
        StringBuilder sql = new StringBuilder("""
            SELECT id, cluster_label, creative_id::text, channel, priority, is_active, created_at
            FROM segment_creative_map
            WHERE tenant_id = ?
            """);
        List<Object> params = new ArrayList<>();
        params.add(tenantId);

        if (cluster_label != null) { sql.append(" AND cluster_label = ?"); params.add(cluster_label); }
        if (channel != null) { sql.append(" AND channel = ?"); params.add(channel.toUpperCase()); }
        if (active_only) sql.append(" AND is_active = TRUE");
        sql.append(" ORDER BY cluster_label, priority DESC");

        return jdbc.queryForList(sql.toString(), params.toArray());
    }

    // ─── Update ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @PutMapping("/{id}")
    public Map<String, Object> update(@PathVariable UUID id,
                                       @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {
        UUID tenantId = UUID.fromString(TenantContext.get());
        requireOwnership(id, tenantId);

        List<String> sets = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Object> params = new ArrayList<>();

        if (body.containsKey("priority"))   { sets.add("priority = ?");   params.add(((Number)body.get("priority")).intValue()); }
        if (body.containsKey("is_active"))  { sets.add("is_active = ?");  params.add(body.get("is_active")); }
        if (body.containsKey("channel"))    { sets.add("channel = ?");    params.add(((String)body.get("channel")).toUpperCase()); }

        if (sets.isEmpty()) throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "No updatable fields");

        sets.add("updated_at = NOW()");
        params.add(id);
        params.add(tenantId);

        jdbc.update("UPDATE segment_creative_map SET " + String.join(", ", sets)
                + " WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ?", params.toArray());

        return jdbc.queryForMap("""
            SELECT id, cluster_label, creative_id::text, channel, priority, is_active, updated_at
            FROM segment_creative_map WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ?
            """, id, tenantId);
    }

    // ─── Delete ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @DeleteMapping("/{id}")
    public ResponseEntity<Void> delete(@PathVariable UUID id) {
        UUID tenantId = UUID.fromString(TenantContext.get());
        requireOwnership(id, tenantId);
        jdbc.update("DELETE FROM segment_creative_map WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ?", id, tenantId);
        return ResponseEntity.noContent().build();
    }

    // ─── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private String required(Map<String, Object> body, String key) {
        Object v = body.get(key);
        if (v == null || v.toString().isBlank())
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "Missing required field: " + key);
        return v.toString();
    }

    private void requireOwnership(UUID id, UUID tenantId) {
        Integer count = jdbc.queryForObject(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM segment_creative_map WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ?",
            Integer.class, id, tenantId);
        if (count == null || count == 0)
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Mapping not found");
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import com.marketingai.config.AppProperties;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.HttpEntity;
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * What-If Simulator proxy (vision §21.4).
 *
 * POST /api/v1/simulate
 *   Forwards to FastAPI POST /simulate/ with tenant_id injected from JWT context.
 *
 * Scenarios: budget | power | arm_disable
 */
@Slf4j
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/simulate")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class SimulatorController {

    private final RestTemplate  restTemplate;
    private final AppProperties appProperties;

    @PostMapping
    public Map<?, ?> simulate(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {

        // Inject tenant_id from JWT — client must not be able to query other tenants
        body = new java.util.HashMap<>(body);
        body.put("tenant_id", tenantId.toString());

        String url = appProperties.getMlServiceUrl() + "/simulate/";
        HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
        headers.setContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
        headers.set("X-Internal-API-Key", appProperties.getInternalApiKey());

        try {
            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
            Map<?, ?> result = restTemplate.postForObject(
                    url, new HttpEntity<>(body, headers), Map.class);
            return result != null ? result : Map.of();
        } catch (org.springframework.web.client.HttpClientErrorException e) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.valueOf(e.getStatusCode().value()), e.getResponseBodyAsString());
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Simulate call failed for tenant {}: {}", tenantId, e.getMessage());
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_GATEWAY, "Simulator unavailable");
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/site-health")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class SiteHealthController {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;

    @GetMapping
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> getIncidents(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId) {

        List<Map<String, Object>> incidents = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT id, variant_id, cause, opened_at, resolved_at, consecutive_fails, detail
                FROM site_health_incidents
                WHERE tenant_id = ?
                ORDER BY opened_at DESC
                LIMIT 50
                """, tenantId);

        List<Map<String, Object>> recentChecks = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT variant_id, check_type, status, latency_ms, http_status, checked_at
                FROM site_health_checks
                WHERE tenant_id = ?
                  AND checked_at > now() - interval '1 hour'
                ORDER BY checked_at DESC
                LIMIT 100
                """, tenantId);

        return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of(
                "incidents", incidents,
                "recent_checks", recentChecks));
    }

    @PostMapping("/{incidentId}/resolve")
    public ResponseEntity<Void> resolveIncident(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @PathVariable UUID incidentId) {

        int updated = jdbc.update("""
                UPDATE site_health_incidents
                SET resolved_at = now()
                WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ? AND resolved_at IS NULL
                """, incidentId, tenantId);

        if (updated == 0) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Incident not found or already resolved");
        }
        return ResponseEntity.noContent().build();
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import com.marketingai.config.AppProperties;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.*;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Taxonomy Alignment Layer — platform-wide atom registry (arch §15.10, vision §15.12.11).
 *
 * GET  /api/v1/taxonomy          — list atom registry entries (filterable by type/status)
 * POST /api/v1/taxonomy/recalibrate — trigger weekly merge+confirm pass
 * PUT  /api/v1/taxonomy/{id}/merge  — manually merge one entry into another
 */
@Slf4j
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/taxonomy")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class TaxonomyController {

    private final JdbcTemplate   jdbc;
    private final RestTemplate   restTemplate;
    private final AppProperties  appProperties;

    @GetMapping
    public List<Map<String, Object>> list(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String type,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String status) {

        List<Object> params = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        StringBuilder sql = new StringBuilder(
            "SELECT id, atom_type, canonical_value, status, "
            + "appearance_count, tenant_count, merged_into, created_at "
            + "FROM atom_registry WHERE merged_into IS NULL");

        if (type   != null && !type.isBlank())   { sql.append(" AND atom_type = ?"); params.add(type); }
        if (status != null && !status.isBlank()) { sql.append(" AND status = ?");    params.add(status); }
        sql.append(" ORDER BY appearance_count DESC LIMIT 500");

        return jdbc.queryForList(sql.toString(), params.toArray());
    }

    @PostMapping("/recalibrate")
    public Map<String, Object> recalibrate(@RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId) {
        String url = appProperties.getMlServiceUrl() + "/taxonomy/recalibrate";
        HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
        headers.set("X-Internal-API-Key", appProperties.getInternalApiKey());
        try {
            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
            Map<String, Object> result = restTemplate.exchange(
                url, HttpMethod.POST, new HttpEntity<>(headers), Map.class).getBody();
            log.info("Taxonomy recalibrate triggered by tenant {}: {}", tenantId, result);
            return result != null ? result : Map.of();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Taxonomy recalibrate failed: {}", e.getMessage());
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_GATEWAY, "Recalibrate unavailable");
        }
    }

    @PutMapping("/{id}/merge")
    public Map<String, Object> merge(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @PathVariable UUID id,
            @RequestBody MergeRequest req) {

        int count = jdbc.queryForObject(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom_registry WHERE id = ? AND merged_into IS NULL",
            Integer.class, id);
        if (count == 0) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Source entry not found");
        }
        int targetCount = jdbc.queryForObject(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom_registry WHERE id = ? AND merged_into IS NULL",
            Integer.class, req.intoId());
        if (targetCount == 0) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Target entry not found");
        }

        jdbc.update("UPDATE atom_registry SET merged_into = ? WHERE id = ?", req.intoId(), id);
        jdbc.update("UPDATE creative_atoms SET registry_id = ? WHERE registry_id = ?", req.intoId(), id);
        log.info("Manual taxonomy merge: {} -> {} by tenant {}", id, req.intoId(), tenantId);

        return Map.of("merged", id.toString(), "into", req.intoId().toString());
    }

    public record MergeRequest(UUID intoId) {}
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import com.marketingai.dto.meta.MetaCredentialsRequest;
import com.marketingai.security.TenantContext;
import com.marketingai.service.TenantService;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/tenants")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class TenantController {

    private final TenantService tenantService;
    private final JdbcTemplate  jdbc;

    /**
     * Store Meta Marketing API credentials for the current tenant.
     * Tenant admin provides the access_token from Meta Developer console.
     */
    @PutMapping("/me/meta-credentials")
    public ResponseEntity<Void> setMetaCredentials(
            @Valid @RequestBody MetaCredentialsRequest req) {
        tenantService.setMetaCredentials(currentTenant(), req);
        return ResponseEntity.noContent().build();
    }

    @GetMapping("/me/settings")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> getSettings() {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(tenantService.getSettings(currentTenant()));
    }

    @PatchMapping("/me/settings")
    public ResponseEntity<Void> updateSettings(@RequestBody Map<String, String> body) {
        tenantService.updateSettings(currentTenant(), body);
        return ResponseEntity.noContent().build();
    }

    /**
     * Record OAuth scopes granted by the current tenant (vision §12.7).
     * Called after successful OAuth callback to log what scopes were actually granted.
     */
    @PutMapping("/me/oauth-scopes")
    public ResponseEntity<Void> recordOAuthScopes(
            @RequestParam String provider,
            @RequestBody List<String> scopes) {
        UUID tenantId = currentTenant();
        String[] scopeArr = scopes.toArray(new String[0]);
        jdbc.update("""
            INSERT INTO tenant_oauth_scopes (tenant_id, provider, scopes)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?)
            ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, provider)
            DO UPDATE SET scopes = EXCLUDED.scopes, granted_at = now(), revoked_at = NULL
            """, tenantId, provider.toUpperCase(), scopeArr);
        return ResponseEntity.noContent().build();
    }

    /**
     * Get recorded OAuth scopes for this tenant.
     */
    @GetMapping("/me/oauth-scopes")
    public ResponseEntity<List<Map<String, Object>>> getOAuthScopes() {
        UUID tenantId = currentTenant();
        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbc.queryForList(
            "SELECT provider, scopes, granted_at FROM tenant_oauth_scopes WHERE tenant_id = ?",
            tenantId);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(rows);
    }

    private UUID currentTenant() {
        String raw = TenantContext.get();
        if (raw == null) throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED, "No tenant context");
        return UUID.fromString(raw);
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import com.marketingai.dto.variant.VariantRequest;
import com.marketingai.dto.variant.VariantResponse;
import com.marketingai.entity.ThompsonArm;
import com.marketingai.repository.ThompsonArmRepository;
import com.marketingai.security.TenantContext;
import com.marketingai.service.VariantService;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/landings")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class VariantController {

    private final VariantService variantService;
    private final ThompsonArmRepository thompsonArmRepo;

    @GetMapping
    public List<VariantResponse> list(@RequestParam(required = false) String status) {
        return variantService.listVariants(status);
    }

    @GetMapping("/{id}")
    public VariantResponse get(@PathVariable UUID id) {
        return variantService.getVariant(id);
    }

    @PostMapping
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED)
    public VariantResponse create(@Valid @RequestBody VariantRequest req) {
        return variantService.createVariant(req);
    }

    @PutMapping("/{id}")
    public VariantResponse update(@PathVariable UUID id, @Valid @RequestBody VariantRequest req) {
        return variantService.updateVariant(id, req);
    }

    /** Transition DRAFT/PAUSED → REVIEW */
    @PostMapping("/{id}/submit")
    public VariantResponse submitForReview(@PathVariable UUID id) {
        return variantService.submitForReview(id);
    }

    /** Transition REVIEW → ACTIVE, creates ThompsonArm */
    @PostMapping("/{id}/approve")
    public VariantResponse approve(@PathVariable UUID id) {
        // JWT subject = userId (see JwtUtil.generate)
        String principal = SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication().getName();
        UUID approverId = UUID.fromString(principal);
        return variantService.approveVariant(id, approverId);
    }

    /** Transition ACTIVE → PAUSED */
    @PostMapping("/{id}/pause")
    public VariantResponse pause(@PathVariable UUID id) {
        return variantService.pauseVariant(id);
    }

    /** Archive — final state */
    @PostMapping("/{id}/archive")
    public VariantResponse archive(@PathVariable UUID id) {
        return variantService.archiveVariant(id);
    }

    /** A/B arms — Bayesian posteriors for admin dashboard */
    @GetMapping("/arms")
    public List<Map<String, Object>> arms() {
        String raw = TenantContext.get();
        if (raw == null) throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED, "No tenant context");
        UUID tenantId = UUID.fromString(raw);

        List<ThompsonArm> all = thompsonArmRepo.findAllByTenantId(tenantId);
        double totalAlpha = all.stream().mapToDouble(a -> a.getAlpha()).sum();

        return all.stream().map(arm -> {
            double alpha = arm.getAlpha();
            double beta  = arm.getBeta();
            double mean  = alpha / (alpha + beta);
            double winProb = totalAlpha > 0 ? alpha / totalAlpha : 0.0;

            Map<String, Object> row = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            row.put("variant_id",      arm.getVariantId());
            row.put("variant_name",    arm.getVariantId().toString());
            row.put("alpha",           alpha);
            row.put("beta",            beta);
            row.put("win_probability", winProb);
            row.put("posterior_mean",  mean);
            return row;
        }).collect(Collectors.toList());
    }

}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import com.marketingai.config.AppProperties;
import com.marketingai.service.StorageService;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.*;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.client.HttpClientErrorException;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * Video Template Engine endpoints (vision §5.2, Phase 4-1 + 4-2).
 *
 * Footage upload + lifecycle stored in Spring Boot / PostgreSQL.
 * Heavy processing (Whisper, scene tagging, FFmpeg) delegated to FastAPI /video/*.
 * Marketer approval for renders before any creative is launched (vision §5.2).
 */
@Slf4j
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/video")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class VideoController {

    private final RestTemplate    restTemplate;
    private final AppProperties   appProperties;
    private final StorageService  storageService;
    private final JdbcTemplate    jdbc;

    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // 4-3: Footage upload
    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @PostMapping(value = "/footage", consumes = MediaType.MULTIPART_FORM_DATA_VALUE)
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> uploadFootage(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestParam("file") MultipartFile file,
            @RequestParam(required = false) UUID creativeId) throws IOException {

        UUID footageId = UUID.randomUUID();
        String url = storageService.store(tenantId, footageId,
                file.getOriginalFilename(), file.getBytes());

        jdbc.update("""
                INSERT INTO video_footage
                    (id, tenant_id, creative_id, filename, storage_url, file_size_bytes)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                """,
                footageId, tenantId, creativeId,
                file.getOriginalFilename(), url, file.getSize());

        log.info("Footage uploaded: tenantId={} footageId={} size={}",
                tenantId, footageId, file.getSize());

        return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of(
                "footage_id",   footageId,
                "storage_url",  url,
                "filename",     Objects.requireNonNullElse(file.getOriginalFilename(), "upload")
        ));
    }

    @GetMapping("/footage")
    public List<Map<String, Object>> listFootage(@RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId) {
        return jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT id, filename, storage_url, duration_sec, asset_tier,
                       jsonb_array_length(scenes) AS scene_count,
                       uploaded_at
                FROM video_footage
                ORDER BY uploaded_at DESC
                LIMIT 50
                """);
    }

    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // 4-1: Video pipeline proxies → FastAPI
    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @PostMapping("/footage/{footageId}/transcribe")
    public Map<?, ?> transcribe(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @PathVariable UUID footageId,
            @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {

        body = new HashMap<>(body);
        body.put("footage_id", footageId.toString());
        body.put("tenant_id",  tenantId.toString());
        Map<?, ?> result = mlPost("/video/transcribe", body);

        // Persist transcript in footage record
        if (result != null && result.get("transcript") != null) {
            jdbc.update("UPDATE video_footage SET transcript = ? WHERE id = ?",
                    result.get("transcript"), footageId);
        }
        return result != null ? result : Map.of();
    }

    @PostMapping("/footage/{footageId}/tag-scenes")
    public Map<?, ?> tagScenes(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @PathVariable UUID footageId,
            @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {

        body = new HashMap<>(body);
        body.put("footage_id", footageId.toString());
        body.put("tenant_id",  tenantId.toString());
        Map<?, ?> result = mlPost("/video/tag-scenes", body);

        // Persist scenes JSON
        if (result != null && result.get("scenes") != null) {
            jdbc.update("UPDATE video_footage SET scenes = ?::jsonb WHERE id = ?",
                    scenesToJson(result.get("scenes")), footageId);
        }
        return result != null ? result : Map.of();
    }

    @PostMapping("/footage/{footageId}/montage-plan")
    public Map<?, ?> montagePlan(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @PathVariable UUID footageId,
            @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {

        body = new HashMap<>(body);
        body.put("footage_id", footageId.toString());
        body.put("tenant_id",  tenantId.toString());
        return orEmpty(mlPost("/video/montage-plan", body));
    }

    @PostMapping("/footage/{footageId}/render")
    public Map<?, ?> startRender(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @PathVariable UUID footageId,
            @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {

        body = new HashMap<>(body);
        body.put("footage_id", footageId.toString());
        body.put("tenant_id",  tenantId.toString());
        Map<?, ?> result = orEmpty(mlPost("/video/render", body));

        // Create pending render record
        if (result.get("job_id") != null) {
            UUID renderId = UUID.randomUUID();
            jdbc.update("""
                    INSERT INTO video_renders
                        (id, tenant_id, footage_id, render_spec, format, variation_type,
                         status, render_job_id)
                    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?::jsonb, ?, 'CONCEPT', 'PENDING', ?)
                    """,
                    renderId, tenantId, footageId,
                    scenesToJson(body.get("plan")),
                    Objects.toString(body.getOrDefault("format", "9:16"), "9:16"),
                    result.get("job_id"));
        }
        return result;
    }

    @GetMapping("/render/{jobId}/status")
    public Map<?, ?> getRenderStatus(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @PathVariable String jobId) {
        Map<?, ?> result = orEmpty(mlGet("/video/render/" + jobId));

        // Sync completed/failed status back to video_renders so approveRender can work.
        // FastAPI holds job state in Redis; Spring Boot is the source of truth for DB.
        String status = (String) result.get("status");
        if ("completed".equals(status) || "failed".equals(status)) {
            String storageUrl = (String) result.get("storage_url");
            Number renderMs   = (Number) result.get("render_time_ms");
            Number fileSize   = (Number) result.get("file_size_bytes");
            jdbc.update("""
                    UPDATE video_renders
                       SET status           = ?,
                           storage_url      = COALESCE(?, storage_url),
                           render_time_ms   = COALESCE(?, render_time_ms),
                           file_size_bytes  = COALESCE(?, file_size_bytes)
                     WHERE render_job_id = ?
                       AND tenant_id    = ?
                       AND status NOT IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED')
                    """,
                    status.toUpperCase(),
                    storageUrl,
                    renderMs   != null ? renderMs.intValue()  : null,
                    fileSize   != null ? fileSize.longValue()  : null,
                    jobId, tenantId);
        }
        return result;
    }

    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // 4-2: Variation generation
    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @PostMapping("/footage/{footageId}/generate-variations")
    public Map<?, ?> generateVariations(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @PathVariable UUID footageId,
            @RequestBody Map<String, Object> body) {

        body = new HashMap<>(body);
        body.put("footage_id", footageId.toString());
        body.put("tenant_id",  tenantId.toString());
        return orEmpty(mlPost("/video/generate-variations", body));
    }

    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Render management + marketer approval
    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @GetMapping("/renders")
    public List<Map<String, Object>> listRenders(@RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId) {
        return jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT id, footage_id, creative_id, format, variation_type,
                       status, storage_url, approved_at, killed_at, created_at
                FROM video_renders
                ORDER BY created_at DESC
                LIMIT 100
                """);
    }

    /**
     * Marketer approves a completed render (vision §5.2: approval required before launch).
     * Roadmap 4-5: latest FACE/MUSIC/AI_LABEL checks must be PASS or overridden before approve.
     */
    @PostMapping("/renders/{renderId}/approve")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> approveRender(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestAttribute("userId")   UUID userId,
            @PathVariable UUID renderId) {

        // 4-5 compliance gate: all media check types must pass or be overridden
        List<String> mediaCheckTypes = List.of("FACE", "MUSIC", "AI_LABEL");
        for (String checkType : mediaCheckTypes) {
            List<Map<String, Object>> rows2 = jdbc.queryForList("""
                    SELECT result, overridden_by
                    FROM compliance_checks
                    WHERE entity_id = ?
                      AND check_type = ?
                    ORDER BY created_at DESC
                    LIMIT 1
                    """, renderId, checkType);
            if (!rows2.isEmpty()) {
                Map<String, Object> row = rows2.get(0);
                String result = (String) row.get("result");
                Object overriddenBy = row.get("overridden_by");
                if ("FAIL".equals(result) && overriddenBy == null) {
                    throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
                            "Media compliance check " + checkType + " is " + result
                                    + ". Run /compliance/media/check or override before approving.");
                }
            }
        }

        int rows = jdbc.update("""
                UPDATE video_renders
                   SET approved_by = ?,
                       approved_at = now(),
                       status      = 'COMPLETED'
                 WHERE id        = ?
                   AND status    = 'COMPLETED'
                   AND approved_at IS NULL
                """, userId, renderId);

        if (rows == 0) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
                    "Render not found or already approved / not yet completed");
        }

        log.info("Render {} approved by user {}", renderId, userId);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of(
                "render_id",   renderId,
                "approved",    true,
                "approved_by", userId
        ));
    }

    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Helpers
    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private Map<?, ?> mlPost(String path, Object body) {
        String url = appProperties.getMlServiceUrl() + path;
        HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
        headers.setContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
        headers.set("X-Internal-API-Key", appProperties.getInternalApiKey());
        try {
            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
            Map<?, ?> result = restTemplate.postForObject(
                    url, new HttpEntity<>(body, headers), Map.class);
            return result;
        } catch (HttpClientErrorException e) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.valueOf(e.getStatusCode().value()), e.getResponseBodyAsString());
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("ML call {} failed: {}", path, e.getMessage());
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_GATEWAY, "ML service unavailable");
        }
    }

    private Map<?, ?> mlGet(String path) {
        String url = appProperties.getMlServiceUrl() + path;
        HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
        headers.set("X-Internal-API-Key", appProperties.getInternalApiKey());
        try {
            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
            Map<?, ?> result = restTemplate.exchange(
                    url, HttpMethod.GET, new HttpEntity<>(headers), Map.class).getBody();
            return result;
        } catch (HttpClientErrorException e) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.valueOf(e.getStatusCode().value()), e.getResponseBodyAsString());
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("ML GET {} failed: {}", path, e.getMessage());
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_GATEWAY, "ML service unavailable");
        }
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private static Map<?, ?> orEmpty(Map<?, ?> m) {
        return m != null ? m : Map.of();
    }

    private static String scenesToJson(Object obj) {
        if (obj == null) return "[]";
        try {
            return new com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper().writeValueAsString(obj);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return "[]";
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.controller;

import com.marketingai.config.AppProperties;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.*;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * Voice of Customer endpoints (vision §9.2, arch §15.8).
 *
 * POST   /api/v1/voc/import          — import raw quotes, extract objections via ML service
 * GET    /api/v1/voc/objections       — list extracted objections for tenant
 * DELETE /api/v1/voc/sources/{id}    — delete a VoC source and its objections
 */
@Slf4j
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/voc")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class VocController {

    private final JdbcTemplate  jdbc;
    private final RestTemplate  restTemplate;
    private final AppProperties appProperties;

    @PostMapping("/import")
    public Map<String, Object> importQuotes(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestBody ImportRequest req) {

        if (req.quotes() == null || req.quotes().isEmpty()) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "quotes must not be empty");
        }
        String sourceType = req.sourceType() != null ? req.sourceType() : "OTHER";

        UUID sourceId = jdbc.queryForObject(
            "INSERT INTO voc_sources (tenant_id, source_type, source_name, record_count) "
            + "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?) RETURNING id",
            UUID.class,
            tenantId, sourceType, req.sourceName(), req.quotes().size());

        String mlUrl = appProperties.getMlServiceUrl() + "/voc/extract-objections";
        HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
        headers.setContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
        headers.set("X-Internal-API-Key", appProperties.getInternalApiKey());
        Map<String, Object> mlBody = Map.of(
            "quotes", req.quotes(),
            "niche",  req.niche() != null ? req.niche() : "",
            "source_type", sourceType
        );
        List<Map<String, Object>> objections = List.of();
        try {
            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
            Map<String, Object> mlResp = restTemplate.exchange(
                mlUrl, HttpMethod.POST, new HttpEntity<>(mlBody, headers), Map.class).getBody();
            if (mlResp != null && mlResp.get("objections") instanceof List<?> list) {
                @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
                List<Map<String, Object>> o = (List<Map<String, Object>>) list;
                objections = o;
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.warn("VoC ML extraction failed for tenant {}: {}", tenantId, e.getMessage());
        }

        int saved = 0;
        for (Map<String, Object> obj : objections) {
            String cat = String.valueOf(obj.getOrDefault("category", "OTHER")).toUpperCase();
            String text = String.valueOf(obj.getOrDefault("objection_text", ""));
            String quote = String.valueOf(obj.getOrDefault("representative_quote", ""));
            int count = ((Number) obj.getOrDefault("count", 1)).intValue();
            jdbc.update(
                "INSERT INTO voc_objections "
                + "(tenant_id, source_id, category, objection_text, representative_quote, count) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                tenantId, sourceId, cat, text, quote, count);
            saved++;
        }

        log.info("VoC import: tenant={} source={} quotes={} objections_saved={}",
            tenantId, sourceId, req.quotes().size(), saved);
        return Map.of("source_id", sourceId.toString(), "objections_saved", saved);
    }

    @GetMapping("/objections")
    public List<Map<String, Object>> getObjections(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String category) {

        if (category != null && !category.isBlank()) {
            return jdbc.queryForList(
                "SELECT id, source_id, category, objection_text, representative_quote, count, created_at "
                + "FROM voc_objections WHERE tenant_id = ? AND category = ? ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 200",
                tenantId, category.toUpperCase());
        }
        return jdbc.queryForList(
            "SELECT id, source_id, category, objection_text, representative_quote, count, created_at "
            + "FROM voc_objections WHERE tenant_id = ? ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 200",
            tenantId);
    }

    @DeleteMapping("/sources/{id}")
    public ResponseEntity<Void> deleteSource(
            @RequestAttribute("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
            @PathVariable UUID id) {

        int owned = jdbc.queryForObject(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM voc_sources WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ?",
            Integer.class, id, tenantId);
        if (owned == 0) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "VoC source not found");
        }
        jdbc.update("DELETE FROM voc_objections WHERE source_id = ?", id);
        jdbc.update("DELETE FROM voc_sources WHERE id = ?", id);
        log.info("VoC source {} deleted by tenant {}", id, tenantId);
        return ResponseEntity.noContent().build();
    }

    public record ImportRequest(
        List<String> quotes,
        String sourceType,
        String sourceName,
        String niche
    ) {}
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import com.marketingai.config.AppProperties;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.*;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;

import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Unified alert service: Telegram and/or Slack behind one interface.
 * Channel selection via app.alert-channel: TELEGRAM | SLACK | BOTH (default).
 * Per-tenant Slack webhook overrides the global one when provided.
 */
@Slf4j
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class AlertService {

    private final AppProperties props;
    private final RestTemplate restTemplate;

    public void sendAlert(String message) {
        sendAlert(message, null);
    }

    public void sendAlert(String message, String tenantSlackWebhook) {
        String channel = props.getAlertChannel() != null ? props.getAlertChannel() : "BOTH";
        if ("TELEGRAM".equals(channel) || "BOTH".equals(channel)) {
            sendTelegram(message);
        }
        if ("SLACK".equals(channel) || "BOTH".equals(channel)) {
            String webhookUrl = (tenantSlackWebhook != null && !tenantSlackWebhook.isBlank())
                    ? tenantSlackWebhook
                    : props.getSlackWebhookUrl();
            if (webhookUrl != null && !webhookUrl.isBlank()) {
                sendSlack(message, webhookUrl);
            }
        }
    }

    private void sendTelegram(String message) {
        AppProperties.Telegram cfg = props.getTelegram();
        if (!cfg.isConfigured()) {
            log.warn("Telegram not configured — skipping alert");
            return;
        }
        try {
            String url = "https://api.telegram.org/bot" + cfg.getBotToken() + "/sendMessage";
            restTemplate.postForObject(url,
                    Map.of("chat_id", cfg.getChatId(), "text", message, "parse_mode", "HTML"),
                    String.class);
            log.debug("Telegram alert sent");
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Telegram alert failed: {}", e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    private void sendSlack(String message, String webhookUrl) {
        try {
            HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
            headers.setContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
            restTemplate.postForObject(webhookUrl,
                    new HttpEntity<>(Map.of("text", message), headers),
                    String.class);
            log.debug("Slack alert sent");
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Slack alert failed: {}", e.getMessage());
        }
    }
}
```
