```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import com.marketingai.dto.analytics.*;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.namedparam.MapSqlParameterSource;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.namedparam.NamedParameterJdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.random.RandomGenerator;

@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class AnalyticsService {

    private final NamedParameterJdbcTemplate jdbc;

    public static final String DISCLAIMER =
            "Phase 1 analytics: descriptive only. " +
            "Meta metrics (spend, ROAS, impressions, CTR, hook rate) require Phase 3 integration.";

    // ─── Overview ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    public OverviewResponse overview(int days) {
        var params = new MapSqlParameterSource("days", days);

        Map<String, Object> eventStats = jdbc.queryForMap("""
                SELECT
                    COUNT(DISTINCT session_id)                                         AS total_sessions,
                    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type IN ('CONVERSION','PURCHASE'))   AS total_conversions,
                    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN event_type IN ('CONVERSION','PURCHASE')
                                     THEN revenue ELSE 0 END), 0)                     AS total_revenue
                FROM events
                WHERE is_suspicious = false
                  AND event_time >= NOW() - :days * INTERVAL '1 day'
                """, params);

        Map<String, Object> creativeStats = jdbc.queryForMap("""
                SELECT
                    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status != 'ARCHIVED') AS active_creatives,
                    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'ACTIVE')    AS analyzed_creatives
                FROM creatives
                """, new MapSqlParameterSource());

        long totalSessions = toLong(eventStats.get("total_sessions"));
        long totalConversions = toLong(eventStats.get("total_conversions"));

        return OverviewResponse.builder()
                .periodDays(days)
                .totalSessions(totalSessions)
                .totalConversions(totalConversions)
                .conversionRate(totalSessions > 0 ? (double) totalConversions / totalSessions : null)
                .totalRevenue(toDouble(eventStats.get("total_revenue")))
                .activeCreatives(toLong(creativeStats.get("active_creatives")))
                .analyzedCreatives(toLong(creativeStats.get("analyzed_creatives")))
                .disclaimer(DISCLAIMER)
                .build();
    }

    // ─── Per-creative performance ─────────────────────────────────────────────

    public List<CreativePerformanceRow> creativePerformance(int days) {
        var params = new MapSqlParameterSource("days", days);

        return jdbc.query("""
                SELECT
                    c.id                AS creative_id,
                    c.title,
                    c.type,
                    c.status,
                    c.is_anchor,
                    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.id)   AS atoms_count,
                    COALESCE(e.sessions,  0)    AS sessions,
                    COALESCE(e.conversions, 0)  AS conversions,
                    COALESCE(e.revenue,   0)    AS revenue
                FROM creatives c
                LEFT JOIN creative_atoms ca ON ca.creative_id = c.id
                LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT
                        creative_id,
                        COUNT(DISTINCT session_id)                                        AS sessions,
                        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type IN ('CONVERSION','PURCHASE'))  AS conversions,
                        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN event_type IN ('CONVERSION','PURCHASE')
                                         THEN revenue ELSE 0 END), 0)                    AS revenue
                    FROM events
                    WHERE is_suspicious = false
                      AND event_time >= NOW() - :days * INTERVAL '1 day'
                    GROUP BY creative_id
                ) e ON e.creative_id = c.id
                WHERE c.status != 'ARCHIVED'
                GROUP BY c.id, c.title, c.type, c.status, c.is_anchor,
                         e.sessions, e.conversions, e.revenue
                ORDER BY COALESCE(e.sessions, 0) DESC, c.created_at DESC
                """, params, (rs, i) -> {
            long sessions = rs.getLong("sessions");
            long conversions = rs.getLong("conversions");
            return CreativePerformanceRow.builder()
                    .creativeId(UUID.fromString(rs.getString("creative_id")))
                    .title(rs.getString("title"))
                    .type(rs.getString("type"))
                    .status(rs.getString("status"))
                    .isAnchor(rs.getBoolean("is_anchor"))
                    .atomsCount(rs.getInt("atoms_count"))
                    .sessions(sessions)
                    .conversions(conversions)
                    .conversionRate(sessions > 0 ? (double) conversions / sessions : null)
                    .revenue(rs.getDouble("revenue"))
                    .build(); // spend/roas/impressions/ctr stay null (Phase 3)
        });
    }

    // ─── Atom-level performance ───────────────────────────────────────────────

    public List<AtomPerformanceRow> atomPerformance(int days, String atomType) {
        var params = new MapSqlParameterSource("days", days);
        String typeFilter = (atomType != null && !atomType.isBlank()) ? atomType.toUpperCase() : null;
        params.addValue("atomType", typeFilter);

        return jdbc.query("""
                SELECT
                    ca.atom_type,
                    ca.atom_value,
                    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.creative_id)                                    AS creative_count,
                    COALESCE(SUM(e.sessions),     0)                                  AS total_sessions,
                    COALESCE(SUM(e.conversions),  0)                                  AS conversions,
                    CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(e.sessions), 0) > 0
                         THEN COALESCE(SUM(e.conversions), 0)::FLOAT / SUM(e.sessions)
                         ELSE NULL END                                                AS conversion_rate,
                    AVG(CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.conversions, 0) > 0
                             THEN e.revenue ELSE NULL END)                            AS avg_revenue
                FROM creative_atoms ca
                JOIN creatives c ON c.id = ca.creative_id AND c.status != 'ARCHIVED'
                LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT
                        creative_id,
                        COUNT(DISTINCT session_id)                                        AS sessions,
                        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type IN ('CONVERSION','PURCHASE'))  AS conversions,
                        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN event_type IN ('CONVERSION','PURCHASE')
                                         THEN revenue ELSE 0 END), 0)                    AS revenue
                    FROM events
                    WHERE is_suspicious = false
                      AND event_time >= NOW() - :days * INTERVAL '1 day'
                    GROUP BY creative_id
                ) e ON e.creative_id = ca.creative_id
                WHERE (:atomType IS NULL OR ca.atom_type = :atomType)
                GROUP BY ca.atom_type, ca.atom_value
                ORDER BY ca.atom_type, conversion_rate DESC NULLS LAST, total_sessions DESC
                """, params, (rs, i) -> AtomPerformanceRow.builder()
                        .atomType(rs.getString("atom_type"))
                        .atomValue(rs.getString("atom_value"))
                        .creativeCount(rs.getInt("creative_count"))
                        .totalSessions(rs.getLong("total_sessions"))
                        .conversions(rs.getLong("conversions"))
                        .conversionRate(toDoubleNullable(rs.getObject("conversion_rate")))
                        .avgRevenue(toDoubleNullable(rs.getObject("avg_revenue")))
                        .build());
    }

    // ─── Funnel + §3.2 diagnostic card ───────────────────────────────────────

    public FunnelResponse funnel(int days) {
        var params = new MapSqlParameterSource("days", days);

        // Stage counts
        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT event_type, COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS cnt
                FROM events
                WHERE is_suspicious = false
                  AND event_time >= NOW() - :days * INTERVAL '1 day'
                  AND event_type IN ('PAGE_VIEW','SCROLL','FORM_START','FORM_SUBMIT','CONVERSION','PURCHASE')
                GROUP BY event_type
                """, params);

        Map<String, Long> counts = new java.util.HashMap<>();
        for (var r : rows) {
            counts.put((String) r.get("event_type"), toLong(r.get("cnt")));
        }

        // Bounce rate: sessions with PAGE_VIEW but no SCROLL
        Map<String, Object> bounceStats = jdbc.queryForMap("""
                SELECT
                    COUNT(DISTINCT s.session_id)
                        FILTER (WHERE s.event_count = 1 AND NOT s.has_scroll) AS bounced,
                    COUNT(DISTINCT s.session_id)                              AS total
                FROM (
                    SELECT
                        session_id,
                        COUNT(*)                          AS event_count,
                        BOOL_OR(event_type = 'SCROLL')   AS has_scroll
                    FROM events
                    WHERE is_suspicious = false
                      AND event_time >= NOW() - :days * INTERVAL '1 day'
                    GROUP BY session_id
                ) s
                """, params);

        long bounced = toLong(bounceStats.get("bounced"));
        long totalSessions = toLong(bounceStats.get("total"));
        double bounceRate = totalSessions > 0 ? (double) bounced / totalSessions : 0;

        // Build funnel stages in order
        String[] order = {"PAGE_VIEW", "SCROLL", "FORM_START", "FORM_SUBMIT", "CONVERSION", "PURCHASE"};
        List<FunnelResponse.FunnelStage> stages = new ArrayList<>();
        Long prev = null;
        for (String stage : order) {
            long cnt = counts.getOrDefault(stage, 0L);
            Double drop = (prev != null && prev > 0) ? 1.0 - (double) cnt / prev : null;
            stages.add(FunnelResponse.FunnelStage.builder()
                    .stage(stage)
                    .sessions(cnt)
                    .dropOffPct(drop)
                    .build());
            if (cnt > 0) prev = cnt;
        }

        // §3.2 Diagnostic card — Phase 1 detectable symptoms
        List<FunnelResponse.Symptom> symptoms = buildSymptoms(counts, bounceRate, totalSessions);
        int detected = (int) symptoms.stream().filter(FunnelResponse.Symptom::isDetected).count();

        FunnelResponse.DiagnosticCard card = FunnelResponse.DiagnosticCard.builder()
                .symptomsDetected(detected)
                .symptoms(symptoms)
                .note("Hook Rate, CTR, Watch Rate require Meta API (Phase 3). " +
                      "Current diagnostics are based on first-party event data only.")
                .build();

        return FunnelResponse.builder()
                .periodDays(days)
                .stages(stages)
                .diagnostics(card)
                .disclaimer(DISCLAIMER)
                .build();
    }

    // ─── §3.2 Symptom evaluation ──────────────────────────────────────────────

    private List<FunnelResponse.Symptom> buildSymptoms(Map<String, Long> counts,
                                                        double bounceRate,
                                                        long totalSessions) {
        List<FunnelResponse.Symptom> symptoms = new ArrayList<>();

        long pageViews  = counts.getOrDefault("PAGE_VIEW",  0L);
        long scrolls    = counts.getOrDefault("SCROLL",     0L);
        long formStarts = counts.getOrDefault("FORM_START", 0L);
        long formSubs   = counts.getOrDefault("FORM_SUBMIT",0L);
        long conversions = counts.getOrDefault("CONVERSION",0L)
                         + counts.getOrDefault("PURCHASE",  0L);

        // Symptom: High bounce (PAGE_VIEW → SCROLL drop > 60%)
        boolean highBounce = pageViews > 50 && bounceRate > 0.60;
        symptoms.add(FunnelResponse.Symptom.builder()
                .code("HIGH_BOUNCE")
                .detected(highBounce)
                .value(String.format("%.0f%%", bounceRate * 100))
                .diagnosis("Message mismatch: creative promise ≠ landing reality (§3.2)")
                .action("Sync landing headline with creative hook atom")
                .dataSource("first-party events")
                .build());

        // Symptom: Form abandonment (FORM_START → FORM_SUBMIT drop > 50%)
        boolean highFormAbandon = formStarts > 20
                && formSubs < formStarts * 0.5;
        String formAbandonValue = formStarts > 0
                ? String.format("%.0f%% complete", formStarts > 0 ? (double) formSubs / formStarts * 100 : 0)
                : "n/a";
        symptoms.add(FunnelResponse.Symptom.builder()
                .code("HIGH_FORM_ABANDON")
                .detected(highFormAbandon)
                .value(formAbandonValue)
                .diagnosis("Form friction: too many fields or steps")
                .action("Reduce form fields, add progress indicator")
                .dataSource("first-party events")
                .build());

        // Symptom: Low CVR overall (< 1%)
        double cvr = totalSessions > 0 ? (double) conversions / totalSessions : 0;
        boolean lowCvr = totalSessions > 100 && cvr < 0.01;
        symptoms.add(FunnelResponse.Symptom.builder()
                .code("LOW_CVR")
                .detected(lowCvr)
                .value(String.format("%.2f%%", cvr * 100))
                .diagnosis("Offer or trust issue: visitors scroll but don't convert")
                .action("Review offer atoms (proof_type, cta) and landing blocks (pricing, testimonials)")
                .dataSource("first-party events")
                .build());

        // Symptom: Weak CTA signal (scroll but no form_start — drop > 80%)
        boolean weakCta = scrolls > 50
                && formStarts < scrolls * 0.20
                && scrolls > 0;
        symptoms.add(FunnelResponse.Symptom.builder()
                .code("WEAK_CTA")
                .detected(weakCta)
                .value(scrolls > 0 ? String.format("%.0f%% reach form", (double) formStarts / scrolls * 100) : "n/a")
                .diagnosis("Weak CTA or unpersuasive offer: users scroll but don't start the form")
                .action("Test CTA atom variants; strengthen offer (discount, guarantee)")
                .dataSource("first-party events")
                .build());

        // Phase 3 placeholder symptoms (data not available yet)
        symptoms.add(FunnelResponse.Symptom.builder()
                .code("LOW_HOOK_RATE")
                .detected(false)
                .value("n/a — needs Meta API")
                .diagnosis("Hook doesn't grab attention in first 3 seconds")
                .action("Rotate hook atom (Phase 3: Meta 3-sec view data required)")
                .dataSource("Meta API (Phase 3)")
                .build());

        symptoms.add(FunnelResponse.Symptom.builder()
                .code("LOW_CTR")
                .detected(false)
                .value("n/a — needs Meta API")
                .diagnosis("Weak CTA or offer in creative")
                .action("Test CTA and offer sub-atoms (Phase 3: Meta CTR data required)")
                .dataSource("Meta API (Phase 3)")
                .build());

        return symptoms;
    }

    // ─── A/B Dashboard (2-7) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

    public List<AbVariantRow> abDashboard(int days) {
        var params = new MapSqlParameterSource("days", days);

        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT
                    ta.variant_id,
                    lv.name,
                    lv.slug,
                    lv.status,
                    ta.alpha,
                    ta.beta,
                    ta.total_samples,
                    COALESCE(SUM(e.sessions),     0) AS sessions,
                    COALESCE(SUM(e.conversions),  0) AS conversions
                FROM thompson_arms ta
                JOIN landing_variants lv ON lv.id = ta.variant_id
                LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT
                        variant_id,
                        COUNT(DISTINCT session_id)                                        AS sessions,
                        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type IN ('CONVERSION','PURCHASE',
                                                              'FORM_SUBMIT'))             AS conversions
                    FROM events
                    WHERE is_suspicious = false
                      AND variant_id IS NOT NULL
                      AND event_time >= NOW() - :days * INTERVAL '1 day'
                    GROUP BY variant_id
                ) e ON e.variant_id = ta.variant_id
                WHERE lv.status IN ('ACTIVE','PAUSED')
                GROUP BY ta.variant_id, lv.name, lv.slug, lv.status,
                         ta.alpha, ta.beta, ta.total_samples
                ORDER BY ta.alpha / (ta.alpha + ta.beta) DESC
                """, params);

        if (rows.isEmpty()) return List.of();

        // Monte Carlo P(best): sample Beta(α,β) N=5000 times per arm
        int N = 5_000;
        int n = rows.size();
        double[] alpha = new double[n];
        double[] beta  = new double[n];
        int[] wins = new int[n];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            alpha[i] = toDouble(rows.get(i).get("alpha"));
            beta[i]  = toDouble(rows.get(i).get("beta"));
        }

        var rng = RandomGenerator.getDefault();
        for (int s = 0; s < N; s++) {
            int bestIdx = 0;
            double bestVal = -1.0;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                double val = sampleBeta(alpha[i], beta[i], rng);
                if (val > bestVal) { bestVal = val; bestIdx = i; }
            }
            wins[bestIdx]++;
        }

        List<AbVariantRow> result = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Map<String, Object> r = rows.get(i);
            long sessions    = toLong(r.get("sessions"));
            long conversions = toLong(r.get("conversions"));
            result.add(AbVariantRow.builder()
                    .variantId(UUID.fromString(r.get("variant_id").toString()))
                    .name((String) r.get("name"))
                    .slug((String) r.get("slug"))
                    .status((String) r.get("status"))
                    .alpha(alpha[i])
                    .beta(beta[i])
                    .totalSamples(((Number) r.get("total_samples")).intValue())
                    .estimatedCvr(alpha[i] / (alpha[i] + beta[i]))
                    .sessions(sessions)
                    .conversions(conversions)
                    .observedCvr(sessions > 0 ? (double) conversions / sessions : null)
                    .probBest((double) wins[i] / N)
                    .build());
        }
        // Re-sort by probBest descending
        result.sort((x, y) -> Double.compare(y.getProbBest(), x.getProbBest()));
        return result;
    }

    // Marsaglia and Tsang's method for Beta sampling — pure Java, no extra deps
    private static double sampleBeta(double a, double b, RandomGenerator rng) {
        double x = sampleGamma(a, rng);
        double y = sampleGamma(b, rng);
        return x / (x + y);
    }

    private static double sampleGamma(double shape, RandomGenerator rng) {
        if (shape < 1.0) {
            return sampleGamma(1.0 + shape, rng) * Math.pow(rng.nextDouble(), 1.0 / shape);
        }
        double d = shape - 1.0 / 3.0;
        double c = 1.0 / Math.sqrt(9 * d);
        while (true) {
            double x, v;
            do { x = rng.nextGaussian(); v = 1.0 + c * x; } while (v <= 0);
            v = v * v * v;
            double u = rng.nextDouble();
            if (u < 1 - 0.0331 * (x * x) * (x * x)) return d * v;
            if (Math.log(u) < 0.5 * x * x + d * (1 - v + Math.log(v))) return d * v;
        }
    }

    // ─── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private static long toLong(Object v) {
        if (v == null) return 0L;
        if (v instanceof Long l) return l;
        if (v instanceof Number n) return n.longValue();
        return Long.parseLong(v.toString());
    }

    private static double toDouble(Object v) {
        if (v == null) return 0.0;
        if (v instanceof Double d) return d;
        if (v instanceof Number n) return n.doubleValue();
        return Double.parseDouble(v.toString());
    }

    private static Double toDoubleNullable(Object v) {
        if (v == null) return null;
        if (v instanceof Double d) return d;
        if (v instanceof Number n) return n.doubleValue();
        return Double.parseDouble(v.toString());
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import com.marketingai.entity.Appointment;
import com.marketingai.repository.AppointmentRepository;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Appointment lifecycle management.
 *
 * State machine:
 *   SCHEDULED → COMPLETED  (GHL AppointmentUpdate appointmentStatus=showed)
 *   SCHEDULED → NO_SHOW    (GHL AppointmentUpdate appointmentStatus=noshow, or 7-day timeout)
 *   SCHEDULED → CANCELLED  (AppointmentUpdate with unhandled status)
 *
 * GHL is the sole source of truth — sales rep manually sets appointmentStatus in GHL CRM.
 * Google Calendar integration is NOT part of MVP (arch v1.1 §13.1).
 */
@Slf4j
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class AppointmentService {

    private final AppointmentRepository appointmentRepo;
    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;

    private static final int NO_SHOW_TIMEOUT_DAYS   = 7;
    private static final int CALENDAR_CHECK_DELAY_H = 1;

    // ─── GHL webhook handlers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /**
     * Register a new appointment on GHL AppointmentCreate.
     * Idempotent: skips if ghlAppointmentId already exists for this tenant.
     */
    @Transactional
    public void registerAppointment(UUID tenantId, String sessionId, String contactId,
                                    String ghlAppointmentId, Instant scheduledAt) {
        if (ghlAppointmentId != null &&
                appointmentRepo.findByGhlAppointmentIdAndTenantId(ghlAppointmentId, tenantId).isPresent()) {
            log.debug("Appointment already registered: ghlId={}", ghlAppointmentId);
            return;
        }

        Appointment appt = new Appointment();
        appt.setTenantId(tenantId);
        appt.setSessionId(sessionId);
        appt.setGhlContactId(contactId);
        appt.setGhlAppointmentId(ghlAppointmentId);
        appt.setScheduledAt(scheduledAt != null ? scheduledAt : Instant.now());
        appt.setStatus("SCHEDULED");
        appt.setSource("GHL_WEBHOOK");
        appointmentRepo.save(appt);

        log.info("Appointment registered: tenant={} contact={} at={}", tenantId, contactId, scheduledAt);
    }

    /** GHL appointment.completed → mark attended. */
    @Transactional
    public void markCompleted(UUID tenantId, String ghlAppointmentId, String contactId) {
        Appointment appt = findOrCreatePlaceholder(tenantId, ghlAppointmentId, contactId);
        if (!"SCHEDULED".equals(appt.getStatus())) return;
        appt.setStatus("COMPLETED");
        appt.setGhlUpdatedAt(Instant.now());
        appt.setSource("GHL_WEBHOOK");
        appointmentRepo.save(appt);
        updateSessionOutcome(appt.getSessionId(), tenantId, true);
        log.info("Appointment COMPLETED (GHL): ghlId={} tenant={}", ghlAppointmentId, tenantId);
    }

    /** GHL appointment.no_show → mark no-show. */
    @Transactional
    public void markNoShow(UUID tenantId, String ghlAppointmentId, String contactId) {
        Appointment appt = findOrCreatePlaceholder(tenantId, ghlAppointmentId, contactId);
        if (!"SCHEDULED".equals(appt.getStatus())) return;
        appt.setStatus("NO_SHOW");
        appt.setGhlUpdatedAt(Instant.now());
        appt.setSource("GHL_WEBHOOK");
        appointmentRepo.save(appt);
        updateSessionOutcome(appt.getSessionId(), tenantId, false);
        log.info("Appointment NO_SHOW (GHL): ghlId={} tenant={}", ghlAppointmentId, tenantId);
    }

    /** GHL appointment.cancelled → mark cancelled. */
    @Transactional
    public void markCancelled(UUID tenantId, String ghlAppointmentId, String contactId) {
        findOrCreatePlaceholder(tenantId, ghlAppointmentId, contactId);
        appointmentRepo.findByGhlAppointmentIdAndTenantId(ghlAppointmentId, tenantId)
                .filter(a -> "SCHEDULED".equals(a.getStatus()))
                .ifPresent(a -> {
                    a.setStatus("CANCELLED");
                    a.setGhlUpdatedAt(Instant.now());
                    a.setSource("GHL_WEBHOOK");
                    appointmentRepo.save(a);
                    log.info("Appointment CANCELLED (GHL): ghlId={}", ghlAppointmentId);
                });
    }

    // ─── Scheduler: 7-day no-show timeout ────────────────────────────────────

    /**
     * Called every 30 minutes by AppointmentCheckScheduler.
     * Processes appointments that are past their scheduled time.
     */
    @Transactional
    public void reviewPendingAppointments() {
        // 1h delay: check appointments scheduled at least 1h ago
        Instant cutoff = Instant.now().minus(CALENDAR_CHECK_DELAY_H, ChronoUnit.HOURS);
        List<Appointment> pending = appointmentRepo.findPendingBefore(cutoff);
        if (pending.isEmpty()) return;

        log.info("Reviewing {} pending appointments", pending.size());
        for (Appointment appt : pending) {
            reviewSingle(appt);
        }
    }

    private void reviewSingle(Appointment appt) {
        Instant now = Instant.now();

        // 7-day hard timeout — no Calendar API fallback (arch v1.1 §13.1)
        if (appt.getScheduledAt().isBefore(now.minus(NO_SHOW_TIMEOUT_DAYS, ChronoUnit.DAYS))) {
            appt.setStatus("NO_SHOW");
            appt.setSource("TIMEOUT");
            appointmentRepo.save(appt);
            updateSessionOutcome(appt.getSessionId(), appt.getTenantId(), false);
            log.info("Appointment NO_SHOW (7-day timeout): id={} tenant={}", appt.getId(), appt.getTenantId());
        }
    }

    // ─── Session outcome ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /**
     * Update session when appointment outcome is known.
     * completed=true  → mark session as converted (APPOINTMENT)
     * completed=false → leave converted unchanged (no-show ≠ conversion)
     */
    private void updateSessionOutcome(String sessionId, UUID tenantId, boolean completed) {
        if (sessionId == null) return;
        if (completed) {
            jdbc.update(
                    """
                    UPDATE sessions SET
                        converted       = true,
                        conversion_type = 'APPOINTMENT'
                    WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ? AND converted = false
                    """,
                    sessionId, tenantId
            );
        }
        // No-show: nothing to update on sessions (already not converted)
    }

    // ─── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private Appointment findOrCreatePlaceholder(UUID tenantId, String ghlAppointmentId, String contactId) {
        if (ghlAppointmentId != null) {
            Optional<Appointment> existing =
                    appointmentRepo.findByGhlAppointmentIdAndTenantId(ghlAppointmentId, tenantId);
            if (existing.isPresent()) return existing.get();
        }
        // outcome arrived before appointment.scheduled — create a placeholder
        Appointment placeholder = new Appointment();
        placeholder.setTenantId(tenantId);
        placeholder.setGhlAppointmentId(ghlAppointmentId);
        placeholder.setGhlContactId(contactId);
        placeholder.setScheduledAt(Instant.now());
        placeholder.setStatus("SCHEDULED");
        return appointmentRepo.save(placeholder);
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import com.marketingai.dto.AuthResponse;
import com.marketingai.dto.LoginRequest;
import com.marketingai.dto.RegisterRequest;
import com.marketingai.entity.Tenant;
import com.marketingai.entity.User;
import com.marketingai.repository.TenantRepository;
import com.marketingai.repository.UserRepository;
import com.marketingai.security.JwtUtil;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.security.crypto.password.PasswordEncoder;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.security.SecureRandom;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit;
import java.util.Base64;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class AuthService {

    private final TenantRepository tenantRepo;
    private final UserRepository userRepo;
    private final PasswordEncoder passwordEncoder;
    private final JwtUtil jwtUtil;
    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;

    private static final SecureRandom SECURE_RANDOM = new SecureRandom();
    private static final long REFRESH_EXPIRY_DAYS = 30L;

    @Transactional
    public AuthResponse register(RegisterRequest req) {
        if (tenantRepo.existsBySlug(req.getTenantSlug())) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "Tenant slug already taken");
        }
        if (userRepo.existsByEmail(req.getEmail())) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "Email already registered");
        }

        Tenant tenant = new Tenant();
        tenant.setName(req.getTenantName());
        tenant.setSlug(req.getTenantSlug());
        tenant = tenantRepo.save(tenant);

        User user = new User();
        user.setTenant(tenant);
        user.setEmail(req.getEmail());
        user.setPasswordHash(passwordEncoder.encode(req.getPassword()));
        user.setRole("ADMIN");
        user = userRepo.save(user);

        String token = jwtUtil.generate(user.getId(), tenant.getId(), user.getRole());
        return new AuthResponse(token, user.getId(), tenant.getId(), user.getRole(), user.getEmail());
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public AuthResponse login(LoginRequest req) {
        User user = userRepo.findByEmail(req.getEmail())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED, "Invalid credentials"));

        if (!"ACTIVE".equals(user.getStatus())) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED, "Account is not active");
        }
        if (!passwordEncoder.matches(req.getPassword(), user.getPasswordHash())) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED, "Invalid credentials");
        }

        String token = jwtUtil.generate(user.getId(), user.getTenant().getId(), user.getRole());
        return new AuthResponse(token, user.getId(), user.getTenant().getId(), user.getRole(), user.getEmail());
    }

    // ─── Refresh Token ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Transactional
    public AuthResponse refresh(String rawToken) {
        String hash = sha256Hex(rawToken);

        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT rt.id, rt.user_id, rt.tenant_id
                FROM refresh_tokens rt
                WHERE rt.token_hash = ? AND NOT rt.revoked AND rt.expires_at > NOW()
                """, hash);

        if (rows.isEmpty()) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED, "Invalid or expired refresh token");
        }

        UUID tokenId = UUID.fromString(rows.get(0).get("id").toString());
        UUID userId  = UUID.fromString(rows.get(0).get("user_id").toString());
        UUID tenantId = UUID.fromString(rows.get(0).get("tenant_id").toString());

        User user = userRepo.findById(userId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED, "User not found"));

        // Revoke old token (rotation)
        jdbc.update("UPDATE refresh_tokens SET revoked = TRUE WHERE id = ?", tokenId);

        // Issue new access + refresh tokens
        String newAccess  = jwtUtil.generate(userId, tenantId, user.getRole());
        String newRefresh = issueRefreshToken(userId, tenantId);

        AuthResponse resp = new AuthResponse(newAccess, userId, tenantId, user.getRole(), user.getEmail());
        // Attach refresh token in the access token field — callers should use the separate refresh field
        // We add a custom field by extending AuthResponse or returning a wrapper.
        // For now, embed refresh token in a response wrapper via an extended class.
        return new AuthResponseWithRefresh(newAccess, userId, tenantId, user.getRole(), user.getEmail(), newRefresh);
    }

    @Transactional
    public void logout(String rawToken) {
        String hash = sha256Hex(rawToken);
        jdbc.update("UPDATE refresh_tokens SET revoked = TRUE WHERE token_hash = ?", hash);
    }

    /** Issues a new refresh token, persists its hash, returns the raw token. */
    public String issueRefreshToken(UUID userId, UUID tenantId) {
        byte[] bytes = new byte[32];
        SECURE_RANDOM.nextBytes(bytes);
        String raw  = Base64.getUrlEncoder().withoutPadding().encodeToString(bytes);
        String hash = sha256Hex(raw);

        jdbc.update("""
                INSERT INTO refresh_tokens (id, tenant_id, user_id, token_hash, expires_at)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, NOW() + INTERVAL '30 days')
                """, UUID.randomUUID(), tenantId, userId, hash);

        return raw;
    }

    private static String sha256Hex(String input) {
        try {
            MessageDigest md = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256");
            byte[] digest = md.digest(input.getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            for (byte b : digest) sb.append(String.format("%02x", b));
            return sb.toString();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new RuntimeException("SHA-256 unavailable", e);
        }
    }

    // ─── Inner DTO with refresh token ────────────────────────────────────────

    public static class AuthResponseWithRefresh extends AuthResponse {
        private final String refreshToken;
        public AuthResponseWithRefresh(String token, UUID userId, UUID tenantId,
                                        String role, String email, String refreshToken) {
            super(token, userId, tenantId, role, email);
            this.refreshToken = refreshToken;
        }
        public String getRefreshToken() { return refreshToken; }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.util.Set;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Single choke point for all Meta write operations (3-17).
 * Checks tenants.autonomy_level before executing writes.
 *
 * Levels: OBSERVER < ADVISOR < SEMI_AUTOPILOT < AUTOPILOT
 */
@Slf4j
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class AutonomyService {

    private static final Set<String> VALID_LEVELS = Set.of(
            "OBSERVER", "ADVISOR", "SEMI_AUTOPILOT", "AUTOPILOT"
    );

    // Actions that require AUTOPILOT even in SEMI_AUTOPILOT mode
    private static final Set<String> AUTOPILOT_ONLY_ACTIONS = Set.of(
            "CAMPAIGN_CREATE", "AUDIENCE_UPDATE"
    );

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;

    /**
     * Check autonomy level and execute the write if allowed.
     * Throws 403 ResponseStatusException if blocked.
     */
    public void checkAndExecute(UUID tenantId, String action, Runnable write) {
        String level = getAutonomyLevel(tenantId);
        switch (level) {
            case "OBSERVER" ->
                throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
                        "OBSERVER mode — no writes allowed. Switch to ADVISOR or higher.");
            case "ADVISOR" ->
                throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
                        "ADVISOR mode — human approval required before writes.");
            case "SEMI_AUTOPILOT" -> {
                if (AUTOPILOT_ONLY_ACTIONS.contains(action)) {
                    throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
                            "Action '" + action + "' requires AUTOPILOT level.");
                }
                log.info("AutonomyService SEMI_AUTOPILOT executing: tenant={} action={}", tenantId, action);
                write.run();
            }
            case "AUTOPILOT" -> {
                log.info("AutonomyService AUTOPILOT executing: tenant={} action={}", tenantId, action);
                write.run();
            }
            default ->
                throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
                        "Unknown autonomy level: " + level);
        }
    }

    public String getAutonomyLevel(UUID tenantId) {
        try {
            String level = jdbc.queryForObject(
                    "SELECT autonomy_level FROM tenants WHERE id = ?",
                    String.class, tenantId);
            return level != null ? level : "ADVISOR";
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.warn("Could not fetch autonomy_level for tenant {}: {}", tenantId, e.getMessage());
            return "ADVISOR";
        }
    }

    public void setAutonomyLevel(UUID tenantId, String level) {
        if (!VALID_LEVELS.contains(level)) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                    "Invalid autonomy level '" + level + "'. Valid: " + VALID_LEVELS);
        }
        jdbc.update("UPDATE tenants SET autonomy_level = ? WHERE id = ?", level, tenantId);
        log.info("AutonomyService: tenant={} level set to {}", tenantId, level);
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * Autopilot evaluation engine (Phase 6-6).
 *
 * Safety rules (§9.1):
 * - Autopilot is OFF by default; must be explicitly enabled per tenant.
 * - max_l1_triggers_per_day=3 hard cap prevents runaway automation.
 * - min_p_best_to_scale=0.95 (Thompson probability) before scaling a winner.
 * - Auto-deploy of competitive intelligence WITHOUT human approval: FORBIDDEN.
 * - Spring Boot is the ONLY server-side CAPI sender.
 */
@Slf4j
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class AutopilotService {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;

    public Map<String, Object> evaluateActions(UUID tenantId) {
        Map<String, Object> settings = loadSettings(tenantId);
        if (Boolean.FALSE.equals(settings.get("enabled"))) {
            return Map.of("evaluated", 0, "reason", "Autopilot disabled for this tenant");
        }

        int maxTriggers = ((Number) settings.getOrDefault("max_l1_triggers_per_day", 3)).intValue();
        int todayCount  = countTodayActions(tenantId);
        if (todayCount >= maxTriggers) {
            return Map.of("evaluated", 0, "reason", "Daily trigger cap reached (" + maxTriggers + ")");
        }

        List<Map<String, Object>> candidates = buildCandidates(tenantId, settings);
        int executed = 0;
        for (Map<String, Object> candidate : candidates) {
            if (todayCount + executed >= maxTriggers) break;
            if (isSafeToExecute(candidate, settings)) {
                executeAction(tenantId, candidate);
                executed++;
            }
        }

        return Map.of("evaluated", candidates.size(), "executed", executed);
    }

    public boolean isSafeToExecute(Map<String, Object> candidate, Map<String, Object> settings) {
        String actionType = (String) candidate.get("action_type");
        double minPBest   = ((Number) settings.getOrDefault("min_p_best_to_scale", 0.95)).doubleValue();

        return switch (actionType) {
            case "PAUSE_BURNOUT" ->
                    Boolean.TRUE.equals(settings.get("auto_pause_burnout"));
            case "SCALE_WINNER" -> {
                double pBest = candidate.containsKey("p_best")
                        ? ((Number) candidate.get("p_best")).doubleValue() : 0.0;
                yield Boolean.TRUE.equals(settings.get("auto_scale_winner")) && pBest >= minPBest;
            }
            case "RETIRE_GRAVEYARD" ->
                    Boolean.TRUE.equals(settings.get("auto_retire_graveyard"));
            default -> false;
        };
    }

    public void executeActions(UUID tenantId, List<Map<String, Object>> actions) {
        for (Map<String, Object> action : actions) {
            executeAction(tenantId, action);
        }
    }

    // ─── private helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private Map<String, Object> loadSettings(UUID tenantId) {
        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT enabled, auto_pause_burnout, auto_scale_winner, auto_retire_graveyard,
                       max_l1_triggers_per_day, min_p_best_to_scale, budget_scale_factor
                FROM autopilot_settings WHERE tenant_id = ?
                """, tenantId);
        return rows.isEmpty() ? Map.of("enabled", false) : rows.get(0);
    }

    private int countTodayActions(UUID tenantId) {
        Integer count = jdbc.queryForObject("""
                SELECT COUNT(*) FROM autopilot_actions
                WHERE tenant_id = ? AND status = 'EXECUTED'
                  AND executed_at > now() - interval '1 day'
                """, Integer.class, tenantId);
        return count != null ? count : 0;
    }

    private List<Map<String, Object>> buildCandidates(UUID tenantId, Map<String, Object> settings) {
        List<Map<String, Object>> candidates = new ArrayList<>();

        if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(settings.get("auto_pause_burnout"))) {
            List<Map<String, Object>> burnout = jdbc.queryForList("""
                    SELECT id AS event_id, ad_set_id AS target_id
                    FROM creative_burnout_events
                    WHERE tenant_id = ? AND stage = 'critical' AND resolved = FALSE
                    LIMIT 3
                    """, tenantId);
            for (Map<String, Object> b : burnout) {
                candidates.add(Map.of(
                        "action_type", "PAUSE_BURNOUT",
                        "target_id",   b.get("target_id"),
                        "payload",     Map.of("event_id", b.get("event_id"))
                ));
            }
        }

        return candidates;
    }

    private void executeAction(UUID tenantId, Map<String, Object> candidate) {
        String actionType = (String) candidate.get("action_type");
        String targetId   = (String) candidate.get("target_id");
        Object payload    = candidate.getOrDefault("payload", Map.of());

        jdbc.update("""
                INSERT INTO autopilot_actions
                    (tenant_id, action_type, target_id, payload, status, executed_at)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?::jsonb, 'EXECUTED', now())
                """, tenantId, actionType, targetId, payload.toString());

        log.info("Autopilot executed {} on target {} for tenant {}", actionType, targetId, tenantId);
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Dynamic booking window based on no-show risk tier (roadmap 8-15; vision §19.18.2).
 * HIGH risk → nearer slots (1-3 days). LOW → standard 2-7 day window.
 */
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class BookingWindowService {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;

    public Map<String, Object> getBookingWindow(UUID tenantId, UUID sessionId) {
        List<Map<String, Object>> scores = jdbc.queryForList("""
            SELECT risk_tier, noshow_prob FROM noshow_scores
            WHERE session_id = ? AND tenant_id = ?
            ORDER BY scored_at DESC LIMIT 1
            """, sessionId, tenantId);

        String riskTier = scores.isEmpty() ? "UNKNOWN"
                : (String) scores.get(0).get("risk_tier");
        Double noshowProb = scores.isEmpty() ? null
                : ((Number) scores.get(0).get("noshow_prob")).doubleValue();

        Map<String, Object> window = new HashMap<>(buildWindow(riskTier));
        window.put("session_id",   sessionId);
        window.put("risk_tier",    riskTier);
        window.put("noshow_prob",  noshowProb);
        window.put("scored",       !scores.isEmpty());
        return window;
    }

    private Map<String, Object> buildWindow(String riskTier) {
        return switch (riskTier) {
            case "HIGH" -> Map.of(
                "min_days_out",    1,
                "max_days_out",    3,
                "slot_window_h",   24,
                "preferred_times", List.of("09:00", "11:00", "14:00"),
                "note",            "Nearer slots offered — high no-show risk"
            );
            case "MED" -> Map.of(
                "min_days_out",    1,
                "max_days_out",    5,
                "slot_window_h",   72,
                "preferred_times", List.of("10:00", "14:00", "16:00"),
                "note",            "Earlier slots preferred — medium risk"
            );
            default -> Map.of(
                "min_days_out",    2,
                "max_days_out",    7,
                "slot_window_h",   96,
                "preferred_times", List.of("10:00", "14:00"),
                "note",            "Standard 4-day booking window"
            );
        };
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonProcessingException;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import com.marketingai.dto.analytics.AtomPerformanceRow;
import com.marketingai.dto.analytics.OverviewResponse;
import com.marketingai.dto.brief.BriefRequest;
import com.marketingai.dto.brief.BriefResponse;
import com.marketingai.entity.CreatorBrief;
import com.marketingai.repository.CreatorBriefRepository;
import com.marketingai.security.TenantContext;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

@Slf4j
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class BriefService {

    private final CreatorBriefRepository briefRepository;
    private final AnalyticsService analyticsService;
    private final ObjectMapper objectMapper;
    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;

    static final String STRUCTURE_TEMPLATE =
            "Hook (3s) → Problem (10s) → Solution (15s) → Proof (15s) → CTA (5s)";

    // ─── List ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    public List<BriefResponse> list() {
        return briefRepository.findByTenantIdOrderByCreatedAtDesc(tenantId())
                .stream().map(b -> toResponse(b, false)).toList();
    }

    // ─── Get ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    public BriefResponse get(UUID id) {
        return toResponse(findOrThrow(id), false);
    }

    // ─── Create (with auto-generated atom suggestions) ────────────────────────

    @Transactional
    public BriefResponse create(BriefRequest req) {
        CreatorBrief brief = new CreatorBrief();
        brief.setTenantId(tenantId());
        applyRequest(brief, req);

        // Pull atom suggestions from descriptive stats (last 90 days)
        populateAtomSuggestions(brief, req.getCreativeType());

        return toResponse(briefRepository.save(brief), false);
    }

    // ─── Update (increments version + snapshots) ─────────────────────────────

    @Transactional
    public BriefResponse update(UUID id, BriefRequest req) {
        CreatorBrief brief = findOrThrow(id);
        snapshotVersion(brief);
        brief.setVersion(brief.getVersion() + 1);
        applyRequest(brief, req);
        return toResponse(briefRepository.save(brief), false);
    }

    // ─── Pair two briefs (video ↔ landing) ───────────────────────────────────

    @Transactional
    public BriefResponse pair(UUID id, UUID otherId) {
        CreatorBrief a = findOrThrow(id);
        CreatorBrief b = briefRepository.findByIdAndTenantId(otherId, tenantId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
                        "Partner brief not found"));
        if (a.getBriefType() != null && b.getBriefType() != null
                && a.getBriefType().equals(b.getBriefType())
                && !"GENERAL".equals(a.getBriefType())) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
                    "Cannot pair two briefs of the same type (" + a.getBriefType() + ")");
        }
        a.setPairedBriefId(otherId);
        b.setPairedBriefId(id);
        briefRepository.save(a);
        briefRepository.save(b);
        return toResponse(a, false);
    }

    // ─── Mark result creative ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Transactional
    public BriefResponse markResult(UUID id, UUID creativeId, UUID userId) {
        CreatorBrief brief = findOrThrow(id);
        brief.setResultCreativeId(creativeId);
        jdbc.update(
            "UPDATE creatives SET creator_id = ? WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ?",
            userId, creativeId, brief.getTenantId());
        return toResponse(briefRepository.save(brief), false);
    }

    // ─── Regenerate atom suggestions ─────────────────────────────────────────

    @Transactional
    public BriefResponse regenerateSuggestions(UUID id) {
        CreatorBrief brief = findOrThrow(id);
        populateAtomSuggestions(brief, brief.getCreativeType());
        return toResponse(briefRepository.save(brief), false);
    }

    // ─── Export as Markdown ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

    public BriefResponse export(UUID id) {
        CreatorBrief brief = findOrThrow(id);
        return toResponse(brief, true);
    }

    // ─── Delete ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Transactional
    public void delete(UUID id) {
        briefRepository.delete(findOrThrow(id));
    }

    // ─── Data-driven brief by cluster/audience (5-8, vision §5.5.4) ─────────

    @Transactional
    public BriefResponse generateDataDriven(String clusterLabel, String audienceSegment) {
        UUID tid = tenantId();

        // Load top posteriors for active variants; filter by cluster via sessions
        // thompson_arms has no cluster_label — we find variants shown to this cluster via events
        List<Map<String, Object>> arms = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT DISTINCT ta.variant_id, ta.alpha, ta.beta, v.name AS variant_name
                FROM thompson_arms ta
                JOIN variants v ON v.id = ta.variant_id
                WHERE v.tenant_id = ?
                  AND v.status = 'ACTIVE'
                  AND EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1 FROM sessions s
                      WHERE s.variant_id = v.id
                        AND s.cluster_label = ?
                        AND s.tenant_id = ?
                  )
                ORDER BY (ta.alpha / NULLIF(ta.alpha + ta.beta, 0)) DESC
                LIMIT 10
                """, tid, clusterLabel, tid);

        // Load VoC signals for this cluster
        List<Map<String, Object>> vocSignals = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT signal_text, sentiment, source
                FROM brief_voc_signals bvs
                JOIN creator_briefs cb ON cb.id = bvs.brief_id
                WHERE cb.tenant_id = ?
                ORDER BY bvs.created_at DESC
                LIMIT 20
                """, tid);

        // Load niche benchmark for context
        List<Map<String, Object>> benchmarks = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT metric_name, niche_mean, niche_std, n_tenants
                FROM niche_benchmarks
                WHERE niche_label = ?
                LIMIT 5
                """, clusterLabel);

        // Build VoC section
        StringBuilder vocSection = new StringBuilder();
        if (!vocSignals.isEmpty()) {
            vocSection.append("## Voice of Customer (").append(clusterLabel).append(")\n");
            vocSignals.stream().limit(5).forEach(s ->
                vocSection.append("- [").append(s.get("sentiment")).append("] ")
                          .append(s.get("signal_text")).append("\n"));
        }

        // Build top performing variant note
        StringBuilder notes = new StringBuilder();
        notes.append("Cluster: ").append(clusterLabel);
        if (audienceSegment != null && !audienceSegment.isBlank()) {
            notes.append(", Segment: ").append(audienceSegment);
        }
        if (!arms.isEmpty()) {
            Map<String, Object> top = arms.get(0);
            double alpha = ((Number) top.get("alpha")).doubleValue();
            double beta  = ((Number) top.get("beta")).doubleValue();
            double cvr   = alpha / (alpha + beta);
            notes.append(String.format(". Top variant '%s': CVR=%.2f%%",
                    top.get("variant_name"), cvr * 100));
        }
        if (!benchmarks.isEmpty()) {
            notes.append(". Niche benchmarks: ");
            benchmarks.forEach(b ->
                notes.append(b.get("metric_name")).append("=").append(b.get("niche_mean")).append(" "));
        }

        CreatorBrief brief = new CreatorBrief();
        brief.setTenantId(tid);
        brief.setTitle("Data-Driven Brief — " + clusterLabel
                + (audienceSegment != null ? " / " + audienceSegment : ""));
        brief.setCreativeType("VIDEO");
        brief.setBriefType("VIDEO");
        brief.setTargetAudience(clusterLabel);
        brief.setNotes(notes.toString());
        brief.setStructureTemplate(STRUCTURE_TEMPLATE);
        brief.setVocSection(vocSection.length() > 0 ? vocSection.toString() : null);

        try {
            String meta = objectMapper.writeValueAsString(Map.of(
                    "cluster_label",    clusterLabel,
                    "audience_segment", audienceSegment != null ? audienceSegment : "",
                    "arms_loaded",      arms.size(),
                    "voc_signals",      vocSignals.size()
            ));
            brief.setMeta(meta);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}

        populateAtomSuggestions(brief, "VIDEO");
        return toResponse(briefRepository.save(brief), false);
    }

    // ─── Block F §3: Enrich with Voice-of-Customer signals ───────────────────

    /**
     * Attach VoC signals (reviews, support tickets, survey responses) to a brief.
     * Stored in brief_voc_signals (V82). Each signal includes source + sentiment
     * so writers can tailor copy to real customer language (vision §8.2).
     */
    @Transactional
    public Map<String, Object> enrichWithVoC(UUID briefId, List<Map<String, Object>> signals) {
        CreatorBrief brief = findOrThrow(briefId);
        UUID tenantId = brief.getTenantId();
        int inserted = 0;

        for (Map<String, Object> signal : signals) {
            String source = String.valueOf(signal.getOrDefault("source", "UNKNOWN")).toUpperCase();
            String text   = String.valueOf(signal.getOrDefault("signal_text", ""));
            String sentiment = signal.containsKey("sentiment")
                    ? String.valueOf(signal.get("sentiment")).toUpperCase() : null;

            if (text.isBlank()) continue;

            jdbc.update("""
                INSERT INTO brief_voc_signals (tenant_id, brief_id, source, signal_text, sentiment)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                """, tenantId, briefId, source, text, sentiment);
            inserted++;
        }

        log.info("Enriched brief {} with {} VoC signals (tenant {})", briefId, inserted, tenantId);
        return Map.of(
            "brief_id",      briefId.toString(),
            "signals_added", inserted,
            "status",        "OK"
        );
    }

    /**
     * Retrieve VoC signals attached to a brief, ordered most recent first.
     */
    public List<Map<String, Object>> getVoC(UUID briefId) {
        findOrThrow(briefId); // ensures tenant isolation via RLS
        return jdbc.queryForList("""
            SELECT id, source, signal_text, sentiment, created_at
            FROM brief_voc_signals
            WHERE brief_id = ?
            ORDER BY created_at DESC
            """, briefId);
    }

    // ─── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private void snapshotVersion(CreatorBrief brief) {
        try {
            java.util.Map<String, Object> snap = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
            snap.put("title",        brief.getTitle());
            snap.put("creativeType", brief.getCreativeType());
            snap.put("targetAudience", brief.getTargetAudience());
            snap.put("productInfo",  brief.getProductInfo());
            snap.put("notes",        brief.getNotes());
            snap.put("status",       brief.getStatus());
            snap.put("briefType",    brief.getBriefType());
            String snapJson = objectMapper.writeValueAsString(snap);
            jdbc.update("""
                INSERT INTO brief_versions (brief_id, tenant_id, version, snapshot)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?::jsonb)
                """, brief.getId(), brief.getTenantId(), brief.getVersion(), snapJson);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.warn("Brief snapshot failed: {}", e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    private void applyRequest(CreatorBrief brief, BriefRequest req) {
        brief.setTitle(req.getTitle());
        brief.setCreativeType(req.getCreativeType() != null
                ? req.getCreativeType().toUpperCase() : null);
        brief.setTargetAudience(req.getTargetAudience());
        brief.setProductInfo(req.getProductInfo());
        brief.setNotes(req.getNotes());
        if (req.getStatus() != null) brief.setStatus(req.getStatus().toUpperCase());
        if (req.getBriefType() != null) brief.setBriefType(req.getBriefType().toUpperCase());
        brief.setStructureTemplate(STRUCTURE_TEMPLATE);
    }

    private void populateAtomSuggestions(CreatorBrief brief, String creativeType) {
        try {
            List<AtomPerformanceRow> atoms = analyticsService.atomPerformance(90, null);
            OverviewResponse overview = analyticsService.overview(90);

            // Top performers: at least 2 creatives, CVR not null, top 10 by CVR
            List<Map<String, Object>> recommended = atoms.stream()
                    .filter(a -> a.getCreativeCount() >= 2 && a.getConversionRate() != null)
                    .sorted((a, b) -> Double.compare(
                            b.getConversionRate(), a.getConversionRate()))
                    .limit(10)
                    .map(a -> Map.<String, Object>of(
                            "atomType", a.getAtomType(),
                            "atomValue", a.getAtomValue(),
                            "cvr", String.format("%.2f%%", a.getConversionRate() * 100),
                            "creativeCount", a.getCreativeCount(),
                            "rationale", "Top CVR performer in this account"
                    ))
                    .toList();

            // Avoid: have sessions but CVR below average, at least 2 creatives
            double avgCvr = overview.getConversionRate() != null
                    ? overview.getConversionRate() : 0.01;

            List<Map<String, Object>> avoid = atoms.stream()
                    .filter(a -> a.getCreativeCount() >= 2
                            && a.getConversionRate() != null
                            && a.getTotalSessions() >= 50
                            && a.getConversionRate() < avgCvr * 0.5)
                    .sorted((a, b) -> Double.compare(
                            a.getConversionRate(), b.getConversionRate()))
                    .limit(5)
                    .map(a -> Map.<String, Object>of(
                            "atomType", a.getAtomType(),
                            "atomValue", a.getAtomValue(),
                            "cvr", String.format("%.2f%%", a.getConversionRate() * 100),
                            "creativeCount", a.getCreativeCount(),
                            "rationale", "Below-average CVR — avoid or test alternatives"
                    ))
                    .toList();

            // Benchmarks
            double topCvr = recommended.isEmpty() ? 0.0
                    : atoms.stream()
                            .filter(a -> a.getConversionRate() != null)
                            .mapToDouble(AtomPerformanceRow::getConversionRate)
                            .max().orElse(0.0);

            String topHook = atoms.stream()
                    .filter(a -> "HOOK".equals(a.getAtomType()) && a.getConversionRate() != null)
                    .max((a, b) -> Double.compare(a.getConversionRate(), b.getConversionRate()))
                    .map(AtomPerformanceRow::getAtomValue)
                    .orElse("n/a");

            Map<String, Object> benchmarks = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
            benchmarks.put("cvrAvg", avgCvr != 0.01
                    ? String.format("%.2f%%", avgCvr * 100) : "n/a");
            benchmarks.put("cvrTopAtom", String.format("%.2f%%", topCvr * 100));
            benchmarks.put("topHook", topHook);
            benchmarks.put("dataPeriodDays", 90);
            benchmarks.put("note",
                    "Phase 1: descriptive stats from first-party events. " +
                    "Causal benchmarks available in Phase 3.");

            brief.setRecommendedAtoms(objectMapper.writeValueAsString(recommended));
            brief.setAvoidAtoms(objectMapper.writeValueAsString(avoid));
            brief.setBenchmarks(objectMapper.writeValueAsString(benchmarks));

        } catch (JsonProcessingException e) {
            log.warn("Failed to serialize atom suggestions: {}", e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    private BriefResponse toResponse(CreatorBrief b, boolean withMarkdown) {
        return BriefResponse.builder()
                .id(b.getId())
                .tenantId(b.getTenantId())
                .title(b.getTitle())
                .creativeType(b.getCreativeType())
                .targetAudience(b.getTargetAudience())
                .productInfo(b.getProductInfo())
                .recommendedAtoms(b.getRecommendedAtoms())
                .avoidAtoms(b.getAvoidAtoms())
                .structureTemplate(b.getStructureTemplate())
                .benchmarks(b.getBenchmarks())
                .notes(b.getNotes())
                .status(b.getStatus())
                .version(b.getVersion())
                .briefType(b.getBriefType())
                .pairedBriefId(b.getPairedBriefId())
                .resultCreativeId(b.getResultCreativeId())
                .markdownExport(withMarkdown ? buildMarkdown(b) : null)
                .createdAt(b.getCreatedAt())
                .updatedAt(b.getUpdatedAt())
                .build();
    }

    private String buildMarkdown(CreatorBrief b) {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.append("# Creator Brief: ").append(b.getTitle()).append("\n\n");
        sb.append("> Phase 1 template brief. Data-driven version available in Phase 3.\n\n");
        sb.append("## 🎯 Creative Type\n").append(b.getCreativeType()).append("\n\n");

        if (b.getTargetAudience() != null && !b.getTargetAudience().isBlank()) {
            sb.append("## 👥 Target Audience\n").append(b.getTargetAudience()).append("\n\n");
        }
        if (b.getProductInfo() != null && !b.getProductInfo().isBlank()) {
            sb.append("## 📦 Product Info\n").append(b.getProductInfo()).append("\n\n");
        }

        sb.append("## 📋 Structure Template\n")
                .append(b.getStructureTemplate() != null
                        ? b.getStructureTemplate() : STRUCTURE_TEMPLATE)
                .append("\n\n");

        appendAtomSection(sb, "✅ Recommended Atoms (Top CVR)", b.getRecommendedAtoms());
        appendAtomSection(sb, "❌ Avoid (Low CVR)", b.getAvoidAtoms());

        sb.append("## 📊 Benchmarks\n");
        sb.append(b.getBenchmarks() != null ? b.getBenchmarks() : "No data yet.").append("\n\n");

        appendVocSection(sb, b.getTenantId());

        if (b.getNotes() != null && !b.getNotes().isBlank()) {
            sb.append("## 📝 Notes\n").append(b.getNotes()).append("\n\n");
        }

        sb.append("---\n_Generated by Marketing AI Platform — Phase 1 descriptive analytics_\n");
        return sb.toString();
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private void appendAtomSection(StringBuilder sb, String heading, String jsonArray) {
        sb.append("## ").append(heading).append("\n");
        if (jsonArray == null || jsonArray.equals("[]")) {
            sb.append("_No data yet — upload and analyze more creatives._\n\n");
            return;
        }
        try {
            List<Map<String, Object>> atoms =
                    objectMapper.readValue(jsonArray, List.class);
            for (var a : atoms) {
                sb.append(String.format("- **%s**: `%s` — CVR %s (%s creatives)\n",
                        a.get("atomType"), a.get("atomValue"),
                        a.get("cvr"), a.get("creativeCount")));
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            sb.append("_Could not parse atom data._\n");
        }
        sb.append("\n");
    }

    private void appendVocSection(StringBuilder sb, UUID tenantId) {
        sb.append("## Возражения аудитории (из VoC)\n");
        try {
            List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbc.queryForList(
                "SELECT category, objection_text, count "
                + "FROM voc_objections WHERE tenant_id = ? "
                + "ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 5",
                tenantId);
            if (rows.isEmpty()) {
                sb.append("_Возражения не загружены. Используйте импорт VoC для анализа._\n\n");
                return;
            }
            for (var row : rows) {
                sb.append(String.format("- **%s**: %s (%s упоминаний)\n",
                    row.get("category"), row.get("objection_text"), row.get("count")));
            }
            sb.append("\n");
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.warn("Failed to fetch VoC objections for brief: {}", e.getMessage());
            sb.append("_Данные VoC недоступны._\n\n");
        }
    }

    private CreatorBrief findOrThrow(UUID id) {
        return briefRepository.findByIdAndTenantId(id, tenantId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Brief not found"));
    }

    private UUID tenantId() {
        return UUID.fromString(TenantContext.get());
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import com.marketingai.dto.budget.*;
import com.marketingai.entity.BudgetGuard;
import com.marketingai.entity.Tenant;
import com.marketingai.repository.BudgetGuardRepository;
import com.marketingai.repository.TenantRepository;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

@Slf4j
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class BudgetGuardService {

    private final BudgetGuardRepository guardRepo;
    private final TenantRepository tenantRepo;
    private final AlertService alertService;

    private static final List<String> VALID_TYPES =
            List.of("PER_CREATIVE_STOP_LOSS", "MONTHLY_CEILING");

    @Transactional
    public BudgetGuardResponse create(UUID tenantId, CreateGuardRequest req) {
        if (!VALID_TYPES.contains(req.getGuardType())) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                    "guardType must be PER_CREATIVE_STOP_LOSS or MONTHLY_CEILING");
        }
        BudgetGuard guard = new BudgetGuard();
        guard.setTenantId(tenantId);
        guard.setGuardType(req.getGuardType());
        guard.setReferenceId(req.getReferenceId());
        guard.setThreshold(req.getThreshold());
        return BudgetGuardResponse.from(guardRepo.save(guard));
    }

    public List<BudgetGuardResponse> list(UUID tenantId) {
        return guardRepo.findByTenantId(tenantId)
                .stream()
                .map(BudgetGuardResponse::from)
                .toList();
    }

    public BudgetGuardResponse get(UUID tenantId, UUID guardId) {
        return BudgetGuardResponse.from(findOwned(tenantId, guardId));
    }

    @Transactional
    public BudgetGuardResponse update(UUID tenantId, UUID guardId, UpdateGuardRequest req) {
        BudgetGuard guard = findOwned(tenantId, guardId);

        if (req.getThreshold() != null) {
            guard.setThreshold(req.getThreshold());
        }
        if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(req.getResetTrigger())) {
            guard.setTriggered(false);
            guard.setTriggeredAt(null);
            log.info("Guard {} manually reset by tenant {}", guardId, tenantId);
        }
        return BudgetGuardResponse.from(guardRepo.save(guard));
    }

    @Transactional
    public void delete(UUID tenantId, UUID guardId) {
        BudgetGuard guard = findOwned(tenantId, guardId);
        guardRepo.delete(guard);
    }

    /**
     * Manual spend update — marketer enters current spend from Meta Ads Manager.
     * Immediately evaluates the guard after updating.
     */
    @Transactional
    public BudgetGuardResponse updateSpend(UUID tenantId, UUID guardId, UpdateSpendRequest req) {
        BudgetGuard guard = findOwned(tenantId, guardId);
        guard.setCurrentSpend(req.getCurrentSpend());
        guardRepo.save(guard);

        if (!guard.isTriggered() && guard.getCurrentSpend() >= guard.getThreshold()) {
            triggerGuard(guard);
        }
        return BudgetGuardResponse.from(guard);
    }

    /**
     * Called by CircuitBreakerScheduler every 5 min.
     * Checks all non-triggered guards across all tenants.
     */
    @Transactional
    public void checkAllGuards() {
        List<BudgetGuard> candidates = guardRepo.findAllByTriggeredFalse();

        for (BudgetGuard guard : candidates) {
            // Monthly ceiling: reset if we've entered a new billing month
            if ("MONTHLY_CEILING".equals(guard.getGuardType())) {
                LocalDate firstOfMonth = LocalDate.now().withDayOfMonth(1);
                if (guard.getPeriodStart() == null || guard.getPeriodStart().isBefore(firstOfMonth)) {
                    guard.setPeriodStart(firstOfMonth);
                    guard.setCurrentSpend(0f);
                    guardRepo.save(guard);
                    continue; // reset — don't evaluate this cycle
                }
            }

            if (guard.getCurrentSpend() >= guard.getThreshold()) {
                triggerGuard(guard);
                guardRepo.save(guard);
            }
        }
    }

    // ─── Internal ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private void triggerGuard(BudgetGuard guard) {
        guard.setTriggered(true);
        guard.setTriggeredAt(Instant.now());
        log.warn("Budget guard triggered: id={} tenant={} type={} spend={}/{}",
                guard.getId(), guard.getTenantId(), guard.getGuardType(),
                guard.getCurrentSpend(), guard.getThreshold());

        tenantRepo.findById(guard.getTenantId()).ifPresent(tenant -> {
            String type = "PER_CREATIVE_STOP_LOSS".equals(guard.getGuardType())
                    ? "Per-Creative Stop-Loss" : "Monthly Ceiling";
            String ref = guard.getReferenceId() != null
                    ? "Creative ID: " + guard.getReferenceId() : "Account-level";
            alertService.sendAlert(String.format(
                    "🚨 Budget Guard Triggered — %s\n\nType: %s\n%s\n" +
                    "Threshold: $%.2f\nCurrent Spend: $%.2f\n\n" +
                    "Action Required: Pause affected ad set(s) in Meta Ads Manager.",
                    tenant.getName(), type, ref,
                    guard.getThreshold(), guard.getCurrentSpend()));
        });
    }

    private BudgetGuard findOwned(UUID tenantId, UUID guardId) {
        return guardRepo.findByIdAndTenantId(guardId, tenantId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(
                        HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Budget guard not found"));
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * CAPI Event Match Quality (EMQ) pre-check (roadmap 8-2; vision §19.2).
 * First-party checks only — actual EMQ score comes from Meta Events Manager after 24h.
 * Target: EMQ ≥ 7.0 for quality stages, ≥ 6.0 acceptable.
 */
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Slf4j
public class CAPIEmqCheckService {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;

    public Map<String, Object> runEmqPreCheck(UUID tenantId) {
        // Events fired vs sent to Meta via capi_events table
        List<Map<String, Object>> capiCounts = jdbc.queryForList("""
            SELECT cem.meta_event_name,
                   COUNT(ce.id)                         AS sent_to_meta,
                   COUNT(DISTINCT ce.session_id)        AS unique_sessions
            FROM capi_event_map cem
            LEFT JOIN capi_events ce
                ON ce.event_name = cem.meta_event_name
                AND ce.tenant_id = cem.tenant_id
                AND ce.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
            WHERE cem.tenant_id = ?
            GROUP BY cem.meta_event_name
            """, tenantId);

        // Dedup: events without event_id cannot be deduped in Meta Events Manager
        List<Map<String, Object>> dupCheck = jdbc.queryForList("""
            SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_events,
                   COUNT(event_id) AS with_event_id,
                   COUNT(*) - COUNT(event_id) AS missing_event_id
            FROM capi_events
            WHERE tenant_id = ? AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
            """, tenantId);

        // Active pixel check
        List<Map<String, Object>> pixels = jdbc.queryForList("""
            SELECT pixel_id, status FROM meta_pixels
            WHERE tenant_id = ? AND status = 'ACTIVE'
            """, tenantId);

        List<String> warnings = new ArrayList<>();
        boolean passed = true;

        for (Map<String, Object> row : capiCounts) {
            long sent = row.get("sent_to_meta") != null
                ? ((Number) row.get("sent_to_meta")).longValue() : 0;
            if (sent == 0) {
                warnings.add("Event '" + row.get("meta_event_name") + "': 0 events sent to Meta in last 7 days");
            }
        }

        if (!dupCheck.isEmpty()) {
            long missing = dupCheck.get(0).get("missing_event_id") != null
                ? ((Number) dupCheck.get(0).get("missing_event_id")).longValue() : 0;
            if (missing > 0) {
                warnings.add(missing + " CAPI events missing event_id — deduplication may fail in Meta Events Manager");
            }
        }

        if (pixels.isEmpty()) {
            warnings.add("No active Meta pixel — CAPI events cannot be matched to pixel traffic");
            passed = false;
        }

        if (capiCounts.stream().allMatch(r ->
                ((Number) r.getOrDefault("sent_to_meta", 0)).longValue() == 0)) {
            passed = false;
        }

        return Map.of(
            "passed",          passed,
            "events_checked",  capiCounts,
            "warnings",        warnings,
            "pixel_count",     pixels.size(),
            "dedup_check",     dupCheck.isEmpty() ? Map.of() : dupCheck.get(0),
            "note",            "First-party pre-check only. Verify EMQ score in Meta Events Manager after 24h.",
            "emq_target",      "EMQ ≥ 7.0 for quality events, ≥ 6.0 acceptable"
        );
    }
}
```
