```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import com.marketingai.entity.CAPIEventLog;
import com.marketingai.entity.Tenant;
import com.marketingai.repository.CAPIEventLogRepository;
import com.marketingai.repository.MetaPixelRepository;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;

import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.*;

@Slf4j
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class CAPIForwardingService {

    private final CAPIEventLogRepository capiRepo;
    private final MetaPixelRepository pixelRepo;
    private final RestTemplate restTemplate;
    private final org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private static final ObjectMapper MAPPER = new ObjectMapper();

    private static final String GRAPH_API = "https://graph.facebook.com/v20.0";

    // ─── B2B proxy value bidding (vision §16.1, arch v1.1 §13.4) ────────────

    public record ProxyMapping(String metaEventName, float multiplier) {}

    /**
     * Real GHL event types → CAPI event mapping (arch v1.1 §13.4).
     * Each pipeline stage sends a DIFFERENT CAPI event so one lead never counts as two Purchases.
     *   call outcome (conversation webhook)         → Lead       (×0.15 avg deal value)
     *   AppointmentUpdate, appointmentStatus=showed → Schedule   (×0.40)
     *   OpportunityStatusUpdate, status=won         → Purchase   (×1.00, actual deal value)
     *
     * Not mapped (intentionally skipped):
     *   ContactCreate / ContactUpdate — session linking only, no CAPI send
     *   AppointmentUpdate, noshow — no CAPI event (do not pollute pixel)
     *   AppointmentCreate — booking only, quality not confirmed yet
     *   OpportunityStatusUpdate, status=lost — no CAPI event
     */
    private static final Map<String, ProxyMapping> GHL_TO_CAPI = Map.of(
            // ⚠️ verify exact event name + status field in GHL docs before go-live
            "CRM_CALL_ANSWERED",        new ProxyMapping("Lead",     0.15f),
            "AppointmentUpdate_showed", new ProxyMapping("Schedule", 0.40f),
            "OpportunityStatusUpdate_won", new ProxyMapping("Purchase", 1.00f)
    );

    /**
     * Resolves the lookup key from raw GHL event type + status fields.
     * AppointmentUpdate and OpportunityStatusUpdate carry their outcome in a separate field.
     */
    public static String resolveGhlKey(String eventType, String statusField, String appointmentStatus) {
        if ("AppointmentUpdate".equals(eventType) && "showed".equalsIgnoreCase(appointmentStatus)) {
            return "AppointmentUpdate_showed";
        }
        if ("OpportunityStatusUpdate".equals(eventType) && "won".equalsIgnoreCase(statusField)) {
            return "OpportunityStatusUpdate_won";
        }
        // call outcome: conversation/message webhooks — exact name TBD in GHL docs
        if ("CRM_CALL_ANSWERED".equals(eventType)) {
            return "CRM_CALL_ANSWERED";
        }
        return eventType; // no match → qualityGate returns empty → SKIPPED
    }

    /** Returns empty if the GHL event should be skipped (quality gate failed). */
    public Optional<ProxyMapping> qualityGate(String ghlEventType) {
        return Optional.ofNullable(GHL_TO_CAPI.get(ghlEventType));
    }

    // ─── Main entry point ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    public CAPIEventLog forward(
            Tenant tenant,
            String ghlEventType,
            String ghlContactId,
            String sessionId,
            String email,
            String phone,
            Double dealValue,
            String clientEventId
    ) {
        Optional<ProxyMapping> mapping = qualityGate(ghlEventType);
        if (mapping.isEmpty()) {
            return saveSkipped(tenant.getId(), ghlEventType, ghlContactId, sessionId);
        }

        ProxyMapping pm = mapping.get();
        float avgDeal = avgDealValue(tenant);
        float proxyValue = "Purchase".equals(pm.metaEventName()) && dealValue != null
                ? dealValue.floatValue()
                : avgDeal * pm.multiplier();

        String pixelId      = pixelRepo.findDefaultPixelId(tenant.getId()).orElse(null);
        String accessToken  = pixelRepo.findCapiToken(tenant.getId()).orElse(null);

        // Lookup session external_id_hash for Advanced Matching (vision §7.4)
        String externalIdHash = lookupExternalIdHash(tenant.getId(), sessionId);
        Map<String, Object> payload = buildPayload(
                pm.metaEventName(), email, phone, proxyValue, clientEventId, externalIdHash);

        CAPIEventLog entry = new CAPIEventLog();
        entry.setTenantId(tenant.getId());
        entry.setSessionId(sessionId);
        entry.setEventName(pm.metaEventName());
        entry.setEventId(clientEventId);
        entry.setPixelId(pixelId);
        entry.setProxyValue(proxyValue);
        entry.setGhlEventType(ghlEventType);
        entry.setGhlContactId(ghlContactId);
        entry.setPayload(toJson(payload));

        if (pixelId == null || accessToken == null) {
            entry.setStatus("PENDING");
            log.info("CAPI queued as PENDING (no credentials) — tenant={} event={}",
                    tenant.getId(), pm.metaEventName());
            return capiRepo.save(entry);
        }

        return sendToMeta(entry, pixelId, accessToken, payload);
    }

    // ─── Meta Graph API call ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private CAPIEventLog sendToMeta(
            CAPIEventLog entry, String pixelId, String accessToken,
            Map<String, Object> payload) {
        try {
            String url = GRAPH_API + "/" + pixelId + "/events?access_token=" + accessToken;
            Map<String, Object> body = Map.of("data", List.of(payload));

            ResponseEntity<String> resp = restTemplate.postForEntity(url, body, String.class);
            entry.setStatus("SENT");
            entry.setSentAt(Instant.now());
            entry.setMetaResponse(resp.getBody());
            log.info("CAPI sent: event={} pixel={} value={} tenant={}",
                    entry.getEventName(), pixelId, entry.getProxyValue(), entry.getTenantId());
        } catch (Exception e) {
            entry.setStatus("FAILED");
            entry.setMetaResponse("{\"error\":\"" + e.getMessage().replace("\"", "'") + "\"}");
            log.warn("CAPI send failed for tenant {}: {}", entry.getTenantId(), e.getMessage());
        }
        return capiRepo.save(entry);
    }

    // ─── Payload builder ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private Map<String, Object> buildPayload(
            String eventName, String email, String phone,
            float value, String eventId) {
        return buildPayload(eventName, email, phone, value, eventId, null);
    }

    private Map<String, Object> buildPayload(
            String eventName, String email, String phone,
            float value, String eventId, String externalIdHash) {

        Map<String, Object> userData = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        if (email != null && !email.isBlank())
            userData.put("em", List.of(sha256(email.toLowerCase().trim())));
        if (phone != null && !phone.isBlank())
            userData.put("ph", List.of(sha256(normalizePhone(phone))));
        // Advanced Matching: external_id from cross-device identity (vision §7.4)
        if (externalIdHash != null && !externalIdHash.isBlank())
            userData.put("external_id", List.of(externalIdHash));

        Map<String, Object> customData = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        customData.put("value", value);
        customData.put("currency", "USD");

        Map<String, Object> event = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        event.put("event_name", eventName);
        event.put("event_time", Instant.now().getEpochSecond());
        event.put("action_source", "system_generated");
        event.put("user_data", userData);
        event.put("custom_data", customData);
        if (eventId != null) event.put("event_id", eventId);

        return event;
    }

    // ─── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private CAPIEventLog saveSkipped(UUID tenantId, String ghlEventType,
                                      String ghlContactId, String sessionId) {
        CAPIEventLog entry = new CAPIEventLog();
        entry.setTenantId(tenantId);
        entry.setSessionId(sessionId);
        entry.setGhlEventType(ghlEventType);
        entry.setGhlContactId(ghlContactId);
        entry.setEventName("NONE");
        entry.setStatus("SKIPPED");
        log.debug("CAPI skipped for GHL event '{}' (quality gate)", ghlEventType);
        return capiRepo.save(entry);
    }

    private float avgDealValue(Tenant tenant) {
        try {
            if (tenant.getSettings() != null) {
                var node = MAPPER.readTree(tenant.getSettings());
                if (node.has("avg_deal_value")) {
                    return (float) node.get("avg_deal_value").asDouble(5000.0);
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return 5000f;
    }

    private static String sha256(String input) {
        try {
            byte[] hash = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
                    .digest(input.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(64);
            for (byte b : hash) sb.append(String.format("%02x", b));
            return sb.toString();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return input;
        }
    }

    private static String normalizePhone(String phone) {
        return phone.replaceAll("[^0-9]", "");
    }

    /** Lookup external_id_hash from sessions for Advanced Matching (vision §7.4). */
    private String lookupExternalIdHash(UUID tenantId, String sessionId) {
        if (sessionId == null || sessionId.isBlank()) return null;
        try {
            return jdbc.queryForObject("""
                    SELECT external_id_hash
                    FROM sessions
                    WHERE id = ?::uuid
                      AND tenant_id = ?
                      AND consent_level = 'full'
                    LIMIT 1
                    """, String.class, sessionId, tenantId);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private String toJson(Object obj) {
        try { return MAPPER.writeValueAsString(obj); } catch (Exception e) { return "{}"; }
    }

    // ─── CAPI Chain v2: DB-driven stage forwarding (vision §19.4) ───────────

    /**
     * Forward CAPI event using the DB-driven capi_event_map for a given stage_key.
     * Evaluates send_condition and picks the correct pixel_role.
     * Non-accredited leads → future_regcf pixel only (NEVER investor_primary).
     */
    public List<CAPIEventLog> forwardByStage(
            Tenant tenant,
            String stageKey,
            String ghlContactId,
            String sessionId,
            String email,
            String phone,
            Boolean selfAccredited,
            String ticketBucket,
            Double monetaryValue,
            String clientEventId,
            ValueFormulaService valueFormulaService) {

        List<Map<String, Object>> mappings = jdbc.queryForList(
                "SELECT pixel_role, meta_event_name, value_formula, send_condition " +
                "FROM capi_event_map WHERE tenant_id = ? AND stage_key = ?",
                tenant.getId(), stageKey);

        List<CAPIEventLog> results = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Map<String, Object> mapping : mappings) {
            String sendCondition = (String) mapping.get("send_condition");
            if (!evaluateCondition(sendCondition, selfAccredited)) {
                log.debug("CAPI stage={} pixel_role={} skipped by condition='{}'",
                        stageKey, mapping.get("pixel_role"), sendCondition);
                continue;
            }

            String formula = (String) mapping.get("value_formula");
            double proxyValue;
            if ("monetaryValue".equals(formula) && monetaryValue != null) {
                proxyValue = monetaryValue;
            } else {
                proxyValue = valueFormulaService.computeValue(
                        tenant.getId(), formula, selfAccredited, ticketBucket);
            }

            String roleKey  = (String) mapping.get("pixel_role");
            String pixelId  = pixelRepo.findPixelIdByRole(tenant.getId(), roleKey).orElse(null);
            String accessToken = pixelRepo.findCapiTokenByRole(tenant.getId(), roleKey).orElse(null);

            String externalIdHash = lookupExternalIdHash(tenant.getId(), sessionId);
            String metaEventName  = (String) mapping.get("meta_event_name");

            Map<String, Object> payload = buildPayload(
                    metaEventName, email, phone, (float) proxyValue, clientEventId, externalIdHash);

            CAPIEventLog entry = new CAPIEventLog();
            entry.setTenantId(tenant.getId());
            entry.setSessionId(sessionId);
            entry.setEventName(metaEventName);
            entry.setEventId(clientEventId);
            entry.setPixelId(pixelId);
            entry.setProxyValue((float) proxyValue);
            entry.setGhlEventType(stageKey);
            entry.setGhlContactId(ghlContactId);
            entry.setPayload(toJson(payload));

            if (pixelId == null || accessToken == null) {
                entry.setStatus("PENDING");
                results.add(capiRepo.save(entry));
                log.info("CAPI v2 queued PENDING stage={} role={} tenant={}",
                        stageKey, roleKey, tenant.getId());
                continue;
            }

            results.add(sendToMeta(entry, pixelId, accessToken, payload));
        }
        return results;
    }

    /**
     * Evaluate a simple send_condition expression.
     * Supported: "self_accredited = true", "self_accredited = false", null/blank = always send.
     */
    static boolean evaluateCondition(String condition, Boolean selfAccredited) {
        if (condition == null || condition.isBlank()) return true;
        String cond = condition.trim().toLowerCase();
        if (cond.equals("self_accredited = true"))  return Boolean.TRUE.equals(selfAccredited);
        if (cond.equals("self_accredited = false")) return Boolean.FALSE.equals(selfAccredited);
        return true; // unknown condition → allow
    }
}
```

## D:/Marketing-AI/platform-api/src/main/java/com/marketingai/service/ChurnPenaltyService.java

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import com.marketingai.config.AppProperties;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.HttpEntity;
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * Delayed Churn Penalty (vision §6.7): retroactively penalise Thompson arms
 * whose sessions subsequently lost the deal in GHL.
 *
 * Attribution: sessions.deal_status='lost'
 *   → decision_log.session_id → chosen_variant_id + context_key
 *   → thompson_arms → arm_id
 *
 * Rules (§6.7):
 *   - min cohort size = 20 decisions for the arm before recalc
 *   - decay weight per lost session: exp(-0.02 * days_since_decision)
 *   - penalty cap: 30% of (α+β) per recalc (enforced in FastAPI)
 *   - force-close sessions after 90 days even if cohort never reached 20
 */
@Slf4j
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class ChurnPenaltyService {

    private static final int MIN_COHORT_SIZE    = 20;
    private static final int FORCE_CLOSE_DAYS   = 90;
    private static final double DECAY_LAMBDA    = 0.02; // λ per §6.7

    private final JdbcTemplate    jdbc;
    private final RestTemplate    restTemplate;
    private final AppProperties   appProperties;

    /**
     * Run one full churn penalty scan for all tenants.
     * Called daily by ChurnPenaltyScheduler.
     */
    public void runScan() {
        List<UUID> tenantIds = jdbc.queryForList(
                "SELECT id FROM tenants", UUID.class);
        for (UUID tenantId : tenantIds) {
            try {
                scanTenant(tenantId);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.error("Churn penalty scan failed for tenant {}: {}", tenantId, e.getMessage(), e);
            }
        }
    }

    private void scanTenant(UUID tenantId) {
        // Find unprocessed lost sessions with their arm attribution
        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbc.queryForList(
                """
                SELECT
                    s.id               AS session_id,
                    s.started_at,
                    dl.decided_at,
                    dl.chosen_variant_id::text AS variant_id,
                    COALESCE(dl.context->>'context_key', 'global') AS context_key,
                    ta.id::text        AS arm_id
                FROM   sessions s
                JOIN   decision_log dl
                    ON  dl.session_id = s.id
                    AND dl.tenant_id  = s.tenant_id
                JOIN   thompson_arms ta
                    ON  ta.variant_id  = dl.chosen_variant_id
                    AND ta.tenant_id   = s.tenant_id
                    AND ta.context_key = COALESCE(dl.context->>'context_key', 'global')
                WHERE  s.deal_status        = 'lost'
                  AND  s.churn_penalized_at IS NULL
                  AND  s.tenant_id          = ?
                ORDER BY dl.decided_at ASC
                """,
                tenantId
        );

        if (rows.isEmpty()) return;

        Instant now = Instant.now();

        // Group rows by arm_id + context_key
        record ArmKey(String armId, String contextKey) {}
        Map<ArmKey, List<Map<String, Object>>> byArm = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (Map<String, Object> row : rows) {
            ArmKey key = new ArmKey(
                    (String) row.get("arm_id"),
                    (String) row.get("context_key")
            );
            byArm.computeIfAbsent(key, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(row);
        }

        Set<String> sessionIdsToClose = new HashSet<>();

        for (Map.Entry<ArmKey, List<Map<String, Object>>> entry : byArm.entrySet()) {
            ArmKey key = entry.getKey();
            List<Map<String, Object>> armRows = entry.getValue();

            // Cohort size = total decisions ever made for this arm
            Integer cohortSize = jdbc.queryForObject(
                    """
                    SELECT COUNT(*)::int
                    FROM decision_log dl
                    JOIN thompson_arms ta
                        ON  ta.variant_id  = dl.chosen_variant_id
                        AND ta.tenant_id   = dl.tenant_id
                        AND ta.context_key = COALESCE(dl.context->>'context_key', 'global')
                        AND ta.id::text    = ?
                    WHERE dl.tenant_id = ?
                    """,
                    Integer.class,
                    key.armId(),
                    tenantId
            );
            if (cohortSize == null) cohortSize = 0;

            // Force-close sessions older than FORCE_CLOSE_DAYS to avoid endless retries
            boolean forceClose = armRows.stream().anyMatch(r -> {
                Instant decidedAt = toInstant(r.get("decided_at"));
                return decidedAt != null
                        && ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(decidedAt, now) > FORCE_CLOSE_DAYS;
            });

            if (cohortSize >= MIN_COHORT_SIZE) {
                double weightedSum = armRows.stream().mapToDouble(r -> {
                    Instant decidedAt = toInstant(r.get("decided_at"));
                    if (decidedAt == null) return 0.0;
                    double days = ChronoUnit.SECONDS.between(decidedAt, now) / 86400.0;
                    return Math.exp(-DECAY_LAMBDA * days);
                }).sum();

                callFastApiChurnPenalty(
                        tenantId.toString(),
                        key.armId(),
                        key.contextKey(),
                        cohortSize,
                        armRows.size(),
                        weightedSum
                );
                armRows.forEach(r -> sessionIdsToClose.add((String) r.get("session_id")));

            } else if (forceClose) {
                // Cohort too small even after 90 days — mark processed, skip penalty
                log.debug("Force-closing {} lost sessions for arm {} (cohort={} < {})",
                        armRows.size(), key.armId(), cohortSize, MIN_COHORT_SIZE);
                armRows.forEach(r -> sessionIdsToClose.add((String) r.get("session_id")));
            }
            // else: cohort still growing — leave unprocessed, retry tomorrow
        }

        if (!sessionIdsToClose.isEmpty()) {
            markSessionsProcessed(tenantId, sessionIdsToClose, now);
        }
    }

    private void callFastApiChurnPenalty(
            String tenantId, String armId, String contextKey,
            int cohortSize, int churnCount, double weightedSum) {
        String url = appProperties.getMlServiceUrl() + "/decide/churn-penalty";
        HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
        headers.setContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
        headers.set("X-Internal-API-Key", appProperties.getInternalApiKey());

        Map<String, Object> body = Map.of(
                "tenant_id",   tenantId,
                "arm_id",      armId,
                "context_key", contextKey,
                "cohort_size", cohortSize,
                "churn_count", churnCount,
                "weighted_sum", weightedSum
        );
        try {
            restTemplate.postForObject(url, new HttpEntity<>(body, headers), Map.class);
            log.info("Churn penalty applied: arm={} cohort={} churned={} weighted_sum={:.4f}",
                    armId, cohortSize, churnCount, weightedSum);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Churn penalty FastAPI call failed for arm {}: {}", armId, e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    private void markSessionsProcessed(UUID tenantId, Set<String> sessionIds, Instant now) {
        for (String sessionId : sessionIds) {
            jdbc.update(
                    "UPDATE sessions SET churn_penalized_at = ? WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ?",
                    now, sessionId, tenantId
            );
        }
    }

    private static Instant toInstant(Object val) {
        if (val instanceof Instant i)   return i;
        if (val instanceof java.sql.Timestamp ts) return ts.toInstant();
        return null;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import com.marketingai.config.AppProperties;
import com.marketingai.entity.*;
import com.marketingai.repository.*;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.OptionalDouble;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Financial Circuit Breaker — three-level protection system (vision §12.5a).
 *
 * L1 (per-creative): spend cap exceeded → pause ad set
 *   Already handled in GateEvaluationService. Here we check for L1→L2 cascade.
 *
 * L2 (per-campaign): Bayesian P(blended CPA > 1.5× target) > 0.85
 *   OR daily spend > 80% ceiling in first 8 hours
 *   OR CPM spike z-score > 3 vs 14-day rolling
 *   Action: throttle (pause new launches in TEST contour)
 *
 * L3 (per-account): P(ROAS < breakeven) > 0.90 for TEST or SCALE
 *   OR monthly budget ceiling reached
 *   Action: pause all active campaigns in the affected contour
 *
 * Cascade rules:
 *   3+ L1 in 24h → trigger L2
 *   L2 unresolved 48h → trigger L3
 */
@Slf4j
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class CircuitBreakerService {

    private static final double L2_CPA_PROB_THRESHOLD  = 0.85;
    private static final double L3_ROAS_PROB_THRESHOLD = 0.90;
    private static final double L2_SPEND_CEILING_PCT   = 0.80;
    private static final double L2_CPM_ZSCORE          = 3.0;
    private static final int    L1_CASCADE_COUNT        = 3;

    private final MetaCampaignRepository    campaignRepo;
    private final MetaAdSetRepository       adSetRepo;
    private final CircuitBreakerEventRepository cbRepo;
    private final CampaignCpmHistoryRepository  cpmRepo;
    private final TenantRepository          tenantRepo;
    private final MetaApiService            metaApi;
    private final AppProperties             props;
    private final AlertService              alertService;
    private final LearningPhaseService      learningPhaseService;
    private final org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate mlRestTemplate =
            new org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate();

    // ─── Main Entry Point ──────────────────────────────────────────────

    /**
     * Run full circuit breaker check for all active TEST campaigns of a tenant.
     * Called by CircuitBreakerScheduler every 30 minutes.
     */
    @Transactional
    public void checkAll(UUID tenantId) {
        List<MetaCampaign> campaigns = campaignRepo.findAllByTenantId(tenantId)
                .stream()
                .filter(c -> "ACTIVE".equals(c.getStatus()))
                .toList();

        for (MetaCampaign campaign : campaigns) {
            try {
                checkCampaign(tenantId, campaign);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.warn("CB check failed for campaign {}: {}", campaign.getId(), e.getMessage());
            }
        }

        // L1→L2 cascade: 3+ L1 in last 24h → trigger L2
        long l1Count = cbRepo.findByTenantIdAndLevelAndCreatedAtAfter(
                tenantId, "L1", Instant.now().minus(24, ChronoUnit.HOURS)).size();
        if (l1Count >= L1_CASCADE_COUNT) {
            boolean l2Active = cbRepo.findByTenantIdAndResolvedAtIsNull(tenantId)
                    .stream().anyMatch(e -> "L2".equals(e.getLevel()));
            if (!l2Active) {
                triggerL2(tenantId, campaigns,
                        String.format("Cascade: %d L1 events in last 24h (≥%d threshold)", l1Count, L1_CASCADE_COUNT),
                        null);
            }
        }

        // L2→L3 cascade: unresolved L2 older than 48h → trigger L3
        cbRepo.findByTenantIdAndResolvedAtIsNull(tenantId).stream()
                .filter(e -> "L2".equals(e.getLevel()))
                .filter(e -> e.getCreatedAt().isBefore(Instant.now().minus(48, ChronoUnit.HOURS)))
                .findFirst()
                .ifPresent(staleL2 -> {
                    boolean l3Active = cbRepo.findByTenantIdAndResolvedAtIsNull(tenantId)
                            .stream().anyMatch(ev -> "L3".equals(ev.getLevel()));
                    if (!l3Active) {
                        triggerL3(tenantId, campaigns, "all",
                                "Cascade: L2 unresolved for >48h", null);
                    }
                });
    }

    // ─── Campaign-Level Check ──────────────────────────────────────────

    private void checkCampaign(UUID tenantId, MetaCampaign campaign) {
        List<MetaAdSet> adSets = adSetRepo.findAllByCampaignId(campaign.getId())
                .stream()
                .filter(a -> "ACTIVE".equals(a.getStatus()))
                .toList();
        if (adSets.isEmpty()) return;

        float totalSpend = (float) adSets.stream()
                .mapToDouble(a -> a.getSpendToday() != null ? a.getSpendToday() : 0f)
                .sum();
        float totalClicks = (float) adSets.stream()
                .mapToDouble(a -> a.getClicksTotal() != null ? a.getClicksTotal() : 0f)
                .sum();
        float totalConversions = (float) adSets.stream()
                .mapToDouble(a -> a.getConversionsTotal() != null ? a.getConversionsTotal() : 0f)
                .sum();
        long totalImpressions = adSets.stream()
                .mapToLong(a -> a.getImpressionsTotal() != null ? a.getImpressionsTotal() : 0L)
                .sum();

        // ── L1 Bayesian check: P(CPA > 2× target) > 0.90 (vision §12.5a)
        if (campaign.getTargetCpa() != null && campaign.getTargetCpa() > 0) {
            boolean l1Bay = checkL1Bayesian(totalSpend, (int) totalClicks, (int) totalConversions,
                    campaign.getTargetCpa());
            if (l1Bay) {
                String reason = String.format(
                        "L1 Bayesian: P(CPA > 2×target) > 0.90 (spend=%.2f, clicks=%.0f, conversions=%.0f, target=%.2f)",
                        totalSpend, totalClicks, totalConversions, campaign.getTargetCpa());
                log.warn("🟠 L1 Bayesian CB triggered — tenant={} reason={}", tenantId, reason);
                recordEvent(tenantId, "L1", reason, null, campaign.getContour(), "PAUSE_AD_SET");
                sendAlertMsg(tenantId, "🟠 L1 Bayesian Circuit Breaker", reason);
                return;
            }
        }

        // ── L2 check 1: Bayesian P(blended CPA > 1.5× target) > 0.85
        if (campaign.getTargetCpa() != null && campaign.getTargetCpa() > 0 && totalConversions > 0) {
            float blendedCpa = totalSpend / totalConversions;
            float target15x = campaign.getTargetCpa() * 1.5f;
            // Model CPA as Gamma posterior (rough approximation): if blended > 1.5× target
            // Use a simple Bayesian bound: P(true_CPA > threshold) given observed data
            double pCpaTooHigh = bayesianProbCpaTooHigh(totalSpend, totalConversions, target15x);
            if (pCpaTooHigh > L2_CPA_PROB_THRESHOLD) {
                triggerL2(tenantId, List.of(campaign),
                        String.format("L2: P(CPA > 1.5×target)=%.2f%% > 85%% (blended CPA=%.2f, target=%.2f)",
                                pCpaTooHigh * 100, blendedCpa, campaign.getTargetCpa()),
                        pCpaTooHigh);
                return;
            }
        }

        // ── L2 check 2: Daily spend > 80% ceiling in first 8 hours
        if (campaign.getDailyBudget() != null && campaign.getDailyBudget() > 0) {
            double ceilingPct = totalSpend / campaign.getDailyBudget();
            // Check if we're in the first 8 hours — heuristic: syncedAt within 8h of midnight
            // Simplified: just check absolute ratio; scheduler runs every 30min so early-day signals come through
            if (ceilingPct > L2_SPEND_CEILING_PCT && isEarlyInDay()) {
                triggerL2(tenantId, List.of(campaign),
                        String.format("L2: Spend %.0f%% of daily ceiling within first 8h (spent=%.2f, ceiling=%.2f)",
                                ceilingPct * 100, totalSpend, campaign.getDailyBudget()),
                        null);
                return;
            }
        }

        // ── L2 check 3: CPM spike z-score > 3
        if (totalImpressions > 0 && totalSpend > 0) {
            float currentCpm = (totalSpend / totalImpressions) * 1000f;
            recordCpm(campaign.getId(), currentCpm);
            double zScore = computeCpmZScore(campaign.getId(), currentCpm);
            if (zScore > L2_CPM_ZSCORE) {
                triggerL2(tenantId, List.of(campaign),
                        String.format("L2: CPM spike z-score=%.2f > 3.0 (CPM=%.2f)", zScore, currentCpm),
                        null);
                return;
            }
        }

        // ── L3 check: P(ROAS < breakeven) > 0.90
        if (campaign.getBreakevenRoas() != null && campaign.getBreakevenRoas() > 0
                && totalConversions > 0 && totalSpend > 0) {
            // ROAS = revenue / spend; we approximate revenue as conversions × avg_order_value
            // Without AOV data, use CPA-based proxy: if CPA > 1/ROAS_breakeven × assumed_AOV
            // Simplified: check if spend is consistently outpacing conversions
            double pRoasBad = bayesianProbRoasBelowBreakeven(
                    totalSpend, totalConversions, campaign.getBreakevenRoas());
            if (pRoasBad > L3_ROAS_PROB_THRESHOLD) {
                triggerL3(tenantId, List.of(campaign), campaign.getContour(),
                        String.format("L3: P(ROAS < breakeven)=%.2f%% > 90%% (contour=%s)",
                                pRoasBad * 100, campaign.getContour()),
                        pRoasBad);
            }
        }

        // ── L3 check: monthly budget ceiling reached
        if (campaign.getMonthlyCeilingBudget() != null && campaign.getMonthlyCeilingBudget() > 0) {
            float monthSpend = (float) adSets.stream()
                    .mapToDouble(a -> a.getSpendTotal() != null ? a.getSpendTotal() : 0f)
                    .sum();
            if (monthSpend >= campaign.getMonthlyCeilingBudget()) {
                triggerL3(tenantId, List.of(campaign), campaign.getContour(),
                        String.format("L3: Monthly budget ceiling reached (spent=%.2f, ceiling=%.2f)",
                                monthSpend, campaign.getMonthlyCeilingBudget()),
                        null);
            }
        }
    }

    // ─── L2 Action: Throttle TEST contour ─────────────────────────────

    @Transactional
    public void triggerL2(UUID tenantId, List<MetaCampaign> campaigns, String reason, Double pValue) {
        // Check if already active
        boolean already = cbRepo.findByTenantIdAndResolvedAtIsNull(tenantId)
                .stream().anyMatch(e -> "L2".equals(e.getLevel()));
        if (already) return;

        log.warn("🟡 CIRCUIT BREAKER L2 — tenant={} reason={}", tenantId, reason);

        // Action: pause new test launches (pause GATE_1 ad sets that aren't ACTIVE yet)
        campaigns.stream()
                .filter(c -> "TEST".equals(c.getContour()))
                .forEach(c -> adSetRepo.findAllByCampaignIdAndStatus(c.getId(), "PAUSED")
                        .stream()
                        .filter(a -> "GATE_1".equals(a.getGateStatus()))
                        .forEach(a -> log.info("L2 throttle: holding back PAUSED GATE_1 adSet={}", a.getId()))
                );
        // Note: we don't pause ACTIVE ad sets at L2 — only throttle NEW launches

        recordEvent(tenantId, "L2", reason, pValue, "TEST", "THROTTLE_TEST");
        sendAlertMsg(tenantId, "🟡 L2 Circuit Breaker", reason);
    }

    // ─── L3 Action: Auto-pause ─────────────────────────────────────────

    @Transactional
    public void triggerL3(UUID tenantId, List<MetaCampaign> campaigns, String contour, String reason, Double pValue) {
        boolean already = cbRepo.findByTenantIdAndResolvedAtIsNull(tenantId)
                .stream().anyMatch(e -> "L3".equals(e.getLevel()));
        if (already) return;

        log.error("🔴 CIRCUIT BREAKER L3 — tenant={} contour={} reason={}", tenantId, contour, reason);

        Tenant tenant = tenantRepo.findById(tenantId).orElse(null);
        String token = tenant != null && tenant.getMetaAccessTokenEnc() != null
                ? new String(tenant.getMetaAccessTokenEnc(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8) : null;

        String action = "all".equals(contour) ? "PAUSE_ALL"
                : "SCALE".equals(contour) ? "PAUSE_SCALE" : "PAUSE_ALL";

        campaigns.stream()
                .filter(c -> "all".equals(contour) || contour.equals(c.getContour()))
                .filter(c -> "ACTIVE".equals(c.getStatus()))
                .forEach(c -> {
                    if (token != null) {
                        try {
                            metaApi.setCampaignStatus(token, c.getMetaCampaignId(), "PAUSED");
                        } catch (Exception e) {
                            log.error("L3: failed to pause campaign {}: {}", c.getId(), e.getMessage());
                        }
                    }
                    c.setStatus("PAUSED");
                    campaignRepo.save(c);
                    log.warn("L3: paused campaign {} ({})", c.getId(), c.getContour());

                    // Log learning phase before L3 PAUSE for all active ad sets
                    adSetRepo.findAllByCampaignIdAndStatus(c.getId(), "ACTIVE")
                            .forEach(a -> learningPhaseService.logBeforeAction(
                                    tenantId, a.getMetaAdSetId(), "PAUSE", a.getLearningPhase()));
                });

        recordEvent(tenantId, "L3", reason, pValue, contour, action);
        sendAlertMsg(tenantId, "🔴 L3 Circuit Breaker — AUTO-PAUSE", reason);
    }

    // ─── Resolution ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Transactional
    public void resolveEvent(UUID tenantId, UUID eventId, String resolvedBy) {
        cbRepo.findById(eventId).ifPresent(event -> {
            if (!event.getTenantId().equals(tenantId)) return;
            event.setResolvedAt(Instant.now());
            event.setResolvedBy(resolvedBy);
            cbRepo.save(event);
            log.info("CB event {} resolved by {}", eventId, resolvedBy);
        });
    }

    // ─── Bayesian helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────

    /**
     * P(true CPA > threshold) using Gamma-Poisson model.
     * Observed: conversions ~ Poisson(spend × rate).
     * Posterior rate ~ Gamma(conversions + 1, spend + 1) (exponential prior).
     * CPA = 1/rate → if rate < 1/threshold → CPA > threshold.
     * P(CPA > threshold) = P(rate < 1/threshold) = CDF of Gamma at 1/threshold.
     */
    static double bayesianProbCpaTooHigh(float spend, float conversions, float targetCpa) {
        // Simple approximation: use normal approximation of Gamma CDF
        double alpha = conversions + 1.0;
        double beta  = spend + 1.0;
        double meanRate = alpha / beta;
        double threshold = 1.0 / targetCpa;
        if (meanRate < threshold) {
            // Rate is already below threshold (CPA already above target) — estimate probability
            double cv = 1.0 / Math.sqrt(alpha); // coefficient of variation of Gamma
            double z = (threshold - meanRate) / (meanRate * cv);
            return 0.5 + 0.5 * erf(z / Math.sqrt(2));
        }
        return 0.0; // CPA is fine
    }

    /**
     * P(ROAS < breakeven) using Beta posterior on conversion rate.
     * ROAS proxy = conversions × avgOrderValue / spend.
     * Without AOV data, use conversion rate as proxy: P(CVR < cvr_breakeven).
     */
    static double bayesianProbRoasBelowBreakeven(float spend, float conversions, float breakevenRoas) {
        // Proxy: if breakevenRoas = target_rev/spend, then target_conversions = breakevenRoas × spend / aov
        // Without AOV, use relative threshold: kill if CVR is very low
        // Simplified: CVR = conversions / (spend × 10) as rough proxy with spend as "clicks"
        double observedRate = conversions / (spend + 1.0);
        double threshold = breakevenRoas / 100.0; // breakeven rate approximation
        if (observedRate < threshold) {
            double z = (threshold - observedRate) / Math.sqrt(observedRate * (1 - observedRate) / (spend + 1));
            return 0.5 + 0.5 * erf(Math.min(z, 5) / Math.sqrt(2));
        }
        return 0.0;
    }

    /**
     * Calls FastAPI /cb/l1-check to compute P(CPA > 2× target | data).
     * Returns true if Bayesian trigger fires (should_pause = true via Bayesian path).
     * Falls back gracefully: on any error returns false (no false positives).
     */
    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    boolean checkL1Bayesian(float spend, int clicks, int conversions, float targetCpa) {
        String mlUrl = props.getMlServiceUrl();
        if (mlUrl == null || mlUrl.isBlank()) return false;
        try {
            java.util.Map<String, Object> req = java.util.Map.of(
                    "spend",       (double) spend,
                    "spend_limit", Double.MAX_VALUE,  // only checking Bayesian trigger here
                    "clicks",      clicks,
                    "conversions", conversions,
                    "target_cpa",  (double) targetCpa,
                    "cpa_multiplier", 2.0
            );
            java.util.Map<String, Object> resp = mlRestTemplate.postForObject(
                    mlUrl + "/cb/l1-check", req, java.util.Map.class);
            if (resp == null) return false;
            Object bt = resp.get("bayesian_trigger");
            return Boolean.TRUE.equals(bt);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.debug("L1 Bayesian check ML call failed (non-blocking): {}", e.getMessage());
            return false;
        }
    }

    /** Error function approximation (Abramowitz & Stegun 7.1.26) */
    static double erf(double x) {
        double t = 1.0 / (1.0 + 0.3275911 * Math.abs(x));
        double poly = t * (0.254829592 + t * (-0.284496736 + t * (1.421413741
                + t * (-1.453152027 + t * 1.061405429))));
        double result = 1.0 - poly * Math.exp(-x * x);
        return x >= 0 ? result : -result;
    }

    // ─── CPM Spike Detection ───────────────────────────────────────────

    private void recordCpm(UUID campaignId, float cpm) {
        CampaignCpmHistory h = new CampaignCpmHistory();
        h.setCampaignId(campaignId);
        h.setRecordedAt(Instant.now());
        h.setCpm(cpm);
        cpmRepo.save(h);
    }

    private double computeCpmZScore(UUID campaignId, float currentCpm) {
        List<CampaignCpmHistory> history = cpmRepo
                .findByCampaignIdAndRecordedAtAfterOrderByRecordedAtDesc(
                        campaignId, Instant.now().minus(14, ChronoUnit.DAYS));
        if (history.size() < 5) return 0.0; // not enough history

        double[] values = history.stream().mapToDouble(h -> h.getCpm()).toArray();
        double mean = 0, variance = 0;
        for (double v : values) mean += v;
        mean /= values.length;
        for (double v : values) variance += (v - mean) * (v - mean);
        double stddev = Math.sqrt(variance / values.length);
        return stddev < 0.001 ? 0.0 : (currentCpm - mean) / stddev;
    }

    // ─── Internal helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────

    private boolean isEarlyInDay() {
        java.time.LocalTime now = java.time.LocalTime.now(java.time.ZoneOffset.UTC);
        return now.getHour() < 8;
    }

    /** Called by PixelPollutionService to surface drift as an L2 CB event. */
    public void createPixelPollutionEvent(UUID tenantId, String campaign, String description) {
        recordEvent(tenantId, "L2",
                "PIXEL_POLLUTION_DRIFT" + (campaign != null ? " campaign=" + campaign : ""),
                null, "TEST", description);
    }

    private void recordEvent(UUID tenantId, String level, String reason, Double pValue,
                             String contour, String action) {
        CircuitBreakerEvent event = new CircuitBreakerEvent();
        event.setTenantId(tenantId);
        event.setLevel(level);
        event.setTriggerReason(reason);
        event.setBayesianProb(pValue != null ? pValue.floatValue() : null);
        event.setContour(contour);
        event.setActionTaken(action);
        cbRepo.save(event);
    }

    private void sendAlertMsg(UUID tenantId, String title, String reason) {
        try {
            String msg = title + "\n\nTenant: " + tenantId + "\nReason: " + reason
                    + "\n\nCheck admin panel to resolve.";
            alertService.sendAlert(msg);
            log.info("CB alert sent: {}", title);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.warn("Failed to send CB alert: {}", e.getMessage());
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import com.marketingai.config.AppProperties;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.*;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.util.UriComponentsBuilder;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * Reactive Competitive Intelligence (vision §9.1).
 *
 * Pipeline per tenant:
 *   1. Read competitor_page_ids from tenants.settings JSONB
 *   2. Poll Meta Ad Library API for ads running > 14 days on those pages
 *   3. For each new/updated ad: call ml-service /competitive/extract-atoms (Claude LLM)
 *   4. Group into an alert with counter-hypotheses
 *   5. Notify via Telegram — marketer approves in admin panel
 *
 * ⚠️ Auto-deploy WITHOUT human approval is FORBIDDEN (vision §9.1).
 *    Approved alerts are surfaced to the test-batch workflow only after
 *    POST /competitive-intel/{id}/approve by an authenticated user.
 */
@Slf4j
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class CompetitiveIntelligenceService {

    private static final int    MIN_RUN_DAYS     = 14;
    private static final String META_API_VERSION = "v19.0";
    private static final String META_AD_ARCHIVE  = "https://graph.facebook.com/%s/ads_archive";

    private final JdbcTemplate               jdbc;
    private final RestTemplate               restTemplate;
    private final AppProperties              appProperties;
    private final AlertService alertService;
    private static final ObjectMapper        MAPPER = new ObjectMapper();

    public void runWeeklyScan() {
        List<Map<String, Object>> tenants = jdbc.queryForList(
                "SELECT id::text AS id, settings, meta_access_token_enc FROM tenants");
        for (Map<String, Object> row : tenants) {
            String tenantId = (String) row.get("id");
            try {
                scanTenant(tenantId, (String) row.get("settings"));
            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.error("Competitive intel scan failed for tenant {}: {}", tenantId, e.getMessage(), e);
            }
        }
    }

    private void scanTenant(String tenantId, String settingsJson) throws Exception {
        List<String> pageIds = extractCompetitorPageIds(settingsJson);
        if (pageIds.isEmpty()) {
            log.debug("No competitor_page_ids configured for tenant {}", tenantId);
            return;
        }

        String accessToken = getMetaAccessToken(tenantId);
        if (accessToken == null || accessToken.isBlank()) {
            log.debug("No Meta access token for tenant {} — skipping CI scan", tenantId);
            return;
        }

        List<Map<String, Object>> longRunningAds = fetchAdLibrary(pageIds, accessToken);
        if (longRunningAds.isEmpty()) return;

        List<String> newAdIds = new ArrayList<>();
        List<String> pageNames = new ArrayList<>();

        for (Map<String, Object> ad : longRunningAds) {
            String metaAdId  = str(ad.get("id"));
            String pageId    = str(ad.get("page_id"));
            String pageName  = str(ad.get("page_name"));
            String adTitle   = str(ad.get("ad_creative_link_title"));
            String adBody    = str(ad.get("ad_creative_body"));
            String snapUrl   = str(ad.get("ad_snapshot_url"));
            int    runDays   = computeRunDays(str(ad.get("ad_delivery_start_time")));

            if (runDays < MIN_RUN_DAYS) continue;

            // Extract atoms via ml-service LLM
            Map<String, Object> atomResult = extractAtoms(tenantId, adTitle, adBody, pageName, runDays);
            String atomsJson = MAPPER.writeValueAsString(atomResult.getOrDefault("atoms", Map.of()));
            String countersJson = MAPPER.writeValueAsString(atomResult.getOrDefault("counter_hypotheses", List.of()));

            // Upsert into competitor_ads
            Integer updated = jdbc.queryForObject(
                    """
                    INSERT INTO competitor_ads
                        (tenant_id, meta_ad_id, page_id, page_name, ad_title, ad_body,
                         snapshot_url, running_since, run_days, atoms_extracted, last_seen_at)
                    VALUES (?::uuid, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, CURRENT_DATE - ?::int, ?, ?::jsonb, now())
                    ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, meta_ad_id) DO UPDATE SET
                        run_days       = EXCLUDED.run_days,
                        atoms_extracted = EXCLUDED.atoms_extracted,
                        last_seen_at   = now()
                    RETURNING (xmax = 0)::int AS is_new
                    """,
                    Integer.class,
                    tenantId, metaAdId, pageId, pageName, adTitle, adBody,
                    snapUrl, runDays, runDays, atomsJson
            );

            if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(updated != null && updated == 1)) {
                newAdIds.add(uuid(tenantId, metaAdId));
                if (pageName != null && !pageNames.contains(pageName)) pageNames.add(pageName);

                // Create per-ad alert with counter-hypotheses
                createAlert(tenantId, metaAdId, countersJson);

                // Block F §4: insert COMPETITOR signal into external_signals
                // so diagnostics and GLM can treat competitor activity as a covariate
                insertCompetitorSignal(tenantId, metaAdId, pageName, runDays, atomsJson);
            }
        }

        if (!newAdIds.isEmpty()) {
            alertService.sendAlert(String.format(
                    "🕵️ Competitive Intelligence Alert — Tenant: %s\n\nDetected %d competitor ad(s) running >14 days from: %s\n\nCounter-hypotheses generated. Login to approve the test batch.",
                    tenantId, newAdIds.size(), String.join(", ", pageNames)));
            log.info("Competitive intel: {} new ads for tenant {}", newAdIds.size(), tenantId);
        }
    }

    // ─── Meta Ad Library API ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private List<Map<String, Object>> fetchAdLibrary(List<String> pageIds, String accessToken) {
        String minDate = LocalDate.now().minusDays(MIN_RUN_DAYS)
                .format(DateTimeFormatter.ISO_LOCAL_DATE);

        String url = UriComponentsBuilder
                .fromHttpUrl(String.format(META_AD_ARCHIVE, META_API_VERSION))
                .queryParam("ad_active_status",       "ACTIVE")
                .queryParam("ad_delivery_date_min",   minDate)
                .queryParam("search_page_ids",        String.join(",", pageIds))
                .queryParam("fields",
                        "id,ad_creative_body,ad_creative_link_title,ad_snapshot_url," +
                        "page_name,page_id,ad_delivery_start_time")
                .queryParam("access_token", accessToken)
                .queryParam("limit", "50")
                .toUriString();

        try {
            @SuppressWarnings("rawtypes")
            Map response = restTemplate.getForObject(url, Map.class);
            if (response == null) return List.of();
            Object data = response.get("data");
            return data instanceof List ? (List<Map<String, Object>>) data : List.of();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Ad Library API call failed: {}", e.getMessage());
            return List.of();
        }
    }

    // ─── ml-service LLM atom extraction ──────────────────────────────────────

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private Map<String, Object> extractAtoms(String tenantId, String title, String body,
                                              String pageName, int runDays) {
        String url = appProperties.getMlServiceUrl() + "/competitive/extract-atoms";
        HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
        headers.setContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
        headers.set("X-Internal-API-Key", appProperties.getInternalApiKey());

        Map<String, Object> reqBody = new HashMap<>();
        reqBody.put("ad_title",  title);
        reqBody.put("ad_body",   body);
        reqBody.put("page_name", pageName);
        reqBody.put("run_days",  runDays);

        try {
            Map<?, ?> result = restTemplate.postForObject(
                    url, new HttpEntity<>(reqBody, headers), Map.class);
            return result != null ? (Map<String, Object>) result : Map.of();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.warn("Atom extraction failed for ad (title={}): {}", title, e.getMessage());
            return Map.of();
        }
    }

    private void createAlert(String tenantId, String metaAdId, String countersJson) {
        try {
            jdbc.update(
                    """
                    INSERT INTO competitive_intel_alerts
                        (tenant_id, competitor_ad_ids, counter_hypotheses)
                    SELECT ?::uuid,
                           ARRAY[ca.id],
                           ?::jsonb
                    FROM   competitor_ads ca
                    WHERE  ca.tenant_id  = ?::uuid
                      AND  ca.meta_ad_id = ?
                    """,
                    tenantId, countersJson, tenantId, metaAdId
            );
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Failed to create CI alert: {}", e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    /**
     * Block F §4: Write COMPETITOR signal into external_signals so diagnostics and
     * GLM models can treat competitor ad activity as a covariate (vision §9.1).
     * signal_date = today; value = run_days (proxy for competitive pressure intensity).
     */
    private void insertCompetitorSignal(String tenantId, String metaAdId, String pageName,
                                        int runDays, String atomsJson) {
        try {
            String description = String.format("Competitor ad (page: %s, meta_ad_id: %s) running %d days. Atoms: %s",
                    pageName, metaAdId, runDays, atomsJson);
            jdbc.update(
                """
                INSERT INTO external_signals
                    (tenant_id, signal_type, signal_date, value, description)
                VALUES (?::uuid, 'COMPETITOR', CURRENT_DATE, ?, ?)
                ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, signal_type, signal_date)
                DO UPDATE SET value = GREATEST(external_signals.value, EXCLUDED.value),
                              description = EXCLUDED.description
                """,
                tenantId, (double) runDays, description);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.warn("Failed to insert COMPETITOR external signal: {}", e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    // ─── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private List<String> extractCompetitorPageIds(String settingsJson) {
        if (settingsJson == null || settingsJson.isBlank()) return List.of();
        try {
            JsonNode root = MAPPER.readTree(settingsJson);
            JsonNode ids = root.get("competitor_page_ids");
            if (ids == null || !ids.isArray()) return List.of();
            List<String> result = new ArrayList<>();
            ids.forEach(n -> result.add(n.asText()));
            return result;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return List.of();
        }
    }

    private String getMetaAccessToken(String tenantId) {
        try {
            // meta_access_token_enc is stored as bytea — for now use plaintext fallback
            return jdbc.queryForObject(
                    "SELECT ENCODE(meta_access_token_enc, 'escape') FROM tenants WHERE id = ?::uuid",
                    String.class, tenantId);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private static int computeRunDays(String startDate) {
        if (startDate == null || startDate.isBlank()) return 0;
        try {
            LocalDate start = LocalDate.parse(startDate.substring(0, 10));
            return (int) java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(start, LocalDate.now());
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return 0;
        }
    }

    private static String str(Object v) { return v == null ? null : v.toString(); }

    private static String uuid(String tenantId, String metaAdId) {
        return tenantId + ":" + metaAdId;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonProcessingException;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import com.marketingai.config.AppProperties;
import com.marketingai.entity.ComplianceCheck;
import com.marketingai.repository.ComplianceCheckRepository;
import com.marketingai.repository.ProductFactRepository;
import com.marketingai.security.TenantContext;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.HttpEntity;
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.UUID;

@Slf4j
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Transactional
public class ComplianceService {

    private final ComplianceCheckRepository repo;
    private final ProductFactRepository factRepo;
    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private final RestTemplate restTemplate;
    private final AppProperties appProperties;
    private final ObjectMapper objectMapper;

    public ComplianceCheck runTextCheck(String entityType, UUID entityId, String text) {
        UUID tenantId = UUID.fromString(TenantContext.get());

        List<String> facts = factRepo.findByTenantIdOrderByCreatedAtDesc(tenantId)
                .stream().map(f -> f.getFact()).toList();

        Map<String, Object> body = new HashMap<>();
        body.put("text", text);
        body.put("product_facts", facts);
        List<String> trademarks = jdbc.queryForList(
                "SELECT term FROM trademark_watchlist ORDER BY term", String.class);
        body.put("trademark_terms", trademarks);

        HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
        headers.setContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
        headers.set("X-Internal-API-Key", appProperties.getInternalApiKey());

        ComplianceCheck check = new ComplianceCheck();
        check.setTenantId(tenantId);
        check.setEntityType(entityType);
        check.setEntityId(entityId);
        check.setCheckType("META_POLICY");

        try {
            String url = appProperties.getMlServiceUrl() + "/compliance/check-text";
            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
            Map<String, Object> response = restTemplate.postForObject(
                    url, new HttpEntity<>(body, headers), Map.class);

            if (response != null) {
                String result = (String) response.getOrDefault("result", "WARN");
                check.setResult(result);
                check.setFindings(objectMapper.writeValueAsString(response.get("findings")));
                check.setModelVersion("ml-service");
            } else {
                check.setResult("WARN");
                check.setFindings("[]");
            }
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            log.warn("ml-service compliance check failed for entity {}: {}", entityId, ex.getMessage());
            check.setResult("WARN");
            check.setFindings("[]");
        }

        return repo.save(check);
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<ComplianceCheck> getChecks(UUID entityId) {
        UUID tenantId = UUID.fromString(TenantContext.get());
        return repo.findByTenantIdAndEntityIdOrderByCreatedAtDesc(tenantId, entityId);
    }

    public ComplianceCheck override(UUID checkId, UUID overriderId, String reason) {
        UUID tenantId = UUID.fromString(TenantContext.get());
        ComplianceCheck check = repo.findById(checkId)
                .filter(c -> c.getTenantId().equals(tenantId))
                .orElseThrow(() -> new org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException(
                        org.springframework.http.HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND));
        check.setOverriddenBy(overriderId);
        check.setOverrideReason(reason);
        return repo.save(check);
    }

    /**
     * Returns true if the latest compliance check for an entity is PASS or has been overridden.
     * Used by VariantService.approveVariant() compliance gate.
     */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public boolean isCompliant(UUID entityId) {
        UUID tenantId = UUID.fromString(TenantContext.get());
        Optional<ComplianceCheck> latest = repo.findLatestByEntityId(tenantId, entityId);
        if (latest.isEmpty()) return false;
        ComplianceCheck c = latest.get();
        return "PASS".equals(c.getResult()) || c.getOverriddenBy() != null;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import com.marketingai.dto.creative.CreativeAtomResponse;
import com.marketingai.dto.creative.CreativeResponse;
import com.marketingai.dto.creative.UpdateAtomRequest;
import com.marketingai.entity.Creative;
import com.marketingai.entity.CreativeAtom;
import com.marketingai.repository.CreativeAtomRepository;
import com.marketingai.repository.CreativeRepository;
import com.marketingai.security.TenantContext;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class CreativeService {

    private final CreativeRepository creativeRepository;
    private final CreativeAtomRepository atomRepository;
    private final StorageService storageService;
    private final MlServiceClient mlServiceClient;

    // ─── List ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    public List<CreativeResponse> list(String typeFilter) {
        UUID tenantId = tenantId();
        List<Creative> creatives = (typeFilter != null && !typeFilter.isBlank())
                ? creativeRepository.findByTenantIdAndTypeAndStatusNotOrderByCreatedAtDesc(tenantId, typeFilter.toUpperCase(), "ARCHIVED")
                : creativeRepository.findByTenantIdAndStatusNotOrderByCreatedAtDesc(tenantId, "ARCHIVED");
        return creatives.stream().map(c -> toResponse(c, false)).toList();
    }

    // ─── Detail ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    public CreativeResponse get(UUID id) {
        Creative creative = findOrThrow(id);
        List<CreativeAtomResponse> atoms = atomRepository
                .findByCreativeIdOrderByAtomTypeAscCreatedAtAsc(id)
                .stream().map(this::toAtomResponse).toList();
        return toResponse(creative, true, atoms);
    }

    // ─── Create ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Transactional
    public CreativeResponse create(String type, String title, String externalId,
                                   String metaAdSetId, String fileUrl, MultipartFile file) {
        UUID tenantId = tenantId();

        Creative creative = new Creative();
        creative.setTenantId(tenantId);
        creative.setType(type.toUpperCase());
        creative.setTitle(title);
        creative.setExternalId(externalId);
        creative.setMetaAdSetId(metaAdSetId);
        creative.setStatus("UPLOADED");
        creative = creativeRepository.save(creative);

        // Store uploaded file if provided
        if (file != null && !file.isEmpty()) {
            try {
                String storedUrl = storageService.store(tenantId, creative.getId(),
                        file.getOriginalFilename(), file.getBytes());
                creative.setFileUrl(storedUrl);
            } catch (IOException e) {
                throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, "Failed to store file");
            }
        } else if (fileUrl != null && !fileUrl.isBlank()) {
            creative.setFileUrl(fileUrl);
        }

        creative = creativeRepository.save(creative);
        return toResponse(creative, false);
    }

    // ─── Update metadata ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Transactional
    public CreativeResponse update(UUID id, String title, String externalId,
                                   String metaAdSetId, String transcript, Float durationSec) {
        Creative creative = findOrThrow(id);
        if (title != null) creative.setTitle(title);
        if (externalId != null) creative.setExternalId(externalId);
        if (metaAdSetId != null) creative.setMetaAdSetId(metaAdSetId);
        if (transcript != null) creative.setTranscript(transcript);
        if (durationSec != null) creative.setDurationSec(durationSec);
        return toResponse(creativeRepository.save(creative), false);
    }

    // ─── Toggle anchor ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Transactional
    public CreativeResponse toggleAnchor(UUID id) {
        Creative creative = findOrThrow(id);
        creative.setAnchor(!creative.isAnchor());
        return toResponse(creativeRepository.save(creative), false);
    }

    // ─── Archive ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Transactional
    public void archive(UUID id) {
        Creative creative = findOrThrow(id);
        creative.setStatus("ARCHIVED");
        creativeRepository.save(creative);
    }

    // ─── Trigger analysis ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Transactional
    public String triggerAnalysis(UUID id) {
        Creative creative = findOrThrow(id);
        if (creative.getFileUrl() == null && creative.getThumbnailUrl() == null) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "Creative has no file to analyze");
        }
        creative.setStatus("ANALYZING");
        creativeRepository.save(creative);

        String jobId = mlServiceClient.analyzeCreative(
                creative.getTenantId(),
                creative.getId(),
                creative.getType(),
                creative.getFileUrl(),
                creative.getThumbnailUrl(),
                creative.getTranscript(),
                creative.getDurationSec()
        );

        if (jobId == null) {
            // ml-service unreachable — revert status so the user can retry
            creative.setStatus("UPLOADED");
            creativeRepository.save(creative);
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, "Analysis service is unavailable");
        }

        return jobId;
    }

    // ─── Manual atom management ──────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Transactional
    public CreativeAtomResponse addAtom(UUID creativeId, UpdateAtomRequest req) {
        findOrThrow(creativeId); // verify ownership
        UUID tenantId = tenantId();
        CreativeAtom atom = new CreativeAtom();
        atom.setCreativeId(creativeId);
        atom.setTenantId(tenantId);
        atom.setAtomType(req.getAtomType().toUpperCase());
        atom.setAtomValue(req.getAtomValue());
        atom.setConfidence(req.getConfidence());
        atom.setExtractedBy("manual");
        return toAtomResponse(atomRepository.save(atom));
    }

    @Transactional
    public CreativeAtomResponse updateAtom(UUID creativeId, UUID atomId, UpdateAtomRequest req) {
        findOrThrow(creativeId);
        CreativeAtom atom = atomRepository.findByIdAndTenantId(atomId, tenantId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Atom not found"));
        atom.setAtomType(req.getAtomType().toUpperCase());
        atom.setAtomValue(req.getAtomValue());
        atom.setConfidence(req.getConfidence());
        atom.setExtractedBy("manual");
        return toAtomResponse(atomRepository.save(atom));
    }

    @Transactional
    public void deleteAtom(UUID creativeId, UUID atomId) {
        findOrThrow(creativeId);
        CreativeAtom atom = atomRepository.findByIdAndTenantId(atomId, tenantId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Atom not found"));
        atomRepository.delete(atom);
    }

    // ─── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private Creative findOrThrow(UUID id) {
        return creativeRepository.findByIdAndTenantId(id, tenantId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Creative not found"));
    }

    private UUID tenantId() {
        return UUID.fromString(TenantContext.get());
    }

    private CreativeResponse toResponse(Creative c, boolean withAtoms) {
        return toResponse(c, withAtoms, withAtoms
                ? atomRepository.findByCreativeIdOrderByAtomTypeAscCreatedAtAsc(c.getId())
                        .stream().map(this::toAtomResponse).toList()
                : null);
    }

    private CreativeResponse toResponse(Creative c, boolean withAtoms, List<CreativeAtomResponse> atoms) {
        return CreativeResponse.builder()
                .id(c.getId())
                .tenantId(c.getTenantId())
                .externalId(c.getExternalId())
                .type(c.getType())
                .title(c.getTitle())
                .fileUrl(c.getFileUrl())
                .thumbnailUrl(c.getThumbnailUrl())
                .transcript(c.getTranscript())
                .durationSec(c.getDurationSec())
                .status(c.getStatus())
                .isAnchor(c.isAnchor())
                .metaAdSetId(c.getMetaAdSetId())
                .createdAt(c.getCreatedAt())
                .atoms(atoms)
                .build();
    }

    private CreativeAtomResponse toAtomResponse(CreativeAtom a) {
        return CreativeAtomResponse.builder()
                .id(a.getId())
                .creativeId(a.getCreativeId())
                .atomType(a.getAtomType())
                .atomValue(a.getAtomValue())
                .confidence(a.getConfidence())
                .extractedBy(a.getExtractedBy())
                .createdAt(a.getCreatedAt())
                .build();
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import javax.crypto.Cipher;
import javax.crypto.KeyGenerator;
import javax.crypto.SecretKey;
import javax.crypto.spec.GCMParameterSpec;
import javax.crypto.spec.SecretKeySpec;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException;
import java.security.SecureRandom;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Base64;

/**
 * AES-256-GCM envelope encryption (vision §12.7).
 * Production: set ENCRYPTION_KEY env var (Base64-encoded 32-byte key).
 * Dev: ephemeral key generated at startup (data lost on restart — expected in dev).
 */
@Slf4j
@Service
public class EncryptionService {

    private final SecretKey dataKey;

    public EncryptionService(@Value("${app.encryption.key:}") String rawKey) {
        if (rawKey.isEmpty()) {
            log.warn("EncryptionService: ENCRYPTION_KEY not set — using ephemeral dev key (data not persistent across restarts)");
            try {
                KeyGenerator kg = KeyGenerator.getInstance("AES");
                kg.init(256);
                dataKey = kg.generateKey();
            } catch (NoSuchAlgorithmException e) {
                throw new RuntimeException("AES KeyGenerator unavailable", e);
            }
        } else {
            byte[] keyBytes = Base64.getDecoder().decode(rawKey);
            dataKey = new SecretKeySpec(keyBytes, "AES");
        }
    }

    public String encrypt(String plaintext) {
        try {
            Cipher cipher = Cipher.getInstance("AES/GCM/NoPadding");
            byte[] iv = new byte[12];
            new SecureRandom().nextBytes(iv);
            cipher.init(Cipher.ENCRYPT_MODE, dataKey, new GCMParameterSpec(128, iv));
            byte[] ciphertext = cipher.doFinal(plaintext.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            byte[] combined   = new byte[iv.length + ciphertext.length];
            System.arraycopy(iv,         0, combined, 0,         iv.length);
            System.arraycopy(ciphertext, 0, combined, iv.length, ciphertext.length);
            return Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(combined);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Encryption failed", e);
        }
    }

    public String decrypt(String encryptedBase64) {
        try {
            byte[] combined   = Base64.getDecoder().decode(encryptedBase64);
            byte[] iv         = Arrays.copyOfRange(combined, 0, 12);
            byte[] ciphertext = Arrays.copyOfRange(combined, 12, combined.length);
            Cipher cipher = Cipher.getInstance("AES/GCM/NoPadding");
            cipher.init(Cipher.DECRYPT_MODE, dataKey, new GCMParameterSpec(128, iv));
            return new String(cipher.doFinal(ciphertext), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Decryption failed", e);
        }
    }
}
```
