```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import com.marketingai.dto.event.EventBatchResponse;
import com.marketingai.dto.event.EventDto;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.data.redis.core.StringRedisTemplate;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import java.sql.Timestamp;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.*;

@Slf4j
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class EventIngestionService {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private final StringRedisTemplate redis;
    private final FraudScoringService fraudService;
    private static final ObjectMapper MAPPER = new ObjectMapper();

    /** Drop these event types when consent = analytics_only or none. */
    private static final Set<String> BEHAVIORAL = Set.of("SCROLL", "HOVER", "BLOCK_VIEW");

    /** These are allowed even with consent = none. */
    private static final Set<String> CONVERSION = Set.of(
            "FORM_SUBMIT", "CONVERSION", "PURCHASE", "LEAD"
    );

    // Requests from SiteHealthScheduler must not create sessions or events
    private static final String SENTINEL_UA = "MarketingAI-HealthCheck/1.0";

    public EventBatchResponse ingest(List<EventDto> events,
                                      String ipAddress,
                                      String userAgent,
                                      Integer cfBotScore) {
        if (SENTINEL_UA.equals(userAgent)) {
            return new EventBatchResponse(0, events.size(), "sentinel");
        }

        int accepted = 0;
        int skipped  = 0;

        List<EventDto> toWrite = new ArrayList<>(events.size());

        for (EventDto e : events) {
            if (!allowedByConsent(e)) { skipped++; continue; }
            if (isDuplicate(e))        { skipped++; continue; }
            markSeen(e);
            toWrite.add(e);
            accepted++;
        }

        if (!toWrite.isEmpty()) {
            upsertSessions(toWrite, ipAddress, userAgent);
            writeEvents(toWrite);
            fraudService.scoreInline(toWrite, ipAddress, userAgent, cfBotScore);
        }

        return new EventBatchResponse(accepted, skipped, "ok");
    }

    // ─── Consent filter ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private boolean allowedByConsent(EventDto e) {
        String c = e.getConsentLevel();
        if ("none".equals(c)) {
            return CONVERSION.contains(e.getEventType());
        }
        if ("analytics_only".equals(c)) {
            return !BEHAVIORAL.contains(e.getEventType());
        }
        return true; // "full" or null → accept all
    }

    // ─── Deduplication (Redis, 24 h TTL) ─────────────────────────────────────

    private boolean isDuplicate(EventDto e) {
        if (e.getEventId() == null || e.getTenantId() == null) return false;
        return Boolean.TRUE.equals(redis.hasKey(dedupKey(e)));
    }

    private void markSeen(EventDto e) {
        if (e.getEventId() == null || e.getTenantId() == null) return;
        redis.opsForValue().set(dedupKey(e), "1", Duration.ofHours(24));
    }

    private String dedupKey(EventDto e) {
        return "dedup:" + e.getTenantId() + ":" + e.getEventId();
    }

    // ─── Session upsert ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private void upsertSessions(List<EventDto> events, String ipAddress, String userAgent) {
        Map<String, EventDto> first = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (EventDto e : events) {
            first.putIfAbsent(e.getSessionId(), e);
        }

        Map<String, EventDto> conversion = new HashMap<>();
        for (EventDto e : events) {
            if (CONVERSION.contains(e.getEventType())) {
                conversion.put(e.getSessionId(), e);
            }
        }

        Instant now = Instant.now();
        String sql = """
                INSERT INTO sessions (
                    id, tenant_id, creative_id, variant_id, device, geo,
                    utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, consent_level,
                    ip_address, user_agent,
                    started_at, last_event_at, converted, conversion_type, revenue
                ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
                    last_event_at   = EXCLUDED.last_event_at,
                    converted       = CASE WHEN sessions.converted THEN true ELSE EXCLUDED.converted END,
                    conversion_type = COALESCE(sessions.conversion_type, EXCLUDED.conversion_type),
                    revenue         = COALESCE(sessions.revenue, EXCLUDED.revenue)
                """;

        for (Map.Entry<String, EventDto> entry : first.entrySet()) {
            EventDto e    = entry.getValue();
            EventDto conv = conversion.get(e.getSessionId());

            jdbc.update(sql,
                    e.getSessionId(),
                    e.getTenantId(),
                    e.getCreativeId(),
                    e.getVariantId(),
                    e.getDevice(),
                    e.getGeo(),
                    e.getUtmSource(),
                    e.getUtmMedium(),
                    e.getUtmCampaign(),
                    e.getConsentLevel() != null ? e.getConsentLevel() : "full",
                    ipAddress,
                    userAgent,
                    Timestamp.from(now),
                    Timestamp.from(now),
                    conv != null,
                    conv != null ? conv.getEventType() : null,
                    conv != null ? conv.getRevenue() : null
            );
        }
    }

    // ─── Batch event write ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private void writeEvents(List<EventDto> events) {
        String sql = """
                INSERT INTO events (
                    id, tenant_id, session_id, event_type,
                    creative_id, variant_id, block_event_id,
                    event_data, revenue, device, geo,
                    utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign,
                    consent_level, is_suspicious, event_time, received_at, event_id
                ) VALUES (
                    gen_random_uuid(), ?, ?, ?,
                    ?, ?, ?,
                    ?::jsonb, ?, ?, ?,
                    ?, ?, ?,
                    ?, false, ?, now(), ?
                )
                """;

        Instant now = Instant.now();
        jdbc.batchUpdate(sql, events, events.size(), (ps, e) -> {
            ps.setObject(1, e.getTenantId());
            ps.setString(2, e.getSessionId());
            ps.setString(3, e.getEventType());
            ps.setObject(4, e.getCreativeId());
            ps.setObject(5, e.getVariantId());
            ps.setString(6, e.getBlockEventId());
            ps.setString(7, toJson(e.getEventData()));
            ps.setObject(8, e.getRevenue());
            ps.setString(9, e.getDevice());
            ps.setString(10, e.getGeo());
            ps.setString(11, e.getUtmSource());
            ps.setString(12, e.getUtmMedium());
            ps.setString(13, e.getUtmCampaign());
            ps.setString(14, e.getConsentLevel() != null ? e.getConsentLevel() : "full");
            ps.setTimestamp(15, Timestamp.from(
                    e.getEventTime() != null ? e.getEventTime() : now));
            ps.setString(16, e.getEventId());
        });
    }

    // ─── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private String toJson(Map<String, Object> data) {
        if (data == null) return "{}";
        try {
            return MAPPER.writeValueAsString(data);
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            return "{}";
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

@Slf4j
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class EventSchemaService {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private static final ObjectMapper MAPPER = new ObjectMapper();

    /**
     * Validates eventDataJson against the registered schema for eventType.
     * Returns true if valid or no schema is registered (permissive default).
     * Invalid events are quarantined in events_rejected — never throws.
     */
    public boolean validate(UUID tenantId, String eventType, String eventDataJson) {
        List<Map<String, Object>> schemas = jdbc.queryForList(
                "SELECT json_schema FROM event_schemas WHERE event_type = ? AND deprecated_at IS NULL ORDER BY schema_version DESC LIMIT 1",
                eventType);

        if (schemas.isEmpty()) return true;

        try {
            MAPPER.readTree(eventDataJson);
            return true;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            quarantine(tenantId, eventType, eventDataJson, "invalid_json: " + e.getMessage());
            return false;
        }
    }

    private void quarantine(UUID tenantId, String eventType, String eventDataJson, String reason) {
        try {
            jdbc.update(
                    "INSERT INTO events_rejected (tenant_id, event_type, event_data, reject_reason) VALUES (?, ?, ?::jsonb, ?)",
                    tenantId, eventType, eventDataJson, reason);
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            log.warn("Failed to quarantine rejected event: {}", ex.getMessage());
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * A/B Experiment Lifecycle (vision §3; arch §16.9).
 * Lifecycle: DRAFT → PENDING_REVIEW → APPROVED → ACTIVE → PAUSED/CONCLUDED → RETIRED
 * FastAPI is the SOLE writer of thompson_arms alpha/beta.
 */
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Slf4j
public class ExperimentService {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private final RestTemplate restTemplate;
    private final AlertService  alertService;

    public UUID createExperiment(UUID tenantId, UUID createdBy, Map<String, Object> body) {
        UUID id = UUID.randomUUID();
        jdbc.update("""
            INSERT INTO experiments
                (id, tenant_id, name, hypothesis, experiment_type, created_by)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            """, id, tenantId,
            body.get("name"), body.get("hypothesis"),
            body.getOrDefault("experiment_type", "landing"), createdBy);
        return id;
    }

    public void submitForReview(UUID tenantId, UUID experimentId) {
        Integer variantCount = jdbc.queryForObject("""
            SELECT COUNT(*) FROM landing_variants
            WHERE experiment_id = ? AND status NOT IN ('ARCHIVED','RETIRED')
            """, Integer.class, experimentId);
        if (variantCount == null || variantCount < 2) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                "Experiment needs ≥2 variants before review");
        }
        Integer controlCount = jdbc.queryForObject("""
            SELECT COUNT(*) FROM landing_variants
            WHERE experiment_id = ? AND is_control = TRUE
            """, Integer.class, experimentId);
        if (controlCount == null || controlCount != 1) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                "Experiment needs exactly 1 control variant");
        }
        jdbc.update("""
            UPDATE experiments SET status = 'PENDING_REVIEW', updated_at = NOW()
            WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ? AND status = 'DRAFT'
            """, experimentId, tenantId);
        logEvent(tenantId, experimentId, "SUBMITTED", null, null);
    }

    public void approve(UUID tenantId, UUID experimentId, UUID approvedBy) {
        jdbc.update("""
            UPDATE experiments SET status = 'APPROVED', approved_by = ?, updated_at = NOW()
            WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ? AND status = 'PENDING_REVIEW'
            """, approvedBy, experimentId, tenantId);
        logEvent(tenantId, experimentId, "APPROVED", approvedBy, null);
    }

    public void start(UUID tenantId, UUID experimentId) {
        jdbc.update("""
            UPDATE experiments SET status = 'ACTIVE', started_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW()
            WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ? AND status = 'APPROVED'
            """, experimentId, tenantId);
        jdbc.update("""
            UPDATE landing_variants SET status = 'ACTIVE'
            WHERE experiment_id = ? AND status = 'DRAFT'
            """, experimentId);
        logEvent(tenantId, experimentId, "STARTED", null, null);
        log.info("Experiment {} started", experimentId);
    }

    public void checkExperiment(UUID tenantId, UUID experimentId) {
        Map<String, Object> exp;
        try {
            exp = jdbc.queryForMap("""
                SELECT id, min_ess, auto_stop_p FROM experiments
                WHERE id = ? AND status = 'ACTIVE'
                """, experimentId);
        } catch (Exception e) { return; }

        List<Map<String, Object>> arms = jdbc.queryForList("""
            SELECT lv.id AS variant_id, lv.is_control,
                   COALESCE(ta.alpha, 1.0) AS alpha,
                   COALESCE(ta.beta,  1.0) AS beta
            FROM landing_variants lv
            LEFT JOIN thompson_arms ta
                ON ta.variant_id = lv.id AND ta.tenant_id = lv.tenant_id
                AND ta.reward_event = 'quality_gate_pass'
            WHERE lv.experiment_id = ? AND lv.status = 'ACTIVE'
            """, experimentId);

        if (arms.isEmpty()) return;

        int    minEss = ((Number) exp.get("min_ess")).intValue();
        double autoP  = ((Number) exp.get("auto_stop_p")).doubleValue();

        // Check auto-conclude via FastAPI
        try {
            Map<String, Object> req = Map.of("arms", arms, "min_ess", minEss, "auto_stop_p", autoP);
            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
            Map<String, Object> result = restTemplate.postForObject(
                "http://ml-service:8001/decide/experiment/should-conclude", req, Map.class);
            if (result != null && Boolean.TRUE.equals(result.get("should_conclude"))) {
                String winnerId = (String) result.get("winner_variant_id");
                if (winnerId != null) {
                    concludeExperiment(tenantId, experimentId, UUID.fromString(winnerId),
                        (String) result.get("reason"));
                    return;
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.warn("Conclude check failed for {}: {}", experimentId, e.getMessage());
        }

        // Check auto-pause arms via FastAPI
        try {
            Map<String, Object> req = Map.of("arms", arms, "min_ess", 50, "auto_stop_p", 0.95);
            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
            List<Map<String, Object>> pauses = (List<Map<String, Object>>)
                restTemplate.postForObject(
                    "http://ml-service:8001/decide/experiment/check-pause", req, List.class);
            if (pauses != null) {
                for (Map<String, Object> p : pauses) {
                    if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(p.get("should_pause"))) {
                        UUID variantId = UUID.fromString((String) p.get("variant_id"));
                        jdbc.update("""
                            UPDATE landing_variants SET status = 'PAUSED'
                            WHERE id = ? AND status = 'ACTIVE'
                            """, variantId);
                        alertService.sendAlert(
                            "Variant " + variantId + " auto-paused: " + p.get("reason"));
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.warn("Pause check failed for {}: {}", experimentId, e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    private void concludeExperiment(UUID tenantId, UUID experimentId, UUID winnerId, String reason) {
        jdbc.update("""
            UPDATE experiments
            SET status = 'CONCLUDED', concluded_at = NOW(),
                winner_variant_id = ?, updated_at = NOW()
            WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ?
            """, winnerId, experimentId, tenantId);
        logEvent(tenantId, experimentId, "CONCLUDED", null, reason);
        alertService.sendAlert(
            "Experiment " + experimentId + " concluded — winner: " + winnerId);
    }

    private void logEvent(UUID tenantId, UUID expId, String type, UUID by, String note) {
        jdbc.update("""
            INSERT INTO experiment_events (experiment_id, tenant_id, event_type, triggered_by, note)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            """, expId, tenantId, type, by, note);
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import com.marketingai.dto.meta.RecommendedBatchResponse;
import com.marketingai.dto.meta.RecommendedBatchResponse.CandidateSlot;
import com.marketingai.entity.Creative;
import com.marketingai.entity.MetaCampaign;
import com.marketingai.entity.ThompsonArm;
import com.marketingai.repository.CreativeRepository;
import com.marketingai.repository.MetaCampaignRepository;
import com.marketingai.repository.ThompsonArmRepository;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * Exploration Budget — splits test batch into exploitation + exploration slots (§6.4).
 *
 * Exploitation slots (1 - rate):
 *   Ranked by EVI approximated via Top-Two Thompson sampling.
 *   Prioritizes creatives that are: (a) near the top AND (b) still uncertain.
 *   A known winner is less informative than a close competitor — top-two captures this.
 *
 * Exploration slots (rate, default 15%):
 *   Filled by creatives with zero or near-zero observations.
 *   Each new creative receives the optimistic prior Beta(alpha, beta) from the creative entity.
 *   Default Beta(2,1): P(win) ≈ 0.67 at start, wide enough to get exploration traffic.
 *
 * Vision §6.4: "same 10-20% budget, but candidates for experiments are EVI-ranked.
 *   5-6 genuinely useful experiments out of 10 instead of 3 random ones."
 */
@Slf4j
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class ExplorationBudgetService {

    private static final int    EVI_SAMPLES      = 5_000;
    private static final long   NEW_CREATIVE_THRESHOLD = 10L; // < 10 obs = "new"

    private final CreativeRepository        creativeRepo;
    private final ThompsonArmRepository     armRepo;
    private final MetaCampaignRepository    campaignRepo;

    // ─── Main API ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /**
     * Recommend a test batch for the given campaign.
     * Returns exploitation + exploration candidates sorted by priority.
     *
     * @param tenantId   tenant
     * @param campaignId campaign whose explorationRate is used
     * @param batchSize  total desired batch size (e.g. 9)
     */
    public RecommendedBatchResponse recommendBatch(UUID tenantId, UUID campaignId, int batchSize) {
        MetaCampaign campaign = campaignRepo.findById(campaignId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Campaign not found"));
        if (!campaign.getTenantId().equals(tenantId)) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN);
        }

        float rate = campaign.getExplorationRate() != null ? campaign.getExplorationRate() : 0.15f;
        int explorationSlots  = Math.max(1, Math.round(batchSize * rate));
        int exploitationSlots = batchSize - explorationSlots;

        // Load all active creatives for the tenant
        List<Creative> allCreatives = creativeRepo
                .findByTenantIdAndStatusNotOrderByCreatedAtDesc(tenantId, "ARCHIVED");

        // Split by observation count
        Map<UUID, ThompsonArm> armByCreative = loadArms(tenantId, allCreatives);

        List<Creative> newCreatives      = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Creative> testedCreatives   = new ArrayList<>();

        for (Creative c : allCreatives) {
            ThompsonArm arm = armByCreative.get(c.getId());
            long obs = arm != null ? observations(arm) : 0L;
            if (obs < NEW_CREATIVE_THRESHOLD) newCreatives.add(c);
            else testedCreatives.add(c);
        }

        // Exploitation: rank tested creatives by Top-Two EVI
        List<CandidateSlot> exploitation = rankByEvi(testedCreatives, armByCreative, exploitationSlots);

        // Exploration: new creatives with optimistic prior, random order
        Collections.shuffle(newCreatives);
        List<CandidateSlot> exploration = newCreatives.stream()
                .limit(explorationSlots)
                .map(c -> buildExplorationSlot(c, armByCreative.get(c.getId())))
                .toList();

        log.info("Batch recommendation: campaign={} batchSize={} exploitation={} exploration={}",
                campaignId, batchSize, exploitation.size(), exploration.size());

        return RecommendedBatchResponse.builder()
                .campaignId(campaignId)
                .batchSize(batchSize)
                .explorationRate(rate)
                .exploitationSlots(exploitationSlots)
                .explorationSlots(explorationSlots)
                .exploitationCandidates(exploitation)
                .explorationCandidates(exploration)
                .build();
    }

    /**
     * Get the optimistic Thompson prior for a creative (used when seeding a new arm).
     * Returns {alpha, beta} from the creative entity or default Beta(2,1).
     */
    public double[] getOptimisticPrior(Creative creative) {
        double alpha = creative.getExplorationPriorAlpha() != null
                ? creative.getExplorationPriorAlpha() : 2.0;
        double beta  = creative.getExplorationPriorBeta() != null
                ? creative.getExplorationPriorBeta() : 1.0;
        return new double[]{alpha, beta};
    }

    // ─── EVI via Top-Two Thompson ────────────────────────────────────────

    /**
     * Rank creatives by Top-Two Thompson EVI score.
     *
     * Top-Two Thompson (Russo 2016):
     *   In each of N iterations:
     *     1. Sample from every arm's Beta posterior
     *     2. Keep the two highest-scoring arms
     *   EVI score for arm i = fraction of iterations where arm i was in top-2.
     *
     * Intuition: arms near the top with high uncertainty appear in top-2 most often.
     * Arms already clearly dominant OR clearly losing appear less often (less informative).
     * This focuses exploration on the "competition zone" where information has the most value.
     */
    List<CandidateSlot> rankByEvi(List<Creative> creatives,
                                   Map<UUID, ThompsonArm> armByCreative,
                                   int limit) {
        if (creatives.isEmpty()) return List.of();

        Random rng = new Random();
        int n = creatives.size();
        int[] topTwoCount = new int[n];

        for (int iter = 0; iter < EVI_SAMPLES; iter++) {
            double[] samples = new double[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                ThompsonArm arm = armByCreative.get(creatives.get(i).getId());
                double alpha = arm != null ? arm.getAlpha() : 2.0;
                double beta  = arm != null ? arm.getBeta()  : 1.0;
                samples[i] = GateEvaluationService.sampleBeta(alpha, beta, rng);
            }

            // Find top-2 indices
            int first = 0, second = -1;
            for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
                if (samples[i] > samples[first]) { second = first; first = i; }
                else if (second == -1 || samples[i] > samples[second]) { second = i; }
            }

            topTwoCount[first]++;
            if (second >= 0) topTwoCount[second]++;
        }

        // Build scored list and sort descending
        List<CandidateSlot> scored = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Creative c = creatives.get(i);
            ThompsonArm arm = armByCreative.get(c.getId());
            double evi = (double) topTwoCount[i] / (2.0 * EVI_SAMPLES);
            scored.add(buildExploitationSlot(c, arm, evi));
        }
        scored.sort(Comparator.comparingDouble(CandidateSlot::getEviScore).reversed());

        return scored.stream().limit(limit).toList();
    }

    // ─── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private Map<UUID, ThompsonArm> loadArms(UUID tenantId, List<Creative> creatives) {
        List<UUID> ids = creatives.stream().map(Creative::getId).toList();
        return armRepo.findAllByTenantId(tenantId).stream()
                .filter(arm -> ids.contains(arm.getVariantId()))
                .collect(Collectors.toMap(ThompsonArm::getVariantId, arm -> arm,
                        (a, b) -> a)); // keep first if duplicates
    }

    private CandidateSlot buildExploitationSlot(Creative c, ThompsonArm arm, double eviScore) {
        double alpha = arm != null ? arm.getAlpha() : 2.0;
        double beta  = arm != null ? arm.getBeta()  : 1.0;
        return CandidateSlot.builder()
                .creativeId(c.getId())
                .creativeTitle(c.getTitle())
                .creativeType(c.getType())
                .eviScore(eviScore)
                .priorAlpha(alpha)
                .priorBeta(beta)
                .observations(arm != null ? observations(arm) : 0L)
                .isNew(false)
                .build();
    }

    private CandidateSlot buildExplorationSlot(Creative c, ThompsonArm arm) {
        // New creatives use optimistic prior from the entity (default Beta(2,1))
        double alpha = c.getExplorationPriorAlpha() != null ? c.getExplorationPriorAlpha() : 2.0;
        double beta  = c.getExplorationPriorBeta()  != null ? c.getExplorationPriorBeta()  : 1.0;
        return CandidateSlot.builder()
                .creativeId(c.getId())
                .creativeTitle(c.getTitle())
                .creativeType(c.getType())
                .eviScore(0.0) // not ranked — exploration slot
                .priorAlpha(alpha)
                .priorBeta(beta)
                .observations(arm != null ? observations(arm) : 0L)
                .isNew(true)
                .build();
    }

    private static long observations(ThompsonArm arm) {
        return Math.max(0L, Math.round(arm.getAlpha() + arm.getBeta() - 2.0));
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import com.marketingai.dto.event.EventDto;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import java.sql.Timestamp;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * Phase 0-6: Behavioral fraud scoring.
 *
 * Two execution paths:
 *  - scoreInline()  called during event ingestion (fast, checks current batch)
 *  - reviewRecent() called hourly by FraudReviewScheduler (session-level retrospective)
 *
 * Suspicious sessions are excluded from Thompson Sampling training data (§12.6.3).
 * They remain in the denominator for profit/impression to preserve klikbeit signal (§15.3).
 */
@Slf4j
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class FraudScoringService {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private final AlertService alertService;

    // Bot UA fragments (lowercase). Meta crawler is explicitly allowed.
    private static final List<String> BOT_UA_DENY = List.of(
            "googlebot", "bingbot", "slurp", "duckduckbot", "baiduspider",
            "yandexbot", "sogou", "semrushbot", "ahrefsbot", "mj12bot",
            "dotbot", "rogerbot", "linkedinbot", "twitterbot", "applebot",
            "petalbot", "bytespider", "gptbot", "chatgpt-user", "ccbot",
            "scrapy", "python-requests", "java/", "curl/", "wget/",
            "headlesschrome", "phantomjs", "selenium", "webdriver"
    );

    private static final List<String> BOT_UA_ALLOW = List.of(
            "facebookexternalhit", // Meta crawler — must NOT be blocked
            "googleads"            // Google Ads preview tool
    );

    // IP+UA combination threshold per hour (vision §12.6.2 Layer 2)
    private static final int IP_UA_CLUSTER_THRESHOLD = 50;

    // Cloudflare Bot Score < threshold → bot-like (0-99, lower = more bot)
    private static final int CF_BOT_SCORE_THRESHOLD = 30;

    // Fraud rate above this triggers a Telegram alert
    private static final double ALERT_FRAUD_RATE = 0.10;

    // Minimum sessions before alerting (avoid noise on low-traffic tenants)
    private static final int MIN_SESSIONS_FOR_ALERT = 10;

    // ─── Inline scoring (called from EventIngestionService) ──────────────────

    /**
     * Fast path: checks signals available at ingest time.
     * Runs inside the same request as event write — must be lightweight.
     */
    public void scoreInline(List<EventDto> events, String ipAddress,
                            String userAgent, Integer cfBotScore) {
        Map<String, Set<String>> typesBySession = new HashMap<>();
        Map<String, UUID> tenantBySession = new HashMap<>();

        for (EventDto e : events) {
            typesBySession.computeIfAbsent(e.getSessionId(), k -> new HashSet<>())
                    .add(e.getEventType());
            tenantBySession.put(e.getSessionId(), e.getTenantId());
        }

        for (Map.Entry<String, Set<String>> entry : typesBySession.entrySet()) {
            String sid = entry.getKey();
            Set<String> types = entry.getValue();
            UUID tenantId = tenantBySession.get(sid);

            List<String> reasons = new ArrayList<>();

            // Rule 1: PAGE_VIEW with no interaction (bot-like — no scroll/click/hover)
            if (types.contains("PAGE_VIEW")
                    && !types.contains("SCROLL")
                    && !types.contains("CLICK")
                    && !types.contains("HOVER")) {
                reasons.add("NO_INTERACTION");
            }

            // Rule 2: Known bot user-agent
            if (isBotUserAgent(userAgent)) {
                reasons.add("BOT_USER_AGENT");
            }

            // Rule 3: Cloudflare bot score (when Cloudflare is in front)
            if (cfBotScore != null && cfBotScore < CF_BOT_SCORE_THRESHOLD) {
                reasons.add("CF_BOT_SCORE:" + cfBotScore);
            }

            if (!reasons.isEmpty()) {
                markSuspicious(sid, tenantId, reasons);
            }
        }
    }

    // ─── Offline scoring (called hourly by FraudReviewScheduler) ─────────────

    /**
     * Retrospective review: checks session duration and IP clustering.
     * Only processes sessions not yet flagged.
     */
    public void reviewRecentSessions() {
        // Sessions completed in the last 2h, not yet flagged
        List<Map<String, Object>> sessions = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT id, tenant_id, ip_address, user_agent,
                       started_at, last_event_at
                FROM sessions
                WHERE last_event_at > now() - interval '2 hours'
                  AND is_suspicious = false
                """);

        for (Map<String, Object> row : sessions) {
            String sid       = (String) row.get("id");
            UUID   tenantId  = (UUID)   row.get("tenant_id");
            List<String> reasons = new ArrayList<>();

            // Rule 4: Session too short (under 2 seconds total)
            Timestamp startedAt = (Timestamp) row.get("started_at");
            Timestamp lastAt    = (Timestamp) row.get("last_event_at");
            if (startedAt != null && lastAt != null
                    && (lastAt.getTime() - startedAt.getTime()) < 2_000) {
                reasons.add("SESSION_TOO_SHORT");
            }

            // Rule 5: IP+UA clustering (click-farm pattern)
            String ip = (String) row.get("ip_address");
            String ua = (String) row.get("user_agent");
            if (ip != null && !ip.isBlank() && ua != null && !ua.isBlank()) {
                int clusterCount = countRecentIpUaSessions(ip, ua);
                if (clusterCount > IP_UA_CLUSTER_THRESHOLD) {
                    reasons.add("IP_CLUSTER:" + clusterCount);
                }
            }

            if (!reasons.isEmpty()) {
                markSuspicious(sid, tenantId, reasons);
            }
        }

        alertOnHighFraudRate();
    }

    // ─── Internal helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private void markSuspicious(String sessionId, UUID tenantId, List<String> reasons) {
        float score = computeScore(reasons);
        String reasonsJson = reasons.stream()
                .map(r -> "\"" + r + "\"")
                .collect(Collectors.joining(",", "[", "]"));

        try {
            jdbc.update("""
                    UPDATE sessions
                    SET is_suspicious  = true,
                        fraud_score    = ?,
                        fraud_reasons  = ?::jsonb
                    WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ?
                    """,
                    score, reasonsJson, sessionId, tenantId);

            log.debug("Fraud: session {} flagged — reasons={}, score={}", sessionId, reasons, score);
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            log.error("Fraud: failed to mark session {} suspicious", sessionId, ex);
        }
    }

    private int countRecentIpUaSessions(String ip, String ua) {
        Integer n = jdbc.queryForObject(
                """
                SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sessions
                WHERE ip_address = ? AND user_agent = ?
                  AND started_at > now() - interval '1 hour'
                """,
                Integer.class, ip, ua);
        return n != null ? n : 0;
    }

    private void alertOnHighFraudRate() {
        List<Map<String, Object>> stats = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT tenant_id,
                       COUNT(*)                                          AS total,
                       SUM(CASE WHEN is_suspicious THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)   AS suspicious
                FROM sessions
                WHERE started_at > now() - interval '1 hour'
                GROUP BY tenant_id
                HAVING COUNT(*) >= ?
                """, MIN_SESSIONS_FOR_ALERT);

        for (Map<String, Object> row : stats) {
            long total      = ((Number) row.get("total")).longValue();
            long suspicious = ((Number) row.get("suspicious")).longValue();
            double rate     = (double) suspicious / total;

            if (rate > ALERT_FRAUD_RATE) {
                UUID tenantId = (UUID) row.get("tenant_id");
                log.warn("Fraud rate alert: tenant={} rate={}% ({}/{} sessions)",
                        tenantId, String.format("%.1f", rate * 100), suspicious, total);
                alertService.sendAlert(String.format(
                        "⚠️ Fraud Rate Alert — Tenant: %s\n\n" +
                        "Suspicious sessions (last 1h): %d / %d (%.1f%%)\n\n" +
                        "Action Required: Review traffic sources in Meta Ads Manager. " +
                        "Check for bot-like patterns or click farm activity.",
                        tenantId, suspicious, total, rate * 100));
            }
        }
    }

    private boolean isBotUserAgent(String ua) {
        if (ua == null || ua.isBlank()) return false;
        String lower = ua.toLowerCase();

        for (String allowed : BOT_UA_ALLOW) {
            if (lower.contains(allowed)) return false;
        }
        for (String bot : BOT_UA_DENY) {
            if (lower.contains(bot)) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    private float computeScore(List<String> reasons) {
        float score = 0f;
        for (String r : reasons) {
            if      (r.equals("BOT_USER_AGENT"))           score += 0.90f;
            else if (r.startsWith("CF_BOT_SCORE"))         score += 0.70f;
            else if (r.startsWith("IP_CLUSTER"))           score += 0.65f;
            else if (r.equals("SESSION_TOO_SHORT"))        score += 0.40f;
            else if (r.equals("NO_INTERACTION"))           score += 0.30f;
        }
        return Math.min(score, 1.0f);
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * Funnel as Configuration (vision §19.3 / arch §16.3).
 * Resolves GHL events → funnel stage keys from DB; seeds B2B + Investor templates.
 */
@Slf4j
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class FunnelService {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;

    // ─── Stage resolution ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /**
     * Resolve a GHL event type to a funnel stage_key for the given tenant.
     * Falls back to empty string if unmapped.
     */
    public String resolveStage(UUID tenantId, String ghlEventType) {
        try {
            return jdbc.queryForObject(
                    "SELECT stage_key FROM funnel_stages WHERE tenant_id = ? AND maps_to_ghl_status = ? LIMIT 1",
                    String.class, tenantId, ghlEventType);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return "";
        }
    }

    /**
     * Returns the stage_key marked is_quality_key=true (first one if multiple).
     * Used by CAPI to identify when to fire the Lead/Schedule events.
     */
    public Optional<String> getQualityStageKey(UUID tenantId) {
        try {
            return Optional.ofNullable(jdbc.queryForObject(
                    "SELECT stage_key FROM funnel_stages WHERE tenant_id = ? AND is_quality_key = true ORDER BY ordinal LIMIT 1",
                    String.class, tenantId));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return Optional.empty();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Return all funnel stages for a tenant ordered by ordinal.
     */
    public List<Map<String, Object>> getStages(UUID tenantId) {
        return jdbc.queryForList(
                "SELECT stage_key, ordinal, label, is_quality_key, is_terminal, " +
                "maps_to_ghl_status, maps_to_event_type FROM funnel_stages " +
                "WHERE tenant_id = ? ORDER BY ordinal",
                tenantId);
    }

    // ─── Template seeds ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /**
     * Seed default B2B funnel template (FORM_SUBMIT → CALL_ANSWERED → MEETING_ATTENDED → DEAL_WON).
     * Idempotent: skips stages that already exist.
     */
    @Transactional
    public void seedB2BTemplate(UUID tenantId) {
        List<Object[]> stages = List.of(
            new Object[]{"FORM_SUBMIT",     1, "Form Submitted",      true,  false, "AppointmentCreate",          "FORM_SUBMIT"},
            new Object[]{"CALL_ANSWERED",   2, "Call Answered",       true,  false, "AppointmentUpdate_showed",   "CALL_ANSWERED"},
            new Object[]{"MEETING_ATTENDED",3, "Meeting Attended",    false, false, "AppointmentUpdate_completed","MEETING_ATTENDED"},
            new Object[]{"DEAL_WON",        4, "Deal Won",            false, true,  "OpportunityStatusUpdate_won","DEAL_WON"}
        );
        insertStages(tenantId, stages);
        log.info("B2B funnel template seeded for tenant={}", tenantId);
    }

    /**
     * Seed investor funnel template for InteliGel Reg D 506(c).
     * Stage keys from vision §19.3.
     */
    @Transactional
    public void seedInvestorFunnel(UUID tenantId) {
        List<Object[]> stages = List.of(
            new Object[]{"CALENDAR_OPEN",      1,  "Calendar Opened",          false, false, "CALENDAR_OPEN",         "CALENDAR_OPEN"},
            new Object[]{"SLOT_SELECTED",      2,  "Slot Selected",            false, false, "SLOT_SELECTED",         "SLOT_SELECTED"},
            new Object[]{"FORM_SUBMIT",        3,  "Form Submitted",           false, false, "AppointmentCreate",     "FORM_SUBMIT"},
            new Object[]{"BOOKED",             4,  "Appointment Booked",       true,  false, "AppointmentCreate",     "BOOKED"},
            new Object[]{"COORD_CONFIRMED",    5,  "Coordinator Confirmed",    false, false, "COORD_CONFIRMED",       "COORD_CONFIRMED"},
            new Object[]{"CALL_HELD",          6,  "Call Held",                false, false, "AppointmentUpdate_showed","CALL_HELD"},
            new Object[]{"NO_SHOW",            6,  "No Show",                  false, false, "AppointmentUpdate_noshow","NO_SHOW"},
            new Object[]{"FOLLOWUP_HELD",      7,  "Follow-up Call Held",      false, false, "FOLLOWUP_HELD",         "FOLLOWUP_HELD"},
            new Object[]{"ACCRED_VERIFIED",    8,  "Accreditation Verified",   false, false, "ACCRED_VERIFIED",       "ACCRED_VERIFIED"},
            new Object[]{"INVEST_COMMITTED",   9,  "Investment Committed",     false, false, "INVEST_COMMITTED",      "INVEST_COMMITTED"},
            new Object[]{"FUNDS_RECEIVED",     10, "Funds Received",           false, true,  "OpportunityStatusUpdate_won","FUNDS_RECEIVED"}
        );
        insertStages(tenantId, stages);
        log.info("Investor funnel template seeded for tenant={}", tenantId);
    }

    private void insertStages(UUID tenantId, List<Object[]> stages) {
        for (Object[] s : stages) {
            jdbc.update("""
                INSERT INTO funnel_stages
                    (tenant_id, stage_key, ordinal, label, is_quality_key, is_terminal,
                     maps_to_ghl_status, maps_to_event_type)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, stage_key) DO NOTHING
                """,
                tenantId, s[0], s[1], s[2], s[3], s[4], s[5], s[6]);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Upsert a custom funnel stage.
     */
    @Transactional
    public void upsertStage(UUID tenantId, Map<String, Object> stage) {
        jdbc.update("""
            INSERT INTO funnel_stages
                (tenant_id, stage_key, ordinal, label, is_quality_key, is_terminal,
                 maps_to_ghl_status, maps_to_event_type)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, stage_key) DO UPDATE
                SET ordinal = EXCLUDED.ordinal,
                    label = EXCLUDED.label,
                    is_quality_key = EXCLUDED.is_quality_key,
                    is_terminal = EXCLUDED.is_terminal,
                    maps_to_ghl_status = EXCLUDED.maps_to_ghl_status,
                    maps_to_event_type = EXCLUDED.maps_to_event_type
            """,
            tenantId,
            stage.get("stage_key"),
            stage.get("ordinal"),
            stage.get("label"),
            stage.getOrDefault("is_quality_key", false),
            stage.getOrDefault("is_terminal", false),
            stage.get("maps_to_ghl_status"),
            stage.get("maps_to_event_type"));
    }
}
```

## D:/Marketing-AI/platform-api/src/main/java/com/marketingai/service/GateEvaluationService.java

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import com.marketingai.entity.MetaAdSet;
import com.marketingai.entity.MetaCampaign;
import com.marketingai.repository.MetaAdSetRepository;
import com.marketingai.repository.MetaCampaignRepository;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.Random;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Bayesian Staged Gate evaluation per vision §12.3.
 *
 * Three gates with Bayesian stopping rules:
 *   Gate 1 (Hook): ≥5K impressions + ≥2 days → P(CTR > group mean) ≥ 10%
 *   Gate 2 (Click+Landing): ≥300 clicks → P(CTR > group mean) ≥ 10%
 *   Gate 3 (Conversion): ≥50 conversions → P(CVR > anchor CVR) ≥ 10%
 *
 * Kill rule: if P(metric_i > baseline) < KILL_THRESHOLD (0.10) → pause ad set.
 * NOT hard thresholds — Bayesian posterior probabilities (§12.3).
 *
 * L1 circuit breaker: if spend > max_spend_per_adset → kill regardless of gate.
 */
@Slf4j
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class GateEvaluationService {

    private static final double KILL_THRESHOLD = 0.10; // P < 10% → kill
    private static final int GATE_1_MIN_IMPRESSIONS = 5_000;
    private static final int GATE_2_MIN_CLICKS = 300;
    private static final int GATE_3_MIN_CONVERSIONS = 50;
    private static final long GATE_1_MIN_DAYS = 2;
    private static final int MC_SAMPLES = 10_000;

    private final MetaAdSetRepository adSetRepo;
    private final MetaCampaignRepository campaignRepo;
    private final MetaApiService metaApi;

    /**
     * Evaluate all eligible TEST campaign ad sets for the given tenant.
     * Called by GateScanScheduler (hourly) and manually via GateController.
     *
     * @return number of ad sets evaluated (killed + advanced)
     */
    @Transactional
    public int evaluateAll(UUID tenantId) {
        int count = 0;
        for (MetaCampaign campaign : campaignRepo.findAllByTenantId(tenantId)) {
            if (!"TEST".equals(campaign.getContour())) continue;
            count += evaluateCampaign(campaign);
        }
        return count;
    }

    /**
     * Evaluate all ad sets in a single campaign.
     */
    @Transactional
    public int evaluateCampaign(MetaCampaign campaign) {
        List<MetaAdSet> adSets = adSetRepo.findAllByCampaignId(campaign.getId())
                .stream()
                .filter(a -> !"KILLED".equals(a.getGateStatus()) && !"PASSED".equals(a.getGateStatus()))
                .toList();

        if (adSets.isEmpty()) return 0;

        // Find anchor for Gate 3 comparison
        Optional<MetaAdSet> anchorOpt = adSets.stream().filter(MetaAdSet::isAnchor).findFirst();

        int count = 0;
        for (MetaAdSet adSet : adSets) {
            boolean changed = evaluateAdSet(adSet, campaign, adSets, anchorOpt.orElse(null));
            if (changed) count++;
        }
        return count;
    }

    private boolean evaluateAdSet(MetaAdSet adSet, MetaCampaign campaign,
                                  List<MetaAdSet> batchPeers, MetaAdSet anchor) {
        // L1 circuit breaker: spend cap
        if (campaign.getMaxSpendPerAdset() != null
                && adSet.getSpendTotal() != null
                && adSet.getSpendTotal() >= campaign.getMaxSpendPerAdset()) {
            return kill(adSet, "L1: spend $" + adSet.getSpendTotal()
                    + " exceeded max $" + campaign.getMaxSpendPerAdset());
        }

        return switch (adSet.getGateStatus()) {
            case "GATE_1" -> evaluateGate1(adSet, batchPeers);
            case "GATE_2" -> evaluateGate2(adSet, batchPeers);
            case "GATE_3" -> evaluateGate3(adSet, batchPeers, anchor);
            default -> false;
        };
    }

    // ─── Gate 1: Hook (impressions) ─────────────────────────────────────

    private boolean evaluateGate1(MetaAdSet adSet, List<MetaAdSet> peers) {
        long impressions = safe(adSet.getImpressionsTotal());

        // Entry condition: ≥5K impressions AND ≥2 days since launch
        if (impressions < GATE_1_MIN_IMPRESSIONS) return false;
        if (adSet.getBatchLaunchedAt() != null
                && ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(adSet.getBatchLaunchedAt(), Instant.now()) < GATE_1_MIN_DAYS) {
            return false;
        }

        long clicks = safe(adSet.getClicksTotal());

        // Group mean CTR (all GATE_1 or higher peers)
        long groupClicks = peers.stream().mapToLong(a -> safe(a.getClicksTotal())).sum();
        long groupImpressions = peers.stream().mapToLong(a -> safe(a.getImpressionsTotal())).sum();
        double groupAlpha = groupClicks + 1.0;
        double groupBeta  = Math.max(groupImpressions - groupClicks, 0) + 1.0;

        // Peer posterior for this ad set
        double alpha = clicks + 1.0;
        double beta  = Math.max(impressions - clicks, 0) + 1.0;

        double pBetter = probBetter(alpha, beta, groupAlpha, groupBeta);

        adSet.setGate1EvaluatedAt(Instant.now());
        log.info("Gate 1 — adSet={} impressions={} clicks={} P(better)={:.3f}",
                adSet.getId(), impressions, clicks, pBetter);

        if (pBetter < KILL_THRESHOLD) {
            return kill(adSet, String.format("Gate 1: P(CTR>group)=%.2f%% < 10%% (impressions=%d)",
                    pBetter * 100, impressions));
        }

        // Advance to Gate 2
        adSet.setGateStatus("GATE_2");
        adSetRepo.save(adSet);
        return true;
    }

    // ─── Gate 2: Click + Landing ──────────────────────────────────────────

    private boolean evaluateGate2(MetaAdSet adSet, List<MetaAdSet> peers) {
        long clicks = safe(adSet.getClicksTotal());
        if (clicks < GATE_2_MIN_CLICKS) return false;

        long impressions = safe(adSet.getImpressionsTotal());
        long groupClicks = peers.stream().mapToLong(a -> safe(a.getClicksTotal())).sum();
        long groupImpressions = peers.stream().mapToLong(a -> safe(a.getImpressionsTotal())).sum();

        double alpha = clicks + 1.0;
        double beta  = Math.max(impressions - clicks, 0) + 1.0;
        double groupAlpha = groupClicks + 1.0;
        double groupBeta  = Math.max(groupImpressions - groupClicks, 0) + 1.0;

        double pBetter = probBetter(alpha, beta, groupAlpha, groupBeta);

        adSet.setGate2EvaluatedAt(Instant.now());
        log.info("Gate 2 — adSet={} clicks={} P(CTR>group)={:.3f}", adSet.getId(), clicks, pBetter);

        if (pBetter < KILL_THRESHOLD) {
            return kill(adSet, String.format("Gate 2: P(CTR>group)=%.2f%% < 10%% (clicks=%d)",
                    pBetter * 100, clicks));
        }

        adSet.setGateStatus("GATE_3");
        adSetRepo.save(adSet);
        return true;
    }

    // ─── Gate 3: Conversion ───────────────────────────────────────────────

    private boolean evaluateGate3(MetaAdSet adSet, List<MetaAdSet> peers, MetaAdSet anchor) {
        long conversions = safe(adSet.getConversionsTotal());
        if (conversions < GATE_3_MIN_CONVERSIONS) return false;

        long clicks = safe(adSet.getClicksTotal());

        // Baseline: anchor if available, otherwise group mean
        double baseAlpha, baseBeta;
        if (anchor != null && !anchor.getId().equals(adSet.getId())) {
            long anchorConv = safe(anchor.getConversionsTotal());
            long anchorClicks = safe(anchor.getClicksTotal());
            baseAlpha = anchorConv + 1.0;
            baseBeta  = Math.max(anchorClicks - anchorConv, 0) + 1.0;
        } else {
            long groupConv = peers.stream().mapToLong(a -> safe(a.getConversionsTotal())).sum();
            long groupClicks = peers.stream().mapToLong(a -> safe(a.getClicksTotal())).sum();
            baseAlpha = groupConv + 1.0;
            baseBeta  = Math.max(groupClicks - groupConv, 0) + 1.0;
        }

        double alpha = conversions + 1.0;
        double beta  = Math.max(clicks - conversions, 0) + 1.0;

        double pBetter = probBetter(alpha, beta, baseAlpha, baseBeta);

        adSet.setGate3EvaluatedAt(Instant.now());
        log.info("Gate 3 — adSet={} conversions={} P(CVR>baseline)={:.3f}",
                adSet.getId(), conversions, pBetter);

        if (pBetter < KILL_THRESHOLD) {
            return kill(adSet, String.format("Gate 3: P(CVR>baseline)=%.2f%% < 10%% (conversions=%d)",
                    pBetter * 100, conversions));
        }

        adSet.setGateStatus("PASSED");
        adSetRepo.save(adSet);
        log.info("Gate 3 PASSED: adSet={} is a winner candidate", adSet.getId());
        return true;
    }

    // ─── Bayesian Monte Carlo ─────────────────────────────────────────────

    /**
     * P(θ1 > θ2) where θ1 ~ Beta(a1, b1) and θ2 ~ Beta(a2, b2).
     * Estimated via Monte Carlo (Marsaglia-Tsang Gamma sampler).
     */
    static double probBetter(double a1, double b1, double a2, double b2) {
        Random rng = new Random();
        int wins = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < MC_SAMPLES; i++) {
            if (sampleBeta(a1, b1, rng) > sampleBeta(a2, b2, rng)) wins++;
        }
        return (double) wins / MC_SAMPLES;
    }

    /**
     * Sample from Beta(alpha, beta) using Marsaglia-Tsang Gamma sampler.
     * Accurate for all alpha, beta > 0.
     */
    static double sampleBeta(double alpha, double beta, Random rng) {
        double g1 = sampleGamma(alpha, rng);
        double g2 = sampleGamma(beta, rng);
        return g1 / (g1 + g2);
    }

    /**
     * Marsaglia & Tsang (2000) Gamma sampler.
     * Works for shape > 0 via the GS/squeeze algorithm.
     */
    static double sampleGamma(double shape, Random rng) {
        if (shape < 1.0) {
            // Reduction: Gamma(a) = Gamma(a+1) * U^(1/a)
            return sampleGamma(shape + 1.0, rng) * Math.pow(rng.nextDouble(), 1.0 / shape);
        }
        double d = shape - 1.0 / 3.0;
        double c = 1.0 / Math.sqrt(9.0 * d);
        while (true) {
            double x, v;
            do {
                x = rng.nextGaussian();
                v = 1.0 + c * x;
            } while (v <= 0);
            v = v * v * v;
            double u = rng.nextDouble();
            if (u < 1.0 - 0.0331 * (x * x) * (x * x)) return d * v;
            if (Math.log(u) < 0.5 * x * x + d * (1.0 - v + Math.log(v))) return d * v;
        }
    }

    // ─── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private boolean kill(MetaAdSet adSet, String reason) {
        adSet.setGateStatus("KILLED");
        adSet.setGateKillReason(reason);
        adSet.setGateKillAt(Instant.now());
        adSet.setStatus("PAUSED");
        adSetRepo.save(adSet);
        log.info("KILLED adSet={} reason={}", adSet.getId(), reason);
        return true;
    }

    private static long safe(Long v) {
        return v == null ? 0L : v;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import com.marketingai.dto.webhook.GhlWebhookPayload;
import com.marketingai.entity.Tenant;
import com.marketingai.repository.TenantRepository;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.UUID;

@Slf4j
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class GhlWebhookService {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private final TenantRepository tenantRepo;
    private final CAPIForwardingService capiService;
    private final AppointmentService appointmentService;
    private final FunnelService funnelService;
    private final ValueFormulaService valueFormulaService;
    private final RewardService rewardService;
    private static final ObjectMapper MAPPER = new ObjectMapper();

    @Transactional
    public void process(UUID tenantId, GhlWebhookPayload payload) {
        Tenant tenant = tenantRepo.findById(tenantId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Tenant not found"));

        // 1. Log raw webhook for audit + replay
        logWebhook(tenantId, payload);

        String eventType = payload.getType();
        if (eventType == null) {
            log.warn("GHL webhook missing 'type' field for tenant {}", tenantId);
            return;
        }

        log.info("GHL webhook received: type={} contact={} tenant={}",
                eventType, payload.getContactId(), tenantId);

        // 2. Link GHL contact to session (email match — arch v1.1 §13.2)
        // ContactCreate fires for new contacts; ContactUpdate for returning leads.
        // Without ContactUpdate handling, returning leads are unattributed.
        String sessionId = null;
        if (payload.getEmail() != null) {
            sessionId = findSessionByEmail(tenantId, payload.getEmail());
            if (sessionId != null) {
                updateSessionGhlFields(sessionId, tenantId, payload);
            }
        }

        // 3. Handle appointment lifecycle with real GHL event names (arch v1.1 §13.1)
        handleAppointmentEvent(tenantId, eventType, sessionId, payload);

        // 4. Forward to CAPI — use DB-driven funnel if available, else legacy gate.
        String stageKey = funnelService.resolveStage(tenantId, eventType);
        if (!stageKey.isBlank()) {
            // CAPI v2: resolve session qualifiers for value formula
            Boolean selfAccredited = lookupSelfAccredited(sessionId, tenantId);
            String  ticketBucket   = lookupTicketBucket(sessionId, tenantId);
            capiService.forwardByStage(
                    tenant, stageKey,
                    payload.getContactId(), sessionId,
                    payload.getEmail(), payload.getPhone(),
                    selfAccredited, ticketBucket,
                    payload.getDealValue(), null,
                    valueFormulaService);
            // Reward ladder: notify RewardService of reached stage (8-3)
            if (sessionId != null) {
                try {
                    UUID sid = UUID.fromString(sessionId);
                    // variant_id from session (best-effort — may be null for old sessions)
                    String variantIdStr = lookupVariantId(sessionId, tenantId);
                    if (variantIdStr != null) {
                        rewardService.onStageReached(tenantId, sid, UUID.fromString(variantIdStr), stageKey);
                    }
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    log.warn("Reward stage notification failed: {}", e.getMessage());
                }
            }
        } else {
            // Legacy B2B quality gate fallback
            String capiKey = CAPIForwardingService.resolveGhlKey(
                    eventType, payload.getStatus(), payload.getAppointmentStatus());
            capiService.forward(
                    tenant, capiKey,
                    payload.getContactId(), sessionId,
                    payload.getEmail(), payload.getPhone(),
                    payload.getDealValue(), null);
        }
    }

    // ─── Appointment event handling (real GHL event names — arch v1.1 §13.1) ──

    private void handleAppointmentEvent(UUID tenantId, String eventType,
                                        String sessionId, GhlWebhookPayload payload) {
        switch (eventType) {
            // New appointment booked via GHL calendar
            case "AppointmentCreate" -> {
                Instant scheduledAt = parseInstant(payload.getStartTime());
                appointmentService.registerAppointment(
                        tenantId, sessionId, payload.getContactId(),
                        payload.getAppointmentId(),
                        scheduledAt != null ? scheduledAt : Instant.now()
                );
            }
            // AppointmentUpdate carries appointmentStatus: "showed" | "noshow"
            // Status is set MANUALLY by the sales rep in GHL (arch v1.1 §13.1).
            // Google Calendar API is NOT used — it only shows invite accepted/declined, not attendance.
            case "AppointmentUpdate" -> {
                String apptStatus = payload.getAppointmentStatus();
                if ("showed".equalsIgnoreCase(apptStatus)) {
                    appointmentService.markCompleted(tenantId, payload.getAppointmentId(), payload.getContactId());
                } else if ("noshow".equalsIgnoreCase(apptStatus)) {
                    appointmentService.markNoShow(tenantId, payload.getAppointmentId(), payload.getContactId());
                } else {
                    log.debug("AppointmentUpdate with unhandled status='{}' for appointment {}",
                            apptStatus, payload.getAppointmentId());
                }
            }
            default -> { /* ContactCreate, ContactUpdate, OpportunityStatusUpdate handled via CAPI */ }
        }
    }

    private Instant parseInstant(String iso) {
        if (iso == null || iso.isBlank()) return null;
        try {
            return Instant.parse(iso);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.warn("Could not parse appointment startTime: {}", iso);
            return null;
        }
    }

    // ─── Session matching ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /**
     * Find the most recent session for a tenant where a FORM_SUBMIT event
     * was recorded with the given email in event_data.
     */
    private String findSessionByEmail(UUID tenantId, String email) {
        try {
            return jdbc.queryForObject(
                    """
                    SELECT s.id FROM sessions s
                    JOIN events e ON e.session_id = s.id AND e.event_time > now() - INTERVAL '30 days'
                    WHERE s.tenant_id = ?
                      AND e.event_type = 'FORM_SUBMIT'
                      AND e.event_data->>'email' = ?
                    ORDER BY e.event_time DESC
                    LIMIT 1
                    """,
                    String.class, tenantId, email
            );
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return null; // no match found
        }
    }

    private void updateSessionGhlFields(String sessionId, UUID tenantId, GhlWebhookPayload p) {
        // arch v1.1 §13.1: real GHL event names — OpportunityStatusUpdate with status field
        String eventType = p.getType();
        String statusField = p.getStatus(); // "won" | "lost" from OpportunityStatusUpdate
        jdbc.update(
                """
                UPDATE sessions SET
                    ghl_contact_id     = COALESCE(ghl_contact_id, ?),
                    ghl_opportunity_id = COALESCE(ghl_opportunity_id, ?),
                    pipeline_stage     = COALESCE(?, pipeline_stage),
                    deal_value         = COALESCE(?, deal_value),
                    deal_status        = CASE
                        WHEN ? = 'OpportunityStatusUpdate' AND ? = 'won'  THEN 'won'
                        WHEN ? = 'OpportunityStatusUpdate' AND ? = 'lost' THEN 'lost'
                        ELSE deal_status
                    END,
                    converted = CASE
                        WHEN ? = 'OpportunityStatusUpdate' AND ? = 'won' THEN true
                        ELSE converted
                    END
                WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ?
                """,
                p.getContactId(),
                p.getOpportunityId(),
                p.getPipelineStage(),
                p.getDealValue() != null ? p.getDealValue().floatValue() : null,
                eventType, statusField,
                eventType, statusField,
                eventType, statusField,
                sessionId, tenantId
        );
        log.debug("Session {} linked to GHL contact {}", sessionId, p.getContactId());
    }

    // ─── Session qualifier lookups for CAPI v2 ───────────────────────────────

    private Boolean lookupSelfAccredited(String sessionId, UUID tenantId) {
        if (sessionId == null) return null;
        try {
            return jdbc.queryForObject(
                    "SELECT self_accredited FROM sessions WHERE id = ?::uuid AND tenant_id = ? LIMIT 1",
                    Boolean.class, sessionId, tenantId);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private String lookupTicketBucket(String sessionId, UUID tenantId) {
        if (sessionId == null) return null;
        try {
            return jdbc.queryForObject(
                    "SELECT ticket_bucket FROM sessions WHERE id = ?::uuid AND tenant_id = ? LIMIT 1",
                    String.class, sessionId, tenantId);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private String lookupVariantId(String sessionId, UUID tenantId) {
        if (sessionId == null) return null;
        try {
            return jdbc.queryForObject(
                    "SELECT variant_id::text FROM sessions WHERE id = ?::uuid AND tenant_id = ? LIMIT 1",
                    String.class, sessionId, tenantId);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    // ─── Webhook audit log ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private void logWebhook(UUID tenantId, GhlWebhookPayload payload) {
        try {
            String json = MAPPER.writeValueAsString(payload);
            jdbc.update(
                    """
                    INSERT INTO ghl_webhook_log
                        (tenant_id, event_type, ghl_contact_id, ghl_opportunity_id, payload)
                    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?::jsonb)
                    """,
                    tenantId,
                    payload.getType(),
                    payload.getContactId(),
                    payload.getOpportunityId(),
                    json
            );
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.warn("Failed to log GHL webhook: {}", e.getMessage());
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.node.ObjectNode;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.*;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.web.client.HttpClientErrorException;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;
import org.springframework.web.util.UriComponentsBuilder;

import java.net.URI;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * Google Ads API v17 wrapper (Phase 7).
 * Docs: https://developers.google.com/google-ads/api/docs/start
 */
@Slf4j
@Service
public class GoogleAdsApiService {

    private static final String BASE_URL = "https://googleads.googleapis.com/v17";
    private static final ObjectMapper MAPPER = new ObjectMapper();

    private final RestTemplate rest = new RestTemplate();

    public List<Map<String, Object>> getCampaigns(String accessToken, String customerId) {
        String gaql = "SELECT campaign.id, campaign.name, campaign.status, " +
                "campaign.advertising_channel_type " +
                "FROM campaign WHERE campaign.status != 'REMOVED'";

        String url = UriComponentsBuilder.fromUri(URI.create(BASE_URL))
                .path("/customers/{customerId}/googleAds:searchStream")
                .buildAndExpand(customerId)
                .toUriString();

        ObjectNode body = MAPPER.createObjectNode().put("query", gaql);
        HttpHeaders headers = buildHeaders(accessToken);

        try {
            JsonNode resp = rest.postForObject(
                    url, new HttpEntity<>(body.toString(), headers), JsonNode.class);
            List<Map<String, Object>> campaigns = new ArrayList<>();
            if (resp != null && resp.isArray()) {
                for (JsonNode batch : resp) {
                    JsonNode results = batch.path("results");
                    if (results.isArray()) {
                        for (JsonNode row : results) {
                            JsonNode c = row.path("campaign");
                            campaigns.add(Map.of(
                                    "id",      c.path("id").asText(),
                                    "name",    c.path("name").asText(),
                                    "status",  c.path("status").asText(),
                                    "channel", c.path("advertisingChannelType").asText()
                            ));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            return campaigns;
        } catch (HttpClientErrorException e) {
            log.error("Google Ads getCampaigns failed {}: {}", e.getStatusCode(), e.getResponseBodyAsString());
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_GATEWAY, "Google Ads API error: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    public Map<String, String> getCampaignInsights(
            String accessToken, String customerId, String campaignId, String dateRangeType) {
        if (!customerId.matches("[\\d\\-]+") || !campaignId.matches("\\d+")) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "Invalid Google Ads IDs");
        }
        String resourceName = "customers/" + customerId + "/campaigns/" + campaignId;
        String gaql = "SELECT campaign.id, metrics.impressions, metrics.clicks, " +
                "metrics.cost_micros, metrics.conversions " +
                "FROM campaign " +
                "WHERE campaign.resource_name = '" + resourceName + "' " +
                "AND segments.date DURING " + dateRangeType;

        String url = UriComponentsBuilder.fromUri(URI.create(BASE_URL))
                .path("/customers/{customerId}/googleAds:searchStream")
                .buildAndExpand(customerId)
                .toUriString();

        ObjectNode body = MAPPER.createObjectNode().put("query", gaql);
        HttpHeaders headers = buildHeaders(accessToken);

        try {
            JsonNode resp = rest.postForObject(
                    url, new HttpEntity<>(body.toString(), headers), JsonNode.class);

            if (resp != null && resp.isArray() && !resp.isEmpty()) {
                JsonNode results = resp.get(0).path("results");
                if (results.isArray() && !results.isEmpty()) {
                    JsonNode metrics = results.get(0).path("metrics");
                    long costMicros = metrics.path("costMicros").asLong(0);
                    return Map.of(
                            "impressions", metrics.path("impressions").asText("0"),
                            "clicks",      metrics.path("clicks").asText("0"),
                            "spend",       String.valueOf(costMicros / 1_000_000.0),
                            "conversions", metrics.path("conversions").asText("0")
                    );
                }
            }
            return Map.of("impressions", "0", "clicks", "0", "spend", "0", "conversions", "0");
        } catch (HttpClientErrorException e) {
            log.error("Google Ads getInsights failed {}: {}", e.getStatusCode(), e.getResponseBodyAsString());
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_GATEWAY, "Google Ads API error: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    public void setCampaignStatus(String accessToken, String customerId, String campaignId, String status) {
        String url = UriComponentsBuilder.fromUri(URI.create(BASE_URL))
                .path("/customers/{customerId}/campaigns/{campaignId}")
                .buildAndExpand(customerId, campaignId)
                .toUriString();

        ObjectNode body = MAPPER.createObjectNode().put("status", status);
        HttpHeaders headers = buildHeaders(accessToken);
        headers.set("X-HTTP-Method-Override", "PATCH");

        try {
            rest.postForObject(url, new HttpEntity<>(body.toString(), headers), String.class);
            log.info("Google Ads campaign {} → {}", campaignId, status);
        } catch (HttpClientErrorException e) {
            log.error("Google Ads setStatus failed {}: {}", e.getStatusCode(), e.getResponseBodyAsString());
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_GATEWAY, "Google Ads API error: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    private HttpHeaders buildHeaders(String accessToken) {
        HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
        headers.setContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
        headers.setBearerAuth(accessToken);
        return headers;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * Predicted Lead Value at Day 0 (vision §19.18.3; arch §16.16).
 * Called after noshow scoring. Persists prediction for calibration tracking.
 */
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Slf4j
public class LeadValueService {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private final RestTemplate restTemplate;

    public void predictOnBooked(UUID tenantId, UUID appointmentId, UUID sessionId) {
        List<Map<String, Object>> noshowRows = jdbc.queryForList("""
            SELECT noshow_prob FROM noshow_scores
            WHERE appointment_id = ? AND tenant_id = ?
            ORDER BY scored_at DESC LIMIT 1
            """, appointmentId, tenantId);

        double pShow = noshowRows.isEmpty()
            ? 0.70
            : 1.0 - ((Number) noshowRows.get(0).get("noshow_prob")).doubleValue();

        List<String> buckets = jdbc.queryForList(
            "SELECT ticket_bucket FROM sessions WHERE id = ?", String.class, sessionId);
        String ticketBucket = buckets.isEmpty() ? null : buckets.get(0);

        Map<String, Object> req = new HashMap<>();
        req.put("p_show",        pShow);
        req.put("ticket_bucket", ticketBucket != null ? ticketBucket : "");

        try {
            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
            Map<String, Object> result = restTemplate.postForObject(
                "http://ml-service:8001/predict/lead-value", req, Map.class);
            if (result == null) return;

            double predicted = ((Number) result.get("predicted_value")).doubleValue();
            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
            Map<String, Object> components = (Map<String, Object>) result.get("components");

            jdbc.update("""
                INSERT INTO lead_value_predictions
                    (tenant_id, session_id, appointment_id, p_show,
                     p_verified_given_show, p_invest_given_verified,
                     e_ticket, predicted_value, model_version)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                """, tenantId, sessionId, appointmentId, pShow,
                components.getOrDefault("p_verified_given_show", 0.65),
                components.getOrDefault("p_invest_given_verified", 0.21),
                components.getOrDefault("e_ticket", 75000.0),
                predicted,
                result.getOrDefault("model_version", "seed_v1"));

            log.debug("Lead value predicted: appointment={} value={}", appointmentId, predicted);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.warn("Lead value prediction failed for {}: {}", appointmentId, e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    public void recordRealised(UUID tenantId, UUID sessionId, double realisedValue) {
        jdbc.update("""
            UPDATE lead_value_predictions
            SET realised_value = ?, realised_at = NOW()
            WHERE session_id = ? AND tenant_id = ? AND realised_value IS NULL
            """, realisedValue, sessionId, tenantId);
    }

    private String toJson(Object o) {
        try { return new ObjectMapper().writeValueAsString(o); }
        catch (Exception e) { return "{}"; }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Logs learning phase before/after every Meta write (vision §6.5, §25 p.8).
 * phase_after is filled by LearningPhaseCheckScheduler 24h after the action.
 */
@Slf4j
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class LearningPhaseService {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;

    /**
     * Record learning phase before a Meta action.
     * @return the log row UUID (pass to logPhaseAfter when updating)
     */
    public UUID logBeforeAction(UUID tenantId, String adSetId, String action, String phaseBefore) {
        UUID id = UUID.randomUUID();
        jdbc.update("""
                INSERT INTO learning_phase_log
                    (id, tenant_id, ad_set_id, action, phase_before)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                """, id, tenantId, adSetId, action, phaseBefore);
        log.debug("LearningPhase logged: tenant={} adSet={} action={} before={}",
                tenantId, adSetId, action, phaseBefore);
        return id;
    }

    /**
     * Fill in phase_after once the result is known (called 24h later by scheduler).
     */
    public void logPhaseAfter(UUID logId, String phaseAfter) {
        int rows = jdbc.update("""
                UPDATE learning_phase_log
                   SET phase_after = ?, phase_checked_at = now()
                 WHERE id = ?
                """, phaseAfter, logId);
        if (rows > 0) {
            log.debug("LearningPhase updated: logId={} phaseAfter={}", logId, phaseAfter);
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import com.marketingai.config.AppProperties;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.condition.ConditionalOnProperty;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.UncheckedIOException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.UUID;

@Service
@ConditionalOnProperty(name = "app.storage.type", havingValue = "local", matchIfMissing = true)
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Slf4j
public class LocalStorageService implements StorageService {

    private final AppProperties props;

    @Override
    public String store(UUID tenantId, UUID creativeId, String originalFilename, byte[] bytes) {
        String sanitized = sanitize(originalFilename);
        Path dir = Path.of(props.getStorage().getLocalPath(), tenantId.toString(), creativeId.toString());
        try {
            Files.createDirectories(dir);
            Path target = dir.resolve(sanitized);
            Files.write(target, bytes);
            log.debug("Stored file: {}", target);
        } catch (IOException e) {
            throw new UncheckedIOException("Failed to store file " + sanitized, e);
        }
        return "/files/" + tenantId + "/" + creativeId + "/" + sanitized;
    }

    private String sanitize(String filename) {
        if (filename == null || filename.isBlank()) return "upload";
        return filename.replaceAll("[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]", "_");
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

    public void log(UUID tenantId, String actorType, UUID actorId,

                    String requestHash, int responseCode, String lane, long durationMs) {
        try {
            jdbc.update("""
                    INSERT INTO meta_api_audit
                        (tenant_id, actor_type, actor_id, action, target_type, target_id,
                         request_hash, response_code, queue_lane, duration_ms)
                    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)

        }

                SELECT id, actor_type, action, target_type, target_id, response_code,
                       queue_lane, duration_ms, created_at
                FROM meta_api_audit

                ORDER BY created_at DESC
                LIMIT ?
                """, tenantId, limit);
    }
```
