```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import com.marketingai.config.AppProperties;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.ArrayBlockingQueue;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong;

/**
 * Priority-queue wrapper for Meta Graph API calls (3-15).
 * Three lanes: P0 (emergency/pause), P1 (learning-phase), P2 (bid/budget).
 * Token bucket: 100 calls/hour — refilled each hour.
 * All calls are logged to learning_phase_log.
 */
@Slf4j
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class MetaApiClient {

    private static final int TOKEN_BUCKET_CAPACITY = 100;

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private final AppProperties appProperties;

    private final AtomicInteger tokenBucket = new AtomicInteger(TOKEN_BUCKET_CAPACITY);
    private final AtomicLong bucketRefillAt = new AtomicLong(System.currentTimeMillis() + 3_600_000L);

    // P0 is unbounded — emergencies always execute
    private final ArrayBlockingQueue<Runnable> p1Queue = new ArrayBlockingQueue<>(200);
    private final ArrayBlockingQueue<Runnable> p2Queue = new ArrayBlockingQueue<>(500);

    /**
     * Enqueue a Meta API call.
     * P0 executes immediately (bypasses token bucket).
     * P1/P2 respect the token bucket.
     */
    public void enqueue(String lane, String adSetId, UUID tenantId, String action, Runnable call) {
        refillBucketIfNeeded();

        switch (lane.toUpperCase()) {
            case "P0" -> executeP0(tenantId, adSetId, action, call);
            case "P1" -> scheduleWithBucket("P1", tenantId, adSetId, action, call);
            case "P2" -> scheduleWithBucket("P2", tenantId, adSetId, action, call);
            default   -> {
                log.warn("Unknown Meta API lane '{}' — defaulting to P2", lane);
                scheduleWithBucket("P2", tenantId, adSetId, action, call);
            }
        }
    }

    private void executeP0(UUID tenantId, String adSetId, String action, Runnable call) {
        log.info("MetaApiClient P0 execute: tenant={} adSet={} action={}", tenantId, adSetId, action);
        try {
            call.run();
            logCall(tenantId, adSetId, action, "P0", "SUCCESS");
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("MetaApiClient P0 failed: tenant={} action={} error={}", tenantId, action, e.getMessage());
            logCall(tenantId, adSetId, action, "P0", "FAILED:" + e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    private void scheduleWithBucket(String lane, UUID tenantId, String adSetId, String action, Runnable call) {
        int remaining = tokenBucket.getAndDecrement();
        if (remaining <= 0) {
            tokenBucket.incrementAndGet(); // return token
            log.warn("MetaApiClient token bucket exhausted for lane={} action={}", lane, action);
            return;
        }
        log.info("MetaApiClient {} execute: tenant={} adSet={} action={} tokens_left={}",
                lane, tenantId, adSetId, action, remaining - 1);
        try {
            call.run();
            logCall(tenantId, adSetId, action, lane, "SUCCESS");
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("MetaApiClient {} failed: tenant={} action={} error={}", lane, tenantId, action, e.getMessage());
            logCall(tenantId, adSetId, action, lane, "FAILED:" + e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    private void refillBucketIfNeeded() {
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        long refillAt = bucketRefillAt.get();
        if (now >= refillAt && bucketRefillAt.compareAndSet(refillAt, now + 3_600_000L)) {
            tokenBucket.set(TOKEN_BUCKET_CAPACITY);
            log.info("MetaApiClient token bucket refilled to {}", TOKEN_BUCKET_CAPACITY);
        }
    }

    public void recordLearningPhaseChange(UUID adSetId, UUID tenantId,
                                           String phaseBefore, String phaseAfter, String action) {
        try {
            jdbc.update("""
                    INSERT INTO learning_phase_log
                    (ad_set_id, tenant_id, phase_before, phase_after, action, logged_at)
                    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, now())
                    """, adSetId, tenantId, phaseBefore, phaseAfter, action);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.warn("Failed to record learning_phase_log: {}", e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    private void logCall(UUID tenantId, String adSetId, String action, String lane, String status) {
        try {
            UUID adSetUuid = adSetId != null ? UUID.fromString(adSetId) : null;
            jdbc.update("""
                    INSERT INTO learning_phase_log
                    (ad_set_id, tenant_id, phase_before, phase_after, action, logged_at)
                    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, now())
                    """, adSetUuid, tenantId, lane, status, action);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.trace("learning_phase_log insert skipped (non-adset call): {}", e.getMessage());
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.node.ObjectNode;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.HttpEntity;
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.web.client.HttpClientErrorException;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;
import org.springframework.web.util.UriComponentsBuilder;

import java.net.URI;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Low-level wrapper over Meta Graph API v20.0.
 * Uses RestTemplate (synchronous) — rate-limit retries are caller's responsibility.
 * Docs: https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/reference
 */
@Slf4j
@Service
public class MetaApiService {

    private static final String BASE_URL = "https://graph.facebook.com/v20.0";
    private static final ObjectMapper MAPPER = new ObjectMapper();

    private final RestTemplate rest = new RestTemplate();

    // ─── Campaigns ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /**
     * Create a campaign in Meta Ads Manager.
     * Returns Meta's campaign ID (e.g. "120210000000000").
     */
    public String createCampaign(String accessToken, String adAccountId,
                                 String name, String objective, Float dailyBudget) {
        ObjectNode body = MAPPER.createObjectNode()
                .put("name", name)
                .put("objective", objective)
                .put("status", "PAUSED");
        body.putArray("special_ad_categories");

        if (dailyBudget != null) {
            body.put("daily_budget", Math.round(dailyBudget * 100)); // cents
        }

        return postAndGetId(accessToken, "/" + adAccountId + "/campaigns", body);
    }

    /**
     * Set campaign status: ACTIVE, PAUSED, ARCHIVED, DELETED.
     */
    public void setCampaignStatus(String accessToken, String metaCampaignId, String status) {
        ObjectNode body = MAPPER.createObjectNode().put("status", status);
        post(accessToken, "/" + metaCampaignId, body);
        log.info("Meta campaign {} → {}", metaCampaignId, status);
    }

    // ─── Ad Sets ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /**
     * Create an ad set under the given campaign.
     * Returns Meta's ad set ID.
     */
    public String createAdSet(String accessToken, String adAccountId,
                              String metaCampaignId, String name,
                              String audienceSpec, Float dailyBudget) {
        ObjectNode body = MAPPER.createObjectNode()
                .put("name", name)
                .put("campaign_id", metaCampaignId)
                .put("billing_event", "IMPRESSIONS")
                .put("optimization_goal", "REACH")
                .put("status", "PAUSED");

        if (dailyBudget != null) {
            body.put("daily_budget", Math.round(dailyBudget * 100));
        }

        if (audienceSpec != null) {
            try {
                JsonNode spec = MAPPER.readTree(audienceSpec);
                body.set("targeting", spec);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.warn("Invalid audienceSpec JSON, skipping targeting: {}", e.getMessage());
            }
        }

        return postAndGetId(accessToken, "/" + adAccountId + "/adsets", body);
    }

    /**
     * Set ad set status: ACTIVE, PAUSED, ARCHIVED.
     */
    public void setAdSetStatus(String accessToken, String metaAdSetId, String status) {
        ObjectNode body = MAPPER.createObjectNode().put("status", status);
        post(accessToken, "/" + metaAdSetId, body);
        log.info("Meta ad set {} → {}", metaAdSetId, status);
    }

    // ─── Insights ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /**
     * Fetch today's metrics for a campaign or ad set.
     * Returns: {"spend", "impressions", "clicks", "conversions"}
     * conversions = "actions" of type "offsite_conversion.fb_pixel_purchase" or "lead"
     */
    public Map<String, String> getInsights(String accessToken, String objectId) {
        String url = UriComponentsBuilder.fromUri(URI.create(BASE_URL))
                .path("/{id}/insights")
                .queryParam("fields", "spend,impressions,clicks,actions")
                .queryParam("date_preset", "today")
                .queryParam("access_token", accessToken)
                .buildAndExpand(objectId)
                .toUriString();

        try {
            JsonNode resp = rest.getForObject(url, JsonNode.class);
            JsonNode data = resp != null ? resp.path("data") : null;
            if (data != null && data.isArray() && !data.isEmpty()) {
                JsonNode row = data.get(0);
                String conversions = extractConversions(row.path("actions"));
                return Map.of(
                        "spend",       row.path("spend").asText("0"),
                        "impressions", row.path("impressions").asText("0"),
                        "clicks",      row.path("clicks").asText("0"),
                        "conversions", conversions
                );
            }
            return Map.of("spend", "0", "impressions", "0", "clicks", "0", "conversions", "0");
        } catch (HttpClientErrorException e) {
            log.error("Meta insights error {}: {}", e.getStatusCode(), e.getResponseBodyAsString());
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_GATEWAY, "Meta API error: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    // ─── Custom Audiences (Phase 5-5) ──────────────────────────────────────────

    /**
     * Create or update a Meta Custom Audience from hashed email list.
     *
     * Custom audiences = hints to Advantage+ — NOT hard targeting (§25 п.12).
     * Only hashed emails (SHA-256, lowercase, trimmed) are sent — no PII.
     *
     * Returns the Meta custom audience ID.
     */
    public String upsertCustomAudience(
            String accessToken,
            String adAccountId,
            String name,
            String description,
            List<String> hashedEmails) {

        // Create the custom audience if it doesn't exist (idempotent by name via Meta dedup)
        ObjectNode createBody = MAPPER.createObjectNode()
                .put("name", name)
                .put("subtype", "CUSTOM")
                .put("description", description)
                .put("customer_file_source", "PARTNER_PROVIDED_ONLY");

        String audienceId = postAndGetId(accessToken, "/" + adAccountId + "/customaudiences", createBody);

        // Upload hashed emails to the audience
        if (!hashedEmails.isEmpty()) {
            ObjectNode uploadBody  = MAPPER.createObjectNode();
            ObjectNode payloadNode = MAPPER.createObjectNode();
            com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.node.ArrayNode schemaNode = MAPPER.createArrayNode();
            schemaNode.add("EMAIL_SHA256");
            payloadNode.set("schema", schemaNode);

            com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.node.ArrayNode dataNode = MAPPER.createArrayNode();
            for (String email : hashedEmails) {
                com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.node.ArrayNode row = MAPPER.createArrayNode();
                row.add(email);
                dataNode.add(row);
            }
            payloadNode.set("data", dataNode);
            uploadBody.set("payload", payloadNode);

            post(accessToken, "/" + audienceId + "/users", uploadBody);
            log.info("Uploaded {} hashed emails to Meta audience {}", hashedEmails.size(), audienceId);
        }

        return audienceId;
    }

    /** Sums purchase + lead conversion action types from Meta insights actions array */
    private String extractConversions(JsonNode actions) {
        if (actions == null || !actions.isArray()) return "0";
        long total = 0;
        for (JsonNode action : actions) {
            String type = action.path("action_type").asText("");
            if (type.contains("purchase") || type.contains("lead") || type.equals("complete_registration")) {
                total += action.path("value").asLong(0);
            }
        }
        return String.valueOf(total);
    }

    // ─── Learning Phase (vision §6.5) ──────────────────────────────────────────

    /**
     * Read the current effective_status and learning_phase for an ad set.
     * Returns null if the API call fails (caller should treat as unknown phase).
     */
    public String getAdSetLearningPhase(String accessToken, String metaAdSetId) {
        String url = UriComponentsBuilder.fromUri(URI.create(BASE_URL))
                .path("/" + metaAdSetId)
                .queryParam("fields", "effective_status,learning_phase")
                .queryParam("access_token", accessToken)
                .build()
                .toUriString();
        try {
            JsonNode resp = rest.getForObject(url, JsonNode.class);
            if (resp != null && resp.has("learning_phase")) {
                return resp.get("learning_phase").asText(null);
            }
            if (resp != null && resp.has("effective_status")) {
                return resp.get("effective_status").asText(null);
            }
            return null;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.warn("Could not read learning_phase for ad set {}: {}", metaAdSetId, e.getMessage());
            return null;
        }
    }

    // ─── Internal helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private String postAndGetId(String accessToken, String path, ObjectNode body) {
        String url = UriComponentsBuilder.fromUri(URI.create(BASE_URL))
                .path(path)
                .queryParam("access_token", accessToken)
                .build()
                .toUriString();

        HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
        headers.setContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);

        try {
            JsonNode resp = rest.postForObject(url, new HttpEntity<>(body.toString(), headers), JsonNode.class);
            if (resp == null || !resp.has("id")) {
                throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_GATEWAY,
                        "Meta API returned no ID for path " + path);
            }
            return resp.get("id").asText();
        } catch (HttpClientErrorException e) {
            log.error("Meta API POST {} failed {}: {}", path, e.getStatusCode(), e.getResponseBodyAsString());
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_GATEWAY, "Meta API error: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    private void post(String accessToken, String path, ObjectNode body) {
        String url = UriComponentsBuilder.fromUri(URI.create(BASE_URL))
                .path(path)
                .queryParam("access_token", accessToken)
                .build()
                .toUriString();

        HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
        headers.setContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);

        try {
            rest.postForObject(url, new HttpEntity<>(body.toString(), headers), String.class);
        } catch (HttpClientErrorException e) {
            log.error("Meta API POST {} failed {}: {}", path, e.getStatusCode(), e.getResponseBodyAsString());
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_GATEWAY, "Meta API error: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import com.marketingai.dto.meta.AdSetRequest;
import com.marketingai.dto.meta.AdSetResponse;
import com.marketingai.dto.meta.CampaignRequest;
import com.marketingai.dto.meta.CampaignResponse;
import com.marketingai.entity.MetaAdSet;
import com.marketingai.entity.MetaCampaign;
import com.marketingai.entity.Tenant;
import com.marketingai.repository.MetaAdSetRepository;
import com.marketingai.repository.MetaCampaignRepository;
import com.marketingai.repository.TenantRepository;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

@Slf4j
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class MetaCampaignService {

    private final MetaCampaignRepository campaignRepo;
    private final MetaAdSetRepository adSetRepo;
    private final MetaApiService metaApi;
    private final TenantRepository tenantRepo;

    // ─── Campaigns ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Transactional
    public CampaignResponse createCampaign(UUID tenantId, CampaignRequest req) {
        Tenant tenant = requireTenant(tenantId);
        String token = decodeToken(tenant);
        String adAccountId = tenant.getMetaAdAccountId();
        if (adAccountId == null) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "Tenant has no Meta ad account ID configured");
        }

        String metaCampaignId = metaApi.createCampaign(
                token, adAccountId, req.getName(), req.getObjective(), req.getDailyBudget());

        MetaCampaign campaign = new MetaCampaign();
        campaign.setTenantId(tenantId);
        campaign.setMetaCampaignId(metaCampaignId);
        campaign.setName(req.getName());
        campaign.setObjective(req.getObjective());
        campaign.setContour(req.getContour() != null ? req.getContour() : "TEST");
        campaign.setDailyBudget(req.getDailyBudget());
        campaign.setStatus("PAUSED");

        return toResponse(campaignRepo.save(campaign));
    }

    public List<CampaignResponse> listCampaigns(UUID tenantId) {
        return campaignRepo.findAllByTenantId(tenantId)
                .stream().map(this::toResponse).toList();
    }

    @Transactional
    public CampaignResponse pauseCampaign(UUID tenantId, UUID campaignId) {
        return setStatus(tenantId, campaignId, "PAUSED");
    }

    @Transactional
    public CampaignResponse activateCampaign(UUID tenantId, UUID campaignId) {
        return setStatus(tenantId, campaignId, "ACTIVE");
    }

    /**
     * Transfer winner from TEST contour to SCALE contour.
     * Creates a SCALE campaign if one doesn't exist, then migrates the winning ad set.
     */
    @Transactional
    public CampaignResponse transferToScale(UUID tenantId, UUID winnerAdSetId) {
        MetaAdSet winner = adSetRepo.findById(winnerAdSetId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Ad set not found"));

        if (!winner.getTenantId().equals(tenantId)) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN);
        }

        Tenant tenant = requireTenant(tenantId);
        String token = decodeToken(tenant);
        String adAccountId = tenant.getMetaAdAccountId();

        // Find or create SCALE campaign
        MetaCampaign scale = campaignRepo.findByTenantIdAndContour(tenantId, "SCALE")
                .orElseGet(() -> {
                    String metaId = metaApi.createCampaign(
                            token, adAccountId, "SCALE Campaign", "CONVERSIONS", null);
                    MetaCampaign c = new MetaCampaign();
                    c.setTenantId(tenantId);
                    c.setMetaCampaignId(metaId);
                    c.setName("SCALE Campaign");
                    c.setObjective("CONVERSIONS");
                    c.setContour("SCALE");
                    c.setStatus("PAUSED");
                    return campaignRepo.save(c);
                });

        // Move winner ad set to SCALE campaign
        winner.setCampaignId(scale.getId());
        adSetRepo.save(winner);

        log.info("Transferred ad set {} to SCALE campaign {} for tenant {}",
                winnerAdSetId, scale.getId(), tenantId);
        return toResponse(scale);
    }

    // ─── Ad Sets ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Transactional
    public AdSetResponse createAdSet(UUID tenantId, AdSetRequest req) {
        if (req.getCampaignId() == null) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "campaignId is required");
        }
        MetaCampaign campaign = campaignRepo.findById(req.getCampaignId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Campaign not found"));
        if (!campaign.getTenantId().equals(tenantId)) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN);
        }

        Tenant tenant = requireTenant(tenantId);
        String token = decodeToken(tenant);
        String adAccountId = tenant.getMetaAdAccountId();

        String metaAdSetId = metaApi.createAdSet(
                token, adAccountId, campaign.getMetaCampaignId(),
                req.getName(), req.getAudienceSpec(), req.getDailyBudget());

        MetaAdSet adSet = new MetaAdSet();
        adSet.setTenantId(tenantId);
        adSet.setCampaignId(campaign.getId());
        adSet.setMetaAdSetId(metaAdSetId);
        adSet.setCreativeId(req.getCreativeId());
        adSet.setAudienceSpec(req.getAudienceSpec());
        adSet.setDailyBudget(req.getDailyBudget());
        adSet.setStatus("PAUSED");

        return toAdSetResponse(adSetRepo.save(adSet));
    }

    public List<AdSetResponse> listAdSets(UUID tenantId, UUID campaignId) {
        return adSetRepo.findAllByCampaignId(campaignId)
                .stream()
                .filter(a -> a.getTenantId().equals(tenantId))
                .map(this::toAdSetResponse)
                .toList();
    }

    // ─── Internal ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private CampaignResponse setStatus(UUID tenantId, UUID campaignId, String status) {
        MetaCampaign campaign = campaignRepo.findById(campaignId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Campaign not found"));
        if (!campaign.getTenantId().equals(tenantId)) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN);
        }

        Tenant tenant = requireTenant(tenantId);
        metaApi.setCampaignStatus(decodeToken(tenant), campaign.getMetaCampaignId(), status);
        campaign.setStatus(status);
        return toResponse(campaignRepo.save(campaign));
    }

    private Tenant requireTenant(UUID tenantId) {
        return tenantRepo.findById(tenantId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Tenant not found"));
    }

    private String decodeToken(Tenant tenant) {
        if (tenant.getMetaAccessTokenEnc() == null) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "Tenant has no Meta access token configured");
        }
        return new String(tenant.getMetaAccessTokenEnc(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
    }

    CampaignResponse toResponse(MetaCampaign c) {
        return CampaignResponse.builder()
                .id(c.getId())
                .tenantId(c.getTenantId())
                .metaCampaignId(c.getMetaCampaignId())
                .name(c.getName())
                .objective(c.getObjective())
                .contour(c.getContour())
                .dailyBudget(c.getDailyBudget())
                .status(c.getStatus())
                .learningPhase(c.getLearningPhase())
                .spendToday(c.getSpendToday())
                .spendTotal(c.getSpendTotal())
                .confirmationAdSetId(c.getConfirmationAdSetId())
                .confirmationStatus(c.getConfirmationStatus())
                .syncedAt(c.getSyncedAt())
                .createdAt(c.getCreatedAt())
                .build();
    }

    AdSetResponse toAdSetResponse(MetaAdSet a) {
        return AdSetResponse.builder()
                .id(a.getId())
                .campaignId(a.getCampaignId())
                .metaAdSetId(a.getMetaAdSetId())
                .metaAdId(a.getMetaAdId())
                .creativeId(a.getCreativeId())
                .audienceSpec(a.getAudienceSpec())
                .dailyBudget(a.getDailyBudget())
                .status(a.getStatus())
                .learningPhase(a.getLearningPhase())
                .spendToday(a.getSpendToday())
                .spendTotal(a.getSpendTotal())
                .batchId(a.getBatchId())
                .batchLaunchedAt(a.getBatchLaunchedAt())
                .isExplorationSlot(a.isExplorationSlot())
                .syncedAt(a.getSyncedAt())
                .createdAt(a.getCreatedAt())
                .build();
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import com.marketingai.dto.pixel.CreatePixelRequest;
import com.marketingai.dto.pixel.PixelResponse;
import com.marketingai.dto.pixel.UpdatePixelRequest;
import com.marketingai.entity.MetaPixel;
import com.marketingai.repository.MetaPixelRepository;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Phase 0-9: Multi-Pixel management — §6.8 Pixel Pollution Protection.
 *
 * Each tenant can have multiple pixels with different purposes:
 *  PRIMARY — clean pixel, only confirmed CRM conversions → scale contour
 *  TEST    — isolated pixel for test campaigns → prevents pollution of primary
 *  PRODUCT — per-product pixel when client has multiple product lines
 *
 * Quality filter (JSONB on the pixel) controls which GHL events qualify for
 * CAPI forwarding on that pixel. Empty = use platform B2B defaults (§16.1).
 */
@Slf4j
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class MetaPixelService {

    private final MetaPixelRepository pixelRepo;
    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private static final ObjectMapper MAPPER = new ObjectMapper();

    public List<PixelResponse> listForTenant(UUID tenantId) {
        return pixelRepo.findByTenantIdAndStatus(tenantId, "ACTIVE")
                .stream()
                .map(PixelResponse::from)
                .toList();
    }

    public PixelResponse getOwned(UUID id, UUID tenantId) {
        return PixelResponse.from(findOwned(id, tenantId));
    }

    @Transactional
    public PixelResponse create(UUID tenantId, CreatePixelRequest req) {
        // Prevent duplicate pixel_id per tenant
        boolean exists = pixelRepo.findByTenantIdAndStatus(tenantId, "ACTIVE")
                .stream()
                .anyMatch(p -> p.getPixelId().equals(req.getPixelId()));
        if (exists) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "Pixel ID " + req.getPixelId() + " already exists for this tenant");
        }

        if (req.isDefault()) {
            unsetCurrentDefault(tenantId);
        }

        MetaPixel pixel = new MetaPixel();
        pixel.setTenantId(tenantId);
        pixel.setPixelId(req.getPixelId());
        pixel.setName(req.getName());
        pixel.setPurpose(req.getPurpose() != null ? req.getPurpose() : "PRIMARY");
        pixel.setDefaultPixel(req.isDefault());
        pixel.setQualityFilter(toJson(req.getQualityFilter()));
        pixel.setStatus("ACTIVE");

        if (req.getCapiAccessToken() != null && !req.getCapiAccessToken().isBlank()) {
            pixel.setCapiAccessTokenEnc(
                    req.getCapiAccessToken().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        }

        MetaPixel saved = pixelRepo.save(pixel);
        log.info("Pixel created: tenant={} pixelId={} purpose={}", tenantId, req.getPixelId(), pixel.getPurpose());
        return PixelResponse.from(saved);
    }

    @Transactional
    public PixelResponse update(UUID id, UUID tenantId, UpdatePixelRequest req) {
        MetaPixel pixel = findOwned(id, tenantId);

        if (req.getName() != null)    pixel.setName(req.getName());
        if (req.getPurpose() != null) pixel.setPurpose(req.getPurpose());
        if (req.getStatus() != null)  pixel.setStatus(req.getStatus());

        if (req.getQualityFilter() != null) {
            pixel.setQualityFilter(toJson(req.getQualityFilter()));
        }

        if (req.getCapiAccessToken() != null && !req.getCapiAccessToken().isBlank()) {
            pixel.setCapiAccessTokenEnc(
                    req.getCapiAccessToken().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        }

        return PixelResponse.from(pixelRepo.save(pixel));
    }

    @Transactional
    public void delete(UUID id, UUID tenantId) {
        MetaPixel pixel = findOwned(id, tenantId);
        if (pixel.isDefaultPixel()) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "Cannot deactivate the default pixel. Set another pixel as default first.");
        }
        pixel.setStatus("ARCHIVED");
        pixelRepo.save(pixel);
        log.info("Pixel archived: id={} tenant={}", id, tenantId);
    }

    @Transactional
    public PixelResponse setDefault(UUID id, UUID tenantId) {
        MetaPixel pixel = findOwned(id, tenantId);
        if (!"ACTIVE".equals(pixel.getStatus())) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "Cannot set an archived pixel as default.");
        }
        unsetCurrentDefault(tenantId);
        pixel.setDefaultPixel(true);
        return PixelResponse.from(pixelRepo.save(pixel));
    }

    // ─── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private MetaPixel findOwned(UUID id, UUID tenantId) {
        return pixelRepo.findByIdAndTenantId(id, tenantId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
                        "Pixel not found: " + id));
    }

    /** Unset is_default on all pixels of this tenant. Called before setting a new default. */
    private void unsetCurrentDefault(UUID tenantId) {
        jdbc.update(
                "UPDATE meta_pixels SET is_default = false WHERE tenant_id = ?",
                tenantId);
    }

    private String toJson(Object obj) {
        if (obj == null) return "{}";
        try {
            return MAPPER.writeValueAsString(obj);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return "{}";
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import com.marketingai.config.AppProperties;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.HttpEntity;
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

@Slf4j
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class MlServiceClient {

    private final RestTemplate restTemplate;
    private final AppProperties appProperties;

    /**
     * Submits a creative for async DNA extraction.
     *
     * @return job_id from ml-service, or null if the call fails
     */
    public String analyzeCreative(UUID tenantId, UUID creativeId,
                                   String mediaType, String fileUrl,
                                   String thumbnailUrl, String transcript,
                                   Float durationSec) {
        String url = appProperties.getMlServiceUrl() + "/analyze/creative";

        Map<String, Object> body = new HashMap<>();
        body.put("tenant_id", tenantId.toString());
        body.put("creative_id", creativeId.toString());
        body.put("media_type", mediaType);
        body.put("file_url", fileUrl);
        body.put("thumbnail_url", thumbnailUrl);
        body.put("transcript", transcript);
        body.put("duration_sec", durationSec);

        HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
        headers.setContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
        headers.set("X-Internal-API-Key", appProperties.getInternalApiKey());

        try {
            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
            Map<String, Object> response = restTemplate.postForObject(
                    url, new HttpEntity<>(body, headers), Map.class);
            if (response != null && response.containsKey("job_id")) {
                return (String) response.get("job_id");
            }
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            log.error("ml-service call failed for creative {}: {}", creativeId, ex.getMessage());
        }
        return null;
    }

    /** Generic POST to ml-service with JSON body. */
    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public <T> T post(String path, Object body, Class<T> responseType) {
        String url = appProperties.getMlServiceUrl() + path;
        HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
        headers.setContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
        headers.set("X-Internal-API-Key", appProperties.getInternalApiKey());
        return restTemplate.postForObject(url, new HttpEntity<>(body, headers), responseType);
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * No-show Propensity scoring (vision §19.18.2; arch §16.15).
 * Called on BOOKED event. Score drives follow-up audience override.
 */
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Slf4j
public class NoshowPropensityService {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private final RestTemplate restTemplate;

    public void scoreOnBooked(UUID tenantId, UUID appointmentId, UUID sessionId) {
        Map<String, Object> features = loadFeatures(tenantId, sessionId, appointmentId);
        try {
            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
            Map<String, Object> result = restTemplate.postForObject(
                "http://ml-service:8001/propensity/noshow", features, Map.class);
            if (result == null) return;

            String riskTier   = (String) result.get("risk_tier");
            double noshowProb = ((Number) result.get("noshow_prob")).doubleValue();

            jdbc.update("""
                INSERT INTO noshow_scores
                    (tenant_id, session_id, appointment_id, noshow_prob, risk_tier,
                     features, model_version)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?::jsonb, ?)
                ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
                """, tenantId, sessionId, appointmentId, noshowProb, riskTier,
                toJson(features), result.getOrDefault("model_version", "rule_based_v1"));

            log.debug("NoShow score: appointment={} risk={} prob={}", appointmentId, riskTier, noshowProb);

            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
            Map<String, Object> override = (Map<String, Object>) result.get("followup_override");
            if (override != null && override.get("ghl_tag") != null) {
                log.info("High-risk no-show: appointment={} ghl_tag={}", appointmentId, override.get("ghl_tag"));
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.warn("NoShow scoring failed for appointment {}: {}", appointmentId, e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    private Map<String, Object> loadFeatures(UUID tenantId, UUID sessionId, UUID appointmentId) {
        try {
            return jdbc.queryForMap("""
                SELECT
                    a.booking_distance_h,
                    (a.lead_tz IS NOT NULL)             AS lead_tz_known,
                    s.ticket_bucket,
                    s.self_accredited,
                    s.device_type,
                    COALESCE(s.country != 'US', false)  AS is_international
                FROM sessions s
                JOIN appointments a ON a.id = ?
                WHERE s.id = ? AND s.tenant_id = ?
                """, appointmentId, sessionId, tenantId);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return Map.of("lead_tz_known", false, "is_international", false);
        }
    }

    private String toJson(Object o) {
        try { return new ObjectMapper().writeValueAsString(o); }
        catch (Exception e) { return "{}"; }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.Optional;

/**
 * Validates offer field combinations against architecture §15.6 validity mask.
 * Pure logic — no DB access.
 */
@Service
public class OfferValidator {

    private static final Set<String> VALID_URGENCY_SOURCES =
            Set.of("inventory_api", "crm_deadline", "seasonal_window");

    private static final Set<String> INSTALLMENT_TERMS =
            Set.of("installment", "installment_3", "installment_6");

    public record ValidationResult(boolean valid, List<String> errors, boolean requiresLegalReview) {}

    /** Backward-compatible overload without margin. */
    public ValidationResult validate(Map<String, Object> offer) {
        return validate(offer, null);
    }

    public ValidationResult validate(Map<String, Object> offer, Double minMargin) {
        List<String> errors = new ArrayList<>();

        String discountType = str(offer, "discount_type");
        Object discountDepth = offer.get("discount_depth");
        String guaranteeType = str(offer, "guarantee_type");
        Object guaranteeDays = offer.get("guarantee_days");
        Object hasRealUrgency = offer.get("has_real_urgency");
        String urgencySource = str(offer, "urgency_source");

        // discount_type=none ⇒ discount_depth must be 0
        if ("none".equalsIgnoreCase(discountType)) {
            if (discountDepth != null) {
                double depth = toDouble(discountDepth);
                if (depth != 0.0) {
                    errors.add("discount_type=none requires discount_depth=0 (got " + depth + ")");
                }
            }
        }

        // guarantee_type=none ⇒ guarantee_days must be null
        if ("none".equalsIgnoreCase(guaranteeType)) {
            if (guaranteeDays != null) {
                errors.add("guarantee_type=none requires guarantee_days=null");
            }
        }

        // has_real_urgency=true ⇒ urgency_source must be in allowed set
        if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(hasRealUrgency)) {
            if (urgencySource == null || urgencySource.isBlank()) {
                errors.add("has_real_urgency=true requires urgency_source to be set");
            } else if (!VALID_URGENCY_SOURCES.contains(urgencySource)) {
                errors.add("urgency_source '" + urgencySource + "' is not allowed; " +
                           "must be one of: " + VALID_URGENCY_SOURCES);
            }
        }

        // estimated_margin >= tenants.settings.min_margin (vision §18.5)
        Object estimatedMarginObj = offer.get("estimated_margin");
        if (minMargin != null && estimatedMarginObj != null) {
            double em = toDouble(estimatedMarginObj);
            if (!Double.isNaN(em) && em < minMargin) {
                errors.add(String.format(
                    "estimated_margin=%.4f < min_margin=%.4f (tenant margin floor §18.5)",
                    em, minMargin));
            }
        }

        // Installment terms require legal review flag
        String paymentTerms = str(offer, "payment_terms");
        boolean requiresLegalReview = paymentTerms != null
                && INSTALLMENT_TERMS.contains(paymentTerms.toLowerCase());

        return new ValidationResult(errors.isEmpty(), errors, requiresLegalReview);
    }

    private static String str(Map<String, Object> m, String key) {
        Object v = m.get(key);
        return v != null ? v.toString() : null;
    }

    private static double toDouble(Object v) {
        if (v instanceof Number n) return n.doubleValue();
        try { return Double.parseDouble(v.toString()); } catch (Exception e) { return Double.NaN; }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Pixel Pollution Auto-Detection — Level 3 (vision §6.8).
 *
 * Quality rate = CRM_MEETING_ATTENDED events / FORM_SUBMIT events per UTM campaign.
 * Drift alert fires when:
 *   quality_rate_14d < 0.70 × baseline_rate_30d
 *   AND forms_14d >= 20 (min volume — avoid noise on tiny cohorts)
 *
 * Action: insert pixel_pollution_scans record + CircuitBreaker L2 event + Telegram alert.
 * The CircuitBreaker L2 carries reason="PIXEL_POLLUTION_DRIFT" so the marketer
 * sees it in the existing circuit-breaker dashboard.
 */
@Slf4j
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class PixelPollutionService {

    private static final double DRIFT_THRESHOLD   = 0.70;  // quality_rate < 70% of baseline
    private static final int    MIN_FORM_VOLUME   = 20;    // min FORM_SUBMIT count in 14d

    private final JdbcTemplate                 jdbc;
    private final CircuitBreakerService        circuitBreakerService;
    private final AlertService                 alertService;

    public void runScan() {
        List<UUID> tenants = jdbc.queryForList("SELECT id FROM tenants", UUID.class);
        for (UUID tenantId : tenants) {
            try {
                scanTenant(tenantId);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.error("Pixel pollution scan failed for tenant {}: {}", tenantId, e.getMessage(), e);
            }
        }
    }

    private void scanTenant(UUID tenantId) {
        // Quality rates grouped by utm_campaign (NULL = all campaigns aggregated)
        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbc.queryForList(
                """
                WITH forms_14 AS (
                    SELECT utm_campaign, COUNT(*) AS cnt
                    FROM   sessions
                    WHERE  tenant_id   = ?
                      AND  converted   = true
                      AND  started_at  > now() - INTERVAL '14 days'
                    GROUP  BY utm_campaign
                ),
                meetings_14 AS (
                    SELECT s.utm_campaign, COUNT(*) AS cnt
                    FROM   events e
                    JOIN   sessions s ON s.id = e.session_id AND s.tenant_id = e.tenant_id
                    WHERE  e.tenant_id  = ?
                      AND  e.event_type = 'CRM_MEETING_ATTENDED'
                      AND  e.event_time > now() - INTERVAL '14 days'
                    GROUP  BY s.utm_campaign
                ),
                forms_30 AS (
                    SELECT utm_campaign, COUNT(*) AS cnt
                    FROM   sessions
                    WHERE  tenant_id   = ?
                      AND  converted   = true
                      AND  started_at  > now() - INTERVAL '30 days'
                    GROUP  BY utm_campaign
                ),
                meetings_30 AS (
                    SELECT s.utm_campaign, COUNT(*) AS cnt
                    FROM   events e
                    JOIN   sessions s ON s.id = e.session_id AND s.tenant_id = e.tenant_id
                    WHERE  e.tenant_id  = ?
                      AND  e.event_type = 'CRM_MEETING_ATTENDED'
                      AND  e.event_time > now() - INTERVAL '30 days'
                    GROUP  BY s.utm_campaign
                )
                SELECT
                    f14.utm_campaign,
                    f14.cnt                                 AS forms_14d,
                    COALESCE(m14.cnt, 0)                    AS meetings_14d,
                    CASE WHEN f14.cnt > 0
                         THEN COALESCE(m14.cnt, 0)::numeric / f14.cnt
                    END                                     AS quality_rate_14d,
                    CASE WHEN COALESCE(f30.cnt, 0) > 0
                         THEN COALESCE(m30.cnt, 0)::numeric / f30.cnt
                    END                                     AS baseline_rate_30d
                FROM       forms_14  f14
                LEFT JOIN  meetings_14 m14 ON m14.utm_campaign IS NOT DISTINCT FROM f14.utm_campaign
                LEFT JOIN  forms_30    f30 ON f30.utm_campaign IS NOT DISTINCT FROM f14.utm_campaign
                LEFT JOIN  meetings_30 m30 ON m30.utm_campaign IS NOT DISTINCT FROM f14.utm_campaign
                WHERE  f14.cnt >= ?
                """,
                tenantId, tenantId, tenantId, tenantId, MIN_FORM_VOLUME
        );

        for (Map<String, Object> row : rows) {
            String  campaign    = (String)  row.get("utm_campaign");
            int     forms14     = toInt(row.get("forms_14d"));
            int     meetings14  = toInt(row.get("meetings_14d"));
            Double  rate14      = toDouble(row.get("quality_rate_14d"));
            Double  baseline    = toDouble(row.get("baseline_rate_30d"));

            double driftPct = 0.0;
            boolean alertFired = false;

            if (rate14 != null && baseline != null && baseline > 0) {
                driftPct = (rate14 / baseline - 1.0) * 100.0;
                alertFired = rate14 < DRIFT_THRESHOLD * baseline;
            }

            // Upsert scan record (deduplicated by tenant + campaign + date)
            jdbc.update(
                    """
                    INSERT INTO pixel_pollution_scans
                        (tenant_id, utm_campaign, scan_date, forms_14d, meetings_14d,
                         quality_rate_14d, baseline_rate_30d, drift_pct, alert_fired)
                    VALUES (?, ?, CURRENT_DATE, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                    ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, COALESCE(utm_campaign, ''), scan_date)
                    DO UPDATE SET
                        forms_14d         = EXCLUDED.forms_14d,
                        meetings_14d      = EXCLUDED.meetings_14d,
                        quality_rate_14d  = EXCLUDED.quality_rate_14d,
                        baseline_rate_30d = EXCLUDED.baseline_rate_30d,
                        drift_pct         = EXCLUDED.drift_pct,
                        alert_fired       = EXCLUDED.alert_fired
                    """,
                    tenantId, campaign, forms14, meetings14,
                    rate14, baseline, driftPct, alertFired
            );

            if (alertFired) {
                fireAlert(tenantId, campaign, forms14, meetings14, rate14, baseline, driftPct);
            }
        }
    }

    private void fireAlert(UUID tenantId, String campaign, int forms14, int meetings14,
                           double rate14, double baseline, double driftPct) {
        String desc = String.format(
                "Pixel pollution drift detected — campaign='%s' quality_rate=%.1f%% (baseline=%.1f%%, drift=%.1f%%)",
                campaign != null ? campaign : "(all campaigns)",
                rate14 * 100, baseline * 100, driftPct
        );
        log.warn("PIXEL_POLLUTION_ALERT tenant={} {}", tenantId, desc);

        // Circuit breaker L2 event for dashboard visibility
        try {
            circuitBreakerService.createPixelPollutionEvent(tenantId, campaign, desc);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Failed to create CB event for pixel pollution: {}", e.getMessage());
        }

        // Alert (Telegram + Slack via AlertService)
        try {
            String alertMsg = String.format(
                    "🔴 Pixel Pollution Drift — Tenant: %s\n\nCampaign: %s\nQuality Rate (14d): %.1f%%\n" +
                    "Baseline (30d): %.1f%%\nDrift: %.1f%%\n\nAction Required: Review campaign targeting & creative.",
                    tenantId, campaign != null ? campaign : "(all)", rate14 * 100, baseline * 100, driftPct);
            alertService.sendAlert(alertMsg);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Failed to send pixel pollution alert: {}", e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    // ─── Pure-logic helpers (package-private for unit tests) ────────────────

    static boolean shouldAlert(Double rate14d, Double baseline30d, int forms14d) {
        if (forms14d < MIN_FORM_VOLUME) return false;
        if (rate14d == null || baseline30d == null || baseline30d <= 0) return false;
        return rate14d < DRIFT_THRESHOLD * baseline30d;
    }

    static double driftPct(double rate14d, double baseline30d) {
        return (rate14d / baseline30d - 1.0) * 100.0;
    }

    // ─── Type helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private static int toInt(Object v) {
        return v == null ? 0 : ((Number) v).intValue();
    }

    private static Double toDouble(Object v) {
        return v == null ? null : ((Number) v).doubleValue();
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import com.marketingai.config.AppProperties;
import jakarta.annotation.PostConstruct;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.condition.ConditionalOnProperty;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import software.amazon.awssdk.auth.credentials.AwsBasicCredentials;
import software.amazon.awssdk.auth.credentials.StaticCredentialsProvider;
import software.amazon.awssdk.core.sync.RequestBody;
import software.amazon.awssdk.regions.Region;
import software.amazon.awssdk.services.s3.S3Client;
import software.amazon.awssdk.services.s3.S3Configuration;

import java.net.URI;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Cloudflare R2 storage (S3-compatible).
 * Active when app.storage.type=r2.
 * Architecture §2: R2 preferred — no egress fees.
 */
@Service
@ConditionalOnProperty(name = "app.storage.type", havingValue = "r2")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Slf4j
public class R2StorageService implements StorageService {

    private final AppProperties props;
    private S3Client s3;

    @PostConstruct
    void init() {
        AppProperties.Storage.R2 r2 = props.getStorage().getR2();
        s3 = S3Client.builder()
                .endpointOverride(URI.create("https://" + r2.getAccountId() + ".r2.cloudflarestorage.com"))
                .credentialsProvider(StaticCredentialsProvider.create(
                        AwsBasicCredentials.create(r2.getAccessKeyId(), r2.getSecretAccessKey())))
                .region(Region.of("auto"))
                .serviceConfiguration(S3Configuration.builder()
                        .pathStyleAccessEnabled(true)
                        .build())
                .build();
        log.info("R2StorageService initialised (bucket={})", r2.getBucket());
    }

    @Override
    public String store(UUID tenantId, UUID creativeId, String originalFilename, byte[] bytes) {
        AppProperties.Storage.R2 r2 = props.getStorage().getR2();
        String sanitized = sanitize(originalFilename);
        String key = tenantId + "/" + creativeId + "/" + sanitized;

        s3.putObject(
                r -> r.bucket(r2.getBucket()).key(key).contentLength((long) bytes.length),
                RequestBody.fromBytes(bytes));

        String base = r2.getPublicUrl().isBlank()
                ? "https://" + r2.getBucket() + "." + r2.getAccountId() + ".r2.dev"
                : r2.getPublicUrl();
        String url = base + "/" + key;
        log.debug("Stored R2 object: {}", url);
        return url;
    }

    private String sanitize(String filename) {
        if (filename == null || filename.isBlank()) return "upload";
        return filename.replaceAll("[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]", "_");
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Circuit Breaker recovery diagnosis and batch resume (3-16).
 * Automatically determines the cause of a CB event and suggests resume steps.
 */
@Slf4j
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class RecoveryDiagnosisService {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private final AutonomyService autonomyService;

    /**
     * Diagnose a circuit breaker event.
     * Reads CB event + recent site_health_incidents + fraud scores to determine cause.
     * Sets diagnosis column on the event row.
     * Returns {diagnosis, confidence, resume_steps, evidence}.
     */
    public Map<String, Object> diagnose(UUID tenantId, UUID eventId) {
        Map<String, Object> cbEvent = jdbc.queryForMap(
                "SELECT * FROM circuit_breaker_events WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ?",
                eventId, tenantId);

        String triggerReason = (String) cbEvent.getOrDefault("trigger_reason", "");
        String level = (String) cbEvent.getOrDefault("level", "L1");

        // Check site health
        List<Map<String, Object>> openIncidents = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT id FROM site_health_incidents
                WHERE tenant_id = ? AND resolved_at IS NULL
                """, tenantId);

        // Check fraud
        Map<String, Object> fraudRow = null;
        try {
            fraudRow = jdbc.queryForMap("""
                    SELECT COUNT(*) total,
                           SUM(CASE WHEN is_suspicious THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) fraud_count
                    FROM sessions
                    WHERE tenant_id = ? AND created_at > now() - interval '2 hours'
                    """, tenantId);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.debug("No sessions data for diagnosis: {}", e.getMessage());
        }

        String diagnosis = "NONE";
        double confidence = 0.5;
        List<String> resumeSteps = List.of("Investigate trigger_reason manually.", "Check Telegram alerts for more context.");
        List<String> evidence = new java.util.ArrayList<>();

        if (!openIncidents.isEmpty()) {
            diagnosis = "TECHNICAL";
            confidence = 0.90;
            evidence.add("site_health_incident_open: " + openIncidents.size() + " incidents");
            resumeSteps = List.of(
                    "Resolve site_health_incidents for this tenant.",
                    "Confirm landing pages are responding normally.",
                    "Restart affected ad sets after resolution."
            );
        } else if (fraudRow != null) {
            long total = toLong(fraudRow.get("total"));
            long fraudCount = toLong(fraudRow.get("fraud_count"));
            double fraudRate = total > 0 ? (double) fraudCount / total : 0.0;
            if (fraudRate >= 0.20) {
                diagnosis = "FRAUD";
                confidence = 0.85;
                evidence.add(String.format("fraud_rate=%.1f%% in last 2h", fraudRate * 100));
                resumeSteps = List.of(
                        "Review traffic sources — likely bot or click farm activity.",
                        "Block suspicious IP ranges in Meta Ads Manager.",
                        "Consider excluding affected placements.",
                        "Re-run fraud_l3 scan after mitigation."
                );
            } else if (triggerReason != null && triggerReason.contains("CPM")) {
                diagnosis = "MARKET";
                confidence = 0.75;
                evidence.add("CPM spike in trigger_reason");
                resumeSteps = List.of(
                        "Wait for CPM to normalise (usually 24-48h).",
                        "Check calendar for market events (holidays, competitor launches).",
                        "Resume with conservative daily budget cap."
                );
            } else if (triggerReason != null && (triggerReason.contains("CPA") || triggerReason.contains("ROAS"))) {
                diagnosis = "CREATIVE";
                confidence = 0.70;
                evidence.add("CPA/ROAS trigger with no fraud or site issues");
                resumeSteps = List.of(
                        "Refresh top creatives — run new hook variants.",
                        "Archive creatives with frequency > 4.",
                        "Review anchor divergence report for market vs creative signal."
                );
            }
        }

        // Persist diagnosis (both columns are JSONB)
        try {
            String diagJson = "\"" + diagnosis + "\"";
            String stepsJson = "[" + resumeSteps.stream()
                    .map(s -> "\"" + s.replace("\"", "\\\"") + "\"")
                    .collect(java.util.stream.Collectors.joining(",")) + "]";
            jdbc.update("""
                    UPDATE circuit_breaker_events
                    SET diagnosis = ?::jsonb, resume_steps = ?::jsonb
                    WHERE id = ?
                    """, diagJson, stepsJson, eventId);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.warn("Could not update diagnosis on CB event {}: {}", eventId, e.getMessage());
        }

        Map<String, Object> result = new HashMap<>();
        result.put("event_id", eventId);
        result.put("level", level);
        result.put("diagnosis", diagnosis);
        result.put("confidence", confidence);
        result.put("resume_steps", resumeSteps);
        result.put("evidence", evidence);
        return result;
    }

    /**
     * Record the human-confirmed cause for a CB event.
     */
    public void confirmCause(UUID tenantId, UUID eventId, String cause) {
        jdbc.update("""
                UPDATE circuit_breaker_events
                SET confirmed_cause = ?
                WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ?
                """, cause, eventId, tenantId);
        log.info("CB event {} confirmed cause: {}", eventId, cause);
    }

    /**
     * Batch-resume CB events. Checks autonomy level before acting.
     * Returns count of events resumed.
     */
    public int resumeBatch(UUID tenantId, List<UUID> eventIds) {
        autonomyService.checkAndExecute(tenantId, "CB_RESUME", () -> {
            // autonomy check passed — proceed
        });

        int count = 0;
        for (UUID id : eventIds) {
            try {
                int updated = jdbc.update("""
                        UPDATE circuit_breaker_events
                        SET resolved_at = now(), resolved_by = 'auto_resume', outcome = 'RESUMED'
                        WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ? AND resolved_at IS NULL
                        """, id, tenantId);
                count += updated;
            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.warn("Failed to resume CB event {}: {}", id, e.getMessage());
            }
        }
        log.info("RecoveryDiagnosis: resumed {} CB events for tenant={}", count, tenantId);
        return count;
    }

    private long toLong(Object o) {
        if (o == null) return 0L;
        if (o instanceof Long l) return l;
        if (o instanceof Number n) return n.longValue();
        try { return Long.parseLong(o.toString()); } catch (Exception e) { return 0L; }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Reward Ladder — records reward events and triggers Thompson arm updates (vision §19.3).
 * FastAPI is the SOLE writer of thompson_arms alpha/beta. Spring only fires the notification.
 */
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Slf4j
public class RewardService {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private final RestTemplate restTemplate;
    private final AlertService  alertService;

    /**
     * Called when a funnel stage is reached for a session.
     * Writes reward_events. If quality stage, also writes quality_gate_log and
     * calls FastAPI /thompson/reward (binary increment 1.0 — FastAPI sole writer).
     */
    public void onStageReached(UUID tenantId, UUID sessionId, UUID variantId, String stageKey) {
        List<Boolean> qualityCheck = jdbc.queryForList("""
            SELECT is_quality_key FROM funnel_stages
            WHERE tenant_id = ? AND stage_key = ?
            """, Boolean.class, tenantId, stageKey);
        boolean isQuality = !qualityCheck.isEmpty() && Boolean.TRUE.equals(qualityCheck.get(0));

        List<Double> weightList = jdbc.queryForList("""
            SELECT COALESCE(reward_weight, 1.0) FROM funnel_stages
            WHERE tenant_id = ? AND stage_key = ?
            """, Double.class, tenantId, stageKey);
        double rewardWeight = weightList.isEmpty() ? 1.0 : weightList.get(0);

        jdbc.update("""
            INSERT INTO reward_events
                (tenant_id, session_id, variant_id, stage_key, is_quality_stage, reward_value)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            """, tenantId, sessionId, variantId, stageKey, isQuality, rewardWeight);

        if (isQuality) {
            jdbc.update("""
                INSERT INTO quality_gate_log
                    (tenant_id, session_id, variant_id, stage_key)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
                ON CONFLICT (session_id, variant_id, stage_key) DO NOTHING
                """, tenantId, sessionId, variantId, stageKey);

            try {
                Map<String, Object> req = Map.of(
                    "tenant_id",  tenantId.toString(),
                    "variant_id", variantId.toString(),
                    "reward",     1.0,
                    "event_type", "quality_gate_pass"
                );
                restTemplate.postForObject("http://ml-service:8001/thompson/reward", req, Map.class);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.warn("Thompson reward notification failed for variant {}: {}", variantId, e.getMessage());
            }
        }

        log.debug("Stage reward: tenant={} stage={} quality={}", tenantId, stageKey, isQuality);
    }

    public Map<String, Object> getRewardLadder(UUID tenantId) {
        List<Map<String, Object>> stages = jdbc.queryForList("""
            SELECT
                fs.stage_key,
                fs.stage_label,
                fs.ordinal,
                fs.is_quality_key,
                fs.reward_weight,
                fs.micro_reward_weight,
                cem.meta_event_name                                AS capi_event,
                COUNT(re.id)                                       AS total_rewards,
                COUNT(re.id) FILTER (WHERE re.is_quality_stage)    AS quality_rewards,
                COUNT(DISTINCT re.session_id)                      AS unique_sessions
            FROM funnel_stages fs
            LEFT JOIN reward_events re
                ON re.tenant_id = fs.tenant_id AND re.stage_key = fs.stage_key
            LEFT JOIN capi_event_map cem
                ON cem.tenant_id = fs.tenant_id AND cem.stage_key = fs.stage_key
            WHERE fs.tenant_id = ?
            GROUP BY fs.stage_key, fs.stage_label, fs.ordinal,
                     fs.is_quality_key, fs.reward_weight, fs.micro_reward_weight,
                     cem.meta_event_name
            ORDER BY fs.ordinal
            """, tenantId);

        // Weekly counters: this week vs prev week
        List<Map<String, Object>> thisWeek = jdbc.queryForList("""
            SELECT stage_key, COUNT(*) AS cnt
            FROM reward_events
            WHERE tenant_id = ? AND rewarded_at >= date_trunc('week', NOW())
            GROUP BY stage_key
            """, tenantId);

        List<Map<String, Object>> prevWeek = jdbc.queryForList("""
            SELECT stage_key, COUNT(*) AS cnt
            FROM reward_events
            WHERE tenant_id = ?
              AND rewarded_at >= date_trunc('week', NOW()) - INTERVAL '7 days'
              AND rewarded_at <  date_trunc('week', NOW())
            GROUP BY stage_key
            """, tenantId);

        java.util.Map<String, Long> thisMap = thisWeek.stream().collect(
            java.util.stream.Collectors.toMap(
                r -> (String) r.get("stage_key"),
                r -> ((Number) r.get("cnt")).longValue()
            ));
        java.util.Map<String, Long> prevMap = prevWeek.stream().collect(
            java.util.stream.Collectors.toMap(
                r -> (String) r.get("stage_key"),
                r -> ((Number) r.get("cnt")).longValue()
            ));

        List<Map<String, Object>> weeklyCounters = stages.stream().map(s -> {
            String key  = (String) s.get("stage_key");
            long   curr = thisMap.getOrDefault(key, 0L);
            long   prev = prevMap.getOrDefault(key, 0L);
            Double delta = prev > 0 ? ((curr - prev) * 100.0 / prev) : null;
            return java.util.Map.<String, Object>of(
                "stage_key",       key,
                "count_this_week", curr,
                "count_prev_week", prev,
                "delta_pct",       delta != null ? Math.round(delta * 10.0) / 10.0 : null
            );
        }).collect(java.util.stream.Collectors.toList());

        return Map.of("stages", stages, "weekly_counters", weeklyCounters);
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import com.marketingai.config.AppProperties;
import com.marketingai.entity.BudgetGuard;
import com.marketingai.entity.Tenant;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;

import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

@Slf4j
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class TelegramNotificationService {

    private final AppProperties props;
    private final RestTemplate restTemplate;

    public void sendBudgetAlert(BudgetGuard guard, Tenant tenant) {
        AppProperties.Telegram cfg = props.getTelegram();
        if (!cfg.isConfigured()) {
            log.warn("Telegram not configured — skipping alert for guard {}", guard.getId());
            return;
        }

        String text = buildBudgetAlertText(guard, tenant);
        sendMessage(cfg, text);
    }

    public void sendFraudAlert(UUID tenantId, long suspicious, long total, double rate) {
        AppProperties.Telegram cfg = props.getTelegram();
        if (!cfg.isConfigured()) {
            log.warn("Telegram not configured — skipping fraud alert for tenant {}", tenantId);
            return;
        }
        String text = String.format(
                "⚠️ Fraud Rate Alert — Tenant: %s\n\n" +
                "Suspicious sessions (last 1h): %d / %d (%.1f%%)\n\n" +
                "Action Required: Review traffic sources in Meta Ads Manager. " +
                "Check for bot-like patterns or click farm activity.",
                tenantId, suspicious, total, rate * 100);
        sendMessage(cfg, text);
    }

    public void sendWeeklyReport(String reportText) {
        AppProperties.Telegram cfg = props.getTelegram();
        if (!cfg.isConfigured()) return;
        sendMessage(cfg, reportText);
    }

    public void sendPixelPollutionAlert(UUID tenantId, String campaign,
                                        double rate14, double baseline, double driftPct) {
        AppProperties.Telegram cfg = props.getTelegram();
        if (!cfg.isConfigured()) {
            log.warn("Telegram not configured — skipping pixel pollution alert for tenant {}", tenantId);
            return;
        }
        String text = String.format(
                "🔴 Pixel Pollution Drift — Tenant: %s\n\n" +
                "Campaign: %s\n" +
                "Quality Rate (14d): %.1f%%\n" +
                "Baseline (30d):     %.1f%%\n" +
                "Drift:              %.1f%%\n\n" +
                "Action Required: Review campaign targeting & creative. " +
                "Consider pausing the polluting campaign to protect the Meta pixel.",
                tenantId,
                campaign != null ? campaign : "(all campaigns)",
                rate14 * 100, baseline * 100, driftPct);
        sendMessage(cfg, text);
    }

    public void sendAlert(String text) {
        AppProperties.Telegram cfg = props.getTelegram();
        if (!cfg.isConfigured()) {
            log.warn("Telegram not configured — skipping alert");
            return;
        }
        sendMessage(cfg, text);
    }

    public void sendCompetitiveIntelAlert(UUID tenantId, int adCount, String pageNames) {
        AppProperties.Telegram cfg = props.getTelegram();
        if (!cfg.isConfigured()) return;
        String text = String.format(
                "🕵️ Competitive Intelligence Alert — Tenant: %s\n\n" +
                "Detected %d competitor ad(s) running >14 days from: %s\n\n" +
                "Counter-hypotheses generated. Login to approve the test batch.",
                tenantId, adCount, pageNames);
        sendMessage(cfg, text);
    }

    private String buildBudgetAlertText(BudgetGuard guard, Tenant tenant) {
        String type = "PER_CREATIVE_STOP_LOSS".equals(guard.getGuardType())
                ? "Per-Creative Stop-Loss"
                : "Monthly Ceiling";

        String ref = guard.getReferenceId() != null
                ? "Creative ID: " + guard.getReferenceId()
                : "Account-level";

        return String.format(
                "🚨 Budget Guard Triggered — %s\n\n" +
                "Type: %s\n" +
                "%s\n" +
                "Threshold: $%.2f\n" +
                "Current Spend: $%.2f\n\n" +
                "Action Required: Pause affected ad set(s) in Meta Ads Manager.",
                tenant.getName(),
                type,
                ref,
                guard.getThreshold(),
                guard.getCurrentSpend()
        );
    }

    private void sendMessage(AppProperties.Telegram cfg, String text) {
        try {
            String url = "https://api.telegram.org/bot" + cfg.getBotToken() + "/sendMessage";
            Map<String, Object> body = Map.of(
                    "chat_id", cfg.getChatId(),
                    "text", text,
                    "parse_mode", "HTML"
            );
            restTemplate.postForObject(url, body, String.class);
            log.info("Telegram alert sent to chat {}", cfg.getChatId());
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Failed to send Telegram alert: {}", e.getMessage());
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import com.marketingai.dto.meta.MetaCredentialsRequest;
import com.marketingai.entity.Tenant;
import com.marketingai.repository.TenantRepository;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

@Slf4j
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class TenantService {

    private final TenantRepository tenantRepo;

    @Transactional
    public void setMetaCredentials(UUID tenantId, MetaCredentialsRequest req) {
        Tenant tenant = tenantRepo.findById(tenantId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Tenant not found"));
        tenant.setMetaAccessTokenEnc(req.getAccessToken().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        tenant.setMetaAdAccountId(req.getAdAccountId());
        if (req.getAppId() != null) {
            tenant.setMetaAppId(req.getAppId());
        }
        tenantRepo.save(tenant);
        log.info("Meta credentials updated for tenant {}", tenantId);
    }

    public Map<String, Object> getSettings(UUID tenantId) {
        Tenant tenant = tenantRepo.findById(tenantId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Tenant not found"));
        Map<String, Object> result = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        result.put("report_email",      tenant.getReportEmail());
        result.put("alert_channel",     tenant.getAlertChannel() != null ? tenant.getAlertChannel() : "TELEGRAM");
        result.put("slack_webhook_url", tenant.getSlackWebhookUrl());
        return result;
    }

    @Transactional
    public void updateSettings(UUID tenantId, Map<String, String> body) {
        Tenant tenant = tenantRepo.findById(tenantId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Tenant not found"));
        if (body.containsKey("report_email"))      tenant.setReportEmail(body.get("report_email"));
        if (body.containsKey("alert_channel"))     tenant.setAlertChannel(body.get("alert_channel"));
        if (body.containsKey("slack_webhook_url")) tenant.setSlackWebhookUrl(body.get("slack_webhook_url"));
        tenantRepo.save(tenant);
        log.info("Settings updated for tenant {}", tenantId);
    }

}
```
