```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.node.ObjectNode;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.*;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.web.client.HttpClientErrorException;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;
import org.springframework.web.util.UriComponentsBuilder;

import java.net.URI;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * TikTok Ads API v1.3 wrapper (Phase 7).
 * Docs: https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs
 */
@Slf4j
@Service
public class TikTokApiService {

    private static final String BASE_URL = "https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3";
    private static final ObjectMapper MAPPER = new ObjectMapper();

    private final RestTemplate rest = new RestTemplate();

    public List<Map<String, Object>> getCampaigns(String accessToken, String advertiserId) {
        String url = UriComponentsBuilder.fromUri(URI.create(BASE_URL))
                .path("/campaign/get/")
                .queryParam("advertiser_id", advertiserId)
                .build()
                .toUriString();

        HttpHeaders headers = buildHeaders(accessToken);

        try {
            JsonNode resp = rest.exchange(url, HttpMethod.GET,
                    new HttpEntity<>(headers), JsonNode.class).getBody();

            List<Map<String, Object>> campaigns = new ArrayList<>();
            if (resp != null) {
                JsonNode list = resp.path("data").path("list");
                if (list.isArray()) {
                    for (JsonNode c : list) {
                        campaigns.add(Map.of(
                                "id",     c.path("campaign_id").asText(),
                                "name",   c.path("campaign_name").asText(),
                                "status", c.path("operation_status").asText()
                        ));
                    }
                }
            }
            return campaigns;
        } catch (HttpClientErrorException e) {
            log.error("TikTok getCampaigns failed {}: {}", e.getStatusCode(), e.getResponseBodyAsString());
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_GATEWAY, "TikTok Ads API error: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    public Map<String, Object> getCampaignInsights(
            String accessToken, String advertiserId,
            String campaignId, String startDate, String endDate) {

        String url = UriComponentsBuilder.fromUri(URI.create(BASE_URL))
                .path("/report/integrated/get/")
                .queryParam("advertiser_id", advertiserId)
                .queryParam("report_type", "BASIC")
                .queryParam("data_level", "AUCTION_CAMPAIGN")
                .queryParam("dimensions", "[\"campaign_id\"]")
                .queryParam("metrics", "[\"spend\",\"impressions\",\"clicks\",\"conversions\"]")
                .queryParam("filters", "[{\"field_name\":\"campaign_id\",\"filter_type\":\"IN\",\"filter_value\":\"[\\\"" + campaignId + "\\\"]\"}]")
                .queryParam("start_date", startDate)
                .queryParam("end_date", endDate)
                .build()
                .toUriString();

        HttpHeaders headers = buildHeaders(accessToken);

        try {
            JsonNode resp = rest.exchange(url, HttpMethod.GET,
                    new HttpEntity<>(headers), JsonNode.class).getBody();

            if (resp != null) {
                JsonNode list = resp.path("data").path("list");
                if (list.isArray() && !list.isEmpty()) {
                    JsonNode metrics = list.get(0).path("metrics");
                    return Map.of(
                            "spend",       metrics.path("spend").asDouble(0),
                            "impressions", metrics.path("impressions").asLong(0),
                            "clicks",      metrics.path("clicks").asLong(0),
                            "conversions", metrics.path("conversions").asLong(0)
                    );
                }
            }
            return Map.of("spend", 0.0, "impressions", 0L, "clicks", 0L, "conversions", 0L);
        } catch (HttpClientErrorException e) {
            log.error("TikTok getInsights failed {}: {}", e.getStatusCode(), e.getResponseBodyAsString());
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_GATEWAY, "TikTok Ads API error: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    public void setCampaignStatus(String accessToken, String advertiserId,
                                  String campaignId, String status) {
        String url = UriComponentsBuilder.fromUri(URI.create(BASE_URL))
                .path("/campaign/status/update/")
                .build()
                .toUriString();

        ObjectNode body = MAPPER.createObjectNode()
                .put("advertiser_id", advertiserId)
                .put("operation_status", status);
        body.putArray("campaign_ids").add(campaignId);

        HttpHeaders headers = buildHeaders(accessToken);

        try {
            rest.postForObject(url, new HttpEntity<>(body.toString(), headers), String.class);
            log.info("TikTok campaign {} → {}", campaignId, status);
        } catch (HttpClientErrorException e) {
            log.error("TikTok setStatus failed {}: {}", e.getStatusCode(), e.getResponseBodyAsString());
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_GATEWAY, "TikTok Ads API error: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    private HttpHeaders buildHeaders(String accessToken) {
        HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
        headers.setContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
        headers.set("Access-Token", accessToken);
        return headers;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import com.marketingai.dto.meta.AdSetResponse;
import com.marketingai.dto.meta.CampaignResponse;
import com.marketingai.dto.meta.TestBatchRequest;
import com.marketingai.dto.meta.WinnerResponse;
import com.marketingai.entity.MetaAdSet;
import com.marketingai.entity.MetaCampaign;
import com.marketingai.entity.Tenant;
import com.marketingai.entity.ThompsonArm;
import com.marketingai.repository.MetaAdSetRepository;
import com.marketingai.repository.MetaCampaignRepository;
import com.marketingai.repository.TenantRepository;
import com.marketingai.repository.ThompsonArmRepository;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Orchestrates the two-contour exploration/exploitation lifecycle:
 *
 *   TEST contour  → batch launch (equal budgets) → winner selection (shrinkage)
 *                 → confirmation run → transfer to SCALE
 *
 * SCALE contour is "mostly hands-off" — Meta CBO/Advantage+ manages delivery.
 * We only rotate burned-out creatives there.
 *
 * Rules enforced per vision §6.5:
 *   - Equal budgets in test batch for clean comparison
 *   - Budget changes ≤ 20% per step (see BudgetChangeGuard)
 *   - Winner's curse mitigation via James-Stein shrinkage
 *   - Confirmation run before transfer to SCALE
 */
@Slf4j
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class TwoContourService {

    private final MetaCampaignRepository campaignRepo;
    private final MetaAdSetRepository adSetRepo;
    private final ThompsonArmRepository armRepo;
    private final MetaApiService metaApi;
    private final MetaCampaignService campaignService;
    private final TenantRepository tenantRepo;
    private final ExplorationBudgetService explorationService;
    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private final LearningPhaseService learningPhaseService;

    // ─── 1. Test Batch Launch ─────────────────────────────────────────────

    /**
     * Launch a batch of ad sets in a TEST campaign with equal budgets.
     * All ad sets in this batch share the same batch_id for later winner selection.
     *
     * Vision §6.5: "new creatives launched IN BATCHES (not one by one), equal budgets"
     */
    @Transactional
    public List<AdSetResponse> launchTestBatch(UUID tenantId, TestBatchRequest req) {
        MetaCampaign campaign = requireCampaign(tenantId, req.getCampaignId());
        if (!"TEST".equals(campaign.getContour())) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                    "Batch launch is only for TEST contour campaigns");
        }

        Tenant tenant = requireTenant(tenantId);
        String token = decodeToken(tenant);
        String adAccountId = tenant.getMetaAdAccountId();
        if (adAccountId == null) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "Tenant has no Meta ad account ID configured");
        }

        // Anchor placement rule (vision §11.2): batch must contain ≥2 anchor ad sets
        long anchorCount = req.getAdSets().stream()
                .filter(a -> a.isAnchor()).count();
        if (anchorCount < 2) {
            String overrideReason = req.getAnchorOverrideReason();
            if (overrideReason == null || overrideReason.isBlank()) {
                throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
                        "Batch requires at least 2 anchor ad sets (vision §11.2). " +
                        "Provide anchorOverrideReason to bypass.");
            }
            // Log override
            jdbc.update("""
                    INSERT INTO anchor_override_log (tenant_id, anchor_count, reason)
                    VALUES (?, ?, ?)
                    """, tenantId, (int) anchorCount, overrideReason);
            log.warn("Anchor rule bypassed by tenant {} — anchorCount={} reason={}",
                    tenantId, anchorCount, overrideReason);
        }

        UUID batchId = UUID.randomUUID();
        Instant now = Instant.now();
        List<AdSetResponse> created = new ArrayList<>();

        for (var adSetReq : req.getAdSets()) {
            // Override budget — all ad sets get equal budgets per §6.5
            adSetReq.setDailyBudget(req.getPerAdSetDailyBudget());

            String name = adSetReq.getName() != null ? adSetReq.getName()
                    : "batch-" + batchId.toString().substring(0, 8) + "-" + (created.size() + 1);

            String metaAdSetId = metaApi.createAdSet(
                    token, adAccountId, campaign.getMetaCampaignId(),
                    name, adSetReq.getAudienceSpec(), req.getPerAdSetDailyBudget());

            boolean isExploration = req.getExplorationCreativeIds() != null
                    && adSetReq.getCreativeId() != null
                    && req.getExplorationCreativeIds().contains(adSetReq.getCreativeId());

            MetaAdSet adSet = new MetaAdSet();
            adSet.setTenantId(tenantId);
            adSet.setCampaignId(campaign.getId());
            adSet.setMetaAdSetId(metaAdSetId);
            adSet.setCreativeId(adSetReq.getCreativeId());
            adSet.setAudienceSpec(adSetReq.getAudienceSpec());
            adSet.setDailyBudget(req.getPerAdSetDailyBudget());
            adSet.setStatus("PAUSED");
            adSet.setBatchId(batchId);
            adSet.setBatchLaunchedAt(now);
            adSet.setExplorationSlot(isExploration);
            adSet.setAnchor(adSetReq.isAnchor());

            // Learning Phase Log (vision §6.5): record phase before LAUNCH
            learningPhaseService.logBeforeAction(tenantId, metaAdSetId, "LAUNCH",
                    adSet.getLearningPhase());

            created.add(campaignService.toAdSetResponse(adSetRepo.save(adSet)));
        }

        log.info("Launched TEST batch {} with {} ad sets for campaign {} (tenant {})",
                batchId, created.size(), campaign.getId(), tenantId);
        return created;
    }

    // ─── 2. Winner Selection with Shrinkage ───────────────────────────────

    /**
     * Select the best ad set from the latest batch in a TEST campaign.
     * Applies James-Stein shrinkage to mitigate winner's curse (§6.5).
     *
     * Shrinkage formula:
     *   θ_shrunk_i = group_mean + (1 - shrinkage_factor) × (θ_raw_i - group_mean)
     *   shrinkage_factor = c / (c + n_i)   where c = 10 (pseudo-count, ~prior strength)
     *
     * Result: ad sets with few impressions are pulled toward group mean;
     *         high-data ad sets retain most of their raw estimate.
     */
    public WinnerResponse selectWinner(UUID tenantId, UUID campaignId) {
        requireCampaign(tenantId, campaignId);

        List<MetaAdSet> allAdSets = adSetRepo.findAllByCampaignId(campaignId)
                .stream()
                .filter(a -> a.getTenantId().equals(tenantId))
                .filter(a -> a.getBatchId() != null)
                .toList();

        if (allAdSets.isEmpty()) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
                    "No batched ad sets found for this campaign");
        }

        // Use the most recent batch
        UUID latestBatch = allAdSets.stream()
                .max(Comparator.comparing(a -> a.getBatchLaunchedAt() != null
                        ? a.getBatchLaunchedAt() : Instant.EPOCH))
                .map(MetaAdSet::getBatchId)
                .orElseThrow();

        List<MetaAdSet> batch = allAdSets.stream()
                .filter(a -> latestBatch.equals(a.getBatchId()))
                .toList();

        // Compute raw estimates from Thompson arms (alpha/(alpha+beta))
        List<AdSetScore> scores = batch.stream()
                .map(adSet -> {
                    ThompsonArm arm = armRepo
                            .findByVariantIdAndContextKey(adSet.getId(), "meta_adset")
                            .orElse(null);
                    double alpha = arm != null ? arm.getAlpha() : 1.0;
                    double beta  = arm != null ? arm.getBeta()  : 1.0;
                    double raw = alpha / (alpha + beta);
                    long n = Math.round(alpha + beta - 2); // subtract the (1,1) prior
                    return new AdSetScore(adSet, raw, n);
                })
                .toList();

        // Shrinkage: James-Stein toward group mean
        double groupMean = scores.stream().mapToDouble(s -> s.raw).average().orElse(0.5);
        int c = 10; // prior pseudo-count

        AdSetScore winner = scores.stream()
                .map(s -> {
                    double sf = (double) c / (c + s.observations);
                    s.shrunk = groupMean + (1 - sf) * (s.raw - groupMean);
                    return s;
                })
                .max(Comparator.comparingDouble(s -> s.shrunk))
                .orElseThrow();

        String recommendation = buildRecommendation(winner, groupMean);

        log.info("Winner selected: adSet={}, raw={:.3f}, shrunk={:.3f} (campaign={}, tenant={})",
                winner.adSet.getId(), winner.raw, winner.shrunk, campaignId, tenantId);

        return WinnerResponse.builder()
                .adSetId(winner.adSet.getId())
                .metaAdSetId(winner.adSet.getMetaAdSetId())
                .creativeId(winner.adSet.getCreativeId())
                .rawEstimate(winner.raw)
                .shrunkEstimate(winner.shrunk)
                .impressions(winner.observations)
                .spendTotal(winner.adSet.getSpendTotal() != null ? winner.adSet.getSpendTotal() : 0f)
                .recommendation(recommendation)
                .build();
    }

    // ─── 3. Confirmation Run ─────────────────────────────────────────────

    /**
     * Start a confirmation run for the winner before transfer to SCALE.
     * Creates a new ad set (clone of winner) with 1.5× budget.
     *
     * Vision §6.5: "short run with increased budget to verify result reproduces"
     * Sets campaign.confirmationStatus = RUNNING.
     */
    @Transactional
    public CampaignResponse startConfirmationRun(UUID tenantId, UUID campaignId, UUID winnerAdSetId) {
        MetaCampaign campaign = requireCampaign(tenantId, campaignId);

        if (!"NONE".equals(campaign.getConfirmationStatus())
                && !"FAILED".equals(campaign.getConfirmationStatus())) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "Confirmation run already in progress or passed (status="
                            + campaign.getConfirmationStatus() + ")");
        }

        MetaAdSet winner = adSetRepo.findById(winnerAdSetId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Ad set not found"));
        if (!winner.getTenantId().equals(tenantId)) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN);
        }

        Tenant tenant = requireTenant(tenantId);
        String token = decodeToken(tenant);
        String adAccountId = tenant.getMetaAdAccountId();

        // Confirmation budget = 1.5× winner budget (increased but not huge leap)
        float confirmBudget = winner.getDailyBudget() != null
                ? Math.round(winner.getDailyBudget() * 1.5f * 100) / 100f
                : campaign.getDailyBudget() != null ? campaign.getDailyBudget() : 50f;

        // Validate budget change ≤ 20% rule vs current campaign budget
        validateBudgetStep(campaign.getDailyBudget(), confirmBudget, campaign.getId().toString());

        String confirmMetaAdSetId = metaApi.createAdSet(
                token, adAccountId, campaign.getMetaCampaignId(),
                "confirmation-" + winner.getMetaAdSetId(),
                winner.getAudienceSpec(),
                confirmBudget);

        // Persist confirmation ad set
        MetaAdSet confirmAdSet = new MetaAdSet();
        confirmAdSet.setTenantId(tenantId);
        confirmAdSet.setCampaignId(campaign.getId());
        confirmAdSet.setMetaAdSetId(confirmMetaAdSetId);
        confirmAdSet.setCreativeId(winner.getCreativeId());
        confirmAdSet.setAudienceSpec(winner.getAudienceSpec());
        confirmAdSet.setDailyBudget(confirmBudget);
        confirmAdSet.setStatus("ACTIVE");
        adSetRepo.save(confirmAdSet);

        // Track on campaign
        campaign.setConfirmationAdSetId(confirmMetaAdSetId);
        campaign.setConfirmationStatus("RUNNING");
        campaignRepo.save(campaign);

        log.info("Confirmation run started: metaAdSetId={} budget={} (campaign={}, tenant={})",
                confirmMetaAdSetId, confirmBudget, campaignId, tenantId);

        return campaignService.toResponse(campaign);
    }

    /**
     * Evaluate the confirmation run. If it passes (spend > 0 and no manual override),
     * transfer winner to SCALE and mark confirmationStatus = PASSED.
     *
     * In practice: call after the confirmation run has been live ≥ 3 days.
     * The marketer confirms via UI that the result reproduces before this endpoint is called.
     */
    @Transactional
    public CampaignResponse confirmAndTransfer(UUID tenantId, UUID campaignId, UUID winnerAdSetId) {
        MetaCampaign campaign = requireCampaign(tenantId, campaignId);

        if (!"RUNNING".equals(campaign.getConfirmationStatus())) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "No running confirmation (status=" + campaign.getConfirmationStatus() + ")");
        }

        // Validate confirmation ad set has accrued some spend
        adSetRepo.findByMetaAdSetId(campaign.getConfirmationAdSetId())
                .ifPresent(confirmAdSet -> {
                    float spend = confirmAdSet.getSpendTotal() != null ? confirmAdSet.getSpendTotal() : 0f;
                    if (spend < 1.0f) {
                        throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                                "Confirmation run has not yet accrued spend. Wait and retry.");
                    }
                });

        // Transfer winner to SCALE
        campaignService.transferToScale(tenantId, winnerAdSetId);

        // Mark confirmation passed
        campaign.setConfirmationStatus("PASSED");
        campaignRepo.save(campaign);

        log.info("Confirmation PASSED, winner {} transferred to SCALE (campaign={}, tenant={})",
                winnerAdSetId, campaignId, tenantId);

        return campaignService.toResponse(campaign);
    }

    /**
     * Mark confirmation run as FAILED (marketer decision).
     * Campaign goes back to NONE so a new winner can be selected.
     */
    @Transactional
    public CampaignResponse failConfirmation(UUID tenantId, UUID campaignId) {
        MetaCampaign campaign = requireCampaign(tenantId, campaignId);

        Tenant tenant = requireTenant(tenantId);
        if (campaign.getConfirmationAdSetId() != null) {
            try {
                metaApi.setAdSetStatus(decodeToken(tenant),
                        campaign.getConfirmationAdSetId(), "PAUSED");
            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.warn("Could not pause confirmation ad set {}: {}", campaign.getConfirmationAdSetId(), e.getMessage());
            }
        }

        campaign.setConfirmationStatus("FAILED");
        campaignRepo.save(campaign);
        log.info("Confirmation FAILED for campaign {} (tenant {})", campaignId, tenantId);
        return campaignService.toResponse(campaign);
    }

    // ─── Block F §6: Bid Cap Recommendation ──────────────────────────────

    /**
     * Recommend a bid cap based on the P95 of historical CPA for this campaign.
     * Vision: bid cap prevents overpaying in Advantage+ while staying competitive.
     * Logged to bid_cap_log for audit trail.
     */
    @Transactional
    public java.util.Map<String, Object> recommendBidCap(UUID tenantId, UUID campaignId) {
        requireCampaign(tenantId, campaignId);

        // Pull recent CPA values from decision_log via spend & conversion events
        List<Double> cpaValues = jdbc.queryForList(
            """
            SELECT spend / NULLIF(conversions, 0) AS cpa
            FROM (
                SELECT
                    ms.id,
                    COALESCE(ms.spend_total, 0) AS spend,
                    COUNT(e.id) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = 'CONVERSION') AS conversions
                FROM meta_ad_sets ms
                LEFT JOIN events e ON e.session_id IN (
                    SELECT id FROM sessions WHERE tenant_id = ?
                ) AND e.event_type = 'CONVERSION'
                AND e.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
                WHERE ms.campaign_id = ?
                  AND ms.tenant_id = ?
                GROUP BY ms.id, ms.spend_total
            ) sub
            WHERE spend > 0 AND conversions > 0
            """,
            Double.class, tenantId, campaignId, tenantId);

        if (cpaValues.isEmpty()) {
            return java.util.Map.of(
                "status", "INSUFFICIENT_DATA",
                "reason", "No CPA data in the last 30 days for this campaign"
            );
        }

        cpaValues.sort(Double::compareTo);
        int p95Index = (int) Math.ceil(0.95 * cpaValues.size()) - 1;
        double cpaP95 = cpaValues.get(Math.min(p95Index, cpaValues.size() - 1));
        // Round to 2 decimal places
        double recommendedCap = Math.round(cpaP95 * 100.0) / 100.0;

        // Log to audit table
        jdbc.update(
            """
            INSERT INTO bid_cap_log (tenant_id, campaign_id, recommended_cap, cpa_p95, basis)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'TWO_CONTOUR')
            """,
            tenantId, campaignId.toString(), recommendedCap, cpaP95);

        log.info("Bid cap recommendation: campaignId={} cap={} cpaP95={} n={}",
                campaignId, recommendedCap, cpaP95, cpaValues.size());

        return java.util.Map.of(
            "campaign_id",      campaignId.toString(),
            "recommended_cap",  recommendedCap,
            "cpa_p95",          cpaP95,
            "sample_size",      cpaValues.size(),
            "basis",            "TWO_CONTOUR"
        );
    }

    // ─── Block F §7: CREATIVE_TESTING_TOOL mode ───────────────────────────

    /**
     * Check whether the tenant is in CREATIVE_TESTING_TOOL launch_mode.
     * In this mode: all ad sets receive strictly equal budgets and equal impressions
     * target — no Thompson exploitation until the test window closes.
     */
    public boolean isCreativeTestingToolMode(UUID tenantId) {
        String mode = jdbc.queryForObject(
            "SELECT launch_mode FROM tenants WHERE id = ?",
            String.class, tenantId);
        return "CREATIVE_TESTING_TOOL".equals(mode);
    }

    /**
     * In CREATIVE_TESTING_TOOL mode: equal-split launch where every ad set
     * receives identical budget and is marked as an exploration slot.
     * Returns same response shape as launchTestBatch for API compatibility.
     */
    @Transactional
    public List<AdSetResponse> launchCreativeTestBatch(UUID tenantId, TestBatchRequest req) {
        if (!isCreativeTestingToolMode(tenantId)) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "Tenant is not in CREATIVE_TESTING_TOOL mode. Use launchTestBatch instead.");
        }
        MetaCampaign campaign = requireCampaign(tenantId, req.getCampaignId());
        Tenant tenant = requireTenant(tenantId);
        String token = decodeToken(tenant);
        String adAccountId = tenant.getMetaAdAccountId();
        if (adAccountId == null) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "Tenant has no Meta ad account ID");
        }

        int totalAdSets = req.getAdSets().size();
        if (totalAdSets < 2) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
                    "CREATIVE_TESTING_TOOL mode requires at least 2 ad sets");
        }

        // Strictly equal budget across all slots — no anchor exception in this mode
        float totalBudget = req.getPerAdSetDailyBudget() * totalAdSets;
        float perSlotBudget = Math.round((totalBudget / totalAdSets) * 100) / 100f;

        UUID batchId = UUID.randomUUID();
        Instant now = Instant.now();
        List<AdSetResponse> created = new ArrayList<>();

        for (var adSetReq : req.getAdSets()) {
            String name = adSetReq.getName() != null ? adSetReq.getName()
                    : "ctt-" + batchId.toString().substring(0, 8) + "-" + (created.size() + 1);
            String metaAdSetId = metaApi.createAdSet(
                    token, adAccountId, campaign.getMetaCampaignId(),
                    name, adSetReq.getAudienceSpec(), perSlotBudget);

            MetaAdSet adSet = new MetaAdSet();
            adSet.setTenantId(tenantId);
            adSet.setCampaignId(campaign.getId());
            adSet.setMetaAdSetId(metaAdSetId);
            adSet.setCreativeId(adSetReq.getCreativeId());
            adSet.setAudienceSpec(adSetReq.getAudienceSpec());
            adSet.setDailyBudget(perSlotBudget);
            adSet.setStatus("PAUSED");
            adSet.setBatchId(batchId);
            adSet.setBatchLaunchedAt(now);
            adSet.setExplorationSlot(true); // all slots are exploration in CTT mode
            adSet.setAnchor(false);

            learningPhaseService.logBeforeAction(tenantId, metaAdSetId, "LAUNCH",
                    adSet.getLearningPhase());
            created.add(campaignService.toAdSetResponse(adSetRepo.save(adSet)));
        }

        log.info("CREATIVE_TESTING_TOOL batch {} launched: {} slots × {} budget (tenant {})",
                batchId, totalAdSets, perSlotBudget, tenantId);
        return created;
    }

    // ─── Budget Guard (§6.5: ≤20% per step) ─────────────────────────────

    /**
     * Validates that a budget change does not exceed 20% in one step.
     * A change > 20% can reset Meta's Learning Phase.
     */
    public static void validateBudgetStep(Float currentBudget, Float newBudget, String entityId) {
        if (currentBudget == null || currentBudget == 0) return;
        // Compute as double to avoid float→double widening errors (0.2f widens to 0.200000003...)
        double changePct = Math.abs(newBudget.doubleValue() - currentBudget.doubleValue()) / currentBudget.doubleValue();
        if (changePct > 0.20 + 1e-7) {  // 1e-7 tolerance for floating-point representation
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
                    String.format("Budget change of %.0f%% exceeds the ≤20%% rule (§6.5) for entity %s. "
                            + "Use incremental steps to avoid resetting Meta's Learning Phase.",
                            changePct * 100, entityId));
        }
    }

    // ─── Internal ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private MetaCampaign requireCampaign(UUID tenantId, UUID campaignId) {
        MetaCampaign c = campaignRepo.findById(campaignId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Campaign not found"));
        if (!c.getTenantId().equals(tenantId)) throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN);
        return c;
    }

    private Tenant requireTenant(UUID tenantId) {
        return tenantRepo.findById(tenantId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Tenant not found"));
    }

    private String decodeToken(Tenant tenant) {
        if (tenant.getMetaAccessTokenEnc() == null) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "Tenant has no Meta access token");
        }
        return new String(tenant.getMetaAccessTokenEnc(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
    }

    private String buildRecommendation(AdSetScore winner, double groupMean) {
        double lift = winner.shrunk / groupMean - 1;
        if (winner.observations < 50) {
            return String.format("Winner has limited data (%d obs). "
                    + "Consider running longer before confirmation run. "
                    + "Shrunk estimate: %.1f%% (raw: %.1f%%)",
                    winner.observations, winner.shrunk * 100, winner.raw * 100);
        }
        return String.format("Winner shows %.0f%% lift over group mean (shrunk estimate). "
                + "Ready for confirmation run.",
                lift * 100);
    }

    private static class AdSetScore {
        final MetaAdSet adSet;
        final double raw;
        final long observations;
        double shrunk;

        AdSetScore(MetaAdSet adSet, double raw, long observations) {
            this.adSet = adSet;
            this.raw = raw;
            this.observations = observations;
            this.shrunk = raw;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * CAPI Chain v2 value formula evaluator (vision §19.4 / arch §16.4).
 * Computes proxy values using k_accr × k_ticket multipliers stored in tenants.value_coeffs.
 *
 * Formula tokens: base_lead, base_schedule, base_reg + k_accr + k_ticket
 * e.g. "4000*k_accr*k_ticket" → resolved from coeffs JSONB
 *
 * SECURITY: Spring Boot NEVER writes thompson_arms alpha/beta.
 */
@Slf4j
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class ValueFormulaService {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private static final ObjectMapper MAPPER = new ObjectMapper();

    // ─── Coefficient resolution ───────────────────────────────────────────────

    /**
     * Resolve k_accr multiplier from session's self_accredited field.
     *   true  → 1.0
     *   false → 0.0 (non-accredited; route to future_regcf pixel, NOT investor pixel)
     *   null  → 0.5 (unknown; conservative default)
     */
    public static double resolveKAccr(Boolean selfAccredited) {
        if (selfAccredited == null) return 0.5;
        return selfAccredited ? 1.0 : 0.0;
    }

    /**
     * Resolve k_ticket from ticket_bucket using tenants.value_coeffs.
     * Default scale: LT25K=0.3, 25_50K=0.6, 50_100K=1.0, 100_250K=1.8, GT250K=3.0
     */
    public double resolveKTicket(UUID tenantId, String ticketBucket) {
        JsonNode coeffs = loadValueCoeffs(tenantId);
        if (coeffs == null || ticketBucket == null) return 1.0;
        JsonNode kTicketNode = coeffs.path("k_ticket");
        if (kTicketNode.isMissingNode()) return 1.0;
        return kTicketNode.path(ticketBucket).asDouble(1.0);
    }

    /**
     * Compute CAPI proxy value from formula string + session qualifiers.
     *
     * Supported token substitutions:
     *   base_lead     → coeffs.base_lead
     *   base_schedule → coeffs.base_schedule
     *   base_reg      → coeffs.base_reg
     *   k_accr        → resolved from selfAccredited
     *   k_ticket      → resolved from ticketBucket
     *
     * Arithmetic: only * supported (all formulas are multiplicative).
     */
    public double computeValue(
            UUID tenantId,
            String formula,
            Boolean selfAccredited,
            String ticketBucket) {

        if (formula == null || formula.isBlank()) return 0.0;

        JsonNode coeffs = loadValueCoeffs(tenantId);
        double baseLead     = coeffs != null ? coeffs.path("base_lead").asDouble(4000)     : 4000;
        double baseSchedule = coeffs != null ? coeffs.path("base_schedule").asDouble(7600)  : 7600;
        double baseReg      = coeffs != null ? coeffs.path("base_reg").asDouble(15800)      : 15800;

        double kAccr   = resolveKAccr(selfAccredited);
        double kTicket = resolveKTicket(tenantId, ticketBucket);

        String expr = formula.trim()
                .replace("base_lead",     String.valueOf(baseLead))
                .replace("base_schedule", String.valueOf(baseSchedule))
                .replace("base_reg",      String.valueOf(baseReg))
                .replace("k_accr",        String.valueOf(kAccr))
                .replace("k_ticket",      String.valueOf(kTicket));

        return evalMultiplicative(expr);
    }

    /** Evaluate a pure-multiplicative expression like "4000.0*1.0*1.8". */
    private static double evalMultiplicative(String expr) {
        try {
            String[] tokens = expr.split("\\*");
            double result = 1.0;
            for (String t : tokens) {
                result *= Double.parseDouble(t.trim());
            }
            return result;
        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            log.warn("Value formula parse error: {}", expr);
            return 0.0;
        }
    }

    // ─── Investor CAPI map seed ───────────────────────────────────────────────

    /**
     * Seed capi_event_map for the investor funnel (InteliGel Reg D 506(c)).
     * Non-accredited → future_regcf pixel ONLY (§19.4 critical rule).
     */
    @Transactional
    public void seedInvestorCAPIMap(UUID tenantId) {
        Object[][] entries = {
            // stage_key,          pixel_role,        meta_event_name,       value_formula,                   send_condition
            {"BOOKED",             "investor_primary", "Lead",                "base_lead*k_accr*k_ticket",      "self_accredited = true"},
            {"BOOKED",             "future_regcf",    "Lead",                "base_lead*0.3",                  "self_accredited = false"},
            {"CALL_HELD",          "investor_primary", "Schedule",            "base_schedule*k_accr*k_ticket",  "self_accredited = true"},
            {"ACCRED_VERIFIED",    "investor_primary", "CompleteRegistration","base_reg*k_ticket",              "self_accredited = true"},
            {"INVEST_COMMITTED",   "investor_primary", "Purchase",            "monetaryValue",                  "self_accredited = true"},
        };

        for (Object[] e : entries) {
            jdbc.update("""
                INSERT INTO capi_event_map
                    (tenant_id, stage_key, pixel_role, meta_event_name, value_formula, send_condition)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, stage_key, pixel_role) DO UPDATE
                    SET meta_event_name = EXCLUDED.meta_event_name,
                        value_formula   = EXCLUDED.value_formula,
                        send_condition  = EXCLUDED.send_condition
                """,
                tenantId, e[0], e[1], e[2], e[3], e[4]);
        }
        log.info("Investor CAPI map seeded for tenant={}", tenantId);
    }

    // ─── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private JsonNode loadValueCoeffs(UUID tenantId) {
        try {
            String json = jdbc.queryForObject(
                    "SELECT value_coeffs FROM tenants WHERE id = ?", String.class, tenantId);
            return json != null ? MAPPER.readTree(json) : null;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    // ─── B2B CAPI map seed ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /**
     * Seed capi_event_map for the B2B template (legacy proxy-value bidding).
     */
    @Transactional
    public void seedB2BCAPIMap(UUID tenantId) {
        Object[][] entries = {
            {"CALL_ANSWERED",   "investor_primary", "Lead",     "base_lead",       null},
            {"MEETING_ATTENDED","investor_primary", "Schedule", "base_schedule",   null},
            {"DEAL_WON",        "investor_primary", "Purchase", "monetaryValue",   null},
        };
        for (Object[] e : entries) {
            jdbc.update("""
                INSERT INTO capi_event_map
                    (tenant_id, stage_key, pixel_role, meta_event_name, value_formula, send_condition)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, stage_key, pixel_role) DO NOTHING
                """,
                tenantId, e[0], e[1], e[2], e[3], e[4]);
        }
    }

    public Map<String, Double> getCAPIMap(UUID tenantId) {
        var rows = jdbc.queryForList(
                "SELECT stage_key, value_formula FROM capi_event_map WHERE tenant_id = ?", tenantId);
        Map<String, Double> result = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
        rows.forEach(r -> result.put((String) r.get("stage_key"), 0.0));
        return result;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import com.marketingai.dto.variant.*;
import com.marketingai.entity.LandingVariant;
import com.marketingai.entity.ThompsonArm;
import com.marketingai.entity.VariantOffer;
import com.marketingai.repository.LandingVariantRepository;
import com.marketingai.repository.ThompsonArmRepository;
import com.marketingai.repository.VariantOfferRepository;
import com.marketingai.security.TenantContext;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

@Slf4j
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Transactional
public class VariantService {

    private final LandingVariantRepository variantRepo;
    private final VariantOfferRepository offerRepo;
    private final ThompsonArmRepository armRepo;
    private final ComplianceService complianceService;
    private final OfferValidator offerValidator;
    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;

    // ─── List ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<VariantResponse> listVariants(String status) {
        UUID tenantId = currentTenant();
        List<LandingVariant> variants = status != null
                ? variantRepo.findAllByTenantIdAndStatus(tenantId, status)
                : variantRepo.findAllByTenantId(tenantId);
        if (variants.isEmpty()) return List.of();

        // Batch-load arms (1 query) to avoid N+1
        List<UUID> variantIds = variants.stream().map(LandingVariant::getId).toList();
        Map<UUID, ThompsonArm> armByVariantId = armRepo
                .findByVariantIdInAndContextKey(variantIds, "global")
                .stream()
                .collect(Collectors.toMap(ThompsonArm::getVariantId, a -> a));

        // Batch-load offers (1 query)
        Map<UUID, VariantOffer> offerByVariantId = offerRepo
                .findByVariantIdInAndTenantId(variantIds, tenantId)
                .stream()
                .collect(Collectors.toMap(VariantOffer::getVariantId, o -> o));

        return variants.stream()
                .map(v -> toResponse(v,
                        offerByVariantId.get(v.getId()),
                        armByVariantId.get(v.getId())))
                .toList();
    }

    // ─── Get one ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public VariantResponse getVariant(UUID id) {
        LandingVariant v = findOwned(id);
        VariantOffer offer = offerRepo.findByVariantIdAndTenantId(id, currentTenant()).orElse(null);
        return toResponse(v, offer);
    }

    // ─── Create (DRAFT) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    public VariantResponse createVariant(VariantRequest req) {
        UUID tenantId = currentTenant();
        if (variantRepo.existsByTenantIdAndSlug(tenantId, req.getSlug())) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "Slug already exists: " + req.getSlug());
        }

        validateOffer(req.getOffer(), tenantId, null);

        LandingVariant v = new LandingVariant();
        v.setTenantId(tenantId);
        v.setName(req.getName());
        v.setSlug(req.getSlug());
        v.setCreativeId(req.getCreativeId());
        v.setBlocks(req.getBlocks() != null ? req.getBlocks() : "[]");
        v.setBlockOrder(req.getBlockOrder() != null ? req.getBlockOrder() : new String[0]);
        v.setStatus("DRAFT");
        variantRepo.save(v);

        VariantOffer offer = saveOffer(req.getOffer(), v.getId(), tenantId);
        return toResponse(v, offer);
    }

    // ─── Update ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    public VariantResponse updateVariant(UUID id, VariantRequest req) {
        LandingVariant v = findOwned(id);
        String current = v.getStatus();
        if ("ACTIVE".equals(current) || "ARCHIVED".equals(current)) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "Cannot edit a variant in status: " + current);
        }

        UUID tenantId = currentTenant();
        if (!v.getSlug().equals(req.getSlug())
                && variantRepo.existsByTenantIdAndSlug(tenantId, req.getSlug())) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "Slug already exists: " + req.getSlug());
        }

        validateOffer(req.getOffer(), tenantId, v.getId());

        v.setName(req.getName());
        v.setSlug(req.getSlug());
        v.setCreativeId(req.getCreativeId());
        if (req.getBlocks() != null) v.setBlocks(req.getBlocks());
        if (req.getBlockOrder() != null) v.setBlockOrder(req.getBlockOrder());
        variantRepo.save(v);

        offerRepo.deleteByVariantIdAndTenantId(v.getId(), tenantId);
        VariantOffer offer = saveOffer(req.getOffer(), v.getId(), tenantId);
        return toResponse(v, offer);
    }

    // ─── Workflow: DRAFT → REVIEW ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

    public VariantResponse submitForReview(UUID id) {
        LandingVariant v = findOwned(id);
        if (!"DRAFT".equals(v.getStatus()) && !"PAUSED".equals(v.getStatus())) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "Only DRAFT or PAUSED variants can be submitted for review");
        }
        v.setStatus("REVIEW");
        variantRepo.save(v);
        return toResponse(v, offerRepo.findByVariantIdAndTenantId(id, currentTenant()).orElse(null));
    }

    // ─── Workflow: REVIEW → ACTIVE ────────────────────────────────────────────────

    public VariantResponse approveVariant(UUID id, UUID approverId) {
        LandingVariant v = findOwned(id);
        if (!"REVIEW".equals(v.getStatus())) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "Only REVIEW variants can be approved");
        }
        // Compliance gate: latest check must be PASS or overridden (arch §15.4)
        if (!complianceService.isCompliant(id)) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
                    "Variant cannot be approved: no passing compliance check. " +
                    "Run /api/v1/compliance/check first, or override an existing check.");
        }
        v.setStatus("ACTIVE");
        v.setApprovedBy(approverId);
        v.setApprovedAt(Instant.now());
        variantRepo.save(v);
        // arch v1.1 §12 #12: single writer for thompson_arms = FastAPI.
        // Arms are created lazily by FastAPI on first /decide call for this variant.
        return toResponse(v, offerRepo.findByVariantIdAndTenantId(id, currentTenant()).orElse(null));
    }

    // ─── Workflow: ACTIVE → PAUSED ────────────────────────────────────────────────

    public VariantResponse pauseVariant(UUID id) {
        LandingVariant v = findOwned(id);
        if (!"ACTIVE".equals(v.getStatus())) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "Only ACTIVE variants can be paused");
        }
        v.setStatus("PAUSED");
        variantRepo.save(v);
        return toResponse(v, offerRepo.findByVariantIdAndTenantId(id, currentTenant()).orElse(null));
    }

    // ─── Archive ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    public VariantResponse archiveVariant(UUID id) {
        LandingVariant v = findOwned(id);
        v.setStatus("ARCHIVED");
        variantRepo.save(v);
        return toResponse(v, offerRepo.findByVariantIdAndTenantId(id, currentTenant()).orElse(null));
    }

    // ─── Public lookup by slug (no auth required) ────────────────────────────────

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public VariantResponse getActiveBySlug(String slug) {
        LandingVariant v = variantRepo.findBySlugAndStatus(slug, "ACTIVE")
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
                        "No active variant with slug: " + slug));
        VariantOffer offer = offerRepo.findByVariantIdAndTenantId(v.getId(), v.getTenantId()).orElse(null);
        return toResponse(v, offer);
    }

    // ─── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private void validateOffer(VariantOfferRequest req, UUID tenantId, UUID variantId) {
        if (req == null) return;
        Double minMargin = loadMinMargin(tenantId);
        Map<String, Object> offerMap = new HashMap<>();
        offerMap.put("discount_type",    req.getDiscountType());
        offerMap.put("discount_depth",   req.getDiscountDepth() != null ? req.getDiscountDepth() : 0.0);
        offerMap.put("guarantee_type",   req.getGuaranteeType());
        offerMap.put("guarantee_days",   req.getGuaranteeDays());
        offerMap.put("has_real_urgency", req.getHasRealUrgency());
        offerMap.put("urgency_source",   req.getUrgencySource());
        offerMap.put("estimated_margin", req.getEstimatedMargin());
        offerMap.put("payment_terms",    req.getPaymentTerms());
        OfferValidator.ValidationResult result = offerValidator.validate(offerMap, minMargin);
        if (!result.valid()) {
            // Log violation
            for (String err : result.errors()) {
                try {
                    jdbc.update("""
                        INSERT INTO offer_validity_violations
                            (tenant_id, variant_id, field, reason)
                        VALUES (?, ?, 'offer', ?)
                        """, tenantId, variantId, err);
                } catch (Exception ex) {
                    log.warn("Failed to log offer violation: {}", ex.getMessage());
                }
            }
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
                "Offer validity check failed: " + String.join("; ", result.errors()));
        }
    }

    private Double loadMinMargin(UUID tenantId) {
        try {
            List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbc.queryForList(
                "SELECT settings->>'min_margin' AS min_margin FROM tenants WHERE id = ?",
                tenantId);
            if (!rows.isEmpty() && rows.get(0).get("min_margin") != null) {
                return Double.parseDouble(rows.get(0).get("min_margin").toString());
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.warn("Could not load min_margin for tenant {}: {}", tenantId, e.getMessage());
        }
        return null;
    }

    private LandingVariant findOwned(UUID id) {
        return variantRepo.findByIdAndTenantId(id, currentTenant())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Variant not found"));
    }

    private UUID currentTenant() {
        String raw = TenantContext.get();
        if (raw == null) throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED, "No tenant context");
        return UUID.fromString(raw);
    }

    private VariantOffer saveOffer(VariantOfferRequest req, UUID variantId, UUID tenantId) {
        if (req == null) return null;
        VariantOffer o = new VariantOffer();
        o.setVariantId(variantId);
        o.setTenantId(tenantId);
        o.setDiscountType(req.getDiscountType());
        o.setDiscountDepth(req.getDiscountDepth());
        o.setGuaranteeType(req.getGuaranteeType());
        o.setGuaranteeDays(req.getGuaranteeDays());
        o.setBonus(req.getBonus());
        o.setHasRealUrgency(req.getHasRealUrgency() != null && req.getHasRealUrgency());
        o.setUrgencySource(req.getUrgencySource());
        o.setUrgencyDaysLeft(req.getUrgencyDaysLeft());
        o.setPaymentTerms(req.getPaymentTerms());
        o.setMarginFloor(req.getMarginFloor());
        o.setEstimatedMargin(req.getEstimatedMargin());
        // Mark installment offers for legal review
        boolean isInstallment = req.getPaymentTerms() != null
                && req.getPaymentTerms().toLowerCase().contains("installment");
        o.setRequiresLegalReview(isInstallment);
        return offerRepo.save(o);
    }

    // Single-variant operations still load arm from DB (1 query, acceptable)
    VariantResponse toResponse(LandingVariant v, VariantOffer offer) {
        ThompsonArm arm = armRepo.findByVariantIdAndContextKey(v.getId(), "global").orElse(null);
        return toResponse(v, offer, arm);
    }

    // Batch-friendly overload used by listVariants (arm pre-loaded, no extra query)
    VariantResponse toResponse(LandingVariant v, VariantOffer offer, ThompsonArm arm) {
        return VariantResponse.builder()
                .id(v.getId())
                .tenantId(v.getTenantId())
                .creativeId(v.getCreativeId())
                .name(v.getName())
                .slug(v.getSlug())
                .status(v.getStatus())
                .blocks(v.getBlocks())
                .blockOrder(v.getBlockOrder())
                .matchScore(v.getMatchScore())
                .approvedBy(v.getApprovedBy())
                .approvedAt(v.getApprovedAt())
                .createdAt(v.getCreatedAt())
                .updatedAt(v.getUpdatedAt())
                .offer(offer == null ? null : VariantOfferResponse.builder()
                        .id(offer.getId())
                        .discountType(offer.getDiscountType())
                        .discountDepth(offer.getDiscountDepth())
                        .guaranteeType(offer.getGuaranteeType())
                        .guaranteeDays(offer.getGuaranteeDays())
                        .bonus(offer.getBonus())
                        .hasRealUrgency(offer.getHasRealUrgency())
                        .urgencySource(offer.getUrgencySource())
                        .urgencyDaysLeft(offer.getUrgencyDaysLeft())
                        .paymentTerms(offer.getPaymentTerms())
                        .marginFloor(offer.getMarginFloor())
                        .build())
                .alpha(arm == null ? null : arm.getAlpha())
                .beta(arm == null ? null : arm.getBeta())
                .totalSamples(arm == null ? null : arm.getTotalSamples())
                .build();
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.scheduler;

import com.marketingai.service.AppointmentService;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Slf4j
@Component
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class AppointmentCheckScheduler {

    private final AppointmentService appointmentService;

    /** Every 30 minutes: apply 7-day no-show timeout to pending appointments. */
    @Scheduled(fixedDelay = 1_800_000)
    public void checkPendingAppointments() {
        log.debug("Appointment check started");
        try {
            appointmentService.reviewPendingAppointments();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Appointment check failed: {}", e.getMessage(), e);
        }
        log.debug("Appointment check completed");
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.scheduler;

import com.marketingai.service.AutopilotService;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * Hourly autopilot evaluation (Phase 6-6).
 * Only runs for tenants with enabled=true in autopilot_settings.
 * Safety: max_l1_triggers_per_day=3 cap enforced inside AutopilotService.
 */
@Slf4j
@Component
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class AutopilotScheduler {

    private final JdbcTemplate    jdbc;
    private final AutopilotService autopilotService;

    @Scheduled(cron = "0 0 * * * *")
    public void runHourlyEvaluation() {
        List<UUID> enabledTenants = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT tenant_id FROM autopilot_settings WHERE enabled = TRUE
                """, UUID.class);

        for (UUID tenantId : enabledTenants) {
            try {
                Map<String, Object> result = autopilotService.evaluateActions(tenantId);
                log.info("Autopilot [{}]: {}", tenantId, result);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.warn("Autopilot eval failed for tenant {}: {}", tenantId, e.getMessage());
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.scheduler;

import com.marketingai.service.AlertService;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * Daily burnout scan 06:00 UTC (Phase 6-1 + v1.1).
 * v1.1: uses survival model when n_obs >= 30; auto-creates brief on 7-day warning;
 * suppresses alert when anchor verdict = MARKET (vision §8.1).
 */
@Slf4j
@Component
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class BurnoutScanScheduler {

    private static final int N_MIN_FOR_SURVIVAL = 30;
    private static final int DAYS_REMAINING_ALERT = 7;

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private final RestTemplate restTemplate;
    private final AlertService alertService;

    @Scheduled(cron = "0 0 6 * * *")
    public void runDailyScan() {
        List<UUID> tenantIds = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT DISTINCT tenant_id
                FROM meta_insights_history
                WHERE recorded_at > now() - interval '7 days'
                """, UUID.class);

        log.info("Burnout scan: {} tenants", tenantIds.size());
        for (UUID tenantId : tenantIds) {
            try {
                scanTenant(tenantId);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.warn("Burnout scan failed for tenant {}: {}", tenantId, e.getMessage());
            }
        }
    }

    private void scanTenant(UUID tenantId) {
        List<Map<String, Object>> creatives = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT c.id, c.name,
                       COALESCE(cq.frequency, 1.0)        AS frequency,
                       COALESCE(cq.initial_roas, 1.0)     AS initial_roas,
                       COALESCE(cq.days_running, 0)       AS days_running,
                       COALESCE(cq.n_obs, 0)              AS n_obs
                FROM creatives c
                LEFT JOIN creative_quality cq ON cq.creative_id = c.id
                WHERE c.tenant_id = ?
                  AND c.status = 'ACTIVE'
                """, tenantId);

        for (Map<String, Object> row : creatives) {
            UUID creativeId = (UUID) row.get("id");
            int nObs        = ((Number) row.get("n_obs")).intValue();
            double frequency    = ((Number) row.get("frequency")).doubleValue();
            double initialRoas  = ((Number) row.get("initial_roas")).doubleValue();
            int daysRunning     = ((Number) row.get("days_running")).intValue();

            // Check anchor verdict to suppress false burnout alert
            String anchorVerdict = getLatestAnchorVerdict(tenantId, creativeId);

            Map<String, Object> result;
            if (nObs >= N_MIN_FOR_SURVIVAL) {
                result = callSurvivalModel(frequency, initialRoas, daysRunning, nObs, anchorVerdict);
            } else {
                result = callHeuristicModel(frequency, daysRunning);
            }

            if (result == null) continue;

            updateCreativeQuality(tenantId, creativeId, result);

            Boolean alertSuppressed = (Boolean) result.getOrDefault("alert_suppressed", false);
            Integer daysRemaining   = result.get("days_remaining") instanceof Number
                    ? ((Number) result.get("days_remaining")).intValue() : null;

            if (daysRemaining != null && daysRemaining <= DAYS_REMAINING_ALERT && !Boolean.TRUE.equals(alertSuppressed)) {
                UUID briefId = autoCreateReplacementBrief(tenantId, creativeId, (String) row.get("name"), daysRemaining);
                if (briefId != null) {
                    jdbc.update("""
                            UPDATE creative_quality SET replacement_brief_id = ?
                            WHERE creative_id = ? AND tenant_id = ?
                            """, briefId, creativeId, tenantId);
                }
                alertService.sendAlert(String.format(
                        "⚠️ Burnout warning: creative %s predicted to burn out in %d days. Brief auto-created.",
                        row.get("name"), daysRemaining));
            }
        }
    }

    private String getLatestAnchorVerdict(UUID tenantId, UUID creativeId) {
        try {
            List<String> verdicts = jdbc.queryForList("""
                    SELECT verdict FROM anchor_divergence_log
                    WHERE tenant_id = ? AND creative_id = ?
                    ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
                    """, String.class, tenantId, creativeId);
            return verdicts.isEmpty() ? null : verdicts.get(0);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private Map<String, Object> callSurvivalModel(double frequency, double initialRoas,
                                                   int daysRunning, int nObs, String anchorVerdict) {
        try {
            Map<String, Object> req = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            req.put("frequency",            frequency);
            req.put("initial_roas",         initialRoas);
            req.put("current_days_running", daysRunning);
            req.put("n_obs",                nObs);
            if (anchorVerdict != null) req.put("anchor_verdict", anchorVerdict);
            return restTemplate.postForObject("http://ml-service:8001/burnout/survival", req, Map.class);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.debug("Survival model call failed, falling back to heuristic: {}", e.getMessage());
            return callHeuristicModel(frequency, daysRunning);
        }
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private Map<String, Object> callHeuristicModel(double frequency, int daysRunning) {
        try {
            return restTemplate.postForObject("http://ml-service:8001/burnout/score",
                    Map.of("frequency", frequency, "ctr_current", 0.02,
                           "ctr_baseline", 0.03, "spend_current", 0.0, "spend_prev", 0.0,
                           "ctr_drop_rate_per_day", 0.0), Map.class);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.warn("Heuristic burnout call failed: {}", e.getMessage());
            return null;
        }
    }

    private void updateCreativeQuality(UUID tenantId, UUID creativeId, Map<String, Object> result) {
        try {
            Integer burnoutDay = result.get("predicted_burnout_day") instanceof Number
                    ? ((Number) result.get("predicted_burnout_day")).intValue() : null;
            String method = (String) result.getOrDefault("method", "HEURISTIC");
            String confidence = (String) result.getOrDefault("confidence", "LOW");
            jdbc.update("""
                    UPDATE creative_quality
                    SET predicted_burnout_day   = ?,
                        burnout_survival_method = ?,
                        burnout_confidence      = ?
                    WHERE creative_id = ? AND tenant_id = ?
                    """, burnoutDay, method, confidence, creativeId, tenantId);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.debug("creative_quality update skipped: {}", e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    private UUID autoCreateReplacementBrief(UUID tenantId, UUID creativeId, String creativeName, int daysRemaining) {
        try {
            UUID briefId = UUID.randomUUID();
            jdbc.update("""
                    INSERT INTO creator_briefs (id, tenant_id, brief_type, description, version)
                    VALUES (?, ?, 'VIDEO', ?, 1)
                    """,
                    briefId, tenantId,
                    String.format("AUTO: burnout predicted in %d days for creative '%s' (id=%s)",
                            daysRemaining, creativeName, creativeId));
            return briefId;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.warn("Auto brief creation failed: {}", e.getMessage());
            return null;
        }
    }
}
```

## D:/Marketing-AI/platform-api/src/main/java/com/marketingai/scheduler/ClusterFitScheduler.java

```java
package com.marketingai.scheduler;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonProcessingException;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import com.marketingai.config.AppProperties;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.*;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * Weekly K-means cluster fitting (Phase 5-1, §7.3 Этап 1).
 *
 * Fires Sunday 03:00 UTC. For each tenant:
 *   1. Pulls sessions with consent_level='full' AND is_suspicious=false (§12.1a, §12.6.3)
 *   2. Sends feature batch to FastAPI /cluster/fit
 *   3. Persists returned centroids + rule labels to behavior_clusters
 *
 * Minimum 50 qualifying sessions required; skips tenant otherwise.
 */
@Slf4j
@Component
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class ClusterFitScheduler {

    private final RestTemplate  restTemplate;
    private final AppProperties appProperties;
    private final JdbcTemplate  jdbc;

    private static final int MIN_SESSIONS = 50;
    private static final int N_CLUSTERS   = 7;

    @Scheduled(cron = "0 0 3 * * SUN", zone = "UTC")
    public void fitAllTenants() {
        log.info("ClusterFitScheduler started");
        List<Map<String, Object>> tenants = jdbc.queryForList(
                "SELECT id FROM tenants WHERE active = true");

        for (Map<String, Object> tenant : tenants) {
            UUID tenantId = (UUID) tenant.get("id");
            try {
                fitTenant(tenantId);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.error("Cluster fit failed for tenant {}: {}", tenantId, e.getMessage());
            }
        }
        log.info("ClusterFitScheduler completed");
    }

    private void fitTenant(UUID tenantId) {
        // Pull qualified sessions with their events (last 30 days)
        List<Map<String, Object>> sessions = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT s.id AS session_id, s.device, s.started_at, s.last_event_at,
                       s.crm_user_id, s.converted
                FROM sessions s
                WHERE s.tenant_id = ?
                  AND s.consent_level = 'full'
                  AND s.is_suspicious = false
                  AND s.started_at > now() - interval '30 days'
                """, tenantId);

        if (sessions.size() < MIN_SESSIONS) {
            log.debug("Tenant {} has only {} qualifying sessions (need {}), skipping",
                    tenantId, sessions.size(), MIN_SESSIONS);
            return;
        }

        // Build session records with events for ML service
        List<Map<String, Object>> sessionRecords = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Map<String, Object> sess : sessions) {
            String sessionId = (String) sess.get("session_id");
            List<Map<String, Object>> events = jdbc.queryForList("""
                    SELECT event_type, event_data, event_time, block_event_id
                    FROM events
                    WHERE session_id = ? AND tenant_id = ?
                    ORDER BY event_time
                    """, sessionId, tenantId);

            Map<String, Object> record = new HashMap<>();
            record.put("session", sess);
            record.put("events",  events);
            sessionRecords.add(record);
        }

        Map<String, Object> body = new HashMap<>();
        body.put("tenant_id",  tenantId.toString());
        body.put("sessions",   sessionRecords);
        body.put("n_clusters", N_CLUSTERS);

        HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
        headers.setContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
        headers.set("X-Internal-API-Key", appProperties.getInternalApiKey());

        String url = appProperties.getMlServiceUrl() + "/cluster/fit";

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        Map<String, Object> result = restTemplate.postForObject(
                url, new HttpEntity<>(body, headers), Map.class);

        if (result == null) {
            log.error("ML service returned null for tenant {}", tenantId);
            return;
        }

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        List<Map<String, Object>> centroids = (List<Map<String, Object>>) result.get("centroids");
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        List<String> labels = (List<String>) result.get("cluster_labels");

        if (centroids == null || labels == null) {
            log.error("Missing centroids or labels in ML response for tenant {}", tenantId);
            return;
        }

        persistClusters(tenantId, centroids, labels);
        log.info("Cluster fit complete for tenant {}: {} clusters from {} sessions",
                tenantId, centroids.size(), sessions.size());
    }

    private void persistClusters(UUID tenantId, List<Map<String, Object>> centroids,
                                  List<String> labels) {
        for (int i = 0; i < centroids.size(); i++) {
            Map<String, Object> c = centroids.get(i);
            String label = i < labels.size() ? labels.get(i) : "researcher";
            int sessionCount = ((Number) c.getOrDefault("_session_count", 0)).intValue();

            // Convert centroid to JSON string for storage
            String centroidJson = mapToJson(c);

            jdbc.update("""
                    INSERT INTO behavior_clusters
                        (tenant_id, cluster_idx, label, session_count, centroid, fitted_at)
                    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?::jsonb, now())
                    ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, cluster_idx)
                    DO UPDATE SET
                        label = EXCLUDED.label,
                        session_count = EXCLUDED.session_count,
                        centroid = EXCLUDED.centroid,
                        fitted_at = now()
                    """, tenantId, i, label, sessionCount, centroidJson);
        }
    }

    private static final ObjectMapper OBJECT_MAPPER = new ObjectMapper();

    private String mapToJson(Map<String, Object> map) {
        try {
            return OBJECT_MAPPER.writeValueAsString(map);
        } catch (JsonProcessingException e) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Failed to serialise centroid map to JSON", e);
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.scheduler;

import com.marketingai.service.AlertService;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * CRM Discipline weekly report (3-21).
 * Every Monday 08:00 UTC — per-tenant conversion and quality summary.
 */
@Slf4j
@Component
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class CrmDisciplineScheduler {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private final AlertService alertService;

    @Scheduled(cron = "0 0 8 * * MON")
    public void sendWeeklyDisciplineReport() {
        List<Map<String, Object>> tenants = jdbc.queryForList(
                "SELECT id, name FROM tenants WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'");

        for (Map<String, Object> tenant : tenants) {
            UUID tenantId = (UUID) tenant.get("id");
            String tenantName = (String) tenant.getOrDefault("name", tenantId.toString());
            try {
                sendReportForTenant(tenantId, tenantName);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.warn("CrmDisciplineScheduler failed for tenant={}: {}", tenantId, e.getMessage());
            }
        }
    }

    private void sendReportForTenant(UUID tenantId, String tenantName) {
        Map<String, Object> row = jdbc.queryForMap("""
                SELECT
                    COUNT(*) AS total_sessions,
                    SUM(CASE WHEN converted THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS converted,
                    ROUND(AVG(quality_score)::numeric, 3) AS avg_quality_score,
                    SUM(CASE WHEN consent_level = 'full' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS full_consent
                FROM sessions
                WHERE tenant_id = ?
                  AND created_at > now() - interval '7 days'
                """, tenantId);

        long total = toLong(row.get("total_sessions"));
        long converted = toLong(row.get("converted"));
        double convRate = total > 0 ? (double) converted / total : 0.0;
        double avgQs = row.get("avg_quality_score") != null
                ? ((Number) row.get("avg_quality_score")).doubleValue() : 0.0;
        long fullConsent = toLong(row.get("full_consent"));
        double consentRate = total > 0 ? (double) fullConsent / total : 0.0;

        String report = String.format(
                "📊 Weekly CRM Discipline Report — %s\n\n"
                + "Sessions (last 7d):    %,d\n"
                + "Conversions:           %,d (%.1f%%)\n"
                + "Avg Quality Score:     %.3f\n"
                + "Full-consent sessions: %,d (%.1f%%)\n\n"
                + "Review any consent_rate < 50%% for GDPR compliance.",
                tenantName, total, converted, convRate * 100,
                avgQs, fullConsent, consentRate * 100);

        alertService.sendAlert(report);
        log.info("CrmDiscipline report sent for tenant={}", tenantId);
    }

    private long toLong(Object o) {
        if (o == null) return 0L;
        if (o instanceof Long l) return l;
        if (o instanceof Number n) return n.longValue();
        try { return Long.parseLong(o.toString()); } catch (Exception e) { return 0L; }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.scheduler;

import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Computes tenant-specific diagnostic baselines per placement × device (vision §3.2, arch §15.21).
 * Runs weekly Sunday 05:00 UTC. Upserts into diagnostic_baselines.
 * Uses first-party event data only (sessions + events tables).
 */
@Slf4j
@Component
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class DiagnosticsBaselineScheduler {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;

    @Scheduled(cron = "0 0 5 * * SUN", zone = "UTC")
    public void computeBaselines() {
        List<Map<String, Object>> tenants = jdbc.queryForList(
                "SELECT id FROM tenants WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'");

        for (Map<String, Object> tenant : tenants) {
            UUID tenantId = (UUID) tenant.get("id");
            try {
                computeForTenant(tenantId);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.error("DiagnosticsBaselineScheduler failed for tenant {}: {}", tenantId, e.getMessage());
            }
        }
    }

    private void computeForTenant(UUID tenantId) {
        // Bounce rate per placement × device for last 90 days
        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT
                    COALESCE(s.utm_source, 'UNKNOWN')   AS placement,
                    CASE
                        WHEN s.device_type IN ('MOBILE','DESKTOP','TABLET') THEN s.device_type
                        ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
                    END                                  AS device_type,
                    COUNT(*)                             AS n,
                    AVG(CASE WHEN s.bounce THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS bounce_mean,
                    STDDEV_POP(CASE WHEN s.bounce THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS bounce_std,
                    AVG(s.quality_score)                 AS quality_mean,
                    STDDEV_POP(s.quality_score)          AS quality_std
                FROM sessions s
                WHERE s.tenant_id = ?
                  AND s.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'
                  AND s.consent_level = 'full'
                  AND s.is_suspicious = false
                GROUP BY placement, device_type
                HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30
                """, tenantId);

        for (Map<String, Object> row : rows) {
            String placement  = (String) row.get("placement");
            String deviceType = (String) row.get("device_type");
            int    n          = ((Number) row.get("n")).intValue();
            double bounceMean = row.get("bounce_mean") != null ? ((Number) row.get("bounce_mean")).doubleValue() : 0.0;
            Double bounceStd  = row.get("bounce_std")  != null ? ((Number) row.get("bounce_std")).doubleValue()  : null;

            upsertBaseline(tenantId, placement, deviceType, "BOUNCE_RATE", bounceMean,
                    bounceStd != null ? bounceStd : bounceMean * 0.2 + 0.01, n);
        }

        log.debug("DiagnosticsBaseline: tenant {} — {} rows upserted", tenantId, rows.size());
    }

    private void upsertBaseline(UUID tenantId, String placement, String device, String metric,
                                double value, double std, int n) {
        jdbc.update("""
                INSERT INTO diagnostic_baselines
                    (id, tenant_id, placement, device_type, metric, baseline_value, sample_size,
                     confidence_lo, confidence_hi, computed_at)
                VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, NOW())
                ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, placement, device_type, metric)
                DO UPDATE SET
                    baseline_value = EXCLUDED.baseline_value,
                    sample_size    = EXCLUDED.sample_size,
                    confidence_lo  = EXCLUDED.confidence_lo,
                    confidence_hi  = EXCLUDED.confidence_hi,
                    computed_at    = NOW()
                """,
                tenantId, placement, device, metric, value, n,
                value - 1.96 * std / Math.sqrt(n),
                value + 1.96 * std / Math.sqrt(n));
    }
}
```
