## D:/Marketing-AI/platform-api/src/main/java/com/marketingai/scheduler/EntropyScheduler.java

```java
package com.marketingai.scheduler;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import com.marketingai.config.AppProperties;
import com.marketingai.service.AlertService;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.*;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * Weekly Niche Creative Entropy Index scan (6-8, arch §15.10).
 * For each niche with >= 5 tenants: computes entropy from hook embeddings,
 * persists to niche_entropy_scores, and alerts via Telegram when diversity_flag=true.
 * Runs every Monday at 07:00 UTC (after TaxonomyRecalibrateScheduler Sun 04:00).
 */
@Slf4j
@Component
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class EntropyScheduler {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private final RestTemplate restTemplate;
    private final AppProperties appProperties;
    private final AlertService alertService;
    private final ObjectMapper objectMapper;

    private static final int MIN_TENANTS = 5;

    @Scheduled(cron = "0 0 7 * * MON", zone = "UTC")
    public void runEntropyCheck() {
        log.info("Entropy Index scan started");

        // Load per-niche embedding summary from atom_registry.
        // One representative hook embedding per tenant per niche (latest CONFIRMED entry).
        List<Map<String, Object>> niches = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT niche, COUNT(DISTINCT tenant_count) AS tenant_count
                FROM (
                    SELECT
                        t.settings->>'niche' AS niche,
                        t.id AS tenant_count
                    FROM atom_registry ar
                    JOIN creative_atoms ca ON ca.registry_id = ar.id
                    JOIN creatives c        ON c.id = ca.creative_id
                    JOIN tenants t          ON t.id = c.tenant_id
                    WHERE ar.status = 'CONFIRMED'
                      AND ar.atom_type = 'HOOK'
                      AND t.settings->>'niche' IS NOT NULL
                    GROUP BY t.settings->>'niche', t.id
                ) grouped
                GROUP BY niche
                HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT tenant_count) >= ?
                """, MIN_TENANTS);

        if (niches.isEmpty()) {
            log.info("No niche has >= {} tenants yet — entropy scan skipped", MIN_TENANTS);
            return;
        }

        for (Map<String, Object> nicheRow : niches) {
            String niche = (String) nicheRow.get("niche");
            int tenantCount = ((Number) nicheRow.get("tenant_count")).intValue();

            try {
                processNiche(niche, tenantCount);
            } catch (Exception ex) {
                log.error("Entropy scan failed for niche '{}': {}", niche, ex.getMessage());
            }
        }

        log.info("Entropy Index scan complete for {} niches", niches.size());
    }

    private void processNiche(String niche, int tenantCount) {
        // Load one centroid embedding per tenant (average of their CONFIRMED HOOK centroids)
        List<Map<String, Object>> embRows = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT t.id AS tenant_id,
                       ar.centroid::text AS centroid_text
                FROM atom_registry ar
                JOIN creative_atoms ca ON ca.registry_id = ar.id
                JOIN creatives c        ON c.id = ca.creative_id
                JOIN tenants t          ON t.id = c.tenant_id
                WHERE ar.status = 'CONFIRMED'
                  AND ar.atom_type = 'HOOK'
                  AND t.settings->>'niche' = ?
                GROUP BY t.id, ar.id, ar.centroid
                """, niche);

        if (embRows.size() < MIN_TENANTS) {
            log.debug("Niche '{}': only {} tenants with CONFIRMED HOOK centroids — skipping", niche, embRows.size());
            return;
        }

        // Parse embeddings (stored as pg vector string "[x,y,...]" → list of floats)
        List<List<Double>> embeddings = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Map<String, Object> row : embRows) {
            String centroidStr = Objects.toString(row.get("centroid_text"), "");
            List<Double> vec = parsePgVector(centroidStr);
            if (!vec.isEmpty()) {
                embeddings.add(vec);
            }
        }

        if (embeddings.size() < MIN_TENANTS) {
            log.debug("Niche '{}': parsed only {} valid embeddings — skipping", niche, embeddings.size());
            return;
        }

        // Call FastAPI entropy compute
        Map<String, Object> mlReq = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        mlReq.put("niche", niche);
        mlReq.put("embeddings", embeddings);
        mlReq.put("tenant_count", embeddings.size());

        HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
        headers.setContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
        headers.set("X-Internal-API-Key", appProperties.getInternalApiKey());

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        Map<String, Object> result;
        try {
            result = restTemplate.postForObject(
                    appProperties.getMlServiceUrl() + "/entropy/compute",
                    new HttpEntity<>(mlReq, headers), Map.class);
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            log.error("FastAPI entropy/compute failed for niche '{}': {}", niche, ex.getMessage());
            return;
        }
        if (result == null) return;

        double entropy       = result.get("entropy") != null ? ((Number) result.get("entropy")).doubleValue() : 1.0;
        double meanSim       = result.get("mean_similarity") != null ? ((Number) result.get("mean_similarity")).doubleValue() : 0.0;
        boolean diversityFlag = Boolean.TRUE.equals(result.get("diversity_flag"));
        String recommendation = (String) result.getOrDefault("recommendation", "");

        // Persist
        jdbc.update("""
                INSERT INTO niche_entropy_scores
                    (id, niche, tenant_count, entropy, mean_similarity, diversity_flag, recommendation)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                """,
                UUID.randomUUID(), niche, embeddings.size(),
                entropy, meanSim, diversityFlag, recommendation);

        log.info("Niche '{}': entropy={:.3f} diversity_flag={}", niche, entropy, diversityFlag);

        // Telegram alert when diversity is flagged
        if (diversityFlag) {
            String msg = String.format(
                    "⚠️ *Niche Creative Entropy Alert*\n" +
                    "Niche: *%s*\n" +
                    "Entropy: %.3f (threshold: 0.3)\n" +
                    "Tenants: %d\n" +
                    "Recommendation: %s",
                    niche, entropy, embeddings.size(), recommendation);
            try {
                alertService.sendAlert(msg);
            } catch (Exception tex) {
                log.warn("Telegram alert failed for entropy: {}", tex.getMessage());
            }
        }
    }

    /** Parse PostgreSQL vector literal "[x,y,z,...]" or "{x,y,z,...}" to List<Double>. */
    private List<Double> parsePgVector(String raw) {
        if (raw == null || raw.isBlank()) return List.of();
        String cleaned = raw.trim().replaceAll("[\\[\\]{}]", "");
        String[] parts = cleaned.split(",");
        List<Double> vec = new ArrayList<>(parts.length);
        try {
            for (String p : parts) {
                vec.add(Double.parseDouble(p.trim()));
            }
        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            return List.of();
        }
        return vec;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.scheduler;

import com.marketingai.config.AppProperties;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * External Signals Scheduler (3-12).
 * Hourly: aggregate CPM index from campaign_cpm_history → external_signals.
 * Daily 06:00 UTC: fetch weather from Open-Meteo → external_signals.
 */
@Slf4j
@Component
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class ExternalSignalsScheduler {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private final RestTemplate restTemplate;
    private final AppProperties appProperties;

    @Scheduled(fixedDelay = 3_600_000)
    public void aggregateCpmSignals() {
        try {
            List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbc.queryForList("""
                    SELECT tenant_id, AVG(cpm) AS avg_cpm, COUNT(*) AS n
                    FROM campaign_cpm_history
                    WHERE recorded_at > now() - interval '1 hour'
                    GROUP BY tenant_id
                    """);

            for (Map<String, Object> row : rows) {
                UUID tenantId = (UUID) row.get("tenant_id");
                Double avgCpm = ((Number) row.get("avg_cpm")).doubleValue();

                jdbc.update("""
                        INSERT INTO external_signals
                        (tenant_id, signal_type, observed_at, value_num, source, created_at)
                        VALUES (?, 'CPM_INDEX', now(), ?, 'campaign_cpm_history', now())
                        """, tenantId, avgCpm.floatValue());
            }
            if (!rows.isEmpty()) {
                log.debug("ExternalSignals: saved CPM signals for {} tenants", rows.size());
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.warn("ExternalSignalsScheduler CPM aggregation failed: {}", e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    @Scheduled(cron = "0 0 6 * * *")
    public void fetchWeatherSignals() {
        // Default geo: lat,lon pairs from app config (agricultural hydrogel client)
        String geosConfig = "51.5,-0.1";  // default London; override via AppProperties if needed
        String[] geos = geosConfig.split(";");

        for (String geo : geos) {
            try {
                String[] parts = geo.trim().split(",");
                if (parts.length != 2) continue;
                String lat = parts[0].trim();
                String lon = parts[1].trim();

                String url = "https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast"
                        + "?latitude=" + lat
                        + "&longitude=" + lon
                        + "&daily=precipitation_sum,temperature_2m_max,et0_fao_evapotranspiration"
                        + "&forecast_days=1&timezone=UTC";

                @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
                Map<String, Object> response = restTemplate.getForObject(url, Map.class);
                if (response == null) continue;

                @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
                Map<String, Object> daily = (Map<String, Object>) response.get("daily");
                if (daily == null) continue;

                @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
                List<Double> precipitation = (List<Double>) daily.get("precipitation_sum");
                @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
                List<Double> tempMax = (List<Double>) daily.get("temperature_2m_max");
                @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
                List<Double> et0 = (List<Double>) daily.get("et0_fao_evapotranspiration");

                double precip = precipitation != null && !precipitation.isEmpty()
                        ? precipitation.get(0) : 0.0;
                double temp = tempMax != null && !tempMax.isEmpty() ? tempMax.get(0) : 0.0;
                double gdd = et0 != null && !et0.isEmpty() ? et0.get(0) : 0.0;

                List<String> tags = buildWeatherTags(precip, temp, gdd);
                String tagsArray = "{" + String.join(",", tags) + "}";

                // Platform-wide signal (tenant_id = null)
                jdbc.update("""
                        INSERT INTO external_signals
                        (signal_type, geo, observed_at, value_num, value_tags, source, created_at)
                        VALUES ('WEATHER', ?, now(), ?, ?, 'open-meteo', now())
                        """, lat + "," + lon, (float) precip, tagsArray);

                log.debug("ExternalSignals: weather signal saved for geo={}", geo);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.warn("ExternalSignals: failed to fetch weather for geo={}: {}", geo, e.getMessage());
            }
        }
    }

    public void saveCalendarEvent(UUID tenantId, String name, String tag,
                                   LocalDate startsOn, LocalDate endsOn,
                                   String geo, String expectedEffect) {
        jdbc.update("""
                INSERT INTO event_calendar (tenant_id, name, tag, starts_on, ends_on, geo, expected_effect, created_at)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, now())
                """, tenantId, name, tag, startsOn, endsOn, geo, expectedEffect);
    }

    private List<String> buildWeatherTags(double precipMm, double tempCelsius, double et0) {
        List<String> tags = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        if (precipMm < 1.0) tags.add("drought_moderate");
        if (precipMm < 0.1) tags.add("drought_severe");
        if (tempCelsius > 35.0) tags.add("heat_stress");
        if (et0 > 0) tags.add("growing_degree_days");
        if (precipMm > 20.0) tags.add("heavy_rain");
        if (tags.isEmpty()) tags.add("normal");
        return tags;
    }
}
```

## D:/Marketing-AI/platform-api/src/main/java/com/marketingai/scheduler/FollowupAutoPauseScheduler.java

```java
package com.marketingai.scheduler;

import com.marketingai.service.MlServiceClient;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Hourly auto-pause check for follow-up variants (vision §19.6).
 * Calls ML service to compute P(worse than control) via Monte Carlo.
 * Auto-pauses if P(worse) > 0.95 AND ESS >= 100.
 *
 * SECURITY: Control arm NEVER paused (is_control = true → skip).
 */
@Slf4j
@Component
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class FollowupAutoPauseScheduler {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private final MlServiceClient mlClient;

    @Scheduled(fixedDelay = 3_600_000) // hourly
    public void checkAutoPause() {
        List<Map<String, Object>> tenants = jdbc.queryForList(
                "SELECT DISTINCT tenant_id FROM followup_variants WHERE lifecycle_state = 'APPROVED'");

        for (Map<String, Object> tenantRow : tenants) {
            Object tenantId = tenantRow.get("tenant_id");
            try {
                checkTenant(tenantId);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.warn("FollowupAutoPause failed for tenant={}: {}", tenantId, e.getMessage());
            }
        }
    }

    private void checkTenant(Object tenantId) {
        List<Map<String, Object>> variants = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT id, name, alpha, beta, is_control
                FROM followup_variants
                WHERE tenant_id = ? AND lifecycle_state IN ('APPROVED', 'PAUSED')
                """, tenantId);

        // Find control arm
        Map<String, Object> control = variants.stream()
                .filter(v -> Boolean.TRUE.equals(v.get("is_control")))
                .findFirst()
                .orElse(null);

        if (control == null) return;

        double ctrlAlpha = ((Number) control.get("alpha")).doubleValue();
        double ctrlBeta  = ((Number) control.get("beta")).doubleValue();

        for (Map<String, Object> v : variants) {
            if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(v.get("is_control"))) continue; // never pause control
            if (!"APPROVED".equals(getLifecycleState(tenantId, v.get("id")))) continue;

            double vAlpha = ((Number) v.get("alpha")).doubleValue();
            double vBeta  = ((Number) v.get("beta")).doubleValue();

            Map<String, Object> mlReq = Map.of(
                    "variant_alpha", vAlpha, "variant_beta", vBeta,
                    "control_alpha", ctrlAlpha, "control_beta", ctrlBeta,
                    "min_ess", 100);

            try {
                @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
                Map<String, Object> result = mlClient.post("/decide/followup/auto-pause", mlReq, Map.class);
                boolean shouldPause = Boolean.TRUE.equals(result.get("should_pause"));

                if (shouldPause) {
                    jdbc.update("""
                            UPDATE followup_variants
                            SET lifecycle_state = 'PAUSED'
                            WHERE id = ?::uuid AND is_control = false
                            """, v.get("id"));
                    log.warn("Follow-up variant AUTO-PAUSED: id={} p_worse={} tenant={}",
                            v.get("id"), result.get("p_worse"), tenantId);
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.warn("Auto-pause ML call failed for variant={}: {}", v.get("id"), e.getMessage());
            }
        }
    }

    private String getLifecycleState(Object tenantId, Object variantId) {
        try {
            return jdbc.queryForObject(
                    "SELECT lifecycle_state FROM followup_variants WHERE id = ?::uuid AND tenant_id = ?",
                    String.class, variantId, tenantId);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return "";
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.scheduler;

import com.marketingai.service.AlertService;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Synthetic form health check every 30 minutes (vision §11.4).
 * After 3 consecutive PASSes, alerts marketer to confirm resume if landing was paused.
 */
@Slf4j
@Component
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class FormHealthScheduler {

    private final JdbcTemplate  jdbc;
    private final RestTemplate  restTemplate;
    private final AlertService  alertService;

    @Scheduled(fixedDelay = 1_800_000)
    public void checkFormHealth() {
        List<Map<String, Object>> landings;
        try {
            landings = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT id, tenant_id, form_endpoint_url,
                       consecutive_form_passes, form_paused
                FROM landing_variants
                WHERE is_active = TRUE AND form_endpoint_url IS NOT NULL
                LIMIT 50
                """);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.warn("FormHealthScheduler: query failed — {}", e.getMessage());
            return;
        }

        for (Map<String, Object> landing : landings) {
            String url = (String) landing.get("form_endpoint_url");
            if (url == null) continue;

            try {
                Map<String, Object> req = Map.of("form_endpoint_url", url);
                @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
                Map<String, Object> result = restTemplate.postForObject(
                    "http://ml-service:8001/analyze/form-health", req, Map.class);

                boolean ok = Boolean.TRUE.equals(result != null ? result.get("ok") : null);
                int currentPasses = landing.get("consecutive_form_passes") instanceof Number n
                    ? n.intValue() : 0;

                if (ok) {
                    int newPasses = currentPasses + 1;
                    jdbc.update(
                        "UPDATE landing_variants SET consecutive_form_passes = ? WHERE id = ?",
                        newPasses, landing.get("id"));
                    if (newPasses >= 3 && Boolean.TRUE.equals(landing.get("form_paused"))) {
                        alertService.sendAlert(
                            "Form health: 3 consecutive passes for landing " + landing.get("id")
                            + ". Marketer confirmation required to resume.");
                        log.info("FormHealthScheduler: resume alert sent for landing {}", landing.get("id"));
                    }
                } else {
                    jdbc.update(
                        "UPDATE landing_variants SET consecutive_form_passes = 0 WHERE id = ?",
                        landing.get("id"));
                    log.warn("FormHealthScheduler: form check FAILED for landing {}: {}",
                        landing.get("id"), result != null ? result.get("error") : "null response");
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.warn("FormHealthScheduler: error checking landing {}: {}",
                    landing.get("id"), e.getMessage());
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## D:/Marketing-AI/platform-api/src/main/java/com/marketingai/scheduler/FraudL2Scheduler.java

```java
package com.marketingai.scheduler;

import com.marketingai.service.AlertService;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Fraud Layer 2 share-of-suspicious monitor (vision §12.6.2 Layer 4).
 *
 * Every 60 minutes: for each ACTIVE tenant, count sessions in the last 24h.
 * If share of is_suspicious sessions > 10% → alert + insert fraud_share_alerts.
 *
 * In LOG_ONLY mode: alert only.
 * In ENFORCE mode: alert + set sessions to is_suspicious (already set) + pause ad sets.
 */
@Slf4j
@Component
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class FraudL2Scheduler {

    private static final double SHARE_THRESHOLD = 0.10;

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private final AlertService alertService;

    @Scheduled(fixedDelay = 3_600_000)
    public void checkSuspiciousShare() {
        List<Map<String, Object>> tenants = jdbc.queryForList(
                "SELECT id, fraud_mode FROM tenants WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'");

        for (Map<String, Object> tenant : tenants) {
            UUID tenantId  = (UUID) tenant.get("id");
            String mode    = (String) tenant.getOrDefault("fraud_mode", "LOG_ONLY");
            try {
                checkTenant(tenantId, mode);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.warn("FraudL2Scheduler failed for tenant={}: {}", tenantId, e.getMessage());
            }
        }
    }

    private void checkTenant(UUID tenantId, String fraudMode) {
        Map<String, Object> stats = jdbc.queryForMap("""
                SELECT
                    COUNT(*) AS total,
                    SUM(CASE WHEN is_suspicious THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS suspicious
                FROM sessions
                WHERE tenant_id = ?
                  AND created_at >= now() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
                """, tenantId);

        long total     = toLong(stats.get("total"));
        long suspicious = toLong(stats.get("suspicious"));
        if (total == 0) return;

        double sharePct = (double) suspicious / total;
        if (sharePct <= SHARE_THRESHOLD) return;

        // Source breakdown (top fraud flags)
        List<Map<String, Object>> sources = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT fraud_flags->>'rule' AS rule, COUNT(*) AS cnt
                FROM sessions,
                     jsonb_array_elements(
                         CASE WHEN fraud_flags IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_array_length(fraud_flags) > 0
                              THEN fraud_flags ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
                     ) AS flag(fraud_flags)
                WHERE tenant_id = ?
                  AND is_suspicious = true
                  AND created_at >= now() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
                GROUP BY fraud_flags->>'rule'
                ORDER BY cnt DESC
                LIMIT 5
                """, tenantId);

        String sourceJson = sources.isEmpty() ? "{}" : sources.toString();

        // Check if alert already sent in last 4h (avoid spam)
        List<Map<String, Object>> recentAlerts = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT id FROM fraud_share_alerts
                WHERE tenant_id = ?
                  AND created_at >= now() - INTERVAL '4 hours'
                """, tenantId);
        if (!recentAlerts.isEmpty()) return;

        jdbc.update("""
                INSERT INTO fraud_share_alerts
                    (tenant_id, window_start, window_end, total_sessions, suspicious_sessions,
                     share_pct, sources, alert_sent)
                VALUES (?, now() - INTERVAL '24 hours', now(), ?, ?, ?, ?::jsonb, TRUE)
                """,
                tenantId, (int) total, (int) suspicious,
                (float) (sharePct * 100), sourceJson);

        String msg = String.format(
                "⚠️ Fraud Share Alert [%s] — Tenant: %s\n\nSuspicious sessions (24h): %d / %d (%.1f%%)\n" +
                "Sources: %s\n\nMode: %s. %s",
                fraudMode, tenantId, suspicious, total, sharePct * 100, sourceJson,
                fraudMode, "ENFORCE".equals(fraudMode)
                        ? "Ad sets paused automatically." : "Review traffic sources in Meta Ads Manager.");

        alertService.sendAlert(msg);
        log.warn("FraudL2 share alert: tenant={} suspicious={}/{} ({:.1f}%) mode={}",
                tenantId, suspicious, total, sharePct * 100, fraudMode);

        if ("ENFORCE".equals(fraudMode)) {
            int paused = jdbc.update(
                    "UPDATE meta_ad_sets SET status='PAUSED', updated_at=now() WHERE tenant_id=? AND status='ACTIVE'",
                    tenantId);
            if (paused > 0) {
                log.warn("FraudL2 ENFORCE: tenant={} paused {} ad sets", tenantId, paused);
            }
        }
    }

    private long toLong(Object o) {
        if (o == null) return 0L;
        if (o instanceof Long l) return l;
        if (o instanceof Number n) return n.longValue();
        try { return Long.parseLong(o.toString()); } catch (Exception e) { return 0L; }
    }
}
```

## D:/Marketing-AI/platform-api/src/main/java/com/marketingai/scheduler/FraudL3Scheduler.java

```java
package com.marketingai.scheduler;

import com.marketingai.service.AlertService;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Fraud L3 detector — hourly CTR/conversion anomaly by geo×placement (3-20).
 * When fraud_rate > 30% for a segment, creates circuit_breaker_events level=3.
 */
@Slf4j
@Component
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class FraudL3Scheduler {

    private static final double FRAUD_L3_THRESHOLD = 0.30;

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private final AlertService alertService;

    @Scheduled(fixedDelay = 3_600_000)
    public void detectFraudL3() {
        List<Map<String, Object>> tenants = jdbc.queryForList(
                "SELECT id FROM tenants WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'");

        for (Map<String, Object> tenant : tenants) {
            UUID tenantId = (UUID) tenant.get("id");
            try {
                checkTenantFraudL3(tenantId);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.warn("FraudL3Scheduler failed for tenant={}: {}", tenantId, e.getMessage());
            }
        }
    }

    private void checkTenantFraudL3(UUID tenantId) {
        List<Map<String, Object>> segments = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT geo, placement,
                       COUNT(*) AS total,
                       SUM(CASE WHEN is_suspicious THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fraud_count
                FROM sessions
                WHERE tenant_id = ?
                  AND created_at > now() - interval '1 hour'
                GROUP BY geo, placement
                HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
                """, tenantId);

        int l3EventsCreated = 0;

        for (Map<String, Object> seg : segments) {
            long total = toLong(seg.get("total"));
            long fraudCount = toLong(seg.get("fraud_count"));
            double fraudRate = (double) fraudCount / total;

            if (fraudRate >= FRAUD_L3_THRESHOLD) {
                String geo = (String) seg.get("geo");
                String placement = (String) seg.get("placement");

                String reason = String.format(
                        "FRAUD_L3: geo=%s placement=%s fraud_rate=%.1f%% (%d/%d sessions)",
                        geo, placement, fraudRate * 100, fraudCount, total);

                // Check if same segment L3 already open
                List<Map<String, Object>> existing = jdbc.queryForList("""
                        SELECT id FROM circuit_breaker_events
                        WHERE tenant_id = ?
                          AND trigger_type = 'FRAUD_L3'
                          AND trigger_reason LIKE ?
                          AND resolved_at IS NULL
                        """, tenantId, "%" + geo + "%" + placement + "%");

                if (existing.isEmpty()) {
                    jdbc.update("""
                            INSERT INTO circuit_breaker_events
                            (tenant_id, level, trigger_type, trigger_reason, metric, value, action_taken, created_at)
                            VALUES (?, 'L3', 'FRAUD_L3', ?, 'fraud_rate', ?, 'PAUSE_SEGMENT', now())
                            """, tenantId, reason, (float) fraudRate);

                    l3EventsCreated++;
                    log.warn("FraudL3: tenant={} geo={} placement={} rate={}%",
                            tenantId, geo, placement, String.format("%.1f", fraudRate * 100));
                }
            }
        }

        if (l3EventsCreated > 0) {
            alertService.sendAlert(String.format(
                    "🔴 Fraud L3 Alert — Tenant: %s\n%d segment(s) exceeded 30%% fraud rate in the last hour.\n"
                    + "Check circuit_breaker_events and review Meta placements.",
                    tenantId, l3EventsCreated));
        }
    }

    private long toLong(Object o) {
        if (o == null) return 0L;
        if (o instanceof Long l) return l;
        if (o instanceof Number n) return n.longValue();
        try { return Long.parseLong(o.toString()); } catch (Exception e) { return 0L; }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.scheduler;

import com.marketingai.entity.Tenant;
import com.marketingai.repository.TenantRepository;
import com.marketingai.service.GateEvaluationService;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import java.util.List;

/**
 * Hourly scan: evaluate staged gates for all tenants' TEST campaigns.
 * Runs after MetaSyncScheduler has updated metrics.
 * Vision §12.3: fixed budget, gates = checkpoints, kill = pause.
 */
@Slf4j
@Component
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class GateScanScheduler {

    private final GateEvaluationService gateService;
    private final TenantRepository tenantRepo;

    @Scheduled(fixedDelay = 60 * 60 * 1000, initialDelay = 90_000)
    public void scanAll() {
        List<Tenant> tenants = tenantRepo.findAll();
        log.info("GateScanScheduler: scanning {} tenants", tenants.size());

        int totalEvaluated = 0;
        for (Tenant tenant : tenants) {
            try {
                int evaluated = gateService.evaluateAll(tenant.getId());
                if (evaluated > 0) {
                    log.info("GateScanScheduler: tenant {} — {} ad sets evaluated", tenant.getId(), evaluated);
                }
                totalEvaluated += evaluated;
            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.warn("GateScanScheduler: failed for tenant {}: {}", tenant.getId(), e.getMessage());
            }
        }

        log.info("GateScanScheduler: done — {} total ad sets evaluated", totalEvaluated);
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.scheduler;

import com.marketingai.service.AlertService;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * Weekly graveyard review — Monday 08:00 UTC (v1.1 — vision §13.2).
 * Checks anchor_divergence_log for MARKET/FRAUD/TECHNICAL verdicts;
 * sets retry_candidate=true on creative_postmortems when conditions are met.
 */
@Slf4j
@Component
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class GraveyardReviewScheduler {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private final RestTemplate restTemplate;
    private final AlertService alertService;

    @Scheduled(cron = "0 0 8 * * MON")
    public void runWeeklyReview() {
        List<UUID> tenantIds = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT DISTINCT tenant_id FROM creative_postmortems
                WHERE retry_candidate = false
                  AND created_at > now() - interval '90 days'
                """, UUID.class);

        log.info("Graveyard review: {} tenants", tenantIds.size());
        for (UUID tenantId : tenantIds) {
            try {
                reviewTenant(tenantId);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.warn("Graveyard review failed for tenant {}: {}", tenantId, e.getMessage());
            }
        }
    }

    private void reviewTenant(UUID tenantId) {
        List<Map<String, Object>> postmortems = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT cp.id AS postmortem_id, cp.creative_id
                FROM creative_postmortems cp
                WHERE cp.tenant_id = ?
                  AND cp.retry_candidate = false
                  AND cp.created_at > now() - interval '90 days'
                """, tenantId);

        for (Map<String, Object> pm : postmortems) {
            UUID postmortemId = (UUID) pm.get("postmortem_id");
            UUID creativeId   = (UUID) pm.get("creative_id");

            String anchorVerdict = getLatestAnchorVerdict(tenantId, creativeId);
            boolean fraudFlag            = hasFraudFlag(tenantId, creativeId);
            boolean siteHealthIncident   = hasSiteHealthIncident(tenantId, creativeId);

            Boolean shouldRetry = callGraveyardReview(anchorVerdict, fraudFlag, siteHealthIncident);
            if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(shouldRetry)) {
                String reason = buildReason(anchorVerdict, fraudFlag, siteHealthIncident);
                jdbc.update("""
                        UPDATE creative_postmortems
                        SET retry_candidate  = true,
                            retry_reason     = ?,
                            retry_flagged_at = now()
                        WHERE id = ?
                        """, reason, postmortemId);
                log.info("Graveyard retry flagged for creative {} (reason: {})", creativeId, reason);
            }
        }
    }

    private String getLatestAnchorVerdict(UUID tenantId, UUID creativeId) {
        try {
            List<String> verdicts = jdbc.queryForList("""
                    SELECT verdict FROM anchor_divergence_log
                    WHERE tenant_id = ? AND creative_id = ?
                    ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
                    """, String.class, tenantId, creativeId);
            return verdicts.isEmpty() ? null : verdicts.get(0);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private boolean hasFraudFlag(UUID tenantId, UUID creativeId) {
        try {
            Integer count = jdbc.queryForObject("""
                    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fraud_share_alerts
                    WHERE tenant_id = ? AND created_at > now() - interval '30 days'
                    """, Integer.class, tenantId);
            return count != null && count > 0;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    private boolean hasSiteHealthIncident(UUID tenantId, UUID creativeId) {
        // MVP: no site health table yet; always false until Phase 7
        return false;
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private Boolean callGraveyardReview(String anchorVerdict, boolean fraudFlag, boolean siteHealthIncident) {
        try {
            Map<String, Object> req = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            if (anchorVerdict != null) req.put("anchor_verdict", anchorVerdict);
            req.put("fraud_flag",            fraudFlag);
            req.put("site_health_incident",  siteHealthIncident);
            Map<String, Object> resp = restTemplate.postForObject(
                    "http://ml-service:8001/evolve/graveyard-review", req, Map.class);
            return resp != null && Boolean.TRUE.equals(resp.get("retry_candidate"));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.debug("Graveyard review call failed: {}", e.getMessage());
            return false;
        }
    }

    private String buildReason(String anchorVerdict, boolean fraudFlag, boolean siteHealthIncident) {
        if ("MARKET".equals(anchorVerdict)) return "MARKET_SHIFT";
        if ("FRAUD".equals(anchorVerdict) || fraudFlag) return "FRAUD_CLEARED";
        if ("TECHNICAL".equals(anchorVerdict) || siteHealthIncident) return "TECHNICAL_RESOLVED";
        return "REVIEW";
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.scheduler;

import com.marketingai.service.LearningPhaseService;
import com.marketingai.service.MetaApiService;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Re-reads ad set learning_phase 24h after every Meta write (vision §6.5, §25 p.8).
 * Fills phase_after in learning_phase_log so the system knows whether an action
 * caused a learning reset.
 */
@Slf4j
@Component
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class LearningPhaseCheckScheduler {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private final MetaApiService metaApi;
    private final LearningPhaseService learningPhaseService;

    /** Every 30 minutes: fill phase_after for entries older than 24h */
    @Scheduled(fixedDelay = 30 * 60 * 1000)
    public void checkPendingPhases() {
        List<Map<String, Object>> pending = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT lpl.id, lpl.ad_set_id, t.meta_access_token_enc
                FROM learning_phase_log lpl
                JOIN tenants t ON t.id = lpl.tenant_id
                WHERE lpl.phase_after IS NULL
                  AND lpl.created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
                LIMIT 100
                """);

        if (pending.isEmpty()) return;

        log.info("LearningPhaseCheck: {} pending entries to resolve", pending.size());

        for (Map<String, Object> row : pending) {
            UUID logId = (UUID) row.get("id");
            String adSetId = (String) row.get("ad_set_id");
            byte[] tokenBytes = (byte[]) row.get("meta_access_token_enc");

            if (tokenBytes == null || adSetId == null) {
                learningPhaseService.logPhaseAfter(logId, "UNKNOWN");
                continue;
            }

            String accessToken = new String(tokenBytes, java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            try {
                String phase = metaApi.getAdSetLearningPhase(accessToken, adSetId);
                learningPhaseService.logPhaseAfter(logId, phase != null ? phase : "UNKNOWN");
            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.warn("Could not fetch phase for adSetId={}: {}", adSetId, e.getMessage());
                learningPhaseService.logPhaseAfter(logId, "FETCH_ERROR");
            }
        }

        log.info("LearningPhaseCheck: resolved {} entries", pending.size());
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.scheduler;

import com.marketingai.service.AlertService;
import com.marketingai.config.AppProperties;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.*;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * Monthly match-score calibration report (vision §6.3a).
 * Loads last month's predictions + actuals, calls FastAPI /analyze/calibration,
 * alerts via AlertService if ECE > 0.10.
 */
@Slf4j
@Component
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class MatchScoreCalibrationScheduler {

    private final JdbcTemplate       jdbc;
    private final RestTemplate        restTemplate;
    private final AlertService        alertService;
    private final AppProperties       appProperties;

    /** 1st of month, 07:00 UTC */
    @Scheduled(cron = "0 0 7 1 * *", zone = "UTC")
    public void runCalibration() {
        log.info("MatchScoreCalibrationScheduler: running monthly match-score calibration");

        LocalDate end   = LocalDate.now().withDayOfMonth(1).minusDays(1);
        LocalDate start = end.withDayOfMonth(1);

        // match_score lives on landings; join via landing_id on sessions
        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT l.match_score AS score,
                       (EXISTS (
                           SELECT 1 FROM events e
                           WHERE e.session_id = s.id AND e.event_type = 'CONVERSION'
                       )) AS converted
                FROM sessions s
                JOIN landings l ON l.id = s.landing_id
                WHERE l.match_score IS NOT NULL
                  AND s.created_at BETWEEN ? AND ?
                LIMIT 50000
                """, start.atStartOfDay(), end.plusDays(1).atStartOfDay());

        if (rows.isEmpty()) {
            log.info("MatchScoreCalibrationScheduler: no sessions with match_score in {}/{}", start, end);
            return;
        }

        Map<String, Object> req = Map.of("predictions_and_actuals", rows);
        HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
        headers.setContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
        headers.set("X-Internal-API-Key", appProperties.getInternalApiKey());

        Map<?, ?> result;
        try {
            result = restTemplate.postForObject(
                    appProperties.getMlServiceUrl() + "/analyze/calibration",
                    new HttpEntity<>(req, headers), Map.class);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("MatchScoreCalibrationScheduler: FastAPI call failed: {}", e.getMessage());
            return;
        }

        if (result == null) return;

        Object eceObj = result.get("ece");
        double ece = eceObj instanceof Number ? ((Number) eceObj).doubleValue() : -1.0;
        log.info("MatchScoreCalibrationScheduler: ECE={} for {}/{}", ece, start, end);

        if (ece > 0.10) {
            alertService.sendAlert(
                    String.format("⚠️ Match-score calibration alert: ECE=%.4f (>0.10) for %s/%s. " +
                            "Consider retraining the match-score model (vision §6.3a).", ece, start, end));
        }
    }
}
```

## D:/Marketing-AI/platform-api/src/main/java/com/marketingai/scheduler/MetaSyncScheduler.java

```java
package com.marketingai.scheduler;

import com.marketingai.entity.MetaAdSet;
import com.marketingai.entity.MetaCampaign;
import com.marketingai.entity.Tenant;
import com.marketingai.repository.MetaAdSetRepository;
import com.marketingai.repository.MetaCampaignRepository;
import com.marketingai.repository.TenantRepository;
import com.marketingai.service.MetaApiService;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Pulls spend + learning_phase from Meta every 30 minutes for all ACTIVE campaigns.
 * Updates local spend_today and spend_total columns.
 */
@Slf4j
@Component
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class MetaSyncScheduler {

    private final MetaCampaignRepository campaignRepo;
    private final MetaAdSetRepository adSetRepo;
    private final MetaApiService metaApi;
    private final TenantRepository tenantRepo;

    @Scheduled(fixedDelay = 30 * 60 * 1000, initialDelay = 60_000)
    public void syncAll() {
        log.info("MetaSyncScheduler: starting 30-min Meta sync");
        int synced = 0;

        for (MetaCampaign campaign : campaignRepo.findAllByStatus("ACTIVE")) {
            try {
                Optional<Tenant> tenantOpt = tenantRepo.findById(campaign.getTenantId());
                if (tenantOpt.isEmpty() || tenantOpt.get().getMetaAccessTokenEnc() == null) continue;

                String token = new String(tenantOpt.get().getMetaAccessTokenEnc(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);

                Map<String, String> insights = metaApi.getInsights(token, campaign.getMetaCampaignId());
                float spend = Float.parseFloat(insights.getOrDefault("spend", "0"));
                campaign.setSpendToday(spend);
                campaign.setSpendTotal((campaign.getSpendTotal() == null ? 0f : campaign.getSpendTotal()) + spend);
                campaign.setSyncedAt(Instant.now());
                campaignRepo.save(campaign);
                synced++;

                syncAdSets(token, campaign.getId());
            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.warn("MetaSyncScheduler: failed to sync campaign {}: {}",
                        campaign.getId(), e.getMessage());
            }
        }

        log.info("MetaSyncScheduler: synced {} campaigns", synced);
    }

    private void syncAdSets(String token, UUID campaignId) {
        for (MetaAdSet adSet : adSetRepo.findAllByCampaignIdAndStatus(campaignId, "ACTIVE")) {
            try {
                Map<String, String> insights = metaApi.getInsights(token, adSet.getMetaAdSetId());
                float spend = Float.parseFloat(insights.getOrDefault("spend", "0"));
                long impressions = Long.parseLong(insights.getOrDefault("impressions", "0"));
                long clicks = Long.parseLong(insights.getOrDefault("clicks", "0"));
                long conversions = Long.parseLong(insights.getOrDefault("conversions", "0"));

                adSet.setSpendToday(spend);
                adSet.setSpendTotal((adSet.getSpendTotal() == null ? 0f : adSet.getSpendTotal()) + spend);
                // Accumulate totals (today's delta added each sync cycle)
                adSet.setImpressionsTotal((adSet.getImpressionsTotal() == null ? 0L : adSet.getImpressionsTotal()) + impressions);
                adSet.setClicksTotal((adSet.getClicksTotal() == null ? 0L : adSet.getClicksTotal()) + clicks);
                adSet.setConversionsTotal((adSet.getConversionsTotal() == null ? 0L : adSet.getConversionsTotal()) + conversions);
                adSet.setSyncedAt(Instant.now());
                adSetRepo.save(adSet);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.warn("MetaSyncScheduler: failed to sync ad set {}: {}", adSet.getId(), e.getMessage());
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.scheduler;

import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Daily refresh of niche_benchmarks from FIRST-PARTY data only (vision §25 p.19).
 * Never reads Meta Platform data — only from form_submissions, appointments, reward_events.
 */
@Component
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Slf4j
public class NicheBenchmarkScheduler {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private final RestTemplate restTemplate;

    @Scheduled(cron = "0 0 3 * * *", zone = "UTC")
    public void refreshBenchmarks() {
        log.info("NicheBenchmarkScheduler: refreshing niche benchmarks (first-party only)");

        List<Map<String, Object>> tenantData = jdbc.queryForList("""
            SELECT
                t.id::text                        AS tenant_id,
                COALESCE(t.niche_key, 'generic')  AS niche_key,
                COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) FILTER (
                    WHERE a.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
                )                                 AS booked,
                COUNT(DISTINCT re.session_id) FILTER (
                    WHERE re.is_quality_stage = TRUE
                    AND re.rewarded_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
                )                                 AS held,
                COUNT(DISTINCT fs.id) FILTER (
                    WHERE fs.submitted_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
                )                                 AS form_submits,
                AVG(a.booking_distance_h) FILTER (
                    WHERE a.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
                )                                 AS avg_booking_distance_h
            FROM tenants t
            LEFT JOIN appointments    a  ON a.tenant_id = t.id
            LEFT JOIN reward_events   re ON re.tenant_id = t.id
            LEFT JOIN form_submissions fs ON fs.tenant_id = t.id
            GROUP BY t.id, t.niche_key
            """);

        if (tenantData.isEmpty()) {
            log.info("NicheBenchmarkScheduler: no tenant data, skipping");
            return;
        }

        try {
            Map<String, Object> req = Map.of(
                "tenant_funnel_data", tenantData,
                "data_window_days",   30
            );
            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
            List<Map<String, Object>> benchmarks = restTemplate.postForObject(
                "http://ml-service:8001/attribution/benchmarks/compute", req, List.class);

            if (benchmarks == null) return;

            for (Map<String, Object> bm : benchmarks) {
                jdbc.update("""
                    INSERT INTO niche_benchmarks (niche_key, metric_key, value, tenant_count, data_window_days)
                    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                    """,
                    bm.get("niche_key"), bm.get("metric_key"),
                    bm.get("value"),     bm.get("tenant_count"),
                    bm.getOrDefault("data_window_days", 30));
            }
            log.info("NicheBenchmarkScheduler: {} rows inserted", benchmarks.size());
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("NicheBenchmarkScheduler error: {}", e.getMessage());
        }
    }
}
```

## D:/Marketing-AI/platform-api/src/main/java/com/marketingai/scheduler/NicheFeatureStoreScheduler.java

```java
package com.marketingai.scheduler;

import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Niche feature store — monthly aggregation of first-party benchmarks.
 * vision §15.12.7: effect sizes + CI per niche × placement × device.
 * vision §25 p.19: FIRST_PARTY only until Meta Platform Terms legal check clears.
 * Aggregate floor: ≥5 tenants, otherwise is_published = false.
 * Runs 1st of month 06:00 UTC.
 */
@Slf4j
@Component
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class NicheFeatureStoreScheduler {

    private static final int MIN_TENANTS = 5;
    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;

    @Scheduled(cron = "0 0 6 1 * *", zone = "UTC")
    public void computeNicheBenchmarks() {
        // Aggregate bounce_rate per niche × placement × device across tenants
        // niche comes from tenants.settings->>'niche'
        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT
                    COALESCE(t.settings->>'niche', 'UNKNOWN')   AS niche,
                    COALESCE(s.utm_source, 'UNKNOWN')            AS placement,
                    CASE WHEN s.device_type IN ('MOBILE','DESKTOP','TABLET')
                         THEN s.device_type ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END   AS device_type,
                    'BOUNCE_RATE'                                 AS metric,
                    COUNT(DISTINCT t.id)                          AS n_tenants,
                    COUNT(*)                                      AS n_obs,
                    AVG(CASE WHEN s.bounce THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS mean_val,
                    STDDEV_POP(CASE WHEN s.bounce THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS std_val
                FROM sessions s
                JOIN tenants t ON s.tenant_id = t.id
                WHERE s.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'
                  AND s.consent_level = 'full'
                  AND s.is_suspicious = false
                GROUP BY niche, placement, device_type
                HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50
                """);

        // Global mean for Cohen's d
        Map<String, Object> global = jdbc.queryForMap("""
                SELECT
                    AVG(CASE WHEN bounce THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS global_mean,
                    STDDEV_POP(CASE WHEN bounce THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS global_std,
                    COUNT(*) AS global_n
                FROM sessions
                WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'
                  AND consent_level = 'full'
                  AND is_suspicious = false
                """);

        double globalMean = global.get("global_mean") != null ? ((Number) global.get("global_mean")).doubleValue() : 0.55;
        double globalStd  = global.get("global_std")  != null ? ((Number) global.get("global_std")).doubleValue()  : 0.15;
        int    globalN    = global.get("global_n")    != null ? ((Number) global.get("global_n")).intValue()    : 0;

        for (Map<String, Object> row : rows) {
            String niche      = (String) row.get("niche");
            String placement  = (String) row.get("placement");
            String device     = (String) row.get("device_type");
            String metric     = (String) row.get("metric");
            int    nTenants   = ((Number) row.get("n_tenants")).intValue();
            int    nObs       = ((Number) row.get("n_obs")).intValue();
            double nicheMean  = ((Number) row.get("mean_val")).doubleValue();
            Double nicheStdRaw = row.get("std_val") != null ? ((Number) row.get("std_val")).doubleValue() : null;
            double nicheStd   = nicheStdRaw != null ? nicheStdRaw : nicheMean * 0.2 + 0.01;

            boolean published = nTenants >= MIN_TENANTS;
            double effectSize = computeCohensD(nicheMean, nicheStd, nObs, globalMean, globalStd, globalN);
            double se = computeCohensSe(nObs, globalN, effectSize);
            double ciLo = effectSize - 1.96 * se;
            double ciHi = effectSize + 1.96 * se;

            jdbc.update("""
                    INSERT INTO niche_benchmarks
                        (id, niche, placement, device_type, metric, effect_size, ci_lower, ci_upper,
                         n_tenants, n_observations, is_published, source, computed_at)
                    VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'FIRST_PARTY', NOW())
                    ON CONFLICT (niche, placement, device_type, metric)
                    DO UPDATE SET
                        effect_size    = EXCLUDED.effect_size,
                        ci_lower       = EXCLUDED.ci_lower,
                        ci_upper       = EXCLUDED.ci_upper,
                        n_tenants      = EXCLUDED.n_tenants,
                        n_observations = EXCLUDED.n_observations,
                        is_published   = EXCLUDED.is_published,
                        computed_at    = NOW()
                    """,
                    niche, placement, device, metric,
                    effectSize, ciLo, ciHi, nTenants, nObs, published);
        }

        log.info("NicheFeatureStore: {} rows upserted", rows.size());
    }

    private double computeCohensD(double m1, double s1, int n1, double m2, double s2, int n2) {
        if (n1 < 2 || n2 < 2) return 0.0;
        double pooledVar = ((n1 - 1) * s1 * s1 + (n2 - 1) * s2 * s2) / (n1 + n2 - 2);
        double pooledSd  = Math.sqrt(Math.max(pooledVar, 1e-12));
        return (m1 - m2) / pooledSd;
    }

    private double computeCohensSe(int n1, int n2, double d) {
        if (n1 < 1 || n2 < 1) return 1.0;
        return Math.sqrt((double)(n1 + n2) / (n1 * n2) + d * d / (2.0 * (n1 + n2 - 2)));
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.scheduler;

import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Logs variants that received new conversion events in the last 15 minutes.
 * Actual alpha/beta writes happen in FastAPI /decide (single writer rule).
 * This scheduler ensures the decide endpoint is called for active variants
 * and the posterior stays fresh (vision §2.x, §10.1 single-writer invariant).
 */
@Slf4j
@Component
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class PosteriorRecalcScheduler {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;

    @Scheduled(fixedDelay = 900_000)
    public void logStaleVariants() {
        // Find variants that have new conversion events but haven't had a /decide call
        // ONLY FastAPI writes alpha/beta — Spring Boot NEVER modifies thompson_arms
        List<Map<String, Object>> stale = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT DISTINCT v.id  AS variant_id,
                                v.tenant_id,
                                COUNT(e.id) AS new_conversions
                FROM variants v
                JOIN sessions s ON s.tenant_id = v.tenant_id
                JOIN events   e ON e.session_id = s.id
                WHERE v.status = 'ACTIVE'
                  AND e.event_type = 'CONVERSION'
                  AND e.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '15 minutes'
                GROUP BY v.id, v.tenant_id
                LIMIT 200
                """);

        if (!stale.isEmpty()) {
            log.debug("PosteriorRecalcScheduler: {} variants have new conversion events — "
                    + "posteriors will refresh on next FastAPI /decide call", stale.size());
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.scheduler;

import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Proxy Calibration Scheduler — weekly Pearson + Spearman correlation
 * between sessions.quality_score and actual conversion (3-21).
 */
@Slf4j
@Component
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class ProxyCalibrationScheduler {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;

    @Scheduled(cron = "0 0 3 * * MON")
    public void calibrateProxies() {
        List<Map<String, Object>> tenants = jdbc.queryForList(
                "SELECT id FROM tenants WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'");

        for (Map<String, Object> tenant : tenants) {
            UUID tenantId = (UUID) tenant.get("id");
            try {
                calibrateForTenant(tenantId);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.warn("ProxyCalibrationScheduler failed for tenant={}: {}", tenantId, e.getMessage());
            }
        }
    }

    private void calibrateForTenant(UUID tenantId) {
        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT quality_score,
                       CASE WHEN converted THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS converted
                FROM sessions
                WHERE tenant_id = ?
                  AND created_at > now() - interval '30 days'
                  AND quality_score IS NOT NULL
                LIMIT 10000
                """, tenantId);

        if (rows.size() < 30) {
            log.debug("ProxyCalibration: insufficient data for tenant={} (n={})", tenantId, rows.size());
            return;
        }

        double[] qs = rows.stream()
                .mapToDouble(r -> ((Number) r.get("quality_score")).doubleValue()).toArray();
        double[] cv = rows.stream()
                .mapToDouble(r -> ((Number) r.get("converted")).doubleValue()).toArray();

        double pearsonR = pearson(qs, cv);
        double spearmanR = spearman(qs, cv);
        int n = rows.size();

        jdbc.update("""
                INSERT INTO proxy_calibration_runs
                (tenant_id, proxy_col, target_col, n_samples, pearson_r, spearman_r, calibrated_at, created_at)
                VALUES (?, 'quality_score', 'converted', ?, ?, ?, now(), now())
                """, tenantId, n, (float) pearsonR, (float) spearmanR);

        log.info("ProxyCalibration: tenant={} n={} pearson={:.3f} spearman={:.3f}",
                tenantId, n, pearsonR, spearmanR);
    }

    public static double pearson(double[] x, double[] y) {
        int n = x.length;
        double sumX = 0, sumY = 0, sumXY = 0, sumX2 = 0, sumY2 = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            sumX  += x[i];
            sumY  += y[i];
            sumXY += x[i] * y[i];
            sumX2 += x[i] * x[i];
            sumY2 += y[i] * y[i];
        }
        double num = n * sumXY - sumX * sumY;
        double den = Math.sqrt((n * sumX2 - sumX * sumX) * (n * sumY2 - sumY * sumY));
        return den < 1e-10 ? 0.0 : num / den;
    }

    public static double spearman(double[] x, double[] y) {
        return pearson(rankTransform(x), rankTransform(y));
    }

    private static double[] rankTransform(double[] arr) {
        int n = arr.length;
        Integer[] idx = new Integer[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) idx[i] = i;
        java.util.Arrays.sort(idx, (a, b) -> Double.compare(arr[a], arr[b]));
        double[] ranks = new double[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) ranks[idx[i]] = i + 1.0;
        return ranks;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.scheduler;

import com.marketingai.config.AppProperties;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Computes sessions.quality_score for recently closed sessions
 * and updates creative_quality aggregate table.
 * Quality Score is a protective metric only — not added to Thompson arms (arch §4.4).
 */
@Slf4j
@Component
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class QualityScoreScheduler {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private final AppProperties appProperties;

    @Scheduled(fixedDelay = 900_000) // every 15 minutes
    public void computeQualityScores() {
        Instant cutoff = Instant.now().minus(16, ChronoUnit.MINUTES);

        // Sessions closed in the last 16 min that don't yet have a quality_score
        List<Map<String, Object>> sessions = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT s.id, s.tenant_id, s.variant_id, s.creative_id,
                       s.event_count, s.converted, s.max_scroll_depth,
                       (SELECT EXISTS(
                           SELECT 1 FROM events e
                           WHERE e.session_id = s.id AND e.event_type = 'FORM_START'
                       )) AS form_started,
                       lv.match_score AS variant_match_score
                FROM sessions s
                LEFT JOIN landing_variants lv ON lv.id = s.variant_id
                WHERE s.closed_at IS NOT NULL
                  AND s.closed_at >= ?
                  AND s.quality_score IS NULL
                  AND s.consent_level = 'full'
                  AND s.is_suspicious = false
                LIMIT 5000
                """, cutoff);

        if (sessions.isEmpty()) return;
        log.debug("QualityScoreScheduler: scoring {} sessions", sessions.size());

        int updated = 0;
        for (Map<String, Object> s : sessions) {
            try {
                double score = computeScore(s);
                jdbc.update("""
                        UPDATE sessions SET quality_score = ? WHERE id = ?
                        """, score, s.get("id"));
                updated++;
            } catch (Exception ex) {
                log.warn("quality_score failed for session {}: {}", s.get("id"), ex.getMessage());
            }
        }
        log.info("QualityScoreScheduler: updated {} session quality scores", updated);

        refreshCreativeQuality();
    }

    private double computeScore(Map<String, Object> s) {
        Number matchScoreRaw = (Number) s.get("variant_match_score");
        double matchScore = matchScoreRaw != null ? matchScoreRaw.doubleValue() : 0.5;

        Number eventCount = (Number) s.get("event_count");
        boolean bounced = eventCount == null || eventCount.intValue() <= 1;

        Number scrollRaw = (Number) s.get("max_scroll_depth");
        double scroll = scrollRaw != null ? Math.min(1.0, scrollRaw.doubleValue() / 100.0) : 0.0;

        boolean converted = Boolean.TRUE.equals(s.get("converted"));
        boolean formStarted = Boolean.TRUE.equals(s.get("form_started"));
        double formCompletion = converted ? 1.0 : formStarted ? 0.3 : 0.0;

        double score = 0.25 * matchScore
                     + 0.25 * (bounced ? 0.0 : 1.0)
                     + 0.25 * scroll
                     + 0.25 * formCompletion;
        return Math.round(Math.max(0.0, Math.min(1.0, score)) * 10000.0) / 10000.0;
    }

    private void refreshCreativeQuality() {
        // Upsert 30-day creative_quality aggregates for variants/creatives with new scores
        jdbc.update("""
                INSERT INTO creative_quality
                    (id, tenant_id, creative_id, variant_id, window,
                     quality_score, clickbait_suspect, components, computed_at)
                SELECT
                    gen_random_uuid(),
                    s.tenant_id,
                    s.creative_id,
                    NULL,
                    '30d',
                    AVG(s.quality_score),
                    false,
                    NULL,
                    now()
                FROM sessions s
                WHERE s.quality_score IS NOT NULL
                  AND s.closed_at >= now() - INTERVAL '30 days'
                  AND s.consent_level = 'full'
                  AND s.is_suspicious = false
                  AND s.creative_id IS NOT NULL
                GROUP BY s.tenant_id, s.creative_id
                ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
                """);
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.scheduler;

import com.marketingai.service.AlertService;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.HttpEntity;
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * Red flags scanner — early kill for landing pages with P(bounce > threshold) > 0.90.
 * vision §15.12.5: landings only, NOT Meta creatives.
 * Runs every 30 minutes.
 */
@Slf4j
@Component
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class RedFlagsScanScheduler {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private final RestTemplate restTemplate;
    private final AlertService alertService;

    private static final String ML_BASE = System.getenv("ML_SERVICE_URL") != null
            ? System.getenv("ML_SERVICE_URL") : "http://ml-service:8001";

    @Scheduled(fixedDelay = 1_800_000)
    public void scan() {
        // Find active landing variants with bounce data in last 24h
        List<Map<String, Object>> variants = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT
                    lv.id          AS variant_id,
                    lv.tenant_id,
                    t.settings->>'niche' AS niche,
                    COUNT(s.id)    AS total_visits,
                    SUM(CASE WHEN s.bounce THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bounced
                FROM landing_variants lv
                JOIN tenants t ON lv.tenant_id = t.id
                JOIN sessions s ON s.landing_variant_id = lv.id
                WHERE lv.status = 'ACTIVE'
                  AND s.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
                  AND s.consent_level = 'full'
                  AND s.is_suspicious = false
                GROUP BY lv.id, lv.tenant_id, t.settings->>'niche'
                HAVING COUNT(s.id) >= 50
                """);

        for (Map<String, Object> v : variants) {
            UUID   variantId   = (UUID)   v.get("variant_id");
            UUID   tenantId    = (UUID)   v.get("tenant_id");
            int    totalVisits = ((Number) v.get("total_visits")).intValue();
            int    bounced     = ((Number) v.get("bounced")).intValue();
            String niche       = (String) v.get("niche");

            try {
                checkVariant(variantId, tenantId, bounced, totalVisits, niche);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.warn("RedFlagsScan: variant {} check failed: {}", variantId, e.getMessage());
            }
        }
    }

    private void checkVariant(UUID variantId, UUID tenantId, int bounced, int total, String niche) {
        // Load niche benchmark if available
        List<Map<String, Object>> benchmarks = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT effect_size, ci_lower, ci_upper, is_published
                FROM niche_benchmarks
                WHERE niche = ? AND metric = 'BOUNCE_RATE' AND is_published = true
                LIMIT 1
                """, niche != null ? niche : "UNKNOWN");

        Map<String, Object> benchmark = benchmarks.isEmpty() ? null : benchmarks.get(0);

        Map<String, Object> reqBody = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        reqBody.put("landing_id",       variantId.toString());
        reqBody.put("bounced",          bounced);
        reqBody.put("total_visits",     total);
        reqBody.put("niche_benchmark",  benchmark);
        reqBody.put("is_landing",       true);

        HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
        headers.setContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        Map<String, Object> result;
        try {
            result = restTemplate.postForObject(
                    ML_BASE + "/red-flags/check",
                    new HttpEntity<>(reqBody, headers),
                    Map.class);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.warn("RedFlags ML call failed for variant {}: {}", variantId, e.getMessage());
            return;
        }

        if (result == null) return;

        boolean shouldKill = Boolean.TRUE.equals(result.get("should_kill"));
        double  pExceed    = result.get("p_exceed") instanceof Number
                ? ((Number) result.get("p_exceed")).doubleValue() : 0.0;
        double  threshold  = result.get("threshold") instanceof Number
                ? ((Number) result.get("threshold")).doubleValue() : 0.75;
        String  label      = (String) result.getOrDefault("label", "heuristic");

        if (shouldKill) {
            jdbc.update("""
                    INSERT INTO red_flag_events
                        (id, tenant_id, variant_id, p_exceed, threshold, bounced, total_visits, label, action_taken)
                    VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'ALERT')
                    """,
                    tenantId, variantId, pExceed, threshold, bounced, total, label);

            alertService.sendAlert(String.format(
                    "🚩 Red Flag: landing variant %s — P(bounce > %.2f) = %.3f [%s]. Visits: %d",
                    variantId, threshold, pExceed, label, total));

            log.warn("RedFlag fired: variant={} p_exceed={} threshold={} label={}", variantId, pExceed, threshold, label);
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.scheduler;

import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import java.time.LocalDate;

/**
 * Monthly retention sweep: materialise aggregates then delete expired rows.
 * Retention policy: events 13 months, sessions 13 months, decision_log 25 months.
 */
@Slf4j
@Component
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class RetentionScheduler {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;

    @Scheduled(cron = "0 0 2 1 * *")
    public void runRetentionSweep() {
        log.info("RetentionScheduler: starting retention sweep");

        LocalDate cutoffEvents = LocalDate.now().minusMonths(13);

        // Materialise variant aggregates before dropping old events
        jdbc.update("""
                INSERT INTO agg_variant_daily (tenant_id, variant_id, day, sessions, conversions, revenue)
                SELECT tenant_id, variant_id::uuid, event_time::date AS day,
                       COUNT(DISTINCT session_id)                                           AS sessions,
                       COUNT(CASE WHEN event_type = 'CONVERSION' THEN 1 END)               AS conversions,
                       COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'PURCHASE' THEN revenue ELSE 0 END), 0) AS revenue
                FROM events
                WHERE event_time < ?::timestamptz
                  AND variant_id IS NOT NULL
                GROUP BY tenant_id, variant_id, event_time::date
                ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, variant_id, day) DO UPDATE
                    SET sessions    = EXCLUDED.sessions    + agg_variant_daily.sessions,
                        conversions = EXCLUDED.conversions + agg_variant_daily.conversions,
                        revenue     = EXCLUDED.revenue     + agg_variant_daily.revenue
                """, cutoffEvents.atStartOfDay());

        // Materialise creative aggregates
        jdbc.update("""
                INSERT INTO agg_creative_daily (tenant_id, creative_id, day, sessions, conversions, revenue)
                SELECT tenant_id, creative_id, event_time::date AS day,
                       COUNT(DISTINCT session_id)                                           AS sessions,
                       COUNT(CASE WHEN event_type = 'CONVERSION' THEN 1 END)               AS conversions,
                       COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'PURCHASE' THEN revenue ELSE 0 END), 0) AS revenue
                FROM events
                WHERE event_time < ?::timestamptz
                  AND creative_id IS NOT NULL
                GROUP BY tenant_id, creative_id, event_time::date
                ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, creative_id, day) DO UPDATE
                    SET sessions    = EXCLUDED.sessions    + agg_creative_daily.sessions,
                        conversions = EXCLUDED.conversions + agg_creative_daily.conversions,
                        revenue     = EXCLUDED.revenue     + agg_creative_daily.revenue
                """, cutoffEvents.atStartOfDay());

        int deletedEvents = jdbc.update(
                "DELETE FROM events WHERE event_time < ?::timestamptz",
                cutoffEvents.atStartOfDay());

        int deletedSessions = jdbc.update(
                "DELETE FROM sessions WHERE started_at < ?::timestamptz",
                cutoffEvents.atStartOfDay());

        LocalDate cutoffDecisions = LocalDate.now().minusMonths(25);
        int deletedDecisions = jdbc.update(
                "DELETE FROM decision_log WHERE decided_at < ?::timestamptz",
                cutoffDecisions.atStartOfDay());

        log.info("RetentionScheduler: deleted {} events, {} sessions, {} decision_log rows",
                deletedEvents, deletedSessions, deletedDecisions);
    }
}
```
