```java
package com.marketingai.scheduler;

import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Cross-Device Identity — Retro Correction Job (vision §7.4).
 *
 * Daily 03:00 UTC: for each tenant, finds sessions with external_id_hash (consented)
 * and links earlier anonymous sessions from the same hash.
 * Sets bounce_corrected_at so earlier "bounce" sessions are re-attributed as
 * "returned & converted" before posterior recalculation.
 *
 * Safety:
 *   - Only sessions with consent_level = 'full'
 *   - Never touches sessions with existing bounce_corrected_at
 */
@Slf4j
@Component
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class RetroCorrectionJob {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;

    @Scheduled(cron = "0 0 3 * * *", zone = "UTC")
    public void run() {
        List<UUID> tenantIds = jdbc.queryForList(
                "SELECT id FROM tenants WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'", UUID.class);

        for (UUID tenantId : tenantIds) {
            try {
                processTenant(tenantId);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.error("RetroCorrectionJob failed for tenant {}: {}", tenantId, e.getMessage());
            }
        }
    }

    void processTenant(UUID tenantId) {
        // Find all distinct external_id_hashes for consented sessions in this tenant
        List<String> hashes = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT DISTINCT external_id_hash
                FROM sessions
                WHERE tenant_id = ?
                  AND external_id_hash IS NOT NULL
                  AND consent_level = 'full'
                """, String.class, tenantId);

        if (hashes.isEmpty()) return;

        int matched = 0;
        int corrected = 0;

        for (String hash : hashes) {
            // Find the earliest (anchor) consented session with this hash
            List<Map<String, Object>> anchorRows = jdbc.queryForList("""
                    SELECT id
                    FROM sessions
                    WHERE tenant_id = ?
                      AND external_id_hash = ?
                      AND consent_level = 'full'
                    ORDER BY created_at ASC
                    LIMIT 1
                    """, tenantId, hash);

            if (anchorRows.isEmpty()) continue;
            UUID anchorId = (UUID) anchorRows.get(0).get("id");

            // Find earlier anonymous sessions (no hash) within 90 days before the anchor.
            // NOTE: without a persistent cross-visit cookie_id we cannot guarantee same-device;
            // the 90-day window reduces false matches. True cross-device linking requires
            // a persistent first-party identifier (§7.4 — deferred to post-MVP).
            List<UUID> earlierSessions = jdbc.queryForList("""
                    SELECT s.id
                    FROM sessions s
                    WHERE s.tenant_id = ?
                      AND s.external_id_hash IS NULL
                      AND s.bounce_corrected_at IS NULL
                      AND s.consent_level = 'full'
                      AND s.created_at < (
                          SELECT created_at FROM sessions WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ?
                      )
                      AND s.created_at > (
                          SELECT created_at - INTERVAL '90 days' FROM sessions WHERE id = ? AND tenant_id = ?
                      )
                    LIMIT 50
                    """, UUID.class, tenantId, anchorId, tenantId, anchorId, tenantId);

            matched += earlierSessions.size();

            for (UUID sid : earlierSessions) {
                jdbc.update("""
                        UPDATE sessions
                           SET bounce_corrected_at = now(),
                               linked_session_ids  = array_append(
                                   COALESCE(linked_session_ids, '{}'), ?::uuid
                               )
                         WHERE id = ?
                           AND tenant_id = ?
                        """, anchorId, sid, tenantId);
                corrected++;
            }
        }

        if (matched > 0 || corrected > 0) {
            jdbc.update("""
                    INSERT INTO retro_correction_runs
                        (tenant_id, sessions_matched, sessions_corrected)
                    VALUES (?, ?, ?)
                    """, tenantId, matched, corrected);
            log.info("RetroCorrectionJob tenant={}: matched={} corrected={}",
                    tenantId, matched, corrected);
        }
    }
}
```

## D:/Marketing-AI/platform-api/src/main/java/com/marketingai/scheduler/ShowRateCorrectorScheduler.java

```java
package com.marketingai.scheduler;

import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Weekly show-rate corrector (roadmap 8-3; vision §19.10).
 * Every Monday 06:00 UTC: computes Beta-shrinkage multiplier from BOOKED/CALL_HELD
 * and writes it to tenants.settings.show_rate_multiplier.
 * Gate 2 += booking_rate: gates tighten when show rate is below prior.
 */
@Component
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Slf4j
public class ShowRateCorrectorScheduler {

    private final JdbcTemplate  jdbc;
    private final RestTemplate  restTemplate;

    @Scheduled(cron = "0 0 6 * * MON")
    public void weeklyCorrection() {
        List<Map<String, Object>> tenants = jdbc.queryForList(
                "SELECT id FROM tenants WHERE is_active = TRUE");
        for (Map<String, Object> tenant : tenants) {
            try {
                correct((UUID) tenant.get("id"));
            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.warn("ShowRateCorrector failed for tenant {}: {}", tenant.get("id"), e.getMessage());
            }
        }
    }

    private void correct(UUID tenantId) {
        Map<String, Object> counts = jdbc.queryForMap("""
            SELECT
                COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE stage_key = 'BOOKED')    AS booked_count,
                COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE stage_key = 'CALL_HELD') AS held_count
            FROM reward_events
            WHERE tenant_id = ? AND rewarded_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
            """, tenantId);

        int booked = ((Number) counts.get("booked_count")).intValue();
        int held   = ((Number) counts.get("held_count")).intValue();

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        Map<String, Object> result = restTemplate.postForObject(
                "http://ml-service:8001/reward/show-rate-corrector",
                Map.of("booked_count", booked, "held_count", held),
                Map.class);

        if (result != null && result.get("multiplier") != null) {
            double multiplier = ((Number) result.get("multiplier")).doubleValue();
            jdbc.update("""
                UPDATE tenants
                SET settings = jsonb_set(
                    COALESCE(settings, '{}'),
                    '{show_rate_multiplier}',
                    to_jsonb(?)
                )
                WHERE id = ?
                """, multiplier, tenantId);
            log.info("ShowRateCorrector: tenant={} booked={} held={} multiplier={}",
                    tenantId, booked, held, multiplier);
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.scheduler;

import com.marketingai.service.MetaApiClient;
import com.marketingai.service.AlertService;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.HttpEntity;
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
import org.springframework.http.HttpMethod;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import org.springframework.web.client.ResourceAccessException;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Pings every ACTIVE landing variant URL every minute.
 * Two consecutive FAILs within 10 minutes → open incident + Telegram alert.
 * Uses sentinel UA to avoid polluting analytics sessions.
 */
@Slf4j
@Component
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class SiteHealthScheduler {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private final AlertService alertService;
    private final RestTemplate restTemplate;
    private final MetaApiClient metaApiClient;

    public static final String SENTINEL_UA = "MarketingAI-HealthCheck/1.0";

    @Scheduled(fixedDelay = 60_000)
    public void checkAllLandings() {
        List<Map<String, Object>> variants = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT lv.id AS variant_id, lv.tenant_id, lv.slug,
                       t.settings->>'base_url' AS base_url
                FROM landing_variants lv
                JOIN tenants t ON t.id = lv.tenant_id
                WHERE lv.status = 'ACTIVE'
                """);

        for (Map<String, Object> variant : variants) {
            UUID tenantId  = (UUID) variant.get("tenant_id");
            UUID variantId = (UUID) variant.get("variant_id");
            String slug    = (String) variant.get("slug");
            String baseUrl = (String) variant.get("base_url");

            if (baseUrl == null || baseUrl.isBlank()) continue;

            String url = baseUrl.replaceAll("/$", "") + "/l/" + slug;
            checkUrl(tenantId, variantId, url);
        }
    }

    private void checkUrl(UUID tenantId, UUID variantId, String url) {
        long start = System.currentTimeMillis();
        String status = "PASS";
        int httpCode = 0;
        String failCause = null;

        try {
            HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
            headers.set("User-Agent", SENTINEL_UA);

            var resp = restTemplate.exchange(url, HttpMethod.HEAD,
                    new HttpEntity<>(headers), String.class);
            httpCode = resp.getStatusCode().value();
            if (httpCode >= 500) {
                status = "FAIL";
                failCause = "HTTP_5XX";
            }
        } catch (ResourceAccessException e) {
            status = "FAIL";
            failCause = "TIMEOUT";
        } catch (Exception e) {
            status = "FAIL";
            failCause = "HTTP_5XX";
        }

        int latency = (int) (System.currentTimeMillis() - start);

        jdbc.update("""
                INSERT INTO site_health_checks (tenant_id, variant_id, check_type, status, latency_ms, http_status)
                VALUES (?, ?, 'HTTP', ?, ?, ?)
                """, tenantId, variantId, status, latency, httpCode);

        if ("FAIL".equals(status)) {
            evaluateIncident(tenantId, variantId, failCause, url);
        }
    }

    private void evaluateIncident(UUID tenantId, UUID variantId, String cause, String url) {
        Integer consecutiveFails = jdbc.queryForObject("""
                SELECT COUNT(*) FROM site_health_checks
                WHERE tenant_id = ? AND variant_id = ? AND status = 'FAIL'
                  AND checked_at > now() - interval '10 minutes'
                """, Integer.class, tenantId, variantId);

        if (consecutiveFails != null && consecutiveFails >= 2) {
            List<Map<String, Object>> openIncidents = jdbc.queryForList("""
                    SELECT id FROM site_health_incidents
                    WHERE tenant_id = ? AND variant_id = ? AND resolved_at IS NULL
                    """, tenantId, variantId);

            if (openIncidents.isEmpty()) {
                jdbc.update("""
                        INSERT INTO site_health_incidents (tenant_id, variant_id, cause, consecutive_fails, alerted)
                        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, TRUE)
                        """, tenantId, variantId, cause, consecutiveFails);

                alertService.sendAlert(
                        "🔴 Site Health: " + url + " failed " + consecutiveFails +
                        " consecutive checks (" + cause + "). Incident opened.");
                log.warn("Site health incident opened: tenant={} variant={} cause={}", tenantId, variantId, cause);

                // P0 autopause: pause all ACTIVE ad sets to prevent wasted spend during site outage
                metaApiClient.enqueue("P0", null, tenantId, "AUTOPAUSE_SITE_INCIDENT", () -> {
                    int paused = jdbc.update(
                            "UPDATE meta_ad_sets SET status='PAUSED', updated_at=now() WHERE tenant_id=? AND status='ACTIVE'",
                            tenantId);
                    if (paused > 0) {
                        log.warn("Site health P0 autopause: tenant={} paused {} ad sets", tenantId, paused);
                    }
                });
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.scheduler;

import com.marketingai.config.AppProperties;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.*;
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;

import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Weekly taxonomy recalibration (arch §15.10):
 * merges near-duplicate centroids (cosine ≥ 0.92) and promotes mature CANDIDATEs → CONFIRMED.
 * Runs every Sunday at 04:00 UTC.
 */
@Slf4j
@Component
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class TaxonomyRecalibrateScheduler {

    private final RestTemplate  restTemplate;
    private final AppProperties appProperties;

    @Scheduled(cron = "0 0 4 * * SUN", zone = "UTC")
    public void recalibrate() {
        String url = appProperties.getMlServiceUrl() + "/taxonomy/recalibrate";
        HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
        headers.set("X-Internal-API-Key", appProperties.getInternalApiKey());
        try {
            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
            Map<String, Object> result = restTemplate.exchange(
                url, HttpMethod.POST, new HttpEntity<>(headers), Map.class).getBody();
            log.info("Taxonomy recalibrate scheduled run: {}", result);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Taxonomy recalibrate scheduled run failed: {}", e.getMessage());
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.scheduler;

import com.marketingai.config.AppProperties;
import com.marketingai.service.AlertService;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import java.sql.Timestamp;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Daily Meta token age check.
 * Day 50+: attempt rotation; day 58+: mark INVALID and alert.
 */
@Slf4j
@Component
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class TokenRotationScheduler {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private final AlertService alertService;
    private final AppProperties appProperties;

    @Scheduled(cron = "0 0 4 * * *")
    public void rotateTokens() {
        log.info("TokenRotationScheduler: checking Meta token ages");

        List<Map<String, Object>> tenants = jdbc.queryForList("""
                SELECT id, name, meta_token_status, meta_token_created_at
                FROM tenants
                WHERE meta_access_token_enc IS NOT NULL
                """);

        for (Map<String, Object> tenant : tenants) {
            UUID tenantId = (UUID) tenant.get("id");
            String name   = (String) tenant.get("name");

            Timestamp createdAt = (Timestamp) tenant.get("meta_token_created_at");
            if (createdAt == null) continue;

            long daysOld = ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(
                    createdAt.toLocalDateTime().toLocalDate(), LocalDate.now());

            try {
                if (daysOld >= 58) {
                    jdbc.update("UPDATE tenants SET meta_token_status = 'INVALID' WHERE id = ?", tenantId);
                    alertService.sendAlert(
                            "🔴 Meta token INVALID for tenant " + name +
                            " (age: " + daysOld + " days). Platform paused Meta writes.");
                    log.warn("Tenant {} Meta token INVALID ({} days old)", name, daysOld);

                } else if (daysOld >= 50) {
                    boolean rotated = attemptTokenRotation(tenantId);
                    if (rotated) {
                        jdbc.update(
                                "UPDATE tenants SET meta_token_status = 'OK', meta_token_rotated_at = now() WHERE id = ?",
                                tenantId);
                        log.info("Tenant {} Meta token rotated successfully", name);
                    } else {
                        jdbc.update("UPDATE tenants SET meta_token_status = 'EXPIRING' WHERE id = ?", tenantId);
                        alertService.sendAlert(
                                "⚠️ Meta token EXPIRING for tenant " + name +
                                " (age: " + daysOld + " days). Manual rotation required.");
                    }
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.error("TokenRotationScheduler error for tenant {}: {}", name, e.getMessage());
            }
        }
    }

    private boolean attemptTokenRotation(UUID tenantId) {
        // Full token rotation requires META_APP_ID + META_APP_SECRET.
        // Graph API: GET /v20.0/oauth/access_token?grant_type=fb_exchange_token&...
        // Returns false (EXPIRING alert) until credentials are configured.
        String appId     = appProperties.getMeta() != null ? appProperties.getMeta().getAppId()     : null;
        String appSecret = appProperties.getMeta() != null ? appProperties.getMeta().getAppSecret() : null;
        if (appId == null || appId.isBlank() || appSecret == null || appSecret.isBlank()) {
            log.warn("Meta app credentials not configured — token rotation skipped for tenant {}", tenantId);
            return false;
        }
        return false; // placeholder — wire real exchange when credentials are present
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.scheduler;

import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

/**
 * Video asset lifecycle management (vision §23 Phase 4).
 *
 * Rules:
 *   - HOT footage older than 90 days → COLD (archived in object storage)
 *   - Renders whose footage is COLD and were not approved → marked killed after 30 days
 */
@Component
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Slf4j
public class VideoLifecycleScheduler {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;

    @Scheduled(cron = "0 0 2 * * *")
    public void runLifecycleScan() {
        archiveOldFootage();
        killOrphanedRenders();
    }

    private void archiveOldFootage() {
        int moved = jdbc.update("""
                UPDATE video_footage
                   SET asset_tier  = 'COLD',
                       archived_at = now()
                 WHERE asset_tier  = 'HOT'
                   AND uploaded_at < now() - interval '90 days'
                """);
        if (moved > 0) {
            log.info("VideoLifecycle: moved {} footage files HOT → COLD", moved);
        }
    }

    // Renders that are PENDING/RENDERING and still have no storage_url after 30 days
    // (never completed — mark as FAILED to keep DB clean)
    private void killOrphanedRenders() {
        int killed = jdbc.update("""
                UPDATE video_renders
                   SET killed_at = now(),
                       status    = 'FAILED'
                 WHERE killed_at  IS NULL
                   AND status    NOT IN ('COMPLETED')
                   AND created_at < now() - interval '30 days'
                """);
        if (killed > 0) {
            log.info("VideoLifecycle: killed {} stale renders (>30d, no output)", killed);
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.scheduler;

import com.marketingai.config.AppProperties;
import com.marketingai.dto.analytics.AtomPerformanceRow;
import com.marketingai.dto.analytics.CreativePerformanceRow;
import com.marketingai.dto.analytics.FunnelResponse;
import com.marketingai.dto.analytics.OverviewResponse;
import com.marketingai.entity.Tenant;
import com.marketingai.repository.TenantRepository;
import com.marketingai.security.TenantContext;
import com.marketingai.service.AnalyticsService;
import com.marketingai.service.AlertService;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.http.*;
import org.springframework.mail.SimpleMailMessage;
import org.springframework.mail.javamail.JavaMailSender;
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.List;

@Slf4j
@Component
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class WeeklyReportScheduler {

    private final TenantRepository tenantRepository;
    private final AnalyticsService analyticsService;
    private final AlertService alertService;
    private final AppProperties appProperties;
    private final RestTemplate restTemplate;

    @Autowired(required = false)
    private JavaMailSender mailSender;

    /** Every Monday at 08:00 UTC */
    @Scheduled(cron = "0 0 8 * * MON", zone = "UTC")
    public void sendWeeklyReports() {
        if (!appProperties.getReport().isEnabled()) {
            log.info("Weekly reports disabled — skipping");
            return;
        }

        List<Tenant> tenants = tenantRepository.findAll();
        log.info("Weekly report run: {} tenants", tenants.size());

        for (Tenant tenant : tenants) {
            try {
                TenantContext.set(tenant.getId().toString());
                sendReportForTenant(tenant);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.error("Weekly report failed for tenant {}: {}", tenant.getId(), e.getMessage());
            } finally {
                TenantContext.clear();
            }
        }
    }

    private void sendReportForTenant(Tenant tenant) {
        OverviewResponse overview = analyticsService.overview(7);
        List<CreativePerformanceRow> creatives = analyticsService.creativePerformance(7);
        List<AtomPerformanceRow> atoms = analyticsService.atomPerformance(7, null);
        FunnelResponse funnel = analyticsService.funnel(7);

        String report = buildReport(tenant, overview, creatives, atoms, funnel);

        // Enrich with explain-service narrative (vision §1.5 weekly report)
        String narrative = fetchNarrative(overview, funnel);
        if (narrative != null && !narrative.isBlank()) {
            report = report + "\n─── AI Narrative ───\n" + narrative + "\n";
        }

        boolean sentTelegram = sendTelegram(report);
        boolean sentEmail    = sendEmail(tenant, report);

        if (!sentTelegram && !sentEmail) {
            log.warn("No delivery channel configured for tenant {} — weekly report not sent",
                    tenant.getId());
        }
    }

    // ─── Report builder ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private String buildReport(Tenant tenant, OverviewResponse ov,
                                List<CreativePerformanceRow> creatives,
                                List<AtomPerformanceRow> atoms,
                                FunnelResponse funnel) {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.append("📊 Weekly Marketing Report — ").append(tenant.getName()).append("\n");
        sb.append("Period: last 7 days\n\n");

        // Overview
        sb.append("─── Overview ───\n");
        sb.append(String.format("Sessions:    %,d\n", ov.getTotalSessions()));
        sb.append(String.format("Conversions: %,d\n", ov.getTotalConversions()));
        if (ov.getConversionRate() != null) {
            sb.append(String.format("CVR:         %.2f%%\n", ov.getConversionRate() * 100));
        }
        sb.append(String.format("Revenue:     $%.2f\n", ov.getTotalRevenue()));
        sb.append(String.format("Creatives:   %d active, %d analyzed\n\n",
                ov.getActiveCreatives(), ov.getAnalyzedCreatives()));

        // Top 3 creatives by sessions
        sb.append("─── Top Creatives (by sessions) ───\n");
        creatives.stream().limit(3).forEach(c -> {
            String cvr = c.getConversionRate() != null
                    ? String.format("%.2f%%", c.getConversionRate() * 100) : "n/a";
            sb.append(String.format("• %s [%s] — %,d sessions, CVR %s, $%.0f revenue\n",
                    c.getTitle() != null ? c.getTitle() : "Untitled",
                    c.getType(), c.getSessions(), cvr, c.getRevenue()));
        });
        if (creatives.isEmpty()) sb.append("  (no data yet)\n");
        sb.append("\n");

        // Top atom combos by CVR
        sb.append("─── Top Atom Insights ───\n");
        atoms.stream()
                .filter(a -> a.getConversionRate() != null && a.getTotalSessions() >= 10)
                .sorted((a, b) -> Double.compare(b.getConversionRate(), a.getConversionRate()))
                .limit(5)
                .forEach(a -> sb.append(String.format("• %s=%s → CVR %.2f%% (%d sessions)\n",
                        a.getAtomType(), a.getAtomValue(),
                        a.getConversionRate() * 100, a.getTotalSessions())));
        if (atoms.stream().noneMatch(a -> a.getConversionRate() != null)) {
            sb.append("  (no event data for atom insights yet)\n");
        }
        sb.append("\n");

        // Funnel anomalies from diagnostic card
        sb.append("─── Funnel Diagnostics ───\n");
        funnel.getDiagnostics().getSymptoms().stream()
                .filter(FunnelResponse.Symptom::isDetected)
                .forEach(s -> sb.append(String.format("⚠️ %s: %s\n   → %s\n",
                        s.getCode(), s.getDiagnosis(), s.getAction())));
        if (funnel.getDiagnostics().getSymptomsDetected() == 0) {
            sb.append("  ✅ No anomalies detected.\n");
        }
        sb.append("\n");

        sb.append("─── Note ───\n");
        sb.append(AnalyticsService.DISCLAIMER).append("\n");

        return sb.toString();
    }

    // ─── Explain service narrative ────────────────────────────────────────────

    private String fetchNarrative(OverviewResponse ov, FunnelResponse funnel) {
        String mlUrl = appProperties.getMlServiceUrl();
        if (mlUrl == null || mlUrl.isBlank()) return null;
        try {
            Map<String, Object> stats = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            stats.put("sessions",       ov.getTotalSessions());
            stats.put("conversions",    ov.getTotalConversions());
            stats.put("cvr",            ov.getConversionRate());
            stats.put("revenue",        ov.getTotalRevenue());
            stats.put("symptoms_detected", funnel.getDiagnostics().getSymptomsDetected());

            Map<String, Object> req = Map.of("stats", stats, "raw", false);
            HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
            headers.setContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
            headers.set("X-Internal-API-Key", appProperties.getInternalApiKey());

            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
            Map<String, Object> result = restTemplate.postForObject(
                    mlUrl + "/explain/campaign",
                    new HttpEntity<>(req, headers), Map.class);
            return result != null ? (String) result.get("explanation") : null;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.warn("Explain service unavailable for weekly report: {}", e.getMessage());
            return null;
        }
    }

    // ─── Delivery ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private boolean sendTelegram(String text) {
        AppProperties.Telegram cfg = appProperties.getTelegram();
        String slackUrl = appProperties.getSlackWebhookUrl();
        if (!cfg.isConfigured() && (slackUrl == null || slackUrl.isBlank())) return false;
        try {
            alertService.sendAlert(text);
            return true;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Alert weekly report failed: {}", e.getMessage());
            return false;
        }
    }

    private boolean sendEmail(Tenant tenant, String text) {
        AppProperties.Report reportCfg = appProperties.getReport();
        if (mailSender == null || !reportCfg.isEmailConfigured()) return false;
        try {
            SimpleMailMessage msg = new SimpleMailMessage();
            msg.setFrom(reportCfg.getEmailFrom());
            msg.setTo(reportCfg.getEmailTo());
            msg.setSubject("Weekly Report — " + tenant.getName());
            msg.setText(text);
            mailSender.send(msg);
            log.info("Weekly report email sent for tenant {}", tenant.getId());
            return true;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Email weekly report failed for tenant {}: {}", tenant.getId(), e.getMessage());
            return false;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.security;

import io.jsonwebtoken.Claims;
import jakarta.servlet.FilterChain;
import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.security.authentication.UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken;
import org.springframework.security.core.authority.SimpleGrantedAuthority;
import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import org.springframework.web.filter.OncePerRequestFilter;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.List;

@Component
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class JwtFilter extends OncePerRequestFilter {

    private final JwtUtil jwtUtil;

    @Override
    protected void doFilterInternal(HttpServletRequest request,
                                    HttpServletResponse response,
                                    FilterChain chain) throws ServletException, IOException {
        String header = request.getHeader("Authorization");
        if (header != null && header.startsWith("Bearer ")) {
            String token = header.substring(7);
            if (jwtUtil.isValid(token)) {
                Claims claims = jwtUtil.parse(token);
                String tenantId = claims.get("tenantId", String.class);
                String userId   = claims.getSubject();   // user UUID stored as JWT subject
                String role     = claims.get("role", String.class);

                TenantContext.set(tenantId);
                // Set as request attributes so controllers can use @RequestAttribute
                if (tenantId != null) request.setAttribute("tenantId", java.util.UUID.fromString(tenantId));
                if (userId   != null) request.setAttribute("userId",   java.util.UUID.fromString(userId));

                var auth = new UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken(
                        claims.getSubject(),
                        null,
                        List.of(new SimpleGrantedAuthority("ROLE_" + role)));
                SecurityContextHolder.getContext().setAuthentication(auth);
            }
        }
        try {
            chain.doFilter(request, response);
        } finally {
            TenantContext.clear();
            SecurityContextHolder.clearContext();
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.security;

import com.marketingai.config.AppProperties;
import io.jsonwebtoken.Claims;
import io.jsonwebtoken.JwtException;
import io.jsonwebtoken.Jwts;
import io.jsonwebtoken.security.Keys;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import javax.crypto.SecretKey;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.UUID;

@Component
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class JwtUtil {

    private final AppProperties props;

    private SecretKey key() {
        return Keys.hmacShaKeyFor(
                props.getJwt().getSecret().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
    }

    public String generate(UUID userId, UUID tenantId, String role) {
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        return Jwts.builder()
                .subject(userId.toString())
                .claim("tenantId", tenantId.toString())
                .claim("role", role)
                .issuedAt(new Date(now))
                .expiration(new Date(now + props.getJwt().getExpiryMs()))
                .signWith(key())
                .compact();
    }

    public Claims parse(String token) {
        return Jwts.parser()
                .verifyWith(key())
                .build()
                .parseSignedClaims(token)
                .getPayload();
    }

    public boolean isValid(String token) {
        try {
            parse(token);
            return true;
        } catch (JwtException | IllegalArgumentException e) {
            return false;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.security;

import jakarta.servlet.FilterChain;
import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import org.springframework.web.filter.OncePerRequestFilter;

import java.io.IOException;

/**
 * reCAPTCHA Enterprise v3 guard (vision §12.6).
 * When RECAPTCHA_SECRET_KEY is set, validates X-Recaptcha-Token header on mutating endpoints.
 * Skipped entirely in dev (key not configured).
 */
@Slf4j
@Component
public class RecaptchaFilter extends OncePerRequestFilter {

    @Value("${app.recaptcha.secret-key:}")
    private String secretKey;

    private static final String HEADER = "X-Recaptcha-Token";
    private static final float  MIN_SCORE = 0.5f;

    @Override
    protected void doFilterInternal(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response,
            FilterChain chain) throws ServletException, IOException {

        // Only enforce on mutating methods when key is configured
        String method = request.getMethod();
        boolean mutating = "POST".equals(method) || "PUT".equals(method) || "DELETE".equals(method);

        if (secretKey.isEmpty() || !mutating) {
            chain.doFilter(request, response);
            return;
        }

        String token = request.getHeader(HEADER);
        if (token == null || token.isBlank()) {
            // No token present — allow through (frontend may not have loaded reCAPTCHA script yet)
            chain.doFilter(request, response);
            return;
        }

        // Token present — verify asynchronously; on error, allow through with warning
        try {
            boolean valid = verifyToken(token);
            if (!valid) {
                log.warn("reCAPTCHA verification failed for {} {}", method, request.getRequestURI());
                response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_FORBIDDEN, "reCAPTCHA verification failed");
                return;
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.warn("reCAPTCHA verification error (allowing through): {}", e.getMessage());
        }

        chain.doFilter(request, response);
    }

    private boolean verifyToken(String token) throws IOException {
        String url = "https://recaptchaenterprise.googleapis.com/v1/projects/default/assessments?key=" + secretKey;
        String body = String.format(
            "{\"event\":{\"token\":\"%s\",\"expectedAction\":\"approve\",\"siteKey\":\"\"}}",
            token.replace("\"", "\\\""));

        java.net.HttpURLConnection conn = (java.net.HttpURLConnection)
            new java.net.URL(url).openConnection();
        conn.setRequestMethod("POST");
        conn.setDoOutput(true);
        conn.setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/json");
        conn.setConnectTimeout(3000);
        conn.setReadTimeout(3000);
        try (java.io.OutputStream os = conn.getOutputStream()) {
            os.write(body.getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        }
        int code = conn.getResponseCode();
        if (code != 200) return false;

        try (java.io.InputStream is = conn.getInputStream()) {
            String resp = new String(is.readAllBytes(), java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            // Naive score extraction: "score": 0.9
            int idx = resp.indexOf("\"score\":");
            if (idx < 0) return true; // can't parse → allow
            float score = Float.parseFloat(resp.substring(idx + 8, resp.indexOf(",", idx + 8)).trim());
            return score >= MIN_SCORE;
        }
    }
}
```

## D:/Marketing-AI/platform-api/src/main/java/com/marketingai/security/TenantAwareDataSource.java

```java
package com.marketingai.security;

import org.springframework.jdbc.datasource.AbstractDataSource;

import javax.sql.DataSource;
import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.sql.Statement;
import java.util.UUID;

public class TenantAwareDataSource extends AbstractDataSource {

    private final DataSource delegate;

    public TenantAwareDataSource(DataSource delegate) {
        this.delegate = delegate;
    }

    @Override
    public Connection getConnection() throws SQLException {
        Connection conn = delegate.getConnection();
        applyTenant(conn);
        return conn;
    }

    @Override
    public Connection getConnection(String username, String password) throws SQLException {
        Connection conn = delegate.getConnection(username, password);
        applyTenant(conn);
        return conn;
    }

    private void applyTenant(Connection conn) throws SQLException {
        String tenantId = TenantContext.get();
        // arch v1.1 §8: SET LOCAL is transaction-scoped — resets automatically when the
        // transaction ends. Plain SET persists on the pooled connection and leaks the tenant
        // to whoever gets that connection next from HikariCP.
        String sql = (tenantId != null && isValidUuid(tenantId))
                ? "SET LOCAL app.current_tenant = '" + tenantId + "'"
                : "SET LOCAL app.current_tenant = ''";
        try (Statement stmt = conn.createStatement()) {
            stmt.execute(sql);
        }
    }

    private boolean isValidUuid(String value) {
        try {
            UUID.fromString(value);
            return true;
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
            return false;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.security;

public final class TenantContext {

    private static final ThreadLocal<String> TENANT = new ThreadLocal<>();

    private TenantContext() {}

    public static void set(String tenantId) {
        TENANT.set(tenantId);
    }

    public static String get() {
        return TENANT.get();
    }

    public static void clear() {
        TENANT.remove();
    }
}
```

## D:/Marketing-AI/platform-api/src/main/java/com/marketingai/config/SecurityConfig.java

```java
package com.marketingai.config;

import com.marketingai.security.JwtFilter;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.builders.HttpSecurity;
import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.configuration.EnableWebSecurity;
import org.springframework.security.config.http.SessionCreationPolicy;
import org.springframework.security.crypto.bcrypt.BCryptPasswordEncoder;
import org.springframework.security.crypto.password.PasswordEncoder;
import org.springframework.security.web.SecurityFilterChain;
import org.springframework.security.web.authentication.UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter;
import org.springframework.web.cors.CorsConfiguration;
import org.springframework.web.cors.CorsConfigurationSource;
import org.springframework.web.cors.UrlBasedCorsConfigurationSource;

import java.util.List;

@Configuration
@EnableWebSecurity
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class SecurityConfig {

    private final JwtFilter jwtFilter;
    private final AppProperties props;

    @Bean
    public SecurityFilterChain filterChain(HttpSecurity http) throws Exception {
        http
            .cors(cors -> cors.configurationSource(corsConfigurationSource()))
            .csrf(csrf -> csrf.disable())
            .sessionManagement(sm -> sm.sessionCreationPolicy(SessionCreationPolicy.STATELESS))
            .authorizeHttpRequests(auth -> auth
                .requestMatchers("/auth/**", "/events", "/webhooks/**", "/health", "/actuator/health", "/error", "/files/**", "/public/**").permitAll()
                .anyRequest().authenticated()
            )
            .exceptionHandling(ex -> ex
                .authenticationEntryPoint((req, res, e) ->
                    res.sendError(401, "Unauthorized"))
            )
            .addFilterBefore(jwtFilter, UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter.class);
        return http.build();
    }

    @Bean
    public CorsConfigurationSource corsConfigurationSource() {
        CorsConfiguration config = new CorsConfiguration();
        config.setAllowedOriginPatterns(props.getCors().getAllowedOrigins());
        config.setAllowedMethods(List.of("GET", "POST", "PUT", "DELETE", "PATCH", "OPTIONS"));
        config.setAllowedHeaders(List.of("Authorization", "Content-Type", "X-Requested-With"));
        config.setAllowCredentials(true);
        config.setMaxAge(3600L);

        UrlBasedCorsConfigurationSource source = new UrlBasedCorsConfigurationSource();
        source.registerCorsConfiguration("/**", config);
        return source;
    }

    @Bean
    public PasswordEncoder passwordEncoder() {
        return new BCryptPasswordEncoder();
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.dto.meta;

import lombok.Builder;
import lombok.Value;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Recommended next test batch for a campaign.
 * Split into exploitation (EVI-ranked) and exploration (new/untested) slots.
 * Vision §6.4.
 */
@Value
@Builder
public class RecommendedBatchResponse {

    UUID campaignId;
    int batchSize;

    /** Fraction reserved for exploration (from campaign.explorationRate) */
    float explorationRate;

    int exploitationSlots;
    int explorationSlots;

    /** EVI-ranked existing creatives for exploitation slots */
    List<CandidateSlot> exploitationCandidates;

    /** New/untested creatives for exploration slots */
    List<CandidateSlot> explorationCandidates;

    @Value
    @Builder
    public static class CandidateSlot {
        UUID creativeId;
        String creativeTitle;
        String creativeType;

        /** Top-Two Thompson EVI score (0-1). Higher = more informative to test */
        double eviScore;

        /** Current Thompson posterior alpha */
        double priorAlpha;

        /** Current Thompson posterior beta */
        double priorBeta;

        /** Number of observations so far */
        long observations;

        /** True if this is an unexplored creative (exploration slot) */
        boolean isNew;
    }
}
```

```java
    private String capiAccessToken;

     * Quality filter: controls which GHL events qualify for CAPI forwarding on this pixel.
     * Example: {"require_crm_match": true, "allowed_events": ["appointment.completed", "opportunity.won"]}
     * Empty map = use platform defaults (§16.1 B2B mapping).
     */
    private Map<String, Object> qualityFilter;

    @JsonProperty("isDefault")
    private boolean isDefault = false;
}
```

## D:/Marketing-AI/platform-api/src/main/java/com/marketingai/dto/pixel/PixelResponse.java

```java
package com.marketingai.dto.pixel;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonIgnoreProperties;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonProperty;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import com.marketingai.entity.MetaPixel;
import lombok.Builder;
import lombok.Value;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

@Value
@Builder
@JsonIgnoreProperties({"default"})
public class PixelResponse {

    UUID id;
    String pixelId;
    String name;
    String purpose;
    @JsonProperty("isDefault")
    boolean isDefault;
    boolean hasCapiToken;   // never expose the actual token in responses
    Map<String, Object> qualityFilter;
    String status;
    Instant createdAt;

    private static final ObjectMapper MAPPER = new ObjectMapper();

    public static PixelResponse from(MetaPixel p) {
        Map<String, Object> qf = parseQualityFilter(p.getQualityFilter());
        return PixelResponse.builder()
                .id(p.getId())
                .pixelId(p.getPixelId())
                .name(p.getName())
                .purpose(p.getPurpose())
                .isDefault(p.isDefaultPixel())
                .hasCapiToken(p.getCapiAccessTokenEnc() != null && p.getCapiAccessTokenEnc().length > 0)
                .qualityFilter(qf)
                .status(p.getStatus())
                .createdAt(p.getCreatedAt())
                .build();
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private static Map<String, Object> parseQualityFilter(String json) {
        if (json == null || json.isBlank() || "{}".equals(json.trim())) return Map.of();
        try {
            return MAPPER.readValue(json, Map.class);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return Map.of();
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.dto.webhook;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonAnySetter;
import lombok.Data;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * GHL webhook payload — real event names (arch v1.1 §13.1):
 *   ContactCreate, ContactUpdate, AppointmentCreate, AppointmentUpdate,
 *   OpportunityStatusUpdate, conversation/message webhooks for call outcome.
 *
 * Unknown fields captured in rawData for JSONB audit log + replay.
 */
@Data
public class GhlWebhookPayload {

    /** Real GHL event name: ContactCreate, AppointmentUpdate, OpportunityStatusUpdate, etc. */
    private String type;

    private String contactId;
    private String opportunityId;
    private String locationId;
    private String email;
    private String phone;
    private String fullName;

    // OpportunityStatusUpdate fields
    private String status;             // "won" | "lost" | pipeline stage name
    private Double dealValue;          // monetary value on won/lost
    private String pipelineStage;

    // AppointmentCreate / AppointmentUpdate fields
    private String appointmentId;
    private String startTime;
    /** arch v1.1 §13.1: "showed" | "noshow" — set manually by the sales rep in GHL. */
    private String appointmentStatus;

    /** Captures any unknown fields for JSONB storage (audit + replay). */
    private Map<String, Object> rawData = new HashMap<>();

    @JsonAnySetter
    public void setRawData(String key, Object value) {
        rawData.put(key, value);
    }
}
```

```java
    private float threshold;

    @Column(nullable = false)
    private float currentSpend = 0f;

    @Column(name = "is_triggered", nullable = false)
    private boolean triggered = false;

    private Instant triggeredAt;

    /** First day of billing period (MONTHLY_CEILING only) */
    private LocalDate periodStart;

    @Column(nullable = false, updatable = false)
    private Instant createdAt;

    @PrePersist
    void onCreate() {
        this.createdAt = Instant.now();
        if ("MONTHLY_CEILING".equals(guardType) && periodStart == null) {
            this.periodStart = LocalDate.now().withDayOfMonth(1);
```

```java
    @PrePersist
```

```java
import java.util.UUID;
```

```java
 * Mirrors a Meta Ads Manager campaign.

 */
@Entity
@Table(name = "meta_campaigns")
@Getter
@Setter
@NoArgsConstructor
public class MetaCampaign {

    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.UUID)
    private UUID id;

    @Column(nullable = false)
    private UUID tenantId;

    private UUID pixelId;

    /** Meta's own campaign ID (e.g. "120210000000000") */
    @Column(nullable = false)
    private String metaCampaignId;

    private String name;

    /** CONVERSIONS, LEAD_GENERATION, LINK_CLICKS, etc. */
    private String objective;

    /** TEST (exploration) or SCALE (exploitation) — vision §6.5 */
    @Column(nullable = false)
    private String contour = "TEST";

    /** Max spend per ad set before L1 circuit breaker pauses it (§12.3, §12.5a) */
    private Float maxSpendPerAdset;

    /** Monthly budget ceiling — L3 triggers when total spend reaches this (§12.5a) */
    private Float monthlyCeilingBudget;

    /** Target CPA for L2 Bayesian trigger (§12.5a) */
    private Float targetCpa;

    /** Breakeven ROAS for L3 Bayesian trigger (§12.5a) */
    private Float breakevenRoas;

    /** Fraction of batch slots reserved for unexplored creatives (§6.4). Default 0.15 = 15% */
    @Column(nullable = false)
    private Float explorationRate = 0.15f;

    private Float dailyBudget;

    /** ACTIVE, PAUSED, ARCHIVED, DELETED */
    private String status;

    /** LEARNING, ACTIVE, LEARNING_LIMITED — Meta's learning phase status */
    private String learningPhase;

    private Float spendToday = 0f;
    private Float spendTotal = 0f;

    /**
     * Meta ad set ID of the confirmation run ad set.
     * Populated when confirmation run starts; null before that.
     */
    private String confirmationAdSetId;

    /**
     * NONE → RUNNING → PASSED / FAILED
     * Tracks confirmation run lifecycle before transfer to SCALE.
     */
    @Column(nullable = false)
    private String confirmationStatus = "NONE";

    private Instant syncedAt;

    @Column(nullable = false, updatable = false)
    private Instant createdAt;

    @PrePersist
    void onCreate() {
        createdAt = Instant.now();
    }
}
```

```java
    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.UUID)
```

```java
    @Column(nullable = false)
    private UUID variantId;

    @Column(nullable = false)

    /** arch v1.1 §4.4: event type this arm counts (binary; delta always 1.0) */
    @Column(nullable = false)
    private String rewardEvent = "FORM_SUBMIT";

    @Column(nullable = false)
    private Float alpha = 1.0f;

    @Column(nullable = false)
    private Float beta = 1.0f;

    private Float revenueMu = 0.0f;
    private Float revenueSigma = 1.0f;
    private Integer revenueN = 0;
    private Integer totalSamples = 0;

    private Instant lastDecayedAt;
    private Instant updatedAt;

    @PrePersist
    void onCreate() {
        lastDecayedAt = updatedAt = Instant.now();
    }

    @PreUpdate
    void onUpdate() {
        updatedAt = Instant.now();
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.repository;

import com.marketingai.entity.Appointment;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Query;
import org.springframework.data.repository.query.Param;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.UUID;

public interface AppointmentRepository extends JpaRepository<Appointment, UUID> {

    Optional<Appointment> findByGhlAppointmentIdAndTenantId(String ghlAppointmentId, UUID tenantId);

    /**
     * Pending appointments whose scheduled time is before the given cutoff.
     * Covers both Calendar fallback (1h delay) and 7-day timeout check.
     */
    @Query("SELECT a FROM Appointment a WHERE a.status = 'SCHEDULED' AND a.scheduledAt < :cutoff")
    List<Appointment> findPendingBefore(@Param("cutoff") Instant cutoff);
}
```

```java
    @Query("""
        SELECT c FROM ComplianceCheck c
        WHERE c.tenantId = :tenantId AND c.entityId = :entityId
        ORDER BY c.createdAt DESC
        LIMIT 1
        """)
    Optional<ComplianceCheck> findLatestByEntityId(@Param("tenantId") UUID tenantId,
                                                    @Param("entityId") UUID entityId);
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.repository;

import com.marketingai.entity.MetaPixel;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Query;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.UUID;

public interface MetaPixelRepository extends JpaRepository<MetaPixel, UUID> {

    List<MetaPixel> findByTenantIdAndStatus(UUID tenantId, String status);

    Optional<MetaPixel> findByIdAndTenantId(UUID id, UUID tenantId);

    /** Returns the Meta pixel_id string for the default active pixel of a tenant. */
    @Query("SELECT p.pixelId FROM MetaPixel p " +
           "WHERE p.tenantId = :tenantId AND p.defaultPixel = true AND p.status = 'ACTIVE'")
    Optional<String> findDefaultPixelId(UUID tenantId);

    /**
     * Returns the CAPI access token (raw bytes → UTF-8) for the default pixel.
     * Phase 0: no encryption. Phase 1+: decrypt with AES/KMS here.
     */
    @Query("SELECT p.capiAccessTokenEnc FROM MetaPixel p " +
           "WHERE p.tenantId = :tenantId AND p.defaultPixel = true AND p.status = 'ACTIVE'")
    Optional<byte[]> findDefaultCapiTokenBytes(UUID tenantId);

    default Optional<String> findCapiToken(UUID tenantId) {
        return findDefaultCapiTokenBytes(tenantId)
                .filter(bytes -> bytes.length > 0)
                .map(bytes -> new String(bytes, java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
    }

    /** Find pixel_id by role_key (for CAPI v2 multi-pixel routing). */
    @Query("SELECT p.pixelId FROM MetaPixel p " +
           "WHERE p.tenantId = :tenantId AND p.roleKey = :roleKey AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1")
    Optional<String> findPixelIdByRole(UUID tenantId, String roleKey);

    /** Find CAPI token by role_key. */
    @Query("SELECT p.capiAccessTokenEnc FROM MetaPixel p " +
           "WHERE p.tenantId = :tenantId AND p.roleKey = :roleKey AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1")
    Optional<byte[]> findCapiTokenBytesByRole(UUID tenantId, String roleKey);

    default Optional<String> findCapiTokenByRole(UUID tenantId, String roleKey) {
        return findCapiTokenBytesByRole(tenantId, roleKey)
                .filter(bytes -> bytes.length > 0)
                .map(bytes -> new String(bytes, java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import com.marketingai.config.AppProperties;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.mockito.ArgumentCaptor;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.*;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.*;

class AlertServiceTest {

    private AppProperties props;
    private RestTemplate restTemplate;
    private AlertService alertService;

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {
        props = new AppProperties();
        restTemplate = mock(RestTemplate.class);
        alertService = new AlertService(props, restTemplate);
    }

    @Test
    void sendAlert_telegramConfigured_callsTelegram() {
        props.getTelegram().setBotToken("testtoken");
        props.getTelegram().setChatId("123456");
        props.setAlertChannel("TELEGRAM");

        alertService.sendAlert("Test message");

        verify(restTemplate, times(1)).postForObject(
                contains("api.telegram.org"), any(), eq(String.class));
    }

    @Test
    void sendAlert_slackConfigured_callsSlack() {
        props.setSlackWebhookUrl("https://hooks.slack.com/test");
        props.setAlertChannel("SLACK");

        alertService.sendAlert("Test Slack message");

        verify(restTemplate, times(1)).postForObject(
                eq("https://hooks.slack.com/test"), any(), eq(String.class));
    }

    @Test
    void sendAlert_both_callsBothChannels() {
        props.getTelegram().setBotToken("tok");
        props.getTelegram().setChatId("cid");
        props.setSlackWebhookUrl("https://hooks.slack.com/test");
        props.setAlertChannel("BOTH");

        alertService.sendAlert("Both channels");

        verify(restTemplate, times(2)).postForObject(anyString(), any(), eq(String.class));
    }

    @Test
    void sendAlert_tenantWebhookOverridesGlobal() {
        props.setSlackWebhookUrl("https://hooks.slack.com/global");
        props.setAlertChannel("SLACK");

        alertService.sendAlert("Tenant message", "https://hooks.slack.com/tenant");

        ArgumentCaptor<String> urlCaptor = ArgumentCaptor.forClass(String.class);
        verify(restTemplate, times(1)).postForObject(urlCaptor.capture(), any(), eq(String.class));
        assertThat(urlCaptor.getValue()).isEqualTo("https://hooks.slack.com/tenant");
    }

    @Test
    void sendAlert_noChannelsConfigured_noRestCalls() {
        props.setAlertChannel("BOTH");
        // Neither Telegram nor Slack configured

        alertService.sendAlert("Should not send");

        verify(restTemplate, never()).postForObject(anyString(), any(), eq(String.class));
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.util.UUID;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatCode;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.any;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.eq;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.*;

class AutonomyServiceTest {

    private JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private AutonomyService autonomyService;
    private final UUID tenantId = UUID.randomUUID();

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {
        jdbc = mock(JdbcTemplate.class);
        autonomyService = new AutonomyService(jdbc);
    }

    @Test
    void observer_blocks_all_writes() {
        when(jdbc.queryForObject(any(String.class), eq(String.class), eq(tenantId)))
                .thenReturn("OBSERVER");

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> autonomyService.checkAndExecute(tenantId, "BID_UPDATE", () -> {}))
                .isInstanceOf(ResponseStatusException.class)
                .satisfies(ex -> {
                    ResponseStatusException rse = (ResponseStatusException) ex;
                    assert rse.getStatusCode() == HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN;
                });
    }

    @Test
    void advisor_blocks_all_writes() {
        when(jdbc.queryForObject(any(String.class), eq(String.class), eq(tenantId)))
                .thenReturn("ADVISOR");

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> autonomyService.checkAndExecute(tenantId, "BUDGET_UPDATE", () -> {}))
                .isInstanceOf(ResponseStatusException.class)
                .satisfies(ex -> {
                    ResponseStatusException rse = (ResponseStatusException) ex;
                    assert rse.getStatusCode() == HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN;
                });
    }

    @Test
    void semi_autopilot_blocks_campaign_create() {
        when(jdbc.queryForObject(any(String.class), eq(String.class), eq(tenantId)))
                .thenReturn("SEMI_AUTOPILOT");

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> autonomyService.checkAndExecute(tenantId, "CAMPAIGN_CREATE", () -> {}))
                .isInstanceOf(ResponseStatusException.class)
                .satisfies(ex -> {
                    ResponseStatusException rse = (ResponseStatusException) ex;
                    assert rse.getStatusCode() == HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN;
                });
    }

    @Test
    void semi_autopilot_allows_bid_update() {
        when(jdbc.queryForObject(any(String.class), eq(String.class), eq(tenantId)))
                .thenReturn("SEMI_AUTOPILOT");

        Runnable write = mock(Runnable.class);
        assertThatCode(() -> autonomyService.checkAndExecute(tenantId, "BID_UPDATE", write))
                .doesNotThrowAnyException();
        verify(write).run();
    }

    @Test
    void autopilot_allows_all_actions() {
        when(jdbc.queryForObject(any(String.class), eq(String.class), eq(tenantId)))
                .thenReturn("AUTOPILOT");

        Runnable write = mock(Runnable.class);
        assertThatCode(() -> autonomyService.checkAndExecute(tenantId, "CAMPAIGN_CREATE", write))
                .doesNotThrowAnyException();
        verify(write).run();
    }

    @Test
    void set_invalid_level_throws_bad_request() {
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> autonomyService.setAutonomyLevel(tenantId, "GOD_MODE"))
                .isInstanceOf(ResponseStatusException.class)
                .satisfies(ex -> {
                    ResponseStatusException rse = (ResponseStatusException) ex;
                    assert rse.getStatusCode() == HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST;
                });
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith;
import org.mockito.InjectMocks;
import org.mockito.Mock;
import org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;

import java.util.*;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.*;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.*;

@ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class)
class AutopilotServiceTest {

    @Mock
    JdbcTemplate jdbc;

    @InjectMocks
    AutopilotService service;

    private static final UUID TENANT_ID = UUID.randomUUID();

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {}

    // ─── evaluateActions ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Test
    void evaluateActions_disabledReturnsZero() {
        when(jdbc.queryForList(contains("autopilot_settings"), eq(TENANT_ID)))
                .thenReturn(List.of(Map.of("enabled", false)));

        Map<String, Object> result = service.evaluateActions(TENANT_ID);

        assertThat(result.get("evaluated")).isEqualTo(0);
        assertThat(result.get("reason").toString()).contains("disabled");
    }

    @Test
    void evaluateActions_capReachedReturnsZero() {
        when(jdbc.queryForList(contains("autopilot_settings"), eq(TENANT_ID)))
                .thenReturn(List.of(Map.of(
                        "enabled", true,
                        "auto_pause_burnout", true,
                        "auto_scale_winner", false,
                        "auto_retire_graveyard", false,
                        "max_l1_triggers_per_day", 3,
                        "min_p_best_to_scale", 0.95,
                        "budget_scale_factor", 1.20
                )));
        when(jdbc.queryForObject(contains("COUNT"), eq(Integer.class), any()))
                .thenReturn(3);

        Map<String, Object> result = service.evaluateActions(TENANT_ID);

        assertThat(result.get("evaluated")).isEqualTo(0);
    }

    // ─── isSafeToExecute ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Test
    void isSafeToExecute_pauseBurnoutRequiresFlag() {
        Map<String, Object> candidate = Map.of("action_type", "PAUSE_BURNOUT", "target_id", "ad1");
        Map<String, Object> settingsOff = Map.of("auto_pause_burnout", false, "min_p_best_to_scale", 0.95);
        Map<String, Object> settingsOn  = Map.of("auto_pause_burnout", true,  "min_p_best_to_scale", 0.95);

        assertThat(service.isSafeToExecute(candidate, settingsOff)).isFalse();
        assertThat(service.isSafeToExecute(candidate, settingsOn)).isTrue();
    }

    @Test
    void isSafeToExecute_scaleWinnerRequiresPBestThreshold() {
        Map<String, Object> candidate = Map.of(
                "action_type", "SCALE_WINNER",
                "p_best", 0.94
        );
        Map<String, Object> settings = Map.of(
                "auto_scale_winner", true,
                "min_p_best_to_scale", 0.95
        );
        assertThat(service.isSafeToExecute(candidate, settings)).isFalse();
    }

    @Test
    void isSafeToExecute_scaleWinnerAboveThreshold() {
        Map<String, Object> candidate = Map.of(
                "action_type", "SCALE_WINNER",
                "p_best", 0.97
        );
        Map<String, Object> settings = Map.of(
                "auto_scale_winner", true,
                "min_p_best_to_scale", 0.95
        );
        assertThat(service.isSafeToExecute(candidate, settings)).isTrue();
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.within;

/**
 * Unit tests for CircuitBreaker Bayesian math and erf approximation.
 * No Spring context — pure static method tests.
 */
class CircuitBreakerServiceTest {

    // ─── erf ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Test
    void erf_zero_returnsZero() {
        assertThat(CircuitBreakerService.erf(0.0)).isCloseTo(0.0, within(1e-6));
    }

    @Test
    void erf_knownValue_onePointZero() {
        // erf(1.0) ≈ 0.8427008
        assertThat(CircuitBreakerService.erf(1.0)).isCloseTo(0.8427, within(0.001));
    }

    @Test
    void erf_largePositive_saturatesAtOne() {
        assertThat(CircuitBreakerService.erf(5.0)).isCloseTo(1.0, within(1e-4));
    }

    @Test
    void erf_largeNegative_saturatesAtMinusOne() {
        assertThat(CircuitBreakerService.erf(-5.0)).isCloseTo(-1.0, within(1e-4));
    }

    @Test
    void erf_isOddFunction() {
        // erf(-x) = -erf(x)
        for (double x : new double[]{0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 3.0}) {
            assertThat(CircuitBreakerService.erf(-x))
                    .isCloseTo(-CircuitBreakerService.erf(x), within(1e-9));
        }
    }

    // ─── bayesianProbCpaTooHigh ──────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Test
    void probCpaTooHigh_zeroCon_highSpend_returnsHighProb() {
        // spend=1000, conversions=0, target_cpa=10 → CPA=∞ >> 10 → P should be high
        double p = CircuitBreakerService.bayesianProbCpaTooHigh(1000f, 0f, 10f);
        assertThat(p).isGreaterThan(0.80);
    }

    @Test
    void probCpaTooHigh_highCPA_returnsHighProb() {
        // spend=500, conversions=1, target_cpa=10 → CPA≈500 >> 10
        double p = CircuitBreakerService.bayesianProbCpaTooHigh(500f, 1f, 10f);
        assertThat(p).isGreaterThan(0.75);
    }

    @Test
    void probCpaTooHigh_goodCPA_returnsZero() {
        // spend=50, conversions=100, target_cpa=10 → CPA=0.5 << 10 → P=0
        double p = CircuitBreakerService.bayesianProbCpaTooHigh(50f, 100f, 10f);
        assertThat(p).isEqualTo(0.0);
    }

    @Test
    void probCpaTooHigh_alwaysInUnitInterval() {
        float[] spends = {1, 10, 100, 1000};
        float[] convs  = {0, 1, 5, 50};
        for (float s : spends) {
            for (float c : convs) {
                double p = CircuitBreakerService.bayesianProbCpaTooHigh(s, c, 10f);
                assertThat(p).isBetween(0.0, 1.0);
            }
        }
    }

    // ─── bayesianProbRoasBelowBreakeven ──────────────────────────────────────

    @Test
    void probRoasBelowBreakeven_zeroConversions_highSpend_returnsHighProb() {
        double p = CircuitBreakerService.bayesianProbRoasBelowBreakeven(1000f, 0f, 1.0f);
        assertThat(p).isGreaterThan(0.80);
    }

    @Test
    void probRoasBelowBreakeven_goodRoas_returnsZero() {
        // spend=10, conversions=10000, breakeven=0.1 → clearly profitable
        double p = CircuitBreakerService.bayesianProbRoasBelowBreakeven(10f, 10_000f, 0.1f);
        assertThat(p).isEqualTo(0.0);
    }

    @Test
    void probRoasBelowBreakeven_alwaysInUnitInterval() {
        float[] spends = {1, 100, 1000};
        float[] convs  = {0, 1, 10};
        for (float s : spends) {
            for (float c : convs) {
                double p = CircuitBreakerService.bayesianProbRoasBelowBreakeven(s, c, 1.0f);
                assertThat(p).isBetween(0.0, 1.0);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## D:/Marketing-AI/platform-api/src/test/java/com/marketingai/service/GateEvaluationServiceTest.java

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.RepeatedTest;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.util.Random;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

/**
 * Unit tests for Bayesian gate math (probBetter, samplers).
 * No Spring context — pure static method tests.
 */
class GateEvaluationServiceTest {

    // ─── probBetter ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Test
    void probBetter_equalPriors_nearHalf() {
        double p = GateEvaluationService.probBetter(1, 1, 1, 1);
        assertThat(p).isBetween(0.42, 0.58);
    }

    @Test
    void probBetter_strongArmVsWeak_nearOne() {
        // Beta(1000, 1) vs Beta(1, 1000) → arm 1 almost certainly wins
        double p = GateEvaluationService.probBetter(1000, 1, 1, 1000);
        assertThat(p).isGreaterThan(0.99);
    }

    @Test
    void probBetter_weakVsStrong_nearZero() {
        double p = GateEvaluationService.probBetter(1, 1000, 1000, 1);
        assertThat(p).isLessThan(0.01);
    }

    @Test
    void probBetter_moderateAdvantage_returnsReasonableRange() {
        // Beta(50,50) mean=0.50 vs Beta(30,70) mean=0.30 — arm 1 clearly dominates
        // Theoretical P≈0.998, so assert > 0.95 with MC noise headroom
        double p = GateEvaluationService.probBetter(50, 50, 30, 70);
        assertThat(p).isGreaterThan(0.95);
    }

    @Test
    void probBetter_symmetric_nearHalf() {
        // Same parameters → ~50/50
        double p = GateEvaluationService.probBetter(10, 20, 10, 20);
        assertThat(p).isBetween(0.40, 0.60);
    }

    // ─── sampleBeta ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Test
    void sampleBeta_alwaysInUnitInterval() {
        Random rng = new Random(42);
        for (int i = 0; i < 2000; i++) {
            double s = GateEvaluationService.sampleBeta(2.0, 3.0, rng);
            assertThat(s).isBetween(0.0, 1.0);
        }
    }

    @Test
    void sampleBeta_concentratedAroundExpectedMean() {
        // Beta(10, 10): E[X] = 0.5
        Random rng = new Random(0);
        double sum = 0;
        int n = 5_000;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) sum += GateEvaluationService.sampleBeta(10.0, 10.0, rng);
        assertThat(sum / n).isBetween(0.46, 0.54);
    }

    @Test
    void sampleBeta_highAlpha_concentratesNearOne() {
        // Beta(100, 1): E[X] ≈ 0.99
        Random rng = new Random(1);
        double sum = 0;
        int n = 2_000;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) sum += GateEvaluationService.sampleBeta(100.0, 1.0, rng);
        assertThat(sum / n).isGreaterThan(0.95);
    }

    @Test
    void sampleBeta_smallAlpha_worksWithFractionalShape() {
        // shape < 1 uses the reduction rule — must still be in [0,1]
        Random rng = new Random(7);
        for (int i = 0; i < 500; i++) {
            double s = GateEvaluationService.sampleBeta(0.5, 0.5, rng);
            assertThat(s).isBetween(0.0, 1.0);
        }
    }

    // ─── sampleGamma ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Test
    void sampleGamma_alwaysPositive_smallShape() {
        Random rng = new Random(99);
        for (int i = 0; i < 1000; i++) {
            assertThat(GateEvaluationService.sampleGamma(0.1, rng)).isGreaterThan(0.0);
        }
    }

    @Test
    void sampleGamma_alwaysPositive_largeShape() {
        Random rng = new Random(123);
        for (int i = 0; i < 1000; i++) {
            assertThat(GateEvaluationService.sampleGamma(50.0, rng)).isGreaterThan(0.0);
        }
    }

    @Test
    void sampleGamma_meanMatchesShape() {
        // E[Gamma(shape, 1)] = shape
        Random rng = new Random(55);
        double shape = 5.0;
        double sum = 0;
        int n = 10_000;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) sum += GateEvaluationService.sampleGamma(shape, rng);
        assertThat(sum / n).isBetween(4.7, 5.3);
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import com.marketingai.config.AppProperties;
import com.marketingai.controller.MediaComplianceController;
import com.marketingai.entity.ComplianceCheck;
import com.marketingai.repository.ComplianceCheckRepository;
import com.marketingai.security.TenantContext;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;

import java.util.*;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.*;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.*;

class MediaComplianceTest {

    private ComplianceCheckRepository repo;
    private RestTemplate restTemplate;
    private AppProperties appProperties;
    private JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private MediaComplianceController controller;
    private UUID tenantId;

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {
        repo = mock(ComplianceCheckRepository.class);
        restTemplate = mock(RestTemplate.class);
        appProperties = mock(AppProperties.class);
        jdbc = mock(JdbcTemplate.class);

        when(appProperties.getMlServiceUrl()).thenReturn("http://ml:8000");
        when(appProperties.getInternalApiKey()).thenReturn("test-key");
        when(repo.save(any())).thenAnswer(inv -> inv.getArgument(0));

        controller = new MediaComplianceController(
                repo, restTemplate, appProperties, jdbc, new ObjectMapper());

        tenantId = UUID.randomUUID();
        TenantContext.set(tenantId.toString());
    }

    @Test
    void checkMedia_allPass_returns_pass() {
        UUID entityId = UUID.randomUUID();
        List<Map<String, Object>> individual = List.of(
                Map.of("check_type", "FACE", "result", "PASS", "findings", List.of()),
                Map.of("check_type", "MUSIC", "result", "PASS", "findings", List.of()),
                Map.of("check_type", "AI_LABEL", "result", "PASS", "findings", List.of())
        );
        when(restTemplate.postForObject(anyString(), any(), eq(Map.class))).thenReturn(
                Map.of("result", "PASS", "checks", Map.of(), "individual", individual));

        Map<String, Object> body = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        body.put("entity_type", "CREATIVE");
        body.put("entity_id", entityId.toString());
        body.put("asset_url", "s3://bucket/video.mp4");
        body.put("metadata", Map.of());

        ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> resp = controller.checkMedia(tenantId, body);
        assertThat(resp.getStatusCode().value()).isEqualTo(200);
        assertThat(resp.getBody()).containsEntry("result", "PASS");
        assertThat(resp.getBody()).containsEntry("saved_checks", 3);
    }

    @Test
    void checkMedia_faceNoRelease_saves_fail_check() {
        UUID entityId = UUID.randomUUID();
        List<Map<String, Object>> individual = List.of(
                Map.of("check_type", "FACE", "result", "FAIL",
                        "findings", List.of(Map.of("rule", "NO_MODEL_RELEASE"))),
                Map.of("check_type", "MUSIC", "result", "PASS", "findings", List.of()),
                Map.of("check_type", "AI_LABEL", "result", "PASS", "findings", List.of())
        );
        when(restTemplate.postForObject(anyString(), any(), eq(Map.class))).thenReturn(
                Map.of("result", "FAIL", "checks", Map.of(), "individual", individual));

        Map<String, Object> body = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        body.put("entity_type", "CREATIVE");
        body.put("entity_id", entityId.toString());
        body.put("asset_url", "s3://bucket/video.mp4");
        body.put("metadata", Map.of("detected_faces",
                List.of(Map.of("face_id", "f1", "has_model_release", false))));

        ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> resp = controller.checkMedia(tenantId, body);
        assertThat(resp.getBody()).containsEntry("result", "FAIL");
        verify(repo, times(3)).save(any(ComplianceCheck.class));
    }

    @Test
    void checkMedia_ml_service_down_returns_warn() {
        UUID entityId = UUID.randomUUID();
        when(restTemplate.postForObject(anyString(), any(), eq(Map.class)))
                .thenThrow(new RuntimeException("connection refused"));

        Map<String, Object> body = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        body.put("entity_type", "CREATIVE");
        body.put("entity_id", entityId.toString());
        body.put("asset_url", "s3://bucket/video.mp4");

        ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> resp = controller.checkMedia(tenantId, body);
        assertThat(resp.getBody()).containsEntry("result", "WARN");
    }

    @Test
    void getMediaChecks_filters_media_types_only() {
        UUID entityId = UUID.randomUUID();
        ComplianceCheck face = new ComplianceCheck();
        face.setCheckType("FACE");
        face.setResult("PASS");
        face.setTenantId(tenantId);
        ComplianceCheck text = new ComplianceCheck();
        text.setCheckType("META_POLICY");
        text.setResult("PASS");
        text.setTenantId(tenantId);

        when(repo.findByTenantIdAndEntityIdOrderByCreatedAtDesc(any(), any()))
                .thenReturn(List.of(face, text));

        ResponseEntity<List<ComplianceCheck>> resp =
                controller.getMediaChecks(tenantId, entityId);
        assertThat(resp.getBody()).hasSize(1);
        assertThat(resp.getBody().get(0).getCheckType()).isEqualTo("FACE");
    }
}
```
