```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.util.Map;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

class OfferValidatorTest {

    private OfferValidator validator;

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {
        validator = new OfferValidator();
    }

    @Test
    void valid_standard_discount_offer() {
        var result = validator.validate(Map.of(
                "discount_type", "percentage",
                "discount_depth", 15.0,
                "guarantee_type", "money_back",
                "guarantee_days", 30,
                "has_real_urgency", true,
                "urgency_source", "crm_deadline"
        ));
        assertThat(result.valid()).isTrue();
        assertThat(result.errors()).isEmpty();
    }

    @Test
    void discount_type_none_with_nonzero_depth_fails() {
        var result = validator.validate(Map.of(
                "discount_type", "none",
                "discount_depth", 10.0
        ));
        assertThat(result.valid()).isFalse();
        assertThat(result.errors()).anyMatch(e -> e.contains("discount_depth=0"));
    }

    @Test
    void discount_type_none_with_zero_depth_passes() {
        var result = validator.validate(Map.of(
                "discount_type", "none",
                "discount_depth", 0.0
        ));
        assertThat(result.valid()).isTrue();
    }

    @Test
    void guarantee_type_none_with_days_set_fails() {
        var result = validator.validate(Map.of(
                "guarantee_type", "none",
                "guarantee_days", 30
        ));
        assertThat(result.valid()).isFalse();
        assertThat(result.errors()).anyMatch(e -> e.contains("guarantee_days=null"));
    }

    @Test
    void guarantee_type_none_with_null_days_passes() {
        var result = validator.validate(Map.of("guarantee_type", "none"));
        assertThat(result.valid()).isTrue();
    }

    @Test
    void urgency_true_with_invalid_source_fails() {
        var result = validator.validate(Map.of(
                "has_real_urgency", true,
                "urgency_source", "made_up_source"
        ));
        assertThat(result.valid()).isFalse();
        assertThat(result.errors()).anyMatch(e -> e.contains("urgency_source"));
    }

    @Test
    void urgency_true_with_missing_source_fails() {
        var result = validator.validate(Map.of("has_real_urgency", true));
        assertThat(result.valid()).isFalse();
        assertThat(result.errors()).anyMatch(e -> e.contains("urgency_source to be set"));
    }

    @Test
    void urgency_true_with_valid_source_passes() {
        for (String src : new String[]{"inventory_api", "crm_deadline", "seasonal_window"}) {
            var result = validator.validate(Map.of("has_real_urgency", true, "urgency_source", src));
            assertThat(result.valid()).as("source: " + src).isTrue();
        }
    }

    @Test
    void empty_offer_passes_all_checks() {
        var result = validator.validate(Map.of());
        assertThat(result.valid()).isTrue();
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.within;

/**
 * Unit tests for PixelPollutionService drift detection logic (vision §6.8 Level 3).
 * No Spring context — tests package-private static helpers directly.
 */
class PixelPollutionServiceTest {

    // ─── shouldAlert ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Test
    void shouldAlert_volumeTooLow_returnsFalse() {
        // forms_14d < 20 → no alert regardless of quality rate
        assertThat(PixelPollutionService.shouldAlert(0.01, 0.20, 5)).isFalse();
    }

    @Test
    void shouldAlert_nullRate_returnsFalse() {
        assertThat(PixelPollutionService.shouldAlert(null, 0.20, 30)).isFalse();
    }

    @Test
    void shouldAlert_nullBaseline_returnsFalse() {
        assertThat(PixelPollutionService.shouldAlert(0.05, null, 30)).isFalse();
    }

    @Test
    void shouldAlert_zeroBaseline_returnsFalse() {
        // Zero baseline → no historic data, avoid false positives
        assertThat(PixelPollutionService.shouldAlert(0.0, 0.0, 50)).isFalse();
    }

    @Test
    void shouldAlert_severeDrop_returnsTrue() {
        // quality drops from 20% to 5% (25% of baseline) — clear pollution
        assertThat(PixelPollutionService.shouldAlert(0.05, 0.20, 30)).isTrue();
    }

    @Test
    void shouldAlert_mildDrop_returnsFalse() {
        // quality drops from 20% to 16% (80% of baseline) — within 70% threshold
        assertThat(PixelPollutionService.shouldAlert(0.16, 0.20, 30)).isFalse();
    }

    @Test
    void shouldAlert_exactlyAtThreshold_returnsFalse() {
        // rate14 = exactly 70% of baseline → strict < means no alert
        double baseline = 0.20;
        double quality  = baseline * 0.70;
        assertThat(PixelPollutionService.shouldAlert(quality, baseline, 30)).isFalse();
    }

    @Test
    void shouldAlert_justBelowThreshold_returnsTrue() {
        double baseline = 0.20;
        double quality  = baseline * 0.699;
        assertThat(PixelPollutionService.shouldAlert(quality, baseline, 30)).isTrue();
    }

    @Test
    void shouldAlert_exactlyAtMinVolume_returnsTrue() {
        // exactly 20 forms (min) with severe quality drop → alert fires
        assertThat(PixelPollutionService.shouldAlert(0.05, 0.20, 20)).isTrue();
    }

    @Test
    void shouldAlert_negativeBaseline_returnsFalse() {
        // Defensive: negative baseline should not trigger alert
        assertThat(PixelPollutionService.shouldAlert(0.05, -0.10, 50)).isFalse();
    }

    // ─── driftPct ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Test
    void driftPct_noChange_returnsZero() {
        assertThat(PixelPollutionService.driftPct(0.20, 0.20)).isCloseTo(0.0, within(1e-6));
    }

    @Test
    void driftPct_halfBaseline_returnsMinus50() {
        // quality = 50% of baseline → drift = -50%
        assertThat(PixelPollutionService.driftPct(0.10, 0.20)).isCloseTo(-50.0, within(0.01));
    }

    @Test
    void driftPct_improvement_returnsPositive() {
        // quality = 150% of baseline → drift = +50%
        assertThat(PixelPollutionService.driftPct(0.30, 0.20)).isCloseTo(50.0, within(0.01));
    }

    @Test
    void driftPct_severeDropToFivePercent() {
        // 5% quality vs 20% baseline → drift ≈ -75%
        assertThat(PixelPollutionService.driftPct(0.05, 0.20)).isCloseTo(-75.0, within(0.01));
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import com.marketingai.scheduler.ProxyCalibrationScheduler;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

class ProxyCalibrationTest {

    @Test
    void pearson_perfect_correlation() {
        double[] x = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5};
        double[] y = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5};
        double r = ProxyCalibrationScheduler.pearson(x, y);
        assertThat(r).isCloseTo(1.0, org.assertj.core.data.Offset.offset(0.001));
    }

    @Test
    void pearson_perfect_anti_correlation() {
        double[] x = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5};
        double[] y = {5, 4, 3, 2, 1};
        double r = ProxyCalibrationScheduler.pearson(x, y);
        assertThat(r).isCloseTo(-1.0, org.assertj.core.data.Offset.offset(0.001));
    }

    @Test
    void pearson_no_correlation() {
        double[] x = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5};
        double[] y = {3, 3, 3, 3, 3};
        double r = ProxyCalibrationScheduler.pearson(x, y);
        assertThat(r).isCloseTo(0.0, org.assertj.core.data.Offset.offset(0.001));
    }

    @Test
    void spearman_monotonic_relationship() {
        double[] x = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5};
        double[] y = {2, 4, 6, 8, 10};
        double r = ProxyCalibrationScheduler.spearman(x, y);
        assertThat(r).isCloseTo(1.0, org.assertj.core.data.Offset.offset(0.001));
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.util.*;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.*;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.*;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.*;

class RecoveryDiagnosisServiceTest {

    private JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private AutonomyService autonomyService;
    private RecoveryDiagnosisService service;
    private final UUID tenantId = UUID.randomUUID();
    private final UUID eventId = UUID.randomUUID();

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {
        jdbc = mock(JdbcTemplate.class);
        autonomyService = mock(AutonomyService.class);
        service = new RecoveryDiagnosisService(jdbc, autonomyService);
    }

    @Test
    void diagnose_returns_map_with_diagnosis_key() {
        // CB event row
        Map<String, Object> cbRow = new HashMap<>();
        cbRow.put("id", eventId);
        cbRow.put("trigger_reason", "L2: CPM spike z-score=3.5");
        cbRow.put("level", "L2");

        when(jdbc.queryForMap(anyString(), eq(eventId), eq(tenantId))).thenReturn(cbRow);
        when(jdbc.queryForList(contains("site_health_incidents"), eq(tenantId))).thenReturn(List.of());
        when(jdbc.queryForMap(contains("FROM sessions"), eq(tenantId)))
                .thenReturn(Map.of("total", 100L, "fraud_count", 5L));
        when(jdbc.update(anyString(), any(), any(), any())).thenReturn(1);

        Map<String, Object> result = service.diagnose(tenantId, eventId);

        assertThat(result).containsKey("diagnosis");
        assertThat(result).containsKey("resume_steps");
        assertThat(result).containsKey("confidence");
    }

    @Test
    void diagnose_returns_technical_when_incident_open() {
        Map<String, Object> cbRow = new HashMap<>();
        cbRow.put("trigger_reason", "CPM spike");
        cbRow.put("level", "L2");

        when(jdbc.queryForMap(anyString(), eq(eventId), eq(tenantId))).thenReturn(cbRow);
        // Site health incident is open
        when(jdbc.queryForList(contains("site_health_incidents"), eq(tenantId)))
                .thenReturn(List.of(Map.of("id", UUID.randomUUID())));
        when(jdbc.update(anyString(), any(), any(), any())).thenReturn(1);

        Map<String, Object> result = service.diagnose(tenantId, eventId);

        assertThat(result.get("diagnosis")).isEqualTo("TECHNICAL");
    }

    @Test
    void resume_batch_calls_autonomy_service() {
        // AUTOPILOT — autonomy check passes (no exception)
        doNothing().when(autonomyService).checkAndExecute(eq(tenantId), eq("CB_RESUME"), any());

        when(jdbc.update(anyString(), any(UUID.class), any(UUID.class))).thenReturn(1);

        UUID id1 = UUID.randomUUID();
        UUID id2 = UUID.randomUUID();
        int count = service.resumeBatch(tenantId, List.of(id1, id2));

        verify(autonomyService).checkAndExecute(eq(tenantId), eq("CB_RESUME"), any());
        assertThat(count).isEqualTo(2);
    }

    @Test
    void resume_batch_blocked_by_observer_mode() {
        doThrow(new ResponseStatusException(org.springframework.http.HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN, "OBSERVER"))
                .when(autonomyService).checkAndExecute(eq(tenantId), eq("CB_RESUME"), any());

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> service.resumeBatch(tenantId, List.of(UUID.randomUUID())))
                .isInstanceOf(ResponseStatusException.class);
    }

    @Test
    void confirm_cause_updates_db() {
        when(jdbc.update(anyString(), eq("MARKET"), eq(eventId), eq(tenantId))).thenReturn(1);

        assertThatCode(() -> service.confirmCause(tenantId, eventId, "MARKET"))
                .doesNotThrowAnyException();

        verify(jdbc).update(anyString(), eq("MARKET"), eq(eventId), eq(tenantId));
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

class TokenRotationSchedulerTest {

    @Test
    void tokenAge_51days_needsRotation() {
        LocalDate createdAt = LocalDate.now().minusDays(51);
        long daysOld = ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(createdAt, LocalDate.now());
        assertThat(daysOld).isGreaterThanOrEqualTo(50);
    }

    @Test
    void tokenAge_30days_notDueYet() {
        LocalDate createdAt = LocalDate.now().minusDays(30);
        long daysOld = ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(createdAt, LocalDate.now());
        assertThat(daysOld).isLessThan(50);
    }

    @Test
    void tokenAge_58days_markedInvalid() {
        LocalDate createdAt = LocalDate.now().minusDays(58);
        long daysOld = ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(createdAt, LocalDate.now());
        assertThat(daysOld).isGreaterThanOrEqualTo(58);
    }

    @Test
    void tokenAge_49days_belowRotationThreshold() {
        LocalDate createdAt = LocalDate.now().minusDays(49);
        long daysOld = ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(createdAt, LocalDate.now());
        assertThat(daysOld).isLessThan(50);
    }

    @Test
    void tokenAge_0days_isOk() {
        LocalDate createdAt = LocalDate.now();
        long daysOld = ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(createdAt, LocalDate.now());
        assertThat(daysOld).isEqualTo(0);
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatNoException;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

/**
 * Unit tests for TwoContourService.validateBudgetStep — the ≤20% budget guard
 * that prevents resetting Meta's Learning Phase (vision §6.5).
 * No Spring context needed — tests a public static method.
 */
class TwoContourBudgetGuardTest {

    @Test
    void exactlyTwentyPct_increase_passes() {
        assertThatNoException().isThrownBy(
                () -> TwoContourService.validateBudgetStep(100f, 120f, "entity-1"));
    }

    @Test
    void exactlyTwentyPct_decrease_passes() {
        assertThatNoException().isThrownBy(
                () -> TwoContourService.validateBudgetStep(100f, 80f, "entity-1"));
    }

    @Test
    void twentyOnePct_increase_throws422() {
        assertThatThrownBy(
                () -> TwoContourService.validateBudgetStep(100f, 121f, "entity-1"))
                .isInstanceOf(ResponseStatusException.class)
                .hasMessageContaining("≤20%");
    }

    @Test
    void twentyOnePct_decrease_throws422() {
        assertThatThrownBy(
                () -> TwoContourService.validateBudgetStep(100f, 79f, "entity-1"))
                .isInstanceOf(ResponseStatusException.class)
                .hasMessageContaining("≤20%");
    }

    @Test
    void nullCurrentBudget_alwaysPasses() {
        // No previous budget to compare against → validation skipped
        assertThatNoException().isThrownBy(
                () -> TwoContourService.validateBudgetStep(null, 9999f, "entity-1"));
    }

    @Test
    void zeroCurrent_alwaysPasses() {
        assertThatNoException().isThrownBy(
                () -> TwoContourService.validateBudgetStep(0f, 9999f, "entity-1"));
    }

    @Test
    void smallBudget_percentageRuleAppliesCorrectly() {
        // 10 → 12 = 20% increase ✓
        assertThatNoException().isThrownBy(
                () -> TwoContourService.validateBudgetStep(10f, 12f, "entity-1"));

        // 10 → 12.1 = 21% increase ✗
        assertThatThrownBy(
                () -> TwoContourService.validateBudgetStep(10f, 12.1f, "entity-1"))
                .isInstanceOf(ResponseStatusException.class);
    }

    @Test
    void confirmationBudget_onePointFiveX_typical_throws422() {
        // A typical budget step of 1.5× exceeds 20% — system should guard this
        // (in TwoContourService this is guarded by passing campaign.getDailyBudget())
        assertThatThrownBy(
                () -> TwoContourService.validateBudgetStep(100f, 150f, "campaign-confirm"))
                .isInstanceOf(ResponseStatusException.class);
    }
}
```

```java
package com.marketingai.service;

import com.marketingai.config.AppProperties;
import com.marketingai.controller.VocController;
import com.marketingai.security.TenantContext;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.http.*;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.*;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.*;

/**
 * Unit tests for VocController (vision §9.2):
 * verifies import flow, objection listing, and source deletion.
 */
class VocServiceTest {

    private JdbcTemplate jdbc;
    private RestTemplate restTemplate;
    private AppProperties appProperties;
    private VocController controller;
    private UUID tenantId;

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {
        jdbc = mock(JdbcTemplate.class);
        restTemplate = mock(RestTemplate.class);
        appProperties = mock(AppProperties.class);

        when(appProperties.getMlServiceUrl()).thenReturn("http://ml:8000");
        when(appProperties.getInternalApiKey()).thenReturn("test-key");

        controller = new VocController(jdbc, restTemplate, appProperties);
        tenantId = UUID.randomUUID();
        TenantContext.set(tenantId.toString());
    }

    @Test
    void importQuotes_persists_source_and_objections() {
        UUID sourceId = UUID.randomUUID();
        when(jdbc.queryForObject(contains("INSERT INTO voc_sources"), eq(UUID.class),
                any(), any(), any(), anyInt()))
                .thenReturn(sourceId);

        List<Map<String, Object>> mlObjList = List.of(
                Map.of("category", "PRICE", "objection_text", "Too expensive",
                        "representative_quote", "way too pricey", "count", 3)
        );
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        ResponseEntity<Map> responseEntity = mock(ResponseEntity.class);
        when(responseEntity.getBody()).thenReturn(Map.of("objections", mlObjList, "method", "llm"));
        when(restTemplate.exchange(anyString(), eq(HttpMethod.POST), any(HttpEntity.class), eq(Map.class)))
                .thenReturn(responseEntity);

        var req = new VocController.ImportRequest(
                List.of("too expensive", "costs too much"), "REVIEW", "Google Reviews", null);
        Map<String, Object> result = controller.importQuotes(tenantId, req);

        assertThat(result.get("source_id")).isEqualTo(sourceId.toString());
        assertThat((int) result.get("objections_saved")).isEqualTo(1);
        verify(jdbc, times(1)).update(contains("INSERT INTO voc_objections"), any(), any(),
                eq("PRICE"), any(), any(), anyInt());
    }

    @Test
    void getObjections_delegates_to_jdbc() {
        when(jdbc.queryForList(anyString(), eq(tenantId))).thenReturn(List.of(
                Map.of("category", "TRUST", "objection_text", "Need proof", "count", 5)
        ));

        List<Map<String, Object>> result = controller.getObjections(tenantId, null);
        assertThat(result).hasSize(1);
        assertThat(result.get(0).get("category")).isEqualTo("TRUST");
    }

    @Test
    void deleteSource_not_owned_throws_404() {
        UUID sourceId = UUID.randomUUID();
        when(jdbc.queryForObject(anyString(), eq(Integer.class), any(), any())).thenReturn(0);

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> controller.deleteSource(tenantId, sourceId))
                .isInstanceOf(org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException.class);
    }
}
```

```tsx
"use client";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";

export default function AbResultsPage() {
  const [arms, setArms]       = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    apiFetch<any[]>("/api/v1/landings/arms")
      .then(setArms)
      .catch(() => setArms([]))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">A/B Results</h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">
          Bayesian posterior distributions (Thompson Sampling)
        </p>
      </div>

      {loading ? (
        <p className="text-gray-400 text-sm">Loading...</p>
      ) : arms.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="text-gray-400 text-sm py-8">No active A/B tests yet.</p>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {arms.map((arm: any) => {
            const alpha = arm.alpha ?? 1;
            const beta  = arm.beta  ?? 1;
            const mean  = alpha / (alpha + beta);
            const n     = Math.max(0, alpha + beta - 2);

            return (
              <div
                key={arm.variant_id}
                className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 p-6"
              >
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
                  <div>
                    <h3 className="font-semibold text-gray-800">
                      {arm.variant_name ?? arm.variant_id}
                    </h3>
                    <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">
                      α={alpha.toFixed(1)} β={beta.toFixed(1)} · n≈{n}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-right">
                    <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-indigo-600">
                      {(mean * 100).toFixed(2)}%
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-xs text-gray-400">
                      posterior mean CVR
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-gray-500">
                  <span>0%</span>
                  <div className="flex-1 bg-gray-100 rounded-full h-3 overflow-hidden">
                    <div
                      className="h-3 rounded-full bg-indigo-500 transition-all"
                      style={{
                        width: `${Math.min(mean * 100 * 5, 100)}%`,
                      }}
                    />
                  </div>
                  <span>20%</span>
                </div>

                {arm.win_probability != null && (
                  <div className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="text-xs text-gray-500">P(best):</span>
                    <div className="flex-1 bg-gray-100 rounded-full h-2">
                      <div
                        className={`h-2 rounded-full transition-all ${
                          arm.win_probability > 0.9
                            ? "bg-green-500"
                            : "bg-indigo-400"
                        }`}
                        style={{ width: `${arm.win_probability * 100}%` }}
                      />
                    </div>
                    <span
                      className={`text-xs font-medium ${
                        arm.win_probability > 0.9
                          ? "text-green-600"
                          : "text-gray-600"
                      }`}
                    >
                      {(arm.win_probability * 100).toFixed(1)}%
                      {arm.win_probability > 0.9 && " ✓ WINNER"}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useParams, useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import StatusBadge from "@/components/admin/StatusBadge";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";

export default function BriefDetailPage() {
  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [brief, setBrief]     = useState<any>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError]     = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [approving, setApproving] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    apiFetch<any>(`/api/v1/briefs/${id}`)
      .then(setBrief)
      .catch(() => setError("Could not load brief"))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [id]);

  async function handleApprove() {
    setApproving(true);
    try {
      await apiFetch(`/api/v1/briefs/${id}/approve`, { method: "PUT" });
      setBrief((prev: any) => ({ ...prev, is_draft: false }));
    } catch (e: any) {
      setError(e.message ?? "Approval failed");
    } finally {
      setApproving(false);
    }
  }

  if (loading) return <p className="text-gray-400 text-sm p-8">Loading...</p>;
  if (!brief)
    return (
      <p className="text-red-500 text-sm p-8">{error ?? "Brief not found"}</p>
    );

  return (
    <div className="max-w-3xl space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">
            {brief.title ?? brief.goal ?? brief.id}
          </h1>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mt-2">
            <StatusBadge
              status={brief.is_draft ? "DRAFT" : "APPROVED"}
            />
            {brief.brief_type && (
              <span className="text-xs text-gray-400">{brief.brief_type}</span>
            )}
            {brief.cluster_label && (
              <span className="text-xs bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 px-2 py-0.5 rounded">
                {brief.cluster_label}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
        {brief.is_draft && (
          <button
            onClick={handleApprove}
            disabled={approving}
            className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 text-white text-sm font-medium hover:bg-indigo-700 disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            {approving ? "Approving..." : "Approve Brief"}
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {brief.goal && (
        <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 p-6">
          <h2 className="font-semibold text-gray-800 mb-2">Goal</h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-gray-700">{brief.goal}</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {brief.target_audience && (
        <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 p-6">
          <h2 className="font-semibold text-gray-800 mb-2">Target Audience</h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-gray-700">{brief.target_audience}</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {brief.voc_section && (
        <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 p-6">
          <h2 className="font-semibold text-gray-800 mb-2">VoC Insights</h2>
          <pre className="text-xs text-gray-600 whitespace-pre-wrap">
            {JSON.stringify(brief.voc_section, null, 2)}
          </pre>
        </div>
      )}

      {error && <p className="text-red-500 text-sm">{error}</p>}

      <button
        onClick={() => router.push("/briefs")}
        className="text-sm text-gray-500 hover:underline"
      >
        ← Back to Briefs
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";

const CLUSTERS = [
  "PRICE_SENSITIVE",
  "QUALITY_FOCUSED",
  "BRAND_LOYAL",
  "CONVENIENCE_SEEKER",
  "ENGAGED",
  "COLD_AUDIENCE",
];

const AUDIENCES = [
  "retargeting_engaged",
  "lookalike_buyers",
  "cold_broad",
  "cold_interest",
];

export default function GenerateBriefPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [cluster, setCluster]   = useState(CLUSTERS[0]);
  const [audience, setAudience] = useState(AUDIENCES[0]);
  const [loading, setLoading]   = useState(false);
  const [error, setError]       = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function handleGenerate() {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const brief = await apiFetch<any>("/api/v1/briefs/generate-data-driven", {
        method: "POST",
        body: JSON.stringify({
          cluster_label:    cluster,
          audience_segment: audience,
        }),
      });
      router.push(`/briefs/${brief.id}`);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setError(e.message ?? "Generation failed");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="max-w-xl space-y-6">
      <div>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">
          Generate Data-Driven Brief
        </h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">
          Creates a brief using posteriors, VoC objections, and niche
          benchmarks for the selected segment.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 p-6 space-y-5">
        <div>
          <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">
            Audience Cluster
          </label>
          <select
            value={cluster}
            onChange={(e) => setCluster(e.target.value)}
            className="w-full border border-gray-200 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-400"
          >
            {CLUSTERS.map((c) => (
              <option key={c} value={c}>
                {c}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>

        <div>
          <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">
            Audience Segment
          </label>
          <select
            value={audience}
            onChange={(e) => setAudience(e.target.value)}
            className="w-full border border-gray-200 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-400"
          >
            {AUDIENCES.map((a) => (
              <option key={a} value={a}>
                {a}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>

        {error && <p className="text-red-500 text-sm">{error}</p>}

        <button
          onClick={handleGenerate}
          disabled={loading}
          className="w-full py-2 rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 text-white text-sm font-medium hover:bg-indigo-700 disabled:opacity-50"
        >
          {loading ? "Generating..." : "Generate Brief"}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import StatusBadge from "@/components/admin/StatusBadge";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";

export default function BriefsPage() {
  const [briefs, setBriefs]   = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    apiFetch<any[]>("/api/v1/briefs")
      .then(setBriefs)
      .catch(() => setBriefs([]))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, []);

  async function approve(id: string) {
    try {
      await apiFetch(`/api/v1/briefs/${id}/approve`, { method: "PUT" });
      setBriefs((prev) =>
        prev.map((b) =>
          b.id === id ? { ...b, is_draft: false, status: "APPROVED" } : b
        )
      );
    } catch {
      alert("Approval failed");

  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">Briefs</h1>

            Creative briefs for video and copy generation
          </p>
        </div>
        <Link
          href="/briefs/generate"

        >

        </Link>
      </div>

      {loading ? (
        <p className="text-gray-400 text-sm">Loading...</p>
      ) : briefs.length === 0 ? (

      ) : (
        <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 overflow-hidden">

                      View

}
```

```tsx
"use client";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useParams, useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import StatusBadge from "@/components/admin/StatusBadge";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";

const COMPLIANCE_ITEMS = [
  { id: "ip",       label: "No trademark / IP violations in content" },
  { id: "faces",    label: "No identifiable real faces without consent" },
  { id: "claims",   label: "All product claims are factually verifiable" },
  { id: "ai_label", label: "AI-generated label present (C2PA / disclosed)" },
  { id: "offer",    label: "Offer terms are legally sound and validated" },
  { id: "tone",     label: "Content matches brand tone-of-voice" },
];

export default function VariantDetailPage() {
  const { id }   = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const router   = useRouter();
  const [variant, setVariant]   = useState<any>(null);
  const [checks, setChecks]     = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});
  const [loading, setLoading]   = useState(true);
  const [approving, setApproving] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError]       = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    apiFetch<any>(`/api/v1/landings/${id}`)
      .then(setVariant)
      .catch(() => setError("Could not load variant"))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [id]);

  const allChecked = COMPLIANCE_ITEMS.every((item) => checks[item.id]);

  async function handleApprove() {
    setApproving(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      await apiFetch(`/api/v1/landings/${id}/approve`, { method: "POST" });
      router.push("/creatives");
    } catch (e: any) {
      setError(e.message ?? "Approval failed");
    } finally {
      setApproving(false);
    }
  }

  if (loading) return <p className="text-gray-400 text-sm p-8">Loading...</p>;
  if (!variant)
    return (
      <p className="text-red-500 text-sm p-8">{error ?? "Variant not found"}</p>
    );

  const isAlreadyActive = variant.status === "ACTIVE";

  return (
    <div className="max-w-3xl space-y-8">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">
            {variant.name ?? variant.id}
          </h1>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mt-2">
            <StatusBadge status={variant.status} />
            <span className="text-xs text-gray-400">
              {variant.placement ?? "Unknown placement"}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
        {variant.slug && (
          <a
            href={`/l/${variant.slug}`}
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener noreferrer"
            className="text-sm text-indigo-600 hover:underline"
          >
            Preview landing ↗
          </a>
        )}
      </div>

      {variant.atoms && (
        <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 p-6">
          <h2 className="font-semibold text-gray-800 mb-4">Creative Atoms</h2>
          <dl className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            {Object.entries(variant.atoms).map(([k, v]) => (
              <div key={k}>
                <dt className="text-xs text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wide">
                  {k}
                </dt>
                <dd className="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-700">{String(v)}</dd>
              </div>
            ))}
          </dl>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Compliance checklist — vision §12.1a */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 p-6">
        <h2 className="font-semibold text-gray-800 mb-1">
          Compliance Checklist
        </h2>
        <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 mb-4">
          All items must be confirmed before approval (vision §12.1a)
        </p>
        <ul className="space-y-3">
          {COMPLIANCE_ITEMS.map((item) => (
            <li key={item.id} className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                id={item.id}
                checked={!!checks[item.id]}
                onChange={(e) =>
                  setChecks((prev) => ({
                    ...prev,
                    [item.id]: e.target.checked,
                  }))
                }
                className="w-4 h-4 rounded border-gray-300 text-indigo-600"
              />
              <label htmlFor={item.id} className="text-sm text-gray-700">
                {item.label}
              </label>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </div>

      {error && <p className="text-red-500 text-sm">{error}</p>}

      <div className="flex gap-3 items-center">
        <button
          onClick={handleApprove}
          disabled={!allChecked || approving || isAlreadyActive}
          className={`px-6 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-colors ${
            allChecked && !isAlreadyActive
              ? "bg-indigo-600 text-white hover:bg-indigo-700"
              : "bg-gray-200 text-gray-400 cursor-not-allowed"
          }`}
        >
          {approving
            ? "Approving..."
            : isAlreadyActive
            ? "Already Active"
            : "Approve & Launch"}
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => router.push("/creatives")}
          className="px-6 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium text-gray-600 border border-gray-200 hover:bg-gray-50"
        >
          Back
        </button>
        {!allChecked && !isAlreadyActive && (
          <p className="text-xs text-amber-600">
            Complete all compliance checks to enable approval
          </p>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";

import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";

const STATUSES = ["ALL", "PENDING_REVIEW", "REVIEW", "ACTIVE", "DRAFT", "PAUSED"];

export default function CreativesPage() {
  const [variants, setVariants] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading]   = useState(true);
  const [filter, setFilter]     = useState("ALL");

  useEffect(() => {
    apiFetch<any[]>("/api/v1/landings")
      .then(setVariants)
      .catch(() => setVariants([]))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, []);

  const filtered =
    filter === "ALL"
      ? variants
      : variants.filter((v) => v.status === filter);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">Creatives & Variants</h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">
          Review and approve variants before launch
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="flex gap-2 flex-wrap">
        {STATUSES.map((s) => (
          <button
            key={s}
            onClick={() => setFilter(s)}
            className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium transition-colors ${
              filter === s
                ? "bg-indigo-600 text-white"
                : "bg-white border border-gray-200 text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-50"
            }`}
          >
            {s}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {loading ? (
        <p className="text-gray-400 text-sm">Loading...</p>
      ) : filtered.length === 0 ? (

      ) : (

              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-100">
              {filtered.map((v: any) => (
                <tr key={v.id} className="hover:bg-gray-50">
                  <td className="px-6 py-4">
                    <div className="font-medium text-gray-900">
                      {v.name ?? v.id}
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-xs text-gray-400">{v.id}</div>

}
```

```tsx
import StatCard from "@/components/admin/StatCard";
import StatusBadge from "@/components/admin/StatusBadge";

async function getCampaigns(): Promise<any[]> {
  const base =
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL ?? "http://platform-api:8080";
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${base}/api/v1/campaigns`, {
      cache: "no-store",
    });
    if (!res.ok) return [];
    return res.json();
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

export default async function DashboardPage() {
  const campaigns: any[] = await getCampaigns();

  const totalBudget = campaigns.reduce(
    (s: number, c: any) => s + (c.daily_budget ?? 0),
    0
  );
  const active = campaigns.filter((c: any) => c.status === "ACTIVE").length;
  const paused = campaigns.filter((c: any) => c.status === "PAUSED").length;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      <div>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">Dashboard</h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">Campaign overview</p>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-4">
        <StatCard label="Total Campaigns" value={campaigns.length} color="blue" />
        <StatCard label="Active"          value={active}           color="green" />
        <StatCard label="Paused"          value={paused}           color="yellow" />
        <StatCard
          label="Daily Budget"
          value={`$${totalBudget.toFixed(0)}`}
          color="gray"
        />
      </div>

      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 overflow-hidden">
        <div className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100">
          <h2 className="font-semibold text-gray-800">Campaigns</h2>
        </div>
        {campaigns.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="px-6 py-8 text-gray-400 text-sm">
            No campaigns yet. Connect Meta account to get started.
          </p>
        ) : (
          <table className="w-full text-sm">
            <thead className="bg-gray-50 text-gray-500 text-xs uppercase">
              <tr>
                <th className="px-6 py-3 text-left">Name</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-3 text-left">Status</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-3 text-left">Budget</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-3 text-left">Objective</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-3 text-left">Created</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-100">
              {campaigns.map((c: any) => (
                <tr key={c.id} className="hover:bg-gray-50">
                  <td className="px-6 py-4 font-medium text-gray-900">
                    {c.name}
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-6 py-4">
                    <StatusBadge status={c.status} />

                  <td className="px-6 py-4 text-gray-600">
                    ${c.daily_budget}

                  <td className="px-6 py-4 text-gray-500">{c.objective}</td>

                    {new Date(c.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

interface FunnelStage {
  stage_key: string;
  stage_label: string;
  ordinal: number;
  is_quality_key: boolean;
  reward_weight: number;
  micro_reward_weight: number;
  capi_event: string | null;
}

interface WeeklyCounter {
  stage_key: string;
  count_this_week: number;
  count_prev_week: number;
  delta_pct: number | null;
}

interface ChecklistItem {
  _summary?: { ready_to_launch: boolean; passed: number; total: number };
  key?: string;
  label?: string;
  passed?: boolean;
  detail?: string;
}

export default function FunnelAdminPage() {
  const [stages, setStages] = useState<FunnelStage[]>([]);
  const [counters, setCounters] = useState<WeeklyCounter[]>([]);
  const [checklist, setChecklist] = useState<ChecklistItem[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    Promise.all([
      fetch("/api/v1/funnel/me").then(r => r.json()),
      fetch("/api/v1/reward/ladder").then(r => r.json()),
      fetch("/api/v1/onboarding/checklist").then(r => r.json()),
    ])
      .then(([funnel, ladder, cl]) => {
        setStages(funnel.stages || []);
        setCounters(ladder.weekly_counters || []);
        setChecklist(cl || []);
        setLoading(false);
      })
      .catch(e => {
        setError(e.message);
        setLoading(false);
      });
  }, []);

  if (loading) return <div className="p-8 text-gray-400">Loading funnel…</div>;
  if (error)   return <div className="p-8 text-red-500">Error: {error}</div>;

  const summary = checklist.find(i => i._summary)?._summary;
  const checkItems = checklist.filter(i => !i._summary);

  return (
    <div className="p-8 max-w-5xl mx-auto space-y-8">
      <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">Funnel Configuration</h1>

      {/* Onboarding checklist */}
      {summary && (
        <div className={`rounded-lg p-4 border ${summary.ready_to_launch ? "bg-green-50 border-green-200" : "bg-yellow-50 border-yellow-200"}`}>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
            <h2 className="font-semibold text-sm uppercase tracking-wide text-gray-600">
              Onboarding Checklist
            </h2>
            <span className={`text-sm font-medium ${summary.ready_to_launch ? "text-green-700" : "text-yellow-700"}`}>
              {summary.passed}/{summary.total} ready
              {summary.ready_to_launch ? " ✓ Ready to launch" : ""}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
            {checkItems.map(item => (
              <div key={item.key} className="flex items-start gap-2 text-sm">
                <span className={item.passed ? "text-green-500" : "text-red-400"}>
                  {item.passed ? "✓" : "✗"}
                </span>
                <div>
                  <span className="font-medium">{item.label}</span>
                  <span className="text-gray-400 ml-1">— {item.detail}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Funnel ladder */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-lg shadow overflow-hidden">
        <div className="px-6 py-4 border-b bg-gray-50">
          <h2 className="font-semibold text-gray-700">Funnel Stages — Reward Ladder</h2>
          <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">Green rows = quality gate stages (drive Thompson Sampling)</p>
        </div>
        <table className="min-w-full divide-y divide-gray-200">
          <thead className="bg-gray-50">
            <tr>
              <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase">#</th>
              <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase">Stage</th>
              <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase">CAPI Event</th>
              <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase">Reward</th>
              <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase">This Week</th>
              <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase">Prev Week</th>
              <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase">Δ%</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody className="bg-white divide-y divide-gray-100">
            {stages.map(stage => {
              const counter = counters.find(c => c.stage_key === stage.stage_key);
              const delta = counter?.delta_pct;
              return (
                <tr key={stage.stage_key} className={stage.is_quality_key ? "bg-green-50" : ""}>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3 text-sm text-gray-400">{stage.ordinal}</td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3">
                    <div className="font-medium text-gray-900 text-sm">
                      {stage.stage_label || stage.stage_key}
                      {stage.is_quality_key && (
                        <span className="ml-2 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs bg-green-100 text-green-700 rounded">
                          quality
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-xs text-gray-400 font-mono">{stage.stage_key}</div>
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3 text-sm text-gray-600 font-mono">
                    {stage.capi_event || <span className="text-gray-300">—</span>}
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right text-sm">{stage.reward_weight}</td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right text-sm font-mono">
                    {counter?.count_this_week ?? <span className="text-gray-300">—</span>}
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right text-sm font-mono text-gray-400">
                    {counter?.count_prev_week ?? <span className="text-gray-300">—</span>}
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right text-sm">
                    {delta != null ? (
                      <span className={delta >= 0 ? "text-green-600" : "text-red-500"}>
                        {delta >= 0 ? "+" : ""}{delta.toFixed(1)}%
                      </span>
                    ) : <span className="text-gray-300">—</span>}
                  </td>
                </tr>
              );
            })}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      {/* CAPI event map summary */}
      {stages.some(s => s.capi_event) && (
        <div className="bg-gray-50 rounded-lg p-4">
          <h2 className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wide mb-3">CAPI Event Mapping</h2>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            {stages.filter(s => s.capi_event).map(s => (
              <span key={s.stage_key} className="px-3 py-1 bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded text-xs">
                <span className="text-gray-400 font-mono">{s.stage_key}</span>
                <span className="mx-1 text-gray-300">→</span>
                <span className="font-medium">{s.capi_event}</span>
              </span>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
async function fetchJson(path: string): Promise<any> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${API}${path}`, { cache: "no-store" });
    if (!res.ok) return null;
    return res.json();
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}
```

```tsx
"use client";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";

export default function SettingsPage() {
  const [email, setEmail]               = useState("");
  const [alertChannel, setAlertChannel] = useState("TELEGRAM");
  const [slackWebhook, setSlackWebhook] = useState("");
  const [saving, setSaving]             = useState(false);
  const [saved, setSaved]               = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading]           = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    apiFetch<any>("/api/v1/tenants/me/settings")
      .then((data) => {
        setEmail(data.report_email ?? "");
        setAlertChannel(data.alert_channel ?? "TELEGRAM");
        setSlackWebhook(data.slack_webhook_url ?? "");
      })
      .catch(() => {})
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, []);

  async function handleSave() {
    setSaving(true);
    setSaved(false);
    try {
      await apiFetch("/api/v1/tenants/me/settings", {
        method: "PATCH",
        body: JSON.stringify({
          report_email:      email,
          alert_channel:     alertChannel,
          slack_webhook_url: slackWebhook,
        }),
      });
      setSaved(true);
      setTimeout(() => setSaved(false), 3000);
    } catch {
      alert("Save failed");
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  }

  if (loading) return <p className="text-gray-400 text-sm p-8">Loading...</p>;

  return (
    <div className="max-w-xl space-y-6">
      <div>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">Settings</h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">Tenant configuration</p>
      </div>

      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 p-6 space-y-5">
        <h2 className="font-semibold text-gray-800">Notifications</h2>

        <div>
          <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">
            Weekly Report Email
          </label>
          <input
            type="email"
            value={email}
            onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="marketer@company.com"
            className="w-full border border-gray-200 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-400"
          />
        </div>

        <div>
          <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">
            Alert Channel
          </label>
          <select
            value={alertChannel}
            onChange={(e) => setAlertChannel(e.target.value)}
            className="w-full border border-gray-200 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-400"
          >
            <option value="TELEGRAM">Telegram</option>
            <option value="SLACK">Slack</option>
            <option value="BOTH">Both</option>
          </select>
        </div>

        {(alertChannel === "SLACK" || alertChannel === "BOTH") && (
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">
              Slack Webhook URL
            </label>
            <input
              type="url"
              value={slackWebhook}
              onChange={(e) => setSlackWebhook(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="https://hooks.slack.com/services/..."
              className="w-full border border-gray-200 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-400"
            />
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <button
            onClick={handleSave}
            disabled={saving}
            className="px-6 py-2 rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 text-white text-sm font-medium hover:bg-indigo-700 disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            {saving ? "Saving..." : "Save Settings"}
          </button>
          {saved && (
            <span className="text-green-600 text-sm">Saved!</span>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { cookies } from "next/headers";
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";
import LandingRenderer, { LandingBlock } from "@/components/LandingRenderer";

// Server-side: use internal Docker network URL if available (avoids loopback in containers)
const API_BASE =
  process.env.API_INTERNAL_URL ??
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL ??
  "http://localhost:8080/api/v1";

interface VariantData {
  id: string;
  tenantId: string;
  slug: string;
  name: string;
  blocks: string; // raw JSON string
}

async function fetchVariant(slug: string): Promise<VariantData | null> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/public/l/${slug}`, {
      next: { revalidate: 60 }, // ISR: revalidate every 60s
    });
    if (!res.ok) return null;
    return res.json();
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

interface PageProps {
  params: Promise<{ slug: string }>;
}

export default async function LandingPage({ params }: PageProps) {
  const { slug } = await params;
  const variant = await fetchVariant(slug);

  if (!variant) notFound();

  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  const sessionId =
    cookieStore.get("_sid")?.value ?? crypto.randomUUID();
  const variantId =
    cookieStore.get("_variant")?.value ?? variant.id;
  const decisionId =
    cookieStore.get("_decision")?.value ?? "";

  let parsedBlocks: LandingBlock[] = [];
  try {
    parsedBlocks = JSON.parse(variant.blocks ?? "[]");
  } catch {
    parsedBlocks = [];
  }

  return (
    <LandingRenderer
      blocks={parsedBlocks}
      tenantId={variant.tenantId}
      sessionId={sessionId}
      variantId={variantId}
      decisionId={decisionId}
    />
  );
}

export async function generateMetadata({ params }: PageProps) {
  const { slug } = await params;
  const variant = await fetchVariant(slug);
  return {
    title: variant?.name ?? "Landing Page",
    robots: "noindex", // landing pages should not be indexed by default
  };
}
```

```tsx
import type { Metadata } from "next";
import Script from "next/script";
import "./globals.css";
import CookieBanner from "@/components/CookieBanner";

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: "Marketing AI Platform",
  description: "AI-powered ad optimization",
};

const cookiebotDomainId = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_COOKIEBOT_DOMAIN_ID;

export default function RootLayout({
  children,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <html lang="en">
      <head>
        {/*
         * Cookiebot CMP (§12.1a).
         * Inject only when NEXT_PUBLIC_COOKIEBOT_DOMAIN_ID is configured.
         * blocking-mode="auto" pauses other scripts until consent is given.
         * When absent, our custom <CookieBanner> renders instead.
         */}
        {cookiebotDomainId && (
          <Script
            id="Cookiebot"
            src="https://consent.cookiebot.com/uc.js"
            data-cbid={cookiebotDomainId}
            data-blockingmode="auto"
            strategy="beforeInteractive"
          />
        )}
      </head>
      <body>
        {children}
        {/* Fallback banner shown when Cookiebot is not configured */}
        <CookieBanner />
      </body>
    </html>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";

interface BookingCalendarProps {
  calendarUrl: string;
  calendarId?: string;
  showTimezone?: boolean;
  onSlotSelected?: (slotAt: string, browserTz: string) => void;
}

export default function BookingCalendar({
  calendarUrl,
  showTimezone = true,
  onSlotSelected,
}: BookingCalendarProps) {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const tz = Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone;
  const calendarOpenFired = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handler = (e: MessageEvent) => {
      if (typeof e.data === "object" && e.data?.type === "slot_selected") {
        const slotAt = e.data.slot_at as string;
        setSelected(slotAt);
        onSlotSelected?.(slotAt, tz);
        fetch("/api/v1/events", {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            event_type: "SLOT_SELECTED",
            payload: { slot_at: slotAt, browser_tz: tz },
          }),
        }).catch(() => {});
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener("message", handler);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("message", handler);
  }, [tz, onSlotSelected]);

  return (
    <div className="booking-calendar-atom w-full">
      {showTimezone && (
        <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mb-2">Your timezone: {tz}</p>
      )}
      <iframe
        src={calendarUrl}
        className="w-full min-h-[600px] border-0 rounded-lg"
        title="Schedule a call"
        onLoad={() => {
          if (calendarOpenFired.current) return;
          calendarOpenFired.current = true;
          fetch("/api/v1/events", {
            method: "POST",
            headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
            body: JSON.stringify({
              event_type: "CALENDAR_OPEN",
              payload: { browser_tz: tz },
            }),
          }).catch(() => {});
        }}
      />
      {selected && (
        <p className="text-green-600 text-sm mt-2">
          Slot selected: {new Date(selected).toLocaleString()}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

export interface CTABlockData {
  heading: string;
  subheading?: string;
  cta_text: string;
  cta_url?: string;
  form_id?: string;
  urgency_text?: string;
  background_color?: string;
  text_color?: string;
}

interface Props {
  blockId: string;
  data: CTABlockData;
  onFormStart?: () => void;
  onFormSubmit?: (values: Record<string, string>) => void;
}

export default function CTABlock({ blockId, data, onFormStart, onFormSubmit }: Props) {
  const bg = data.background_color ?? "#1e40af";
  const color = data.text_color ?? "#ffffff";

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const form = e.currentTarget;
    const values: Record<string, string> = {};
    new FormData(form).forEach((v, k) => {
      values[k] = String(v);
    });
    onFormSubmit?.(values);
  };

  return (
    <section
      id={data.form_id ?? "form"}
      data-block-id={blockId}
      data-block-type="CTA"
      style={{ background: bg, color }}
      className="px-6 py-20 text-center"
    >
      <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-4">{data.heading}</h2>
        {data.subheading && (
          <p className="text-lg mb-8 opacity-80">{data.subheading}</p>
        )}
        {data.urgency_text && (
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold bg-yellow-400 text-yellow-900 inline-block px-3 py-1 rounded-full mb-6">
            ⏰ {data.urgency_text}
          </p>
        )}
        <form
          className="flex flex-col gap-4 max-w-md mx-auto"
          onSubmit={handleSubmit}
        >
          <input
            name="name"
            type="text"
            placeholder="Your name"
            required
            onFocus={onFormStart}
            className="px-4 py-3 rounded-xl text-gray-900 text-base border border-gray-300 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-400"
          />
          <input
            name="email"
            type="email"
            placeholder="Work email"
            required
            className="px-4 py-3 rounded-xl text-gray-900 text-base border border-gray-300 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-400"
          />
          <input
            name="phone"
            type="tel"
            placeholder="Phone (optional)"
            className="px-4 py-3 rounded-xl text-gray-900 text-base border border-gray-300 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-400"
          />
          <button
            type="submit"
            className="bg-white text-blue-700 font-bold text-lg px-8 py-4 rounded-xl shadow-lg hover:bg-gray-100 transition-colors"
          >
            {data.cta_text}
          </button>
```

## D:/Marketing-AI/frontend/src/components/CookieBanner.tsx

```tsx
"use client";
/**
 * Fallback consent banner (§12.1a).
 *
 * Shown when Cookiebot is NOT configured (NEXT_PUBLIC_COOKIEBOT_DOMAIN_ID absent).
 * When Cookiebot IS configured, this component renders nothing — Cookiebot's
 * auto-generated banner takes over via its script.
 *
 * Three choices map directly to our consent levels:
 *   "Accept All"     → "full"           (behavioral + marketing tracking)
 *   "Necessary Only" → "analytics_only" (conversions only)
 *   "Decline"        → "none"           (nothing tracked)
 */

import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { hasConsentDecision, setConsentLevel } from "@/lib/consent";

export default function CookieBanner() {
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Cookiebot is configured — its own banner handles consent
    if (process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_COOKIEBOT_DOMAIN_ID) return;
    if (!hasConsentDecision()) setVisible(true);
  }, []);

  if (!visible) return null;

  const accept = () => { setConsentLevel("full");           setVisible(false); };
  const necessary = () => { setConsentLevel("analytics_only"); setVisible(false); };
  const decline = () => { setConsentLevel("none");           setVisible(false); };

  return (
    <div className="fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 bg-gray-900 border-t border-gray-700
                    px-6 py-4 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4 shadow-lg">
      <p className="flex-1 min-w-[200px] text-sm text-gray-300">
        We use cookies to analyze site traffic and optimize your experience.
        <a
          href="/privacy"
          className="ml-1 underline text-indigo-400 hover:text-indigo-300"
        >
          Privacy Policy
        </a>
      </p>
      <div className="flex gap-2 flex-wrap">
        <button
          onClick={decline}
          className="px-4 py-2 text-sm border border-gray-500 rounded text-gray-300
                     hover:bg-gray-800 transition-colors"
        >
          Decline
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={necessary}
          className="px-4 py-2 text-sm border border-indigo-500 rounded text-indigo-300
                     hover:bg-indigo-900/30 transition-colors"
        >
          Necessary Only
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={accept}
          className="px-4 py-2 text-sm bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 rounded
                     text-white transition-colors"
        >
          Accept All
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Tracker } from "@/lib/tracker";
import HeroBlock, { HeroBlockData } from "./blocks/HeroBlock";
import ProblemBlock, { ProblemBlockData } from "./blocks/ProblemBlock";
import ProofBlock, { ProofBlockData } from "./blocks/ProofBlock";
import PricingBlock, { PricingBlockData } from "./blocks/PricingBlock";
import CTABlock, { CTABlockData } from "./blocks/CTABlock";
import FAQBlock, { FAQBlockData } from "./blocks/FAQBlock";
import BookingCalendar from "./blocks/BookingCalendar";
import AccreditationCheckbox from "./blocks/AccreditationCheckbox";
import TicketSelector from "./blocks/TicketSelector";
import Disclaimer506c from "./blocks/Disclaimer506c";
import SocialProofInvestors from "./blocks/SocialProofInvestors";

export interface LandingBlock {
  type:
    | "HERO" | "PROBLEM" | "PROOF" | "PRICING" | "CTA" | "FAQ"
    | "booking_calendar" | "accreditation_checkbox" | "ticket_selector"
    | "disclaimer_506c" | "social_proof_investors";
  id: string;
  data: Record<string, unknown>;
}

interface Props {
  blocks: LandingBlock[];
  tenantId: string;
  sessionId: string;
  variantId: string;
  decisionId: string;
}

const API_BASE = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL ?? "http://localhost:8080/api/v1";

export default function LandingRenderer({
  blocks,
  tenantId,
  sessionId,
  variantId,
  decisionId,
}: Props) {
  const trackerInit = useRef(false);
  const mainRef = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<Record<string, unknown>>({});

  useEffect(() => {
    if (trackerInit.current) return;
    trackerInit.current = true;
    Tracker.init(tenantId, sessionId);
  }, [tenantId, sessionId]);

  // Fire BLOCK_VIEW when a section scrolls into view (IntersectionObserver)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!mainRef.current) return;
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        entries.forEach((entry) => {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            const blockId = (entry.target as HTMLElement).dataset.blockId;
            if (blockId) {
              Tracker.track("BLOCK_VIEW", { block_id: blockId }, { blockEventId: blockId, variantId });
            }
            observer.unobserve(entry.target);
          }
        });
      },
      { threshold: 0.3 }
    );
    mainRef.current.querySelectorAll("[data-block-id]").forEach((el) => observer.observe(el));
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, [variantId]);

  const trackCta = () =>
    Tracker.track("CLICK", { element: "cta" }, { variantId });

  const trackFormStart = () =>
    Tracker.track("FORM_START", {}, { variantId });

  const trackFormSubmit = async (values: Record<string, string>) => {
    Tracker.track("FORM_SUBMIT", { fields: Object.keys(values) }, { variantId });
    try {
      await fetch(`${API_BASE}/public/reward`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ decisionId, rewardType: "FORM_SUBMIT" }),
        keepalive: true,
      });
    } catch {
      // Reward failure must never crash the landing page
    }
  };

  return (
    <main ref={mainRef}>
      {blocks.map((block) => {
        switch (block.type) {
          case "HERO":
            return (
              <HeroBlock
                key={block.id}
                blockId={block.id}
                data={block.data as HeroBlockData}
                onCta={trackCta}
              />
            );
          case "PROBLEM":
            return (
              <ProblemBlock
                key={block.id}
                blockId={block.id}
                data={block.data as ProblemBlockData}
              />
            );
          case "PROOF":
            return (
              <ProofBlock
                key={block.id}
                blockId={block.id}
                data={block.data as ProofBlockData}
              />
            );
          case "PRICING":
            return (
              <PricingBlock
                key={block.id}
                blockId={block.id}
                data={block.data as PricingBlockData}
                onCta={trackCta}
              />
            );
          case "CTA":
            return (
              <CTABlock
                key={block.id}
                blockId={block.id}
                data={block.data as CTABlockData}
                onFormStart={trackFormStart}
                onFormSubmit={trackFormSubmit}
              />
            );
          case "FAQ":
            return (
              <FAQBlock
                key={block.id}
                blockId={block.id}
                data={block.data as FAQBlockData}
              />
            );
          case "booking_calendar":
            return (
              <div key={block.id} data-block-id={block.id}>
                <BookingCalendar
                  calendarUrl={(block.data.calendar_url as string) ?? ""}
                  showTimezone={(block.data.show_timezone as boolean) ?? true}
                />
              </div>
            );
          case "accreditation_checkbox":
            return (
              <div key={block.id} data-block-id={block.id}>
                <AccreditationCheckbox
                  required={(block.data.required as boolean) ?? false}
                  labelText={block.data.label_text as string | undefined}
                  onChange={(checked) =>
                    setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, self_accredited: checked }))
                  }
                />
              </div>
            );
          case "ticket_selector":
            return (
              <div key={block.id} data-block-id={block.id}>
                <TicketSelector
                  label={block.data.label as string | undefined}
                  required={(block.data.required as boolean) ?? false}
                  onChange={(bucket) =>
                    setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, ticket_bucket: bucket }))
                  }
                />
              </div>
            );
          case "disclaimer_506c":
            return (
              <div key={block.id} data-block-id={block.id}>
                <Disclaimer506c
                  text={block.data.text as string | undefined}
                  version={block.data.version as string | undefined}
                />
              </div>
            );
          case "social_proof_investors":
            return (
              <div key={block.id} data-block-id={block.id}>
                <SocialProofInvestors
                  quotes={(block.data.quotes as Array<{ text: string; author?: string; amount?: string }>) ?? []}
                  showAmounts={(block.data.show_amounts as boolean) ?? false}
                />
              </div>
            );
          default:
            return null;
        }
      })}
    </main>
  );
}
```

```ts
const BASE = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL ?? "http://localhost:8080";

export async function apiFetch<T>(
  path: string,
  options?: RequestInit
): Promise<T> {
  const token =
    typeof window !== "undefined" ? localStorage.getItem("access_token") : null;

  const res = await fetch(`${BASE}${path}`, {
    ...options,
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      ...(token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}),
      ...(options?.headers ?? {}),
    },
  });

  if (res.status === 401) {
    const stored =
      typeof window !== "undefined"
        ? localStorage.getItem("refresh_token")
        : null;
    if (stored) {
      const refreshRes = await fetch(`${BASE}/api/v1/auth/refresh`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ refresh_token: stored }),
      });
      if (refreshRes.ok) {
        const data = await refreshRes.json();
        localStorage.setItem("access_token", data.access_token);
        localStorage.setItem("refresh_token", data.refresh_token);
        return apiFetch(path, options);
      }
    }
    throw new Error("Unauthorized");
  }

  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`API error ${res.status}`);

  return res.json() as Promise<T>;
}
```

## D:/Marketing-AI/frontend/src/lib/consent.ts

```ts
/**
 * CMP (Consent Management Platform) integration — §12.1a.
 *
 * Three consent levels used throughout the platform:
 *  "full"           — all tracking + behavioral + personalization
 *  "analytics_only" — conversion events only; no SCROLL/HOVER/BLOCK_VIEW
 *  "none"           — nothing tracked; no personalization
 *
 * Integration priority:
 *  1. Cookiebot (when NEXT_PUBLIC_COOKIEBOT_DOMAIN_ID is set and script loads)
 *  2. Custom banner (stores decision in localStorage key "mai_consent")
 *  3. Default: "none" until user decides
 *
 * Vision §12.1a: refusal ≠ bounce.
 * Sessions with consent="none" are excluded from Thompson Sampling training
 * but remain in the impression denominator — never treated as disinterested.
 */

export type ConsentLevel = "full" | "analytics_only" | "none";

const STORAGE_KEY = "mai_consent";

// Cookiebot injects this global when its script loads
declare global {
  interface Window {
    Cookiebot?: {
      consent: {
        necessary: boolean;
        preferences: boolean;
        statistics: boolean;
        marketing: boolean;
      };
      hasResponse: boolean;
    };
  }
}

/** Read current consent level. Safe to call server-side (returns "none"). */
export function getConsentLevel(): ConsentLevel {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return "none";

  // 1. Cookiebot integration
  const cb = window.Cookiebot;
  if (cb?.hasResponse) {
    if (cb.consent.statistics && cb.consent.marketing) return "full";
    if (cb.consent.statistics) return "analytics_only";
    return "none";
  }

  // 2. Custom banner fallback
  const stored = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) as ConsentLevel | null;
  if (stored === "full" || stored === "analytics_only" || stored === "none") {
    return stored;
  }

  // 3. Unset — conservative default
  return "none";
}

// arch v1.1 §5.2 + vision v1.9.9 §12.1a: consent must be readable by Edge middleware.
// localStorage is client-only; set a non-httpOnly cookie so middleware can check consent
// before passing session_id to /decide (before consent → Thompson with no persistent ID).
const CONSENT_COOKIE = "_consent";
const CONSENT_COOKIE_MAX_AGE = 60 * 60 * 24 * 365; // 1 year

/** Persist consent choice from our custom banner. */
export function setConsentLevel(level: ConsentLevel): void {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
  localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, level);
  document.cookie = `${CONSENT_COOKIE}=${level}; max-age=${CONSENT_COOKIE_MAX_AGE}; path=/; samesite=lax`;
  window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("mai:consent", { detail: level }));
}

/** True if the user has already made a consent decision (banner answered). */
export function hasConsentDecision(): boolean {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return false;
  if (window.Cookiebot?.hasResponse) return true;
  return localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) !== null;
}

/**
 * Subscribe to consent changes.
 * Covers both Cookiebot events and our custom banner events.
 * Returns an unsubscribe function.
 */
export function onConsentChange(handler: (level: ConsentLevel) => void): () => void {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return () => {};

  const fromCookiebot = () => handler(getConsentLevel());
  const fromCustom = (e: Event) =>
    handler((e as CustomEvent<ConsentLevel>).detail);

  window.addEventListener("CookiebotOnAccept", fromCookiebot);
  window.addEventListener("CookiebotOnDecline", fromCookiebot);
  window.addEventListener("mai:consent", fromCustom);

  return () => {
    window.removeEventListener("CookiebotOnAccept", fromCookiebot);
    window.removeEventListener("CookiebotOnDecline", fromCookiebot);
    window.removeEventListener("mai:consent", fromCustom);
  };
}
```

```ts
// reCAPTCHA Enterprise v3 wrapper (vision §12.6).
// Returns null silently when NEXT_PUBLIC_RECAPTCHA_SITE_KEY is not set (dev mode).
export async function getRecaptchaToken(action: string): Promise<string | null> {
  const key = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_RECAPTCHA_SITE_KEY;
  if (!key || typeof window === "undefined") return null;

  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const w = window as unknown as { grecaptcha?: { ready: (cb: () => void) => void; execute: (k: string, opts: { action: string }) => Promise<string> } };
    if (!w.grecaptcha) {
      resolve(null);
      return;
    }
    w.grecaptcha.ready(() => {
      w.grecaptcha!
        .execute(key, { action })
        .then(resolve)
        .catch(() => resolve(null));
    });
  });
}
```
